english.objectives: Return 10 Relics of Ulduar to Rork Sharpchin in Frosthold.
english.description: Why hello thar!$B$BBefore you be headin' off to do your grand questin' and adventure, might I beg a wee favor of ya, $G lad:lass;?$B$BThese mountains be packed full'a precious relics and baubles... this place be a dream come true for tha league. I'd be much obliged if ya could bring any such treasures you stumble upon back ta me. You can even share in me ale for tha trouble! Trust me $G lad:lass;, that's a rich deal!
english.progress: Did ya find some o' dem relics for me?
english.completion: Beaut! Yer a good one you are.$B$BTilt one back wi' me! Let us celebrae' this glorious find!
english.completed: Return to Rork Sharpchin at Frosthold in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 探险者协会的帮助
text.objectives: 将诺甘农之壳交给冰霜堡的拉格努斯。
text.description: 有意思。我没有在诺甘农之壳上发现任何锁定装置，也许仅仅是找到另一半钥石可能还不够。$B$B把诺甘农之壳交给冰霜堡的探险队长拉格努斯吧。只要他能克服自己对“泰坦造物”的敬畏之心，或许就能通过诺甘农之壳推测出它的核心部分应该是什么样子。没准他们还能说服冰霜矮人帮忙寻找它呢。$B$B我要去研究一下怎么把这两半东西拼合起来，等我们都有了进展之后再联络吧。
text.progress: Hello there!
text.completion: By Muradin's beard! Is that what I think it is?! Brann's really outdone himself this time... and you too for that matter! The boys back home are never going to believe this.
text.completed: Return to Lagnus at Frosthold in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: Aid from the Explorers' League
english.objectives: Take Norgannon's Shell to Lagnus at Frosthold.
english.description: Interesting. I don't see any locking mechanisms on the shell. That suggests to me that it may take more than just finding the other piece to combine the keystone.$B$BTake the shell back to the expedition leader, Lagnus, at Frosthold. Once he gets over his awe, he should be able to glean what the core looks like based on the shell, and maybe they can get the Frost Dwarves to help find it.$B$BI'm going to see if I can find out how to combine the two pieces. We'll catch up once we've both made some progress.
english.progress: Hello there!
english.completion: By Muradin's beard! Is that what I think it is?! Brann's really outdone himself this time... and you too for that matter! The boys back home are never going to believe this.
english.completed: Return to Lagnus at Frosthold in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 诺甘农之壳
text.objectives: 从档案员麦卡顿那里拿到诺甘农之壳。
text.description: 正在为创世者的圆盘充能。$B$B已完成充能。$B$B准备启动紧急协议：伽玛。$B$B紧急协议已加载。请使用已充能的圆盘激活诺甘农之壳的守护者，档案员麦卡顿。在确认了你的身份之后，档案员会交出诺甘农之壳。$B$B祝你愉快一千年。
text.progress: Well, don't just stand there, show me the shell!
text.completion: That's it! That's the first half of Norgannon's keystone. Well done, $n. When I get back to Ironforge, I'm going to have you inducted as an honorary member in the Explorers' League!
text.completed: Use Brann's Communicator to contact Brann Bronzebeard.$B$BIf you lose Brann's Communicator, speak to Archaeologist Andorin at Frosthold to replace it.

english.title: Norgannon's Shell
english.objectives: Recover Norgannon's Shell from Archivist Mechaton.
english.description: Charging inventor's disk.$B$BDisk charging completed.$B$BPreparing emergency protocol gamma.$B$BEmergency protocol loaded. Please use the charged disk to activate the guardian of Norgannon's shell, Archivist Mechaton. The archivist will release the shell once your identity has been verified.$B$BPlease have a pleasant millennium.
english.progress: Well, don't just stand there, show me the shell!
english.completion: That's it! That's the first half of Norgannon's keystone. Well done, $n. When I get back to Ironforge, I'm going to have you inducted as an honorary member in the Explorers' League!
english.completed: Use Brann's Communicator to contact Brann Bronzebeard.$B$BIf you lose Brann's Communicator, speak to Archaeologist Andorin at Frosthold to replace it.

starters.name: 创世者的图书馆控制台

text.title: 霜脉矮人之王
text.objectives: 与冰霜堡的约尔格·雷心谈一谈。
text.description: 嗯……我已经可以精确地描绘出核心部分的样子了。只要霜脉部族中的矮人见过它，他们就一定可以认出我所描述的东西。$B$B时间已经不多了，我们直接谈重点吧。你要去跟约尔格·雷心国王谈一谈，请求他的帮助……他一定知道谁能帮我们找到核心部分。哦，记得要对他表现出足够的尊重——他可是非常德高望重的领袖。
text.completion: Norgannon's Core? Never heard of it. I might well know someone that has though.

english.title: The Frostborn King
english.objectives: Speak to Yorg Stormheart in Frosthold.
english.description: Definitely... I can see exactly what the core must look like. If any of the frostborn have seen it, they'll be sure to recognize the description.$B$BThere's no time to waste, let's get straight to business. Go talk to King Stormheart and request his aid... he's sure to know someone who can help us find the core. And be nice about it will you - he's very respected around here.
english.completion: Norgannon's Core? Never heard of it. I might well know someone that has though.

text.title: 霜脉矮人的热情
text.objectives: 冰霜堡的约尔格·雷心要你去和弗亚林·霜眉谈一谈，从他那里获得一匹坐骑，并迎接挑战。
text.description: 我非常乐意为旅行者提供庇护所，但我不会强迫族人插手你们的事情。$B$B我跟你说啊……我的族人都是战士，性格非常直爽，而且很真诚。当一个霜脉矮人成长为男子汉的时候，他就必须通过战斗来证明自己。他必须向所有族人证明，他会在战场上勇往直前，毫不退缩。$B$B如果你能向我证明，你和我的族人一样强壮勇敢，那么我就允许他们帮助你。去和悬崖那边的弗亚林·霜眉谈一谈，他会为你安排试炼的。
text.progress: Ye've come back to me. Have ye come back to me victorious?
text.completion: Ha! Grand tale lad... perhaps ye have a bit of frostborn blood in ye, eh? Yer not just talk anyway, and that's what I needed to hear.
text.completed: Return to Yorg Stormheart at Frosthold in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: Fervor of the Frostborn
english.objectives: Yorg Stormheart at Frosthold has requested that you speak to Fjorlin Frostbrow to secure a ride and face your challenge.
english.description: I be more than willing ta lend my shelter and home ta travelers in need, but I'm nae too keen ta force my people inte yer affairs.$B$BI'll tell ye what... my people are warriors, straight and true. On the day a frostborn becomes a man, he has ta prove himself in battle. He has ta show us that he'll not let size hold'm back.$B$BShow me yer as strong and fierce as one of my men, and I'll have them lend ye an ear or a blade. Speak ta Fjorlin over by the cliff to the south there and he'll put ye ta the test.
english.progress: Ye've come back to me. Have ye come back to me victorious?
english.completion: Ha! Grand tale lad... perhaps ye have a bit of frostborn blood in ye, eh? Yer not just talk anyway, and that's what I needed to hear.
english.completed: Return to Yorg Stormheart at Frosthold in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 经验丰富的向导
text.objectives: 找到德鲁姆·霜握。
text.description: 我不知道这个核心藏在哪里，这你应该早就预料到了。不过我说了会帮忙，就一定会帮忙。$B$B北边的一处山洞里有一位名叫德鲁姆·霜握的隐士……就在山谷里面。我们的生活方式早已与泰坦没有太多联系了，保留下来的有关知识也很少。但是德鲁姆仍然过着传统的生活……他一直在关注着一些重要的泰坦遗迹，还经常和守护者克莱特乌斯谈话。$B$B你可以在他的山洞里面找到他……告诉他是我让你去的，他肯定会向你伸出援手。
text.completion: <Drom coughts up a bit of blood.>$b$bNorgannon's Core, eh? I've spent a fair number of days trying to find anything I could about it myself, but it seems to be one of the relics that's still guarded. With reason I suppose.$b$bIf King Stormheart sent you, he surely must see something noble in ye... and I'm not one to refuse my king.

english.title: An Experienced Guide
english.objectives: Locate Drom Frostgrip.
english.description: I don't know where this core is hiding, but ye knew that. I said I'd help though, and that I shall.$B$BThere's a hermit by the name of Drom Frostgrip who lives in a cave north of here... down in tha valley. We've strayed away from the titans a bit ourselves being that there are so few about, but Drom's loyal to the old ways... he keeps an eye on their most precious places and speaks te the keeper Creteus often.$B$BYer sure to find him in the back of his cave... tell'm I sent ye and he'll help ye.
english.completion: <Drom coughts up a bit of blood.>$b$bNorgannon's Core, eh? I've spent a fair number of days trying to find anything I could about it myself, but it seems to be one of the relics that's still guarded. With reason I suppose.$b$bIf King Stormheart sent you, he surely must see something noble in ye... and I'm not one to refuse my king.

text.title: 不速之客
text.objectives: 冰霜堡的弗亚林·霜眉要你杀死10个雷铸铁矮人入侵者。
text.description: 我们的斥候在北边的山谷里发现了铁矮人。听说国王陛下让你去拜访德鲁姆，我有点担心他的安全。$B$B如果你在路上碰到铁矮人，能帮我干掉他们吗？我想他们还不知道我们的具体位置，以及抵达这里的路线，而我希望这种情况能继续保持下去。
text.progress: Were the scouts right? Were there dwarves down there?
text.completion: Grim news, lad. Those Iron Dwarves seem to be increasing in numbers... we've been seeing them all over the mountains. I smell war coming.$b$bThank you for dealing with this bunch... a little more time bought.
text.completed: Return to Fjorlin Frostbrow at Frosthold in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: Unwelcome Guests
english.objectives: Fjorlin Frostbrow at Frosthold wants you to kill 10 Stormforged Invaders.
english.description: Our scouts have spotted iron dwarves in the valley north of here. I overheard King Stormheart sending you to visit Drom and I'm admittedly a bit worried about'm.$B$BIf you find any iron dwarves when you head down there, put'm down hard and fast for me, eh? I dun think they know exactly where we are or how to get here just yet, and I'd prefer to keep it that way.
english.progress: Were the scouts right? Were there dwarves down there?
english.completion: Grim news, lad. Those Iron Dwarves seem to be increasing in numbers... we've been seeing them all over the mountains. I smell war coming.$b$bThank you for dealing with this bunch... a little more time bought.
english.completed: Return to Fjorlin Frostbrow at Frosthold in The Storm Peaks.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死雷铸铁矮人入侵者

text.title: 孤独的守护者
text.objectives: 从一个铁矮人监督者手中夺回德鲁姆·霜握的徽记之戒，并把它交给山底平原的克莱特乌斯。
text.description: 我从来没找到过核心……但我经常和守护者克莱特乌斯谈话，他曾因为疏忽透露了一些信息给我。你可以在山底平原东部的山上找到克莱特乌斯，他一直在守护着造物者引擎。核心可能就在那里，但你必须获得克莱特乌斯的支持。$B$B铁矮人正在这一带寻找某些东西……可能就是在找核心。他们拿走了我的戒指，去找到他们的首领，拿回戒指。只要把戒指拿给克莱特乌斯看，他就会知道是我让你去的。
text.progress: Hello, $r.$b$bI am pleased that you have opted to utilize your tongue over your blade when making my acquaintance. I have found that a more and more rare quality among your kind of late.
text.completion: Drom's ring? I am to assume Drom is not well if he did not introduce you directly. I am sorry to hear of that. Drom is a noble dwarf, if an inquisitive one.$b$bOn what business have you come then?
text.completed: Return to Creteus at The Foot Steppes in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: The Lonesome Watcher
english.objectives: Recover Frostgrip's Signet Ring from an Iron Dwarf Monitor and then bring it to Creteus in the Foot Steppes.
english.description: I never found the core... but I've often spoken to the keeper Creteus, and his omissions give him away. You'll find Creteus over the mountains to the east, in the Foot Steppes, keeping watch on the Engine of the Makers. The core might well be in there, but you'll need to win Creteus's favor.$B$BThe iron dwarves were here looking for something... it might well be the core. They took my ring. Find their leader, get the ring back, and show it to Creteus so that he knows I sent you.
english.progress: Hello, $r.$b$bI am pleased that you have opted to utilize your tongue over your blade when making my acquaintance. I have found that a more and more rare quality among your kind of late.
english.completion: Drom's ring? I am to assume Drom is not well if he did not introduce you directly. I am sorry to hear of that. Drom is a noble dwarf, if an inquisitive one.$b$bOn what business have you come then?
english.completed: Return to Creteus at The Foot Steppes in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 隐藏的圣物
text.objectives: 山底平原的克莱特乌斯已经把诺甘农之核的位置告诉了你。
text.description: 你不在的时候，我有幸和矮人布莱恩·铜须交谈过。这位矮人展示了他找到钥石的决心，他的动机符合获得钥石的条件，这一点令我非常高兴……我相信钥石就是为他而生的。$B$B诺甘农之核就在东南方的严寒墓穴里。古代的冰雪生物守卫着那里，它们肯定不会对你笑脸相迎。带着我的祝福去击败那些守卫，取得钥石吧，$r。
text.completion: <As the chest opens, air rushes out into the chamber, carrying with it the musty smell of something that has been here for countless years. Norgannon's Core rests in the bottom of the chest, undisturbed by the ages.>

english.title: The Hidden Relic
english.objectives: Creteus in the Foot Steppes has provided you with the information to locate Norgannon's Core.
english.description: During your absence, I was privileged enough to parley with the dwarf Brann Bronzebeard. This dwarf indicated his purpose for seeking the keystone, and I am satisfied that it is for satisfactory intent... I believe this dwarf may be the entity for which the keystone was created.$B$BNorgannon's Core is located in the Frigid Tomb to the southeast. Its guardians are ancient beings of ice, and they will not welcome your presence. Best these guardians and retrieve the keystone with my blessing, $r.
english.completion: <As the chest opens, air rushes out into the chamber, carrying with it the musty smell of something that has been here for countless years. Norgannon's Core rests in the bottom of the chest, undisturbed by the ages.>

text.title: 霜脉国王之怒
text.objectives: 将诺甘农之核交给山底平原的克莱特乌斯。
text.description: <当你从箱子里取出诺甘农之核时，你听到从走廊里传来了沉重的脚步声，正在一步步向你逼近。远处则隐隐传来战斗的声音。>
text.progress: Someone is using the Forge of Wills to create this army... Ulduar is no longer safe. $R, did you recover the core?
text.completion: Someone is using the Forge of Wills to create this army... Ulduar is no longer safe.$b$b$r, I am pleased that you were able to reach the core before these abominations were.
text.completed: Return to Creteus at The Foot Steppes in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: Fury of the Frostborn King
english.objectives: Bring Norgannon's Core back to Creteus in the Foot Steppes.
english.description: <As you retrieve the core from the chest, you hear the thumping of heavy footsteps rushing towards you from the corridor. There is the faint sound of battle in the distance.>
english.progress: Someone is using the Forge of Wills to create this army... Ulduar is no longer safe. $R, did you recover the core?
english.completion: Someone is using the Forge of Wills to create this army... Ulduar is no longer safe.$b$b$r, I am pleased that you were able to reach the core before these abominations were.
english.completed: Return to Creteus at The Foot Steppes in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 探险大师
text.objectives: 将诺甘农之核交给造物者引擎里的布莱恩·铜须。
text.description: 组合钥石需要用到诺甘农的拼合器……这个装置就在造物者引擎里，也就是我们旁边这个大坑。布莱恩已经带着另一半钥石到下面去了，我已经把使用这个装置的方法都告诉了他。他正在等着你。$B$B我会尽量拖住那些铁矮人，但恐怕不能阻挡他们太久。约尔格·雷心国王很快就要带着他的一部分属下回去防守冰霜堡了，你要快一点，$r。
text.progress: Hey there, $glad:lass;! Good to meet ya in person. Did you find it?
text.completion: You're brilliant, lad! Brilliant! This will be a glorious day indeed.$b$bQuickly, hand me the core before those iron dwarves make their way down here.
text.completed: Return to Brann Bronzebeard at the Engine of the Makers in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: The Master Explorer
english.objectives: Bring Norgannon's Core to Brann Bronzebeard in the Engine of the Makers.
english.description: Combining the keystone will require Norgannon's Binding - a device located in the Engine of the Makers, the large pit beside us. Brann should be down there with the other half of the keystone now. I have instructed him on the use of the device. He awaits your presence.$B$BI will do what I can to keep the iron dwarves occupied, but I do not have confidence that I will hold them for long. King Stormheart is returning to the defense of Frosthold with some of his men shortly. Please hurry, $r.
english.progress: Hey there, $glad:lass;! Good to meet ya in person. Did you find it?
english.completion: You're brilliant, lad! Brilliant! This will be a glorious day indeed.$b$bQuickly, hand me the core before those iron dwarves make their way down here.
english.completed: Return to Brann Bronzebeard at the Engine of the Makers in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 远古的圣物
text.objectives: 将10件奥杜尔的圣物交给格罗玛什坠毁点的奥鲁特·埃雷古。
text.description: 欢迎来到风暴峭壁。$B$B在你动身踏上伟大的冒险旅程之前，我有一个简单的请求。奥杜尔的古老圣物和宝藏散布在这一带的群山之中，似乎大部分都在各个智慧种族的手中。$B$B把你找到的圣物交给我，我会好好奖励你的。或许我还会和你分享最棒的麦酒呢。
text.progress: Were you able to find the relics of which I spoke?
text.completion: These will do nicely! I am much obliged. Perhaps a drink for your troubles?
text.completed: Return to Olut Alegut at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: Ancient Relics
english.objectives: Return 10 Relics of Ulduar to Olut Alegut at the Grom'arsh Crash-site.
english.description: Welcome to the peaks.$B$BI have a simple request before you head off on whatever grand jaunt you have planned. There are relics and treasures of ancient Ulduar scattered through these mountains. Most are likely in possession of the various sentient races.$B$BReturn any that you find to me, and I will reward you in kind. Perhaps I'll even let you partake on my many potent ales.
english.progress: Were you able to find the relics of which I spoke?
english.completion: These will do nicely! I am much obliged. Perhaps a drink for your troubles?
english.completed: Return to Olut Alegut at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 达库鲁的命令
text.objectives: 将达库鲁的命令交给祖达克圣光据点的北伐军领主兰迪加。
text.description: 小的们，听从主人的号令！巫妖王派我来全权管理祖达克的天灾部队。我们要做的就是消灭一切。$B$B消灭一切！！！$B$B我们正在死亡旷野对所有的尸体进行处理，然后把它们派去泽尔拉玛斯的纳瓦留斯王子手下，加强天灾军团的实力。在达库鲁的管理下，什么都不会浪费的！$B$B很快我们就将变得前所未有的强大！不久之后，祖达克和古达克就将属于天灾军团！
text.progress: Drakuru, eh? I've heard the name before...
text.completion: If this is the same Drakuru from Drak'Tharon Keep we are going to need... outside assistance.$B$BDeath knights of Acherus are stationed nearby, undoubtedly following the same trail of Scourge destruction that lead the Argent Crusade here. As half of our army is tied up at the Argent Stand, battling crazed Drakkari trolls, we will have to join forces with the Knights of the Ebon Blade.$B$B<Lantinga mutters under his breath.>$B$BI was hoping I'd never have to see those scoundrels again after Light's Hope...
text.completed: Return to Crusader Lord Lantinga at Light's Breach in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Orders From Drakuru
english.objectives: Return the Orders From Drakuru to Crusader Lord Lantinga at Light's Breach in Zul'Drak.
english.description: Minions be hearin' da call of your masta! Da Lich King be givin' Drakuru full control of da armies of da Scourge in Zul'Drak. We be commanded ta kill everyting.$B$BEVERYTING MUST DIE!$B$BWe be processin' all da corpses in da Dead Fields and sendin' em up ta Prince Navarius' crew in  Zeramas for Scourgin'! Notin' goes ta waste on Drakuru's watch!$B$BSoon we be drinkin' da blood of da prophets ta become stronger dan eva before! Zul'Drak and Gundrak gonna fall to da Scourge!
english.progress: Drakuru, eh? I've heard the name before...
english.completion: If this is the same Drakuru from Drak'Tharon Keep we are going to need... outside assistance.$B$BDeath knights of Acherus are stationed nearby, undoubtedly following the same trail of Scourge destruction that lead the Argent Crusade here. As half of our army is tied up at the Argent Stand, battling crazed Drakkari trolls, we will have to join forces with the Knights of the Ebon Blade.$B$B<Lantinga mutters under his breath.>$B$BI was hoping I'd never have to see those scoundrels again after Light's Hope...
english.completed: Return to Crusader Lord Lantinga at Light's Breach in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 黑锋哨站
text.objectives: 将达库鲁的命令交给祖达克黑锋哨站的斯特凡·瓦杜。
text.description: 这里的西面，穿过荒废的道路和建筑之后，就是死亡骑士的营地——黑锋哨站。$B$B<北伐军领主兰迪加卷起达库鲁的命令。>$B$B把这些命令交给斯特凡·瓦杜，他是黑锋哨站死亡骑士的指挥官。告诉他，银色北伐军会对付纳瓦留斯王子，他们要做的就是解决达库鲁。$B$B对了，多加小心，$n。前往黑锋哨站的路上到处都是天灾军团。
text.progress: What have you got there, $r?
text.completion: <Stefan reads the missive, then crumples it up and tosses it into the fire.>$B$BOld news. The Argent Crusade is - once again - late to the party. We've been tracking Drakuru since Grizzly Hills. He is slated for eradication.
text.completed: Report to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

english.title: The Ebon Watch
english.objectives: Deliver the Orders From Drakuru to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.
english.description: West of here, across the ruined roads and structures, is the death knight encampment of Ebon Watch.$B$B<Crusader Lord Lantinga rolls up Drakuru's orders.>$B$BTake these orders and deliver them to Stefan Vadu. He is the death knight in command at Ebon Watch. Let him know that the Argent Crusade will deal with Prince Navarius. They'll have to handle Drakuru.$B$BBe careful, $n. The way to Ebon Watch is teeming with Scourge.
english.progress: What have you got there, $r?
english.completion: <Stefan reads the missive, then crumples it up and tosses it into the fire.>$B$BOld news. The Argent Crusade is - once again - late to the party. We've been tracking Drakuru since Grizzly Hills. He is slated for eradication.
english.completed: Report to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 奥杜尔的流亡者
text.objectives: 与布德克拉格庇护所的塑石者布德克拉格谈一谈。
text.description: 风暴峭壁是个充满吸引力的地方，这里不仅仅只有泰坦遗迹。居住在这里的人民遭受着由洛肯和他的部下带来的巨大威胁。$B$B他派出了他的亲信——铁矮人，残忍地向所有的岩石生物发动进攻。他把土灵赶出了奥杜尔，迫使他们只能在创世者的图书馆西面的山上避难，也就是那处被称为布德克拉格庇护所的地方。布德克拉格和他的同胞被铁矮人围困在那里。去找到他们，帮助他们，$n。
text.completion: So you know Brann Bronzebeard, then? He is our closest ally among those of the flesh. We are as brothers in the struggle against Loken and his followers, in the struggle for Ulduar.

english.title: The Exiles of Ulduar
english.objectives: Speak with Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.
english.description: The Storm Peaks are an intriguing place, but there's far more here than titan ruins. The peoples who live here face a dire threat in Loken and his minions.$B$BHe sent his favorite servants, the iron dwarves, on a brutal campaign against all the creatures of stone. He expelled the earthen from Ulduar, forcing them to take shelter at Bouldercrag's Refuge, on the face of a mountain west of the Inventor's Library. Bouldercrag and his brethren are beset by the iron dwarves there. Find and help them, $n.
english.completion: So you know Brann Bronzebeard, then? He is our closest ally among those of the flesh. We are as brothers in the struggle against Loken and his followers, in the struggle for Ulduar.

text.title: 驭龙赛
text.objectives: 使用海德尼尔鱼叉，在风暴神殿击败10名海德比武会龙骑士。
text.description: 时机已经成熟。你通过了海德比武会的绝大多数试炼……如今只剩下最后一项。在过去的战斗中，你逐渐跻身最强大最凶残的女武士之列。$B$B最后的试炼即将开始——驭龙赛，海德比武会的价值与尚武精神的完美体现。我要你骑上幼龙，使用鱼叉击败所有竞争者。$B$B不要仁慈。没有谁会对你手下留情的。
text.progress: Begone!
text.completion: Sif... is that you?
text.completed: Use the Hyldnir Harpoon on a Column Ornament to exit the Drakkensryd.  Return to Thorim at the Temple of Storms in the Storm Peaks.

english.title: The Drakkensryd
english.objectives: Use the Hyldnir Harpoon to defeat 10 Hyldsmeet Drakeriders at the Temple of Storms.
english.description: This is it.  You've passed all the tests of the Hyldsmeet... all but one.  You've risen among our sisters' best and fiercest.$B$BThe final test is at hand.  The Drakkensryd - the true test of a Hyldnir's worth and warrior spirit.  It'll be you, your riding drake, a chained harpoon and a score of your sisters vying for dominance.$B$BShow no quarter.  None will be expected.
english.progress: Begone!
english.completion: Sif... is that you?
english.completed: Use the Hyldnir Harpoon on a Column Ornament to exit the Drakkensryd.  Return to Thorim at the Temple of Storms in the Storm Peaks.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败海德比武会龙骑士

text.title: 乐趣十足
text.objectives: 摧毁魔眼，然后向暗影拱顶的斯利文男爵报告。
text.description: 黑锋骑士团希望能够占领西北方的天灾基地——暗影拱顶。我在他们的组织里有一个线人，他需要我们的帮助。$B$B巫妖王利用一种被称为“魔眼”的设备监视着整个区域，魔眼就飘浮在拱顶的尖塔上。如果我们想要有所进展的话，就必须先把魔眼除掉。$B$B我们的矮人制造了一种可以对付它的东西。等那只眼睛被摧毁之后，去拱顶寻找斯利文男爵。他在那里假装继续为巫妖王效力。
text.progress: The Ocular still stands! Thassarian was a fool to trust you.$B$BWhoever you are, don't return again until it is destroyed. My position here must not be compromised!
text.completion: Perhaps now we can really get something done. Don't be fooled though, the Lich King can still 'see' through his Scourge minions.$b$bThat's why you're here.
text.completed: Return to Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

english.title: It's All Fun and Games
english.objectives: Destroy The Ocular and then report to Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault.
english.description: The Knights of the Ebon Blade want to take the Scourge base known as The Shadow Vault to the northwest. I have a contact in their group who has asked for help.$B$BThe first step is to blind the Lich King. He's using a device known as The Ocular to watch the area, which floats above the vault's spires.$B$BOur dwarves have created something for you to use against it. After the 'eye' has been destroyed, find Baron Sliver on the vault grounds. He's pretending to still be under the Lich King's will.
english.progress: The Ocular still stands! Thassarian was a fool to trust you.$B$BWhoever you are, don't return again until it is destroyed. My position here must not be compromised!
english.completion: Perhaps now we can really get something done. Don't be fooled though, the Lich King can still 'see' through his Scourge minions.$b$bThat's why you're here.
english.completed: Return to Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

text.title: E型检修员
text.objectives: 将E型检修员控制卡、4份钴螺丝和5份超载电容器交给创世者的图书馆中的E型检修员。
text.description: 这张卡片可以让使用者进入名为“E型检修员”的机器人的控制面板，对机器人进行维护或重新编写机器人的指令。$B$BE型检修员似乎被指派进入创世者的图书馆内部工作。这张卡片上列出了已损坏的部件和瘫痪的系统，只要有合适的零件，机器人就能恢复到正常的工作状态。
text.progress: <You open SCRAP-E's access panel.>
text.completion: <You begin performing the repairs indicated by the access card. When the repairs are complete, you close the access panel and throw the power switch.>
text.completed: Return to SCRAP-E at the Inventor's Library in the Storm Peaks.

english.title: SCRAP-E
english.objectives: Bring the SCRAP-E Access Card along with 4 Handfuls of Cobalt Bolts and 5 Overcharged Capacitors to SCRAP-E at The Inventor's Library.
english.description: This card allows the user to access the control panel of the scrapbot designated SCRAP-E, in order to perform maintenance and reprogram the bot's directives.$B$BSCRAP-E appears to be assigned to the interior of the building at The Inventor's Library. The card displays a list of the bot's broken components and failing systems. With the proper parts, the bot can be restored to working condition.
english.progress: <You open SCRAP-E's access panel.>
english.completion: <You begin performing the repairs indicated by the access card. When the repairs are complete, you close the access panel and throw the power switch.>
english.completed: Return to SCRAP-E at the Inventor's Library in the Storm Peaks.

text.title: 原型机控制台
text.objectives: 使用创世者的图书馆中的原型机控制台。
text.description: 名称：E型检修员。$B$B任务：在守护者米米尔离开时维护创世者的图书馆中的控制台和数据库。$B$B距离上一次维护时间：489天。$B$B结构图资料状态：未知。$B$B当前任务：修理原型机控制台。
text.completion: You examine the display on the repaired prototype console. At least one of Mimir's schematics seems to have survived the long period between maintenance cycles. From the diagrams and instructions displayed in the schematic's file, you could easily construct the mechagnome shown.

english.title: The Prototype Console
english.objectives: Interact with the Prototype Console in The Inventor's Library.
english.description: Designation SCRAP-E.$B$BDirective: Maintain consoles and databases of Inventor's Library in Keeper Mimir's absences.$B$BTime since last maintenance cycle: 489 days.$B$BStatus of schematic data: unknown.$B$BCurrent tasks: Repair prototype console.
english.completion: You examine the display on the repaired prototype console. At least one of Mimir's schematics seems to have survived the long period between maintenance cycles. From the diagrams and instructions displayed in the schematic's file, you could easily construct the mechagnome shown.

text.title: 我有一计……
text.objectives: 暗影拱顶的斯利文男爵要求你去收集一根教徒的魔棒、一根憎恶的弯钩、一条恶鬼的绳子和5份天灾精华。
text.description: 在我为巫妖王——啊咳——效力的时候，我们经常使用一种“统治魔棒”控制一些比较聪明的天灾成员。$B$B我要你帮忙制作一根新的统治魔棒。$B$B你很幸运，所需的材料都在附近：一根教徒的魔棒、一根憎恶的弯钩、一条恶鬼的绳子，外加一些天灾精华。$B$B这应该不难，$c。
text.progress: When you've managed to acquire that which I have asked of you, I will fashion the device, with a few modifications for our purposes, and we'll be on with our business.
text.completion: Quickly, hand them to me and stay out of sight!$B$BThe rod, the hook, and the rope are all very self-evident in their usage when combined. I just need to infuse the result with the essences and we'll be ready to proceed.$B$BIt's all very mundane in its composition, but extraordinary in its application!
text.completed: Return to Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

english.title: I Have an Idea, But First...
english.objectives: Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault has asked you to collect a Cultist Rod, an Abomination Hook, a Geist Rope, and 5 Scourge Essences.
english.description: When I was in the - ahem - employ of the Lich King, we would often use a device known as a sovereign rod to keep some of the more intelligent Scourge in line.$B$BI require that you assist me in the construction of a new one.$B$BLuckily for you, all of the necessary components are at hand: a cultist rod, an abomination hook, a geist rope, and a handful of Scourge essences.$B$BThis should not be difficult, $c.
english.progress: When you've managed to acquire that which I have asked of you, I will fashion the device, with a few modifications for our purposes, and we'll be on with our business.
english.completion: Quickly, hand them to me and stay out of sight!$B$BThe rod, the hook, and the rope are all very self-evident in their usage when combined. I just need to infuse the result with the essences and we'll be ready to proceed.$B$BIt's all very mundane in its composition, but extraordinary in its application!
english.completed: Return to Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

text.title: 乐趣十足
text.objectives: 摧毁魔眼，然后向暗影拱顶的斯利文男爵报告。
text.description: 黑锋骑士团希望能够占领西北方的天灾基地——暗影拱顶。我在他们的组织里有一个线人，他需要我们的帮助。$B$B巫妖王利用一种被称为“魔眼”的设备监视着整个区域，魔眼就飘浮在拱顶的尖塔上。如果我们想要有所进展的话，就必须先把魔眼除掉。$B$B我们的地精制造了一种可以对付它的东西。等那只眼睛被摧毁之后，去拱顶寻找斯利文男爵。他在那里假装继续为巫妖王效力。
text.progress: The Ocular still stands! Koltira was a fool to trust you.$B$BWhoever you are, don't return again until it is destroyed. My position here must not be compromised!
text.completion: Perhaps now we can really get something done. Don't be fooled though, the Lich King can still 'see' through his Scourge minions.$B$BThat's why you're here.
text.completed: Return to Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault in Icecrown.
