english.objectives: Destroy The Ocular and then report to Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault.
english.description: The Knights of the Ebon Blade want to take the Scourge base known as The Shadow Vault to the northwest. I have a contact in their group who has asked for help.$B$BThe first step is to blind the Lich King. He's using a device known as The Ocular to watch the area, which floats above the vault's spires.$B$BOur goblins have created something for you to use against it. After the 'eye' has been destroyed, find Baron Sliver on the vault grounds. He's pretending to still be under the Lich King's will.
english.progress: The Ocular still stands! Koltira was a fool to trust you.$B$BWhoever you are, don't return again until it is destroyed. My position here must not be compromised!
english.completion: Perhaps now we can really get something done. Don't be fooled though, the Lich King can still 'see' through his Scourge minions.$B$BThat's why you're here.
english.completed: Return to Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

text.title: 解放你的思想
text.objectives: 暗影拱顶的斯利文男爵希望你在劣尸维尔、奈丝伍德夫人和跳跃者的尸体上使用统治魔棒。
text.description: 如果劣尸维尔、奈丝伍德夫人和跳跃者可以摆脱巫妖王的控制，就将成为我们对抗巫妖王的得力助手。这就是统治魔棒的用途所在了。$B$B你可以在拱顶东面和西面的平台上，以及我们上方的拱顶中层找到它们。在它们的尸体上使用统治魔棒就行了。$B$B出发吧，这些天灾军团的成员很快就是我们的人了！
text.progress: You have NOT turned them yet. Do not insult my intelligence, $c!
text.completion: We will put those three to good use once we finally take the vault.$B$BSpeaking of which....
text.completed: Return to Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

english.title: Free Your Mind
english.objectives: Baron Sliver at the Shadow Vault wants you to use the Sovereign Rod on the corpses of Vile, Lady Nightswood, and The Leaper.
english.description: Vile, Lady Nightswood, and The Leaper would make excellent weapons in the fight against the Lich King if they can be broken from his will. That is what the Sovereign Rod is for.$B$BYou'll find them on the ledges to the east and west of the vault, as well as on the mid-tier of the vault above us. The rod is to be used upon the corpses of the three.$B$BFly now. We will have them as our own!
english.progress: You have NOT turned them yet. Do not insult my intelligence, $c!
english.completion: We will put those three to good use once we finally take the vault.$B$BSpeaking of which....
english.completed: Return to Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

text.title: 北伐军前线营地
text.objectives: 在祖达克的北伐军前线营地寻找北伐军战士马克拉尔。
text.description: 几天前，北伐军战士达加斯、马克拉尔、工程师里德、双胞胎戈尔克和布尔被派往死亡旷野建立前沿阵地。我最后一次同他们通信时，他们已经在西北方死亡旷野的边界上建立起了一座营地。$B$B根据这份新近发现的与达库鲁和纳瓦留斯王子相关的情报来看，我想我们必须马上派人前往北伐军前线营地。$B$B做好准备，$n。现在就出发！
text.completion: Everything was fine until the Scourge attacked. They took off with Dargath, Gerk and Burr and they also destroyed our ride. Guess who led that attack?$B$B<MacKellar nods.>$B$BNavarius...$B$BSeems this whole area is some type of factory for Scourge. We're in the middle of a damned undead mine field!

english.title: Crusader Forward Camp
english.objectives: Seek out Crusader MacKellar at the Crusader Forward Camp in Zul'Drak.
english.description: Crusader Dargath, Crusader MacKellar, Engineer Reed and the twins, Gerk and Burr, were sent to the Dead Fields to establish a battle front days ago. As of my last correspondence with them, they had successfully established a camp on the border of the Dead Fields, northwest of here.$B$BIn light of this newfound information about Drakuru and Prince Navarius I think it would be prudent to send someone to the Crusader Forward Camp post-haste.$B$BPack up your belongings, $n. You must leave at once!
english.completion: Everything was fine until the Scourge attacked. They took off with Dargath, Gerk and Burr and they also destroyed our ride. Guess who led that attack?$B$B<MacKellar nods.>$B$BNavarius...$B$BSeems this whole area is some type of factory for Scourge. We're in the middle of a damned undead mine field!

text.title: 失踪的布莱恩·铜须
text.objectives: 在布莱恩的营地中找到用麻布裹起来的便笺，把它交给格罗玛什坠毁点的伯克塔·血怒。
text.description: 在动身出发之前，我曾经收到斥候沃塔肯翻译整理的有关布莱恩·铜须的文件。从布莱恩的日记和灰熊丘陵的发现来看，布莱恩肯定已经动身前往风暴峭壁了。在我们坠机之前，我发现在这里南边的山底平原对面有个露营地，俯瞰着冻结的伯尔之息河。$B$B如果布莱恩不在那里的话，就在营地一带找找，看那个该死的矮人有没有留下什么线索。如果你找到任何线索的话，把它带回来给我。
text.progress: Did you have any luck finding Bronzebeard's camp?
text.completion: Of course, with our luck, I probably could've predicted this. Well, we're not going to let him get away that easily. Let's see what that note says.
text.completed: Return to Boktar Bloodfury at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: The Missing Bronzebeard
english.objectives: Retrieve the Burlap-Wrapped Note from Brann's camp and return it to Boktar Bloodfury at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site.
english.description: Before we left, I received the file Scout Vor'takh compiled on this Brann Bronzebeard. There can be no doubt that Brann was headed for the Storm Peaks from his journal entries and findings in Grizzly Hills. Before we crashed, I caught sight of a campsite south of here, across the Foot Steppes, and overlooking the frozen Bor's Breath River.$B$BIf Brann isn't there, search the camp and its environs for any clues as to where that blasted dwarf might've gone. Bring back anything you find.
english.progress: Did you have any luck finding Bronzebeard's camp?
english.completion: Of course, with our luck, I probably could've predicted this. Well, we're not going to let him get away that easily. Let's see what that note says.
english.completed: Return to Boktar Bloodfury at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 顽固的敌人
text.objectives: 击败莱斯班恩将军，然后向联盟飞行战舰上的萨萨里安报捷。
text.description: 除非是最特别的情况下，像莱斯班恩将军这样强大的死亡骑士，都被巫妖王紧紧地控制着，根本无法转化。$B$B莱斯班恩将军在拱顶内部监督着新武器的制作流程。我向你保证，只要弄乱北部熔炉那里的武器架，他一定会冲过来的。我会派劣尸维尔、奈丝伍德夫人和跳跃者去帮助你。$B$B如果我们想得到暗影拱顶，就必须干掉莱斯班恩将军！
text.progress: I ask you, $N, why would we be speaking again if General Lightsbane yet exists?
text.completion: General Lightsbane and his forces are defeated? The Shadow Vault is taken?
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: If He Cannot Be Turned
english.objectives: Defeat General Lightsbane and then report your success back to Thassarian aboard the gunship, The Skybreaker.
english.description: Death knights, such as General Lightsbane, are held on too tight of a leash to be able to be turned from the Lich King's will except under the most extraordinary circumstances.$B$BThe general keeps himself within the vault overseeing the creation of new weapons. Disturb one of his weapon racks at the northern forge and I assure you, he will come. I'll send Vile, Lady Nightswood, and The Leaper in to help you.$B$BIf we are to finally own The Shadow Vault, General Lightsbane must fall!
english.progress: I ask you, $N, why would we be speaking again if General Lightsbane yet exists?
english.completion: General Lightsbane and his forces are defeated? The Shadow Vault is taken?
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 顽固的敌人
text.objectives: 击败莱斯班恩将军，然后向部落飞行战舰上的库尔迪拉·织亡者报捷。
text.description: 除非是最特别的情况下，像莱斯班恩将军这样强大的死亡骑士，都被巫妖王紧紧地控制着，根本无法转化。$B$B莱斯班恩将军在拱顶内部监督着新武器的制作流程。我向你保证，只要弄乱北部熔炉那里的武器架，他一定会冲过来的。我会派劣尸维尔、奈丝伍德夫人和跳跃者去帮助你。$B$B如果我们想得到暗影拱顶，就必须干掉莱斯班恩将军！
text.completion: General Lightsbane and his forces are defeated? The Shadow Vault is taken?
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

english.title: If He Cannot Be Turned
english.objectives: Defeat General Lightsbane and then report your success back to Koltira Deathweaver aboard the gunship, Orgrim's Hammer.
english.description: Death knights, such as General Lightsbane, are held on too tight of a leash to be able to be turned from the Lich King's will except under the most extraordinary circumstances.$B$BThe general keeps himself within the vault overseeing the creation of new weapons. Disturb one of his weapon racks at the northern forge and I assure you, he will come. I'll send Vile, Lady Nightswood, and The Leaper in to help you.$B$BIf we are to finally own The Shadow Vault, General Lightsbane must fall!
english.completion: General Lightsbane and his forces are defeated? The Shadow Vault is taken?
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: 暗影拱顶
text.objectives: 向暗影拱顶的斯利文男爵报到。
text.description: 你干得非常好。而且你还为黑锋骑士团赢得了三位非常重要的伙伴。$B$B<萨萨里安注视着远方的地平线。>$B$B你应该回去了。现在，斯利文男爵和其他的死亡骑士正在为了保卫暗影拱顶，与天灾军团进行着激烈的战斗。$B$B我相信他们需要你的帮助。
text.completion: Good of you to return. As you can see, we have our hands full here.

english.title: The Shadow Vault
english.objectives: Report back to Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault.
english.description: It sounds like you did extremely well. And you secured three very important allies for the Knights of the Ebon Blade in the process.$B$B<Thassarian gazes out over the horizon.>$B$BYou should head back. By now, Baron Sliver and the other death knights will be fighting tooth and nail to hold The Shadow Vault against the might of the Scourge.$B$BI'm sure they'll need your help.
english.completion: Good of you to return. As you can see, we have our hands full here.

text.title: 暗影拱顶
text.objectives: 向暗影拱顶的斯利文男爵报到。
text.description: 你干得非常好。而且你还为黑锋骑士团赢得了三位非常重要的伙伴。$B$B<库尔迪拉注视着远方的地平线。>$B$B你应该回去了。现在，斯利文男爵和其他的死亡骑士正在为了保卫暗影拱顶，与天灾军团进行着激烈的战斗。$B$B我相信他们需要你的帮助。
text.completion: Good of you to return. As you can see, we have our hands full here.

english.title: The Shadow Vault
english.objectives: Report back to Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault.
english.description: It sounds like you did extremely well. And you secured three very important allies for the Knights of the Ebon Blade in the process.$B$B<Koltira gazes down at the map on the floor.>$B$BYou should head back. By now, Baron Sliver and the other death knights will be fighting tooth and nail to hold The Shadow Vault against the might of the Scourge.$B$BI'm sure they'll need your help.
english.completion: Good of you to return. As you can see, we have our hands full here.

text.title: 制造挽具
text.objectives: 布伦希尔达村的艾丝崔·约利塔尔希望你交给她3张冰鬃雪人的毛皮。
text.description: 这么说你想骑熊咯？好吧，既然你已经到了这一步，那么你肯定得去海德比武会试一试了。$B$B先做重要的事，我们要给你制作一副挽具。$B$B你可以在南面的峭壁上找到三五成群的雪人。它们的毛皮非常坚韧，而且厚度也正合适。帮我拿些毛皮回来，我们开始朝着让你骑上熊的目标努力吧。
text.progress: Did you find the hides yet?  You'll find yeti in the hills below.
text.completion: These will do nicely.  I'll have the harness ready for you in no time.
text.completed: Return to Astrid Bjornrittar at Brunnhildar Village in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: Making a Harness
english.objectives: Astrid Bjornrittar in Brunnhildar Village wants you to obtain 3 Icemane Yeti Hides.
english.description: So you want to ride?  Well, if you've made it this far someone must think you've got a shot at the Hyldsmeet.$B$BFirst things first; we'll have to make you a harness.$B$BIn the cliffs to the south, you'll find scattered groups of yeti.  Their hides are tough and just the right thickness.  Bring me some and we'll get you started on the path of the bear-rider.
english.progress: Did you find the hides yet?  You'll find yeti in the hills below.
english.completion: These will do nicely.  I'll have the harness ready for you in no time.
english.completed: Return to Astrid Bjornrittar at Brunnhildar Village in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 从无到有
text.objectives: 北伐军前线营地的工程师里德要求你收集10块天灾金属废料。
text.description: 我们一定要阻止纳瓦留斯王子。不能让天灾继续把这个地方当作他们的僵尸制造场。如果我们能让坦克运转起来的话，也许还有机会。现在，我需要一些配件来修补坦克。$B$B在这里的西北方，有个被称为塞穆之末的地方，天灾军团把那里当作基地。基地周围散布着它们到来之后留下的废料，零碎的天灾金属被扔得到处都是。帮我拿些天灾金属废料回来，我会让它们物尽其用的。
text.progress: I really don't know if this plan will work, $N. Just bring me the scrap metal and I'll do what I can.
text.completion: What is this junk! Ah, damn it all! It's useless. Scourge metal isn't gonna do the trick. What are we going to do?
text.completed: Return to Engineer Reed at Crusader Forward Camp in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Making Something Out Of Nothing
english.objectives: Engineer Reed at Crusader Forward Camp in Zul'Drak has asked that you recover 10 pieces of Scourge Scrap Metal.
english.description: Prince Navarius must be stopped. We can't let the Scourge continue to use this area as a zombie factory. If we can get the tank operational we might stand a chance. What I need right now are spare parts.$B$BNorthwest of here is an area called Thrym's End. The Scourge armies are using the area as a base of sorts. Spread out across the base is the wreckage from their arrival. Bits and pieces of Scourge scrap metal litter the landscape. Get that stuff to me and I'll try and put it to good use.
english.progress: I really don't know if this plan will work, $N. Just bring me the scrap metal and I'll do what I can.
english.completion: What is this junk! Ah, damn it all! It's useless. Scourge metal isn't gonna do the trick. What are we going to do?
english.completed: Return to Engineer Reed at Crusader Forward Camp in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 寻找答案
text.objectives: 前往怒爪巢穴寻找线索，查出向怒爪狼獾人发动进攻的幕后主使。
text.description: 这群可怜的家伙是仅存的幸存者。$B$B按照他们酋长话来说，达卡莱巨魔同怒爪狼獾人已经结盟几千年了。他们世世代代同巨魔一起生活在这里，完全没有注意到周围发生的变化。对于怒爪狼獾人来说，巨魔依然是原来的巨魔，所以当巨魔向他们的巢穴发动进攻时，狼獾人完全吓傻了。$B$B我们需要答案，$n。去东南方的狼獾人村庄寻找线索，找出是谁该为这件事情负责。
text.completion: There is a scroll floating in the air above the strange altar. This must be what Crusader Lord Lantinga is looking for!

english.title: In Search Of Answers
english.objectives: Search Rageclaw Den for a clue about who or what initiated the attacks against the Rageclaw Wolvar.
english.description: These poor creatures are the only survivors.$B$BAccording to their chief, the Drakkari trolls and Rageclaw wolvar have been allies for thousands of years. They've been living here, alongside the trolls, for generations, completely unaware of the ever changing world around them. To the Rageclaw, a troll is a troll, so the troll attack upon their den took them by surprise.$B$BWe need some answers, $n. Scour their village - southeast of here - for clues as to who or what is in charge of these attacks.
english.completion: There is a scroll floating in the air above the strange altar. This must be what Crusader Lord Lantinga is looking for!

text.title: 朋友的意义……
text.objectives: 北伐军前线营地的北伐军战士马克拉尔要求你找到北伐军战士达加斯、戈尔克和布尔。
text.description: 我们受到了纳瓦留斯王子和他的天灾军团的攻击。我让达加斯和双胞胎待在坦克里面，可他们偏偏不听。达加斯严肃地看着我说，“如果没人到坦克外面去的话，它们会把我们全都杀死的。”他让里德切断了动力，随后冲了出去。这是我所见过的最英勇的行为。$B$B我听到王子大声地向它手下的怪物发布着命令，似乎是要把他们带到西北边的塞穆之末去。我们一定要救出伙伴们，你愿意去找他们吗？
text.completion: It was a great sacrifice that those three made and it won't soon be forgotten. Their passing will not be in vain. We will be victorious!
text.completed: Return to Crusader MacKellar at Crusader Forward Camp in Zul'Drak.

english.title: That's What Friends Are For...
english.objectives: Crusader MacKellar at Crusader Forward Camp has asked that you find Crusader Dargath, Gerk and Burr.
english.description: We were attacked by Prince Navarius and at least a dozen Scourge. I told Dargath and the twins to stay inside the tank, but they wouldn't listen. Dargath looked me in the eyes and said, "If somebody doesn't get out of this tank, they'll kill us all." He then made Reed cut the engine and charged. Most heroic thing I've ever seen.$B$BI heard the Prince barking orders to the monsters. Sounded like he was taking them to Thrym's End, northwest of here. We have to rescue our friends. Will you go look for them?
english.completion: It was a great sacrifice that those three made and it won't soon be forgotten. Their passing will not be in vain. We will be victorious!
english.completed: Return to Crusader MacKellar at Crusader Forward Camp in Zul'Drak.

objectiveDetails.description: 找到北伐军战士达加斯

text.title: 圣光不能为我复仇
text.objectives: 塞穆之末的戈尔克希望你去消灭15个瓦古维库人。
text.description: 他们……他们杀死了我的兄弟。$B$B<戈尔克强忍着泪水。>$B$B他们……他们就像宰杀动物一样把他杀死了。现在他们还把我的兄弟放在营地另一端的石板上，准备进行实验。达加斯也死了。这位圣骑士在东北方的废墟中英勇抵抗，但瓦古维库人的首领奥贾尔实在是太强大了。$B$B我是唯一的幸存者，但我也支撑不了多久了。我……我快要不行了。$B$B如果圣光不能为我复仇，或许你可以，$c。把他们全部消灭。
text.progress: You're doing the world a favor, friend. These monsters must be stopped!
text.completion: <Gerk is dying.>$B$BTh... They say these Vargul are the... the ones that weren't found worthy by the Lich King. Can... Can you im... imagine it? Just th... think how powerful the... the... worthy must be...$B$BI'll say a prayer for you in the hereafter, hero... May you never have to face them in number.
text.completed: Return to Gerk at Thrym's End in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Light Won't Grant Me Vengeance
english.objectives: Gerk at Thrym's End in Zul'Drak wants you to kill 15 Vargul.
english.description: They... They killed my brother.$B$B<Gerk fights back tears.>$B$BSlaughtered him like he was some sort of animal. Now they got him laid out on one of their tables on the other side of the camp, ready for their grisly experiments. Dargath's dead too. The paladin made a heroic stand at the ruins to the northeast, but the leader of the Vargul, Algar, was too strong.$B$BI'm all that's left and I'll be dead soon too. I... I'm turning.$B$BIf the Light won't grant me vengeance, maybe you will, $c. Kill them all.
english.progress: You're doing the world a favor, friend. These monsters must be stopped!
english.completion: <Gerk is dying.>$B$BTh... They say these Vargul are the... the ones that weren't found worthy by the Lich King. Can... Can you im... imagine it? Just th... think how powerful the... the... worthy must be...$B$BI'll say a prayer for you in the hereafter, hero... May you never have to face them in number.
english.completed: Return to Gerk at Thrym's End in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 残酷的米尔德蕾
text.objectives: 在荒弃矿洞内与残酷的米尔德蕾谈一谈。
text.description: 好，成交。你帮我摆脱这些枷锁，我帮你找到你的绿皮小伙伴。$B$B管理这座矿洞的海德尼尔人被称为残酷的米尔德蕾——她可不是空有其名。$B$B去跟她说你是被派来帮忙的，在她足够信赖你、把我枷锁的钥匙交给你之前，你要按照她的命令毕恭毕敬地做事。
text.completion: I was expecting a replacement for one of my overseers.  It's about time you showed up.$B$BLet's put you to work.

english.title: Mildred the Cruel
english.objectives: Speak to Mildred the Cruel inside the Forlorn Mine.
english.description: Our deal is made then, $n.  You help me get out of these chains and I'll help you find your little green friend.$B$BThe Hyldnir who runs this mine is known as Mildred the Cruel -- and with good reason.$B$BTell her you've been sent to lend a hand with the mines.  Do whatever she asks until she trusts you with the keys to my shackles.
english.completion: I was expecting a replacement for one of my overseers.  It's about time you showed up.$B$BLet's put you to work.

text.title: 训诫
text.objectives: 荒弃矿洞中的残酷的米尔德蕾要求你使用训诫之杖威吓6个筋疲力尽的维库人。
text.description: 我就直接了当地说吧。在矿洞里为我们工作的男性维库人都不是心甘情愿的……他们只是暂时屈服而已。$B$B每隔一段时间，他们中总是会有几个人失去动力。找到那些不合作的维库人，用这根训诫之杖好好吓唬一下他们。$B$B他们也该清醒清醒了。
text.progress: Is it done? I hope you didn't slay too many of the mongrels. We need the manpower.
text.completion: Not bad for a new overseer.  I've another task for you if you're feeling brave today.
text.completed: Return to Mildred the Cruel at The Forlorn Mine in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: Discipline
english.objectives: Mildred the Cruel at the Forlorn Mine wants you to use the Disciplining Rod on 6 Exhausted Vrykul.
english.description: Let's start you off with something straightforward.  The male vrykul that work the mines for us do so against their will... purely out of fear of our blades.$B$BOnce in a while, one of them will lose their motivation.  Find any uncooperative vrykul and put them in their place.$B$BTake this disciplining rod.  You'll want to inflict pain, not death.  Well, most of the time anyway.
english.progress: Is it done? I hope you didn't slay too many of the mongrels. We need the manpower.
english.completion: Not bad for a new overseer.  I've another task for you if you're feeling brave today.
english.completed: Return to Mildred the Cruel at The Forlorn Mine in The Storm Peaks.

objectiveDetails.description: 训诫筋疲力尽的维库人

text.title: 杀一儆百
text.objectives: 荒弃矿洞内的残酷的米尔德蕾命令你去处死加哈尔。
text.description: 任何事情都会有两面性，我的姐妹。维库人已经无法再忍受高压了，他们逐渐开始有了反抗的念头。$B$B带头的家伙名叫加哈尔。为了进一步证明你的忠诚，去把他干掉……记得一定要当众下手，好好警告一下那些维库人。
text.progress: You're back. Did you kill the insubordinate pig?
text.completion: If I had any reservations regarding your commitment when you first arrived, I no longer have any.  With just a little more effort you could be a permanent member of my operation.
text.completed: Return to Mildred the Cruel at The Forlorn Mine in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: Examples to be Made
english.objectives: Mildred the Cruel at the Forlorn Mine wants you to slay Garhal.
english.description: For every action there is an opposite reaction, sister.  In the case of us applying pressure on the males, this has meant newly spread rumors of insurrection.$B$BThe bearded pig behind this rabble-rousing is called Garhal.  Put an end to him... and make sure the other males see his demise.  They must learn that insubordination will not be tolerated.
english.progress: You're back. Did you kill the insubordinate pig?
english.completion: If I had any reservations regarding your commitment when you first arrived, I no longer have any.  With just a little more effort you could be a permanent member of my operation.
english.completed: Return to Mildred the Cruel at The Forlorn Mine in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 特殊的囚犯
text.objectives: 把米尔德蕾的钥匙交给荒弃矿洞的女巫洛莉拉。
text.description: 你真是心狠手辣啊，不错，我相信你会表现得非常好。$B$B我还有一个任务要交给你。有一个女性维库人囚犯越来越让我无法容忍了。$B$B她竟敢宣称要有参加海德比武会的权利，那可是我们最神圣的格斗比赛！$B$B这是打开她枷锁的钥匙。下手快一点，让她少吃点苦。尽管她不是我们的人，但她毕竟是个女性。
text.progress: It's about time.
text.completion: I knew you'd be back!  Get me out of these shackles and I'll help you find the goblin.
text.completed: Return to Lok'lira the Crone at Snowblind Terrace in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: A Certain Prisoner
english.objectives: Take Mildred's Key to Lok'lira the Crone in the Forlorn Mine.
english.description: You are without mercy.  You will do well around these parts.$B$BI have another task to ask of you.  There is a female vrykul prisoner that's become more of a liability than I had anticipated.$B$BShe had the gall to claim the right to take part in the Hyldsmeet, our sacred competition of strength and fighting prowess.$B$BHere's the key to her shackles.  Make it as painless as possible.  She's a female after all, even if not one of us.
english.progress: It's about time.
english.completion: I knew you'd be back!  Get me out of these shackles and I'll help you find the goblin.
english.completed: Return to Lok'lira the Crone at Snowblind Terrace in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 敏锐的嗅觉
text.objectives: 前往格罗玛什坠毁点以东的山麓，与凯尔莉丝谈一谈。
text.description: 我们必须依赖嗅觉敏锐而且追踪能力超强的动物才有可能找到布莱恩。虽然地精飞艇上没有猎犬，但是也并非只有猎犬才能承担起这样的任务。$B$B飞艇坠毁后，我派凯尔莉丝去东边的山里打猎了。她那只名叫霜齿的小豹子是很擅长雪地狩猎的，你不如和她谈谈，让她把宠物借给你一用。就算没有霜齿，她也能捕获猎物。但是对我们来说，想要寻找布莱恩·铜须，这是唯一的办法。
text.completion: So Boktar has volunteered Frostbite for an errand, eh? Well, this had better be important. He knows better than to try to separate a hunter from her pet!

english.title: The Nose Knows
english.objectives: Speak with Khaliisi at the foot of the mountain east of the Grom'arsh Crash-Site.
english.description: In order to track down Brann, we're going to need a creature with a keen sense of smell and a good tracking ability. There weren't any hounds on the zeppelin, but I think I have a substitute.$B$BAfter the crash, I sent Khaliisi down the east face of the mountain to start hunting for food. Her cat, Frostbite, excels at tracking prey in the snow. Tell her that she'll have to part with her companion for a while, at least. She can hunt on her own, but we have no other way of catching up to Brann Bronzebeard.
english.completion: So Boktar has volunteered Frostbite for an errand, eh? Well, this had better be important. He knows better than to try to separate a hunter from her pet!

text.title: 追踪罪犯
text.objectives: 骑上霜齿，让它带你寻找布莱恩的便笺上的气味的源头。然后找到布莱恩的通讯器，使用它与布莱恩·铜须取得联系。
text.description: 好吧，我答应伯克塔的请求，但是我希望他能做出补偿。别用那种眼神看我。我承认，这里是伯克塔说了算，但是谁也不能对猎人随随便便指手画脚。$B$B他总是对我咆哮，“把那头野兽牵走！”“让它别再叫了！”$B$B你瞧，现在他想起我的小豹子了，这家伙真会见风使舵啊。下次他再敢嘀咕，我就让霜齿扑上去咬他一口。别担心，它会帮助你完成这项追踪任务的。气味的源头可能是铁矮人，布莱恩，或者是别的生物。总之等它找到目标之后，接下来的事就要靠你自己去解决了。
text.progress: Who... who're you?
text.completion: <An image of a dwarf appears as you activate the communicator. It can only be Brann Bronzebeard.>$B$B<From the look on his face, Brann seems shocked to see you and begins gesturing furiously.>
text.completed: Use Brann's Communicator to speak with Brann Bronzebeard.

english.title: Sniffing Out the Perpetrator
english.objectives: Mount Frostbite and ride her to the source of the scent from Brann's note. Then, recover Brann's Communicator and use it to make contact with Brann Bronzebeard.
english.description: Boktar can have his way this time, but I'll expect him to make it up to me. Don't look at me like that. Boktar may be in command, but no one tells a hunter what to do.$B$B'Put that beast away,' he says. 'Make it stop growling.'$B$BAll of a sudden he changes his mind when it suits him. Next time he complains, Frostbite'll just nip him a bit. Don't worry, she'll do an admirable job tracking your prey. After she locates her target, you're on your own to deal with iron dwarves, or Brann, or whatever you find.
english.progress: Who... who're you?
english.completion: <An image of a dwarf appears as you activate the communicator. It can only be Brann Bronzebeard.>$B$B<From the look on his face, Brann seems shocked to see you and begins gesturing furiously.>
english.completed: Use Brann's Communicator to speak with Brann Bronzebeard.

text.title: 擊殺獎勵測試
text.objectives: 對擊殺獎勵測試/揮手
text.description: 對我/揮手，然後我就會給你個「給玩家擊殺獎勵」。
text.completed: Return to Kill Credit Test.

english.title: Kill Credit Test
english.objectives: /wave at Kill Credit Test
english.description: /wave at me and I'll assign 'kill credit to player' to you.
english.completed: Return to Kill Credit Test.

text.title: 风暴将至
text.objectives: 风暴巨人之王盖米尔要求你想办法把他从笼子里面救出来。与北伐军前线营地的工程师里德谈谈该怎么办。
text.description: 你和其他人不同，小东西。你身上没有那种古老的尸臭味。或许我可以信赖你。$B$B我是盖米尔，风暴巨人的国王。我被我的兄弟西亚斯引诱到了这里，他现在已经成了巫妖王的亡灵奴仆。我意识到他的求救其实是个陷阱，但已经太晚了。现在我被天灾军团囚禁了起来，恐怕不久以后就会遭受到其他风暴巨人所遭受的命运。$B$B想办法把我从这只笼子里面救出去，我会尽全力来帮助你的。
text.completion: A... A storm giant? I don't know about this, $n. That sounds risky. On the other hand, I don't think we have too many other options.$B$BIf I do this you have to promise me that you will get your giant friend to help us deal with Navarius and his cronies.

english.title: A Great Storm Approaches
english.objectives: Gymer, King of Storm Giants, has asked you to find a way to release him from his cage. Speak with Engineer Reed at the Crusader Forward Camp.
english.description: You are not like the others, little one. You do not reek of the ancient death. Perhaps you can be trusted.$B$BI am Gymer, king of the storm giants. I was lured here by my brother, Thiassi, now an undead servant of the Lich King. By the time I realized that his cry for help was a trap, it was too late. I am now a prisoner of the Scourge and I fear that soon I will suffer the same fate as many of the other storm giants.$B$BFind a way to release me from this cage and I will aid you to the best of my ability.
english.completion: A... A storm giant? I don't know about this, $n. That sounds risky. On the other hand, I don't think we have too many other options.$B$BIf I do this you have to promise me that you will get your giant friend to help us deal with Navarius and his cronies.

text.title: 讲兽人语会死吗？
text.objectives: 与格罗玛什坠毁点的莫塔哈·风魂谈一谈。
text.description: <布莱恩手上比划着，用他的母语说道。>$B$BRuk MogOth red a mogoth ta eft Thros-garE Haldir。$B$BKha gor ruk khaz ta ke ruk hrim eft thros-am-kha ruk kost-um havar go kost。$B$BA modoss hine ruk bergum eft thros-am-kha ga eft Haldir ke loch Thon we lo gefrunon ta mitta。$B$BGar Ruk dagUm loch angor-magi ta har ruk！$B$B<过了一会儿，你意识到这种谈话根本不会有任何结果。或许格罗玛什坠毁点的萨满祭司莫塔哈·风魂知道该怎么办。>
text.completion: Boktar will not be happy that you didn't find Brann, but at least you didn't come back empty-handed. Now, let's see what we can do about this babbling dwarf.

english.title: Speak Orcish, Man!
english.objectives: Speak with Moteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site.
english.description: <Brann begins gesticulating wildly and rambling in his native language.>$B$BRuk MogOth red a mogoth ta eft Thros-garE Haldir.$B$BKha gor ruk khaz ta ke ruk hrim eft thros-am-kha ruk kost-um havar go kost.$B$BA modoss hine ruk bergum eft thros-am-kha ga eft Haldir ke loch Thon we lo gefrunon ta mitta.$B$B Gar Ruk dagUm loch angor-magi ta har ruk!$B$B<After a few moments, you realize the conversation is going nowhere. Perhaps the shaman, Moteha Windborn, at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site will know what to do.>
english.completion: Boktar will not be happy that you didn't find Brann, but at least you didn't come back empty-handed. Now, let's see what we can do about this babbling dwarf.

text.title: 拯救盖米尔
text.objectives: 北伐军前线营地的工程师里德希望你交给他6份女妖精华和6份硅藻土。
text.description: 你说他被锁在了一只100尺高的笼子里？$B$B如果我的计算无误的话，我们至少应该能让笼子的转轴变得不那么坚固，这样巨人就可以逃出来了。$B$B如果想要实施这个计划，我就需要一些增塑剂和稳定剂。$B$B女妖精华应该是很好的增塑剂，你可以到东北边的死亡旷野去，从那里的女妖身上得到它们。西南方黑锋哨站附近的大地狂怒者身上有我要的稳定剂。$B$B开始行动吧！
text.progress: Without the plasticizers and stabilizers I'll never be able to make the explosives necessary to break your friend out of jail.
text.completion: Thankfully we weren't in short supply of explosives. Putting together the jumbo seaforium charge should be no problem with the materials you brought me.
text.completed: Return to Engineer Reed at Crusader Forward Camp in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Gymer's Salvation
english.objectives: Engineer Reed at Crusader Forward Camp in Zul'Drak wants you to bring him 6 Banshee Essence and 6 Diatomaceous Earth.
english.description: Now you say that he's locked up in a 100 foot tall cage, eh?$B$BIf my calculations are correct, we should be able to at least weaken the hinges on the cage, giving the giant enough leeway to break out.$B$BIf this is going to work I'm going to need some plasticizers and stabilizers.$B$BBanshee essence should do nicely for the plasticizer. You can get that from the banshees in the Dead Fields, northeast of us. The stabilizer can be found on the earthragers to the southwest, near Ebon Watch.$B$BGet a move on!
english.progress: Without the plasticizers and stabilizers I'll never be able to make the explosives necessary to break your friend out of jail.
english.completion: Thankfully we weren't in short supply of explosives. Putting together the jumbo seaforium charge should be no problem with the materials you brought me.
english.completed: Return to Engineer Reed at Crusader Forward Camp in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 弥补关系
text.objectives: 风暴神殿的托里姆要你前往丹尼芬雷东边的弗约恩之砧，杀死弗约恩和5名雷铸铁巨人。$b$b你可以使用托里姆的大地符咒召唤他的土灵助战。必须借助弗约恩之砧附近的花岗岩石块才能使用这枚符咒。
text.description: 如果要从我兄弟手中夺到造物者圣台的控制权，我就必须先想办法修复与旧日盟友之间的关系。$b$b或许我与冰霜巨人可以通过对抗共同的敌人，开始着手恢复彼此的友谊。$b$b弗约恩正在率领铁巨人围攻丹尼芬雷。你必须在东边的弗约恩之砧击败他，并痛击他的部队，帮助霍迪尔之子赢得胜利。$b$b带上这枚符咒吧，$n。你可以用它召唤我的土灵助阵。
text.progress: Does Fjorn still live, $c?
text.completion: So, it is done then.$b$bLet us hope it is enough.
text.completed: Return to Thorim at the Temple of Storms in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: Mending Fences
english.objectives: Thorim at the Temple of Storms wants you to Kill Fjorn and 5 Stormforged Iron Giants at Fjorn's Anvil, east of Dun Niffelem.$b$bUsing Thorim's Charm of Earth will summon his Earthen to fight by your side. The charm requires a Granite Boulder from nearby Fjorn's Anvil.
english.description: If I hope to wrest control of the Temple of the Makers from my brother, I must make amends with my old allies.$b$bPerhaps by eliminating a common enemy, we may at least take a step towards renewing my friendship with the frost giants.$b$bFjorn has besieged Dun Niffelem with giants of iron. You must defeat him at Fjorn's Anvil, far to the east of here, and weaken his forces sufficiently for the Sons of Hodir to emerge victorious.$b$bTake this charm, $n. Use it to summon my earthen to your aid.
english.progress: Does Fjorn still live, $c?
english.completion: So, it is done then.$b$bLet us hope it is enough.
english.completed: Return to Thorim at the Temple of Storms in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 唯一的希望
text.objectives: 在祖达克的塞穆之末使用巨型爆盐炸弹，打开囚禁着盖米尔的天灾围栏，然后与盖米尔谈一谈。
text.description: 我要给你的东西被称为爆盐炸弹，它是使用特殊材料制成的强力炸药。由于它的可塑性，你可以把它塞进牢笼的转轴结合处，以寻求最大的爆炸威力。$B$B去你朋友那里，用这枚巨型爆盐炸弹把他救出来吧。$B$B希望他是个守信的家伙。他是我们唯一的希望了。
text.progress: I am a giant of my word, little one.
text.completion: FREEDOM!$B$BDo not be afraid, little one. Gymer is an honorable giant. Like you and your people, I too wish to see the Scourge driven away from this land and the Lich King destroyed. I will help you, as promised, to the best of my ability.
text.completed: Return to Gymer at Thrym's End in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Our Only Hope
english.objectives: Speak to Gymer at Thrym's End in Zul'Drak once you have used the Jumbo Seaforium Charge to open the Scourge Enclosure that is holding him prisoner.
english.description: What I'm about to give you is called seaforium. It is a highly volatile explosive with some unique properties. Due to its malleable nature, you will be able to fill in the hinges and cracks of the cage for maximum damage.$B$BReturn to your friend and use the jumbo seaforium charge to set him free.$B$BLet's hope he honors the bargain. He's our only hope.
english.progress: I am a giant of my word, little one.
english.completion: FREEDOM!$B$BDo not be afraid, little one. Gymer is an honorable giant. Like you and your people, I too wish to see the Scourge driven away from this land and the Lich King destroyed. I will help you, as promised, to the best of my ability.
english.completed: Return to Gymer at Thrym's End in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 寒风的声音
text.objectives: 将5份寒风之声交给格罗玛什坠毁点的莫塔哈·风魂。
text.description: 如果不是运气够好的话，我们恐怕无法这么轻易地找到布莱恩。如果我们能知道布莱恩在说些什么，你就能劝他说出自己的位置了。$B$B附近群山中的风力很强，这对我们而言是件好事。一个知识渊博的萨满祭司可以通过风的声音理解全世界所有的语言。$B$B我要你到西北方的雪流平原去，寻找由风构成的生物——风暴骑士。去捕捉它们的声音，把那声音带回来给我。
text.progress: Have you brought the wind's voices?
text.completion: You should be able to communicate with the dwarf now. Ask Boktar what he requires of you. There is little time to lose.
text.completed: Return to Moteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: Speaking with the Wind's Voice
english.objectives: Bring 5 Voices of the Wind to Moteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site.
english.description: I suppose we shouldn't have expected to find Brann so easily, not with our luck. If we can make sense of what Brann is saying, you can persuade him to give up his location.$B$BThe power of the wind is strong in these mountains, and it may prove a great boon to us. A knowledgeable shaman can hear the sound of all the world's tongues on the wind.$B$BTo the northwest, on the Snowdrift Plains, you will find beings made of wind, the stormriders. Capture their voices and bring them to me.
english.progress: Have you brought the wind's voices?
english.completion: You should be able to communicate with the dwarf now. Ask Boktar what he requires of you. There is little time to lose.
english.completed: Return to Moteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: Gem Perfection
text.objectives: Return two Huge Citrines, two Dark Jade and two Shadow Crystals to Ounhulo in Valgarde.
text.description: It has the cold of the Icewyrm's breath up here does it not?   Not only do I lack customers for my crafting skills, but I also lack stock of gems to sell!   If you can bring me several uncut gems to replenish my stocks, I can teach you the skill of gem perfection.   This will allow you to sometimes cut a perfect gem with increased bonuses when cutting a uncommon quality gem from Northrend.
text.progress: You are most generous.  The least I can do is to teach you the skills of gem perfection.
text.completion: These are perfect for replenishing my stock.  Not only will I teach you the art of gemcutting perfection, but I cut one of them gems into its perfect form which you may have as a reward.
text.completed: Return to Ounhulo at Valgarde in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Gem Perfection
english.objectives: Return two Huge Citrines, two Dark Jade and two Shadow Crystals to Ounhulo in Valgarde.
english.description: It has the cold of the Icewyrm's breath up here does it not?   Not only do I lack customers for my crafting skills, but I also lack stock of gems to sell!   If you can bring me several uncut gems to replenish my stocks, I can teach you the skill of gem perfection.   This will allow you to sometimes cut a perfect gem with increased bonuses when cutting a uncommon quality gem from Northrend.
english.progress: You are most generous.  The least I can do is to teach you the skills of gem perfection.
english.completion: These are perfect for replenishing my stock.  Not only will I teach you the art of gemcutting perfection, but I cut one of them gems into its perfect form which you may have as a reward.
english.completed: Return to Ounhulo at Valgarde in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 风暴之王的复仇
text.objectives: 与盖米尔交谈以开始行动。$B$B骑着盖米尔去消灭100个天灾士兵，并消灭天选者奥贾尔、塞穆和纳瓦留斯王子。成功之后，向北伐军前线营地的北伐军战士马克拉尔报告。
text.description: 我的人民受到了巫妖王的屠杀。天灾军团正在使用风暴巨人的尸体制造血肉巨人，或者是把它们缝合成像塞穆那样的怪物。$B$B为了将它们完全消灭，我一定会竭尽全力。让我们携手剿灭那些威胁祖达克的天灾亡灵。$B$B不管是纳瓦留斯、奥贾尔还是塞穆，都要消灭掉！$B$B等你准备好之后就告诉我，让我们开始这趟破坏之旅吧。
text.progress: What is going on? Are our enemies dead?
text.completion: Unbelievable! This will be a story for the ages, $N! One $g man:woman; rode upon the head of the king of storm giants and decimated an entire Scourge army!$B$BAnd I was there to see it all happen...
text.completed: Return to Crusader MacKellar at Crusader Forward Camp in Zul'Drak.

english.title: The Storm King's Vengeance
english.objectives: Speak with Gymer to begin.$B$BWhile riding Gymer, destroy 100 Scourge and kill Algar the Chosen, Thrym and Prince Navarius. Report to Crusader MacKellar at Crusader Forward Camp should you succeed.
english.description: My people have been decimated by the Lich King. The Scourge now use the corpses of storm giants to create mindless flesh giants, or worse, stitched together aberrations like Thrym.$B$BI will stop at nothing to see them all driven from this world. We will work together to destroy the Scourge that threaten Zul'Drak.$B$BWe will kill them all: Navarius, Algar and Thrym!$B$BWhen you are ready, let me know and we will begin our destructive journey.
english.progress: What is going on? Are our enemies dead?
english.completion: Unbelievable! This will be a story for the ages, $N! One $g man:woman; rode upon the head of the king of storm giants and decimated an entire Scourge army!$B$BAnd I was there to see it all happen...
english.completed: Return to Crusader MacKellar at Crusader Forward Camp in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 联络布莱恩
text.objectives: 使用布莱恩的通讯器与布莱恩·铜须联络并与他交谈，然后与格罗玛什坠毁的伯克塔·血怒谈一谈。$B$B如果你遗失了布莱恩的通讯器，可以找格罗玛什坠毁点的莫塔哈·风魂再要一个。
text.description: 你还在等什么？多亏了莫塔哈的帮助，语言障碍已经解决了。去联络布莱恩·铜须吧，找出他的藏身之所，问问他究竟在追踪什么。$B$B或许我们还能在这场灾难中挽救一点什么。
text.progress: What did you find out?
text.completion: <Boktar listens as you describe your conversation with Brann.>$B$BThere's truth to the dwarf's words. Vor'takh's plan is not the way of the Horde. If Brann Bronzebeard knows of a way to stop these iron dwarves and their patron, it serves us to help him.
text.completed: Return to Boktar Bloodfury at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: Catching up with Brann
english.objectives: Use Brann's Communicator to contact Brann Bronzebeard and speak with him, then speak to Boktar Bloodfury at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site.$B$BIf you lose Brann's Communicator, speak with Moteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site.
english.description: What are you waiting for? The language barrier has been broken, thanks to Moteha. Contact Brann Bronzebeard and find out anything you can about where he's hiding and what he's chasing after.$B$BMaybe we can still salvage something from this disaster.
english.progress: What did you find out?
english.completion: <Boktar listens as you describe your conversation with Brann.>$B$BThere's truth to the dwarf's words. Vor'takh's plan is not the way of the Horde. If Brann Bronzebeard knows of a way to stop these iron dwarves and their patron, it serves us to help him.
english.completed: Return to Boktar Bloodfury at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 改头换面
text.objectives: 到布伦希尔达村与女巫洛莉拉汇合。
text.description: 好极了。矿井的东面尽头处有一个通向布伦希尔达村的出口。沿着这条路走，我们在村子里汇合。$B$B不能让别人看见我们在一起，这样就不会有人怀疑你在帮我了。我会用魔法给自己加上伪装。别担心，$r——我们很快就能找到你的朋友了。
text.completion: You're here -- good.  I think I know where your goblin is.

english.title: A Change of Scenery
english.objectives: Reconvene with Lok'lira the Crone in Brunnhildar Village.
english.description: Excellent.  There's an exit in the eastern end of the mine that leads to Brunnhildar Village.  Follow it and I'll meet you there.$B$BWe must not be seen together so no one suspects you of aiding me.  I'll use my magic to disguise my appearance.  Do not worry, $r -- we'll find your friend in no time.
english.completion: You're here -- good.  I think I know where your goblin is.

text.title: 精炼之火
text.objectives: 从霜原湖的火热的亡魂身上收集10份狂怒火花，然后前往弗约恩之砧，使用那里的铁砧。
text.description: 这块表面布满孔隙的金属散发出神秘的光芒。$b$b你觉得应该把它放在弗约恩之砧上进行高温处理，除去矿石中的杂质。$b$b正当你思考这片冰原上有什么东西的温度高到足以胜任这项任务时，一只火焰亡魂从你面前飘过……
text.progress: The surface of the anvil is scalding, in sharp contrast with the wintry air.
text.completion: You place the metal on the anvil and immediately upon adding the sparks they work the ore furiously.$b$bWhen at last they burn out, you are left with a large piece of metal that gleams with a light of its own.
text.completed: Return to Fjorn's Anvil at Dun Niffelem in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: The Refiner's Fire
english.objectives: You must collect 10 Furious Sparks from the Seething Revenants at Frostfield Lake and then use the anvil at Fjorn's Anvil.
english.description: Beneath its porous exterior, this hunk of metal gleams with a mysterious quality.$b$bYou feel it would only be prudent to burn off the slag at Fjorn's Anvil.$b$bAs you ponder where in this frozen waste you might find something hot enough for the job, a fire revenant crosses your path...
english.progress: The surface of the anvil is scalding, in sharp contrast with the wintry air.
english.completion: You place the metal on the anvil and immediately upon adding the sparks they work the ore furiously.$b$bWhen at last they burn out, you are left with a large piece of metal that gleams with a light of its own.
english.completed: Return to Fjorn's Anvil at Dun Niffelem in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 重铸盟约
text.objectives: 前往丹尼芬雷，请求约库姆国王帮忙重铸托里姆的护甲。完成约库姆交付的任务之后，与丹尼芬雷的亚米尔德谈一谈。
text.description: <托里姆微笑起来，这是你第一次见到他笑。>$b$b终于，命运向我伸出了手，$r。$b$b你发现的这块金属，原本是我的盔甲的一部分。很久以前，我在极度的悲伤中脱下了它，并把它丢给了那些元素生物。$b$b只有霍迪尔的子孙才能修复它，因为它本来就是他们锻造出来的。$b$b或许你的行动已经减轻了他们对我的仇恨。去找到他们的国王，约库姆。如果他还活着，就请他帮忙吧。
text.completion: It would seem that I have refined my technique considerably. That, or the legends surrounding this anvil are true.$b$bThis suit of armor is superior to the last, and took less material to create.$b$bWith the excess, I was able to fashion you a little something as payment for your assistance.
text.completed: Return to Njormeld at Dun Niffelem in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: Forging an Alliance
english.objectives: You are to go to Dun Niffelem and ask King Jokkum to allow Thorim's armor to be reforged. After completing Jokkum's task, you are to speak with Njormeld in Dun Niffelem.
english.description: <Thorim, for the first time since your meeting him, smiles.>$b$bThis is all beginning to have the smell of fate's hand, $r.$b$bYour discovery is what remains of my armor, long ago cast off in a fit of grief and left to the elements. Only the sons of Hodir are capable of its reforging, for they are its original creators.$b$bPerhaps you've done enough to soften their hatred of me. Seek out their king, Jokkum, if he still breathes.$b$bFind your way into his good graces and plead for his assistance.
english.completion: It would seem that I have refined my technique considerably. That, or the legends surrounding this anvil are true.$b$bThis suit of armor is superior to the last, and took less material to create.$b$bWith the excess, I was able to fashion you a little something as payment for your assistance.
english.completed: Return to Njormeld at Dun Niffelem in The Storm Peaks.

objectiveDetails.description: 将弗约恩之砧带到丹尼芬雷

text.title: 维持传统
text.objectives: 布伦希尔达村的塞拉·克文沙尔要你前往瓦基里安，从瓦基里安候选者身上夺取冰霜油膏，并用冰霜油膏摧毁30枚瘟疫始祖龙卵。
text.description: 巫妖王已经派密使来找过我们三次了，每次都被我们当场拒绝。$B$B但是瓦基里安的那些姐妹们却不那么忠于传统，她们接受了巫妖王的诱惑。现在，她们不再从野外捕捉幼龙，转而用瘟疫和天灾军团的邪恶力量培育龙卵。$B$B从瓦基里安的海德尼尔人身上夺取冰霜油膏，把那些已经感染了瘟疫的龙卵冻僵。据说那些龙卵都放在一个发臭的瘟疫池塘里。
text.progress: Did you destroy the blighted eggs?
text.completion: You have our thanks, sister.  We cannot allow our valiant traditions to be corrupted.
text.completed: Return to Thyra Kvinnshal at Brunnhildar Village in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: Aberrations
english.objectives: Thyra Kvinnshal in Brunnhildar Village wants you to go to Valkyrion and obtain Vials of Frost Oil from the Valkyrion Aspirants.  Use the Vials of Frost Oil to destroy 30 Plagued Proto-Drake Eggs.
english.description: The Lich King sent emissaries to us on three different occasions.  All three were promptly dismembered.$B$BOur sisters in Valkyrion were not as dedicated to our traditions and accepted the Scourge's advances.  Now instead of capturing their drakes from the wild, they raise them from the blight and filth that the Scourge wallow in.$B$BTake the frost oil that the Valkyrion Hyldnir carry on them and use it to freeze any blighted eggs you find.  Rumors speak of a fetid pool of blight where the eggs are kept.
english.progress: Did you destroy the blighted eggs?
english.completion: You have our thanks, sister.  We cannot allow our valiant traditions to be corrupted.
english.completed: Return to Thyra Kvinnshal at Brunnhildar Village in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 拼图游戏
text.objectives: 使用布莱恩的通讯器联络布莱恩·铜须，并了解下一步的行动计划。
text.description: 我们发现铁矮人和他们控制的构造体正在与某种石头生物及其巨人盟友作战。布莱恩将这种石头生物称为土灵。我希望你能联络一下布莱恩，尽可能地帮助他。记住，他的调查结果或许能帮助我们击败铁矮人和他们的主子。
text.progress: Did you complete the disk?
text.completion: That was quick! Now that we have the disk, we have to find out how to use it to unlock the first half of the archive key.
text.completed: Use Brann's Communicator to contact Brann Bronzebeard.$B$BIf you lose Brann's Communicator, speak to Moteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site to replace it.

english.title: Pieces of the Puzzle
english.objectives: Use Brann's Communicator to contact Brann Bronzebeard and find out what to do next.
english.description: We've seen the iron dwarves and their constructs making war on the creatures of stone that Brann calls the earthen, along with their giant allies. Contact him and aid him in any way you can, and remember that anything we can learn from his search may aid us in fighting against the iron dwarves and their master.
english.progress: Did you complete the disk?
english.completion: That was quick! Now that we have the disk, we have to find out how to use it to unlock the first half of the archive key.
english.completed: Use Brann's Communicator to contact Brann Bronzebeard.$B$BIf you lose Brann's Communicator, speak to Moteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site to replace it.

text.title: 采集数据
text.objectives: 使用创世者的圆盘，从数据库中获得7条秘密数据。
text.description: 你拼出来的那个圆盘……是空的！建造这个图书馆的守护者米米尔肯定把信息藏到了别的什么地方。去调查一下创世者的图书馆，看看里面有没有数据库之类的东西。$B$B或许这张圆盘就是干这个用的，到数据库附近去使用它看看吧。它可能就是用来读取和储存数据库信息的。试过以后再联络我，把你的发现告诉我。同时，我要开始着手寻找钥匙的另一半了。
text.progress: Did you try using the disk? What did you find?
text.completion: <Brann looks at the disk as you hold it up.>$B$BI can't tell if there's anything stored there or not, $g lad:lass;. You'll have to tell me what happened.$B$B<You describe the data retrieval process.>$B$BSo it worked? At least we can count on Keeper Mimir to be systematic.
text.completed: Use Brann's Communicator to contact Brann Bronzebeard.$B$BIf you lose Brann's Communicator, speak to Morteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site to replace it.

english.title: Data Mining
english.objectives: Use the Inventor's Disk to retrieve 7 pieces of Hidden Data from the Databanks.
english.description: That disk you assembled... it's blank! Keeper Mimir, the tinker who built this library, must've hidden the information elsewhere. Look around the Inventor's Library; do you see any databanks there?$B$BThat might be the disk's purpose. Try using it near some of those databanks. Perhaps it's set to retrieve and store information from them. After you've tried your hand at that, contact me again and let me know what you've found. Meanwhile, I'll be trying to track down the other half of the archive key.
english.progress: Did you try using the disk? What did you find?
english.completion: <Brann looks at the disk as you hold it up.>$B$BI can't tell if there's anything stored there or not, $g lad:lass;. You'll have to tell me what happened.$B$B<You describe the data retrieval process.>$B$BSo it worked? At least we can count on Keeper Mimir to be systematic.
english.completed: Use Brann's Communicator to contact Brann Bronzebeard.$B$BIf you lose Brann's Communicator, speak to Morteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site to replace it.

text.title: 诺甘农之壳
text.objectives: 从档案员麦卡顿那里拿到诺甘农之壳。
text.description: 正在为创世者的圆盘充能。$B$B已完成充能。$B$B准备启动紧急协议：伽玛。$B$B紧急协议已加载。请使用已充能的圆盘激活诺甘农之壳的守护者，档案员麦卡顿。在确认了你的身份之后，档案员会交出诺甘农之壳。$B$B祝你愉快一千年。
text.progress: Did you find Norgannon's shell?
text.completion: That's it! That's the first half of Norgannon's keystone. Well done, $N. I've had Archaeologist Andorin on the lookout for clues to the shell's whereabouts for a long time. He's never going to believe me when I tell him it was an intrepid $r who found it instead.
text.completed: Use Brann's Communicator to contact Brann Bronzebeard.$B$BIf you lose Brann's Communicator, speak to Morteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site to replace it.

english.title: Norgannon's Shell
english.objectives: Recover Norgannon's Shell from Archivist Mechaton.
english.description: Charging inventor's disk.$B$BDisk charging completed.$B$BPreparing emergency protocol gamma.$B$BEmergency protocol loaded. Please use the charged disk to activate the guardian of Norgannon's shell, Archivist Mechaton. The archivist will release the shell once your identity has been verified.$B$BPlease have a pleasant millennium.
english.progress: Did you find Norgannon's shell?
english.completion: That's it! That's the first half of Norgannon's keystone. Well done, $N. I've had Archaeologist Andorin on the lookout for clues to the shell's whereabouts for a long time. He's never going to believe me when I tell him it was an intrepid $r who found it instead.
english.completed: Use Brann's Communicator to contact Brann Bronzebeard.$B$BIf you lose Brann's Communicator, speak to Morteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site to replace it.

starters.name: 创世者的图书馆控制台

text.title: 奥杜尔的土灵
text.objectives: 与布德克拉格庇护所的塑石者布德克拉格谈一谈。
text.description: 土灵建造了奥杜尔，并在那里快乐地生活着。直到有一天，洛肯占领整座城市，把他们赶出了家园。从那时起，他的铁矮人随从们就一直在无情地向流亡的土灵发动攻击。$B$B他们现在躲藏在创世者的图书馆西面的山坡上，以古老的泰坦建筑为家，他们把那里称为布德克拉格庇护所。布德克拉格和他的同胞英勇地抵挡着妄图侵入庇护所的铁矮人，不过他们这样坚持不了多久的。去找到他们，帮助他们，$n。
text.completion: So you know Brann Bronzebeard, then? He is our closest ally among those of the flesh. We are as brothers in the struggle against Loken and his followers, in the struggle for Ulduar.

english.title: The Earthen of Ulduar
english.objectives: Speak with Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.
english.description: The earthen who once inhabited, built, and maintained Ulduar were ousted from their home when Loken took over the city. Since then, his iron dwarf followers have relentlessly attacked the exiles.$B$BThey have taken refuge in an old titan building, which they now call Bouldercrag's Refuge, on the face of a mountain west of the Inventor's Library. Bouldercrag and his brethren fight to keep the irons from overrunning their haven, but they cannot hold their ground long. Find and help them, $n.
english.completion: So you know Brann Bronzebeard, then? He is our closest ally among those of the flesh. We are as brothers in the struggle against Loken and his followers, in the struggle for Ulduar.

text.title: 稀有的土壤
text.objectives: 使用土灵采矿锄收集7块魔化土壤。将这些土壤和5张霜纹布交给布德克拉格庇护所的塑石者布德克拉格。
text.description: 一直以来，这些锤子只被用来敲击石头，而不是敲击铁矮人。被驱逐出奥杜尔之后，我们亲眼目睹了柔弱的伙伴一个个地死去，而我们最强壮的工匠作为战士重生。$B$B当铁矮人逼得我们节节败退时，即使最强壮的战士也无力回天。$B$B我们对伤者毫无办法，除非能有一些魔化土壤的储备。我们以前一直都是在西北方的峭壁表面上采集它们，但持续不断的战争让我们根本没有机会补充储备。你能帮助我们吗？
text.progress: Were you able to find any of the earth?
text.completion: This will allow us to patch up more of the fallen. Thank you, $N, on behalf of all who defend the refuge.
text.completed: Return to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: Rare Earth
english.objectives: Use the Earthen Mining Pick to mine 7 clumps of Enchanted Earth. Bring the earth and 5 Frostweave Cloth to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.
english.description: It seems so long ago that these hammers pounded and hewed stone instead of iron. Our expulsion from Ulduar saw the weakest of us dead and the strongest of our craftsmen reborn as warriors.$B$BAs the irons beat us back, even the strongest find themselves failing.$B$BWe can do little for the wounded, save when we have a stock of enchanted earth. We used to mine it from the deposits on the sheer cliff face to the northwest, but the constant battle has prevented us from replenishing our stock. Would you help?
english.progress: Were you able to find any of the earth?
english.completion: This will allow us to patch up more of the fallen. Thank you, $N, on behalf of all who defend the refuge.
english.completed: Return to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 反击
text.objectives: 塑石者布德克拉格希望你杀死总计10名雷铸袭击者或雷铸掠夺者，然后返回布德克拉格庇护所向他复命。
text.description: 庇护所的卫兵已经尽了最大的努力来抵挡铁矮人的攻击，但是我们仍然在节节败退。我的部下非常勇敢，但他们并非不知疲倦。如果没有增援的话，我们全面溃败恐怕只是个时间问题而已。$B$B你愿意帮我们保卫庇护所吗？这样可以会大大提升卫兵的士气，并给他们——还有我——带来发动反击的希望。$B$B消灭庇护所外面的铁矮人，以及他们的创造物。
text.progress: How goes the battle?
text.completion: You've given the defenders something to cheer about. Seeing the enemy fall by your hand has reinvigorated them and bolstered their courage.
text.completed: Return to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: Fighting Back
english.objectives: Bouldercrag the Rockshaper wants you to slay 10 Stormforged Attackers and return to him at Bouldercrag's Refuge. You may kill either Stormforged Raiders or Stormforged Reavers.
english.description: The refuge's defenders have done their best to blunt the iron dwarves' attacks, but we keep losing ground inch by inch. My men are hardy, but not tireless. Without reinforcements, it's only a matter of time until we will be overrun.$B$BWould you lend your skills to the refuge's defense? It would greatly improve the morale of the defenders and give them -- and me -- hope of mounting a counterattack.$B$BKill any of the stormforged or their creations you encounter outside the refuge.
english.progress: How goes the battle?
english.completion: You've given the defenders something to cheer about. Seeing the enemy fall by your hand has reinvigorated them and bolstered their courage.
english.completed: Return to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 痛苦斗兽场：伊戈达斯！
text.objectives: 进入痛苦斗兽场，击败伊戈达斯！回到巨魔仆从伍迪那里领取你的奖励。
text.description: 我跟你说啊，伙计，这地方和一望无际的纳格兰平原可完全不一样。这些巨魔可比食人魔脏多了！不过，有钱赚的话，谁管那么多啊！那么欢迎来到祖达克，朋友。$B$B你是新来的，我也就不多说废话了。我是比赛组织者，我旁边那个坏脾气的巨魔是我的保镖伍迪。而你是我们的娱乐对象。等你想要开始战斗了，就告诉我，我会为你安排一场比赛。$B$B那么，如果你已经准备就绪，又有一群伙伴能与你并肩而战的话，就马上开始吧！怎么样？
text.completion: Not bad, friend. You might make some gold out here - if you manage to stay alive.
text.completed: 去祖达克找痛苦斗兽场的巨魔仆从伍迪。

english.title: The Amphitheater of Anguish: Yggdras!
english.objectives: Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat Yggdras! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.
english.description: I'll tell you what, buddy, this place is a far cry from the rolling plains of Nagrand. These trolls are dirtier than ogres; but hey, I go where the gold's at! So welcome to Zul'Drak, pal.$B$BYou're new to this racket, so let me set you straight. I'm the fight promoter and this feisty troll next to me is Wodin, my bodyguard. You're the entertainment. When you wanna fight, let me know and I'll set up the match.$B$BIf you're ready and got a group of friends with you, we can start! What do you say?
english.completion: Not bad, friend. You might make some gold out here - if you manage to stay alive.
english.completed: Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant at Amphitheater of Anguish in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 痛苦斗兽场：猛犸人！
text.objectives: 进入痛苦斗兽场，击败恶臭之须！回到巨魔仆从伍迪那里领取你的奖励。
text.description: 下场比赛可非比寻常啊，伙计！显然，龙骨荒野的猛犸人也想来凑个热闹。你以前和他们交过手吗？一定要全力以赴啊！$B$B等你准备好了就告诉我，精彩的战斗马上开始！
text.completion: Wow! When I first saw Stinkbeard, I thought you were done for! Nice work!
text.completed: 去祖达克找痛苦斗兽场的巨魔仆从伍迪。

english.title: The Amphitheater of Anguish: Magnataur!
english.objectives: Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat Stinkbeard! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.
english.description: This next match is a doozy, buddy! Apparently some magnataur from the Dragonblight wants a piece of the action. You ever fought one of those before? All I can tell you is to aim high!$B$BWe'll get this party started when you give me the word.
english.completion: Wow! When I first saw Stinkbeard, I thought you were done for! Nice work!
english.completed: Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant at Amphitheater of Anguish in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 痛苦斗兽场：异界的对手！
text.objectives: 进入痛苦斗兽场，击败一位元素领主！回到巨魔仆从伍迪那里领取你的奖励。
text.description: 我不想骗你，朋友。你很可能会输掉这一场。你的下一个对手来自元素位面，我甚至都不知道出场的会是什么样的怪物！$B$B如果你觉得自己已经准备好了，就去把它打得落花流水吧！
text.completion: Unbelievable! I thought this whole place was going to explode when it first appeared! You really dominated that round!
text.completed: 去祖达克找痛苦斗兽场的巨魔仆从伍迪。

english.title: The Amphitheater of Anguish: From Beyond!
english.objectives: Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat one of the elemental lords! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.
english.description: I'm not gonna lie to you, pal. You might be overmatched here. This next one is a being from the elemental planes! I don't even know what's gonna show up in that arena!$B$BIf you think you're up to it, get in there and give 'em hell!
english.completion: Unbelievable! I thought this whole place was going to explode when it first appeared! You really dominated that round!
english.completed: Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant at Amphitheater of Anguish in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 痛苦斗兽场：海象人的末日！
text.objectives: 进入痛苦斗兽场，击败奥里努克·碎牙！回到巨魔仆从伍迪那里领取你的奖励。
text.description: 下一个对手来自黑暗的角落，孩子。只有当你身处绝境的时候，才能感觉得到那种黑暗。他对胜利充满着渴望，为了胜利，他可以不择手段。小心！我听说他一直通过与雪怪摔跤来锻炼自己！$B$B等你准备好了，我们就开始吧。
text.completion: I was worried for a while there, $n. When he busted out the seals and penguins... Well, I didn't know what to think to be honest. It looked pretty damn ridiculous.
text.completed: 去祖达克找痛苦斗兽场的巨魔仆从伍迪。

english.title: The Amphitheater of Anguish: Tuskarrmageddon!
english.objectives: Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat Orinoko Tuskbreaker! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.
english.description: This next one's fightin' from a dark place, kid. The kind of dark that can only happen when you've been on the flip-side. He's hungry and willing to do whatever it takes to win. Watch yourself! I've heard he wrestles yetis for exercise!$B$BWe'll start when you're ready.
english.completion: I was worried for a while there, $n. When he busted out the seals and penguins... Well, I didn't know what to think to be honest. It looked pretty damn ridiculous.
english.completed: Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant at Amphitheater of Anguish in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 痛苦斗兽场：血怒者科尔拉克！
text.objectives: 进入痛苦斗兽场，击败血怒者科尔拉克！回到巨魔仆从伍迪那里领取你的奖励。
text.description: 你不会相信的，朋友。你的下一个对手，竟然就是血怒者科尔拉克！达卡莱巨魔似乎使出杀手锏了！我跟你说啊，伙计，他一直都在吸收动物之神的力量。这家伙非常强壮，已经准备要把你打扁了。$B$B你准备好了吗？
text.completion: Damn, I remember Korrak from way back in my younger days when I used to work for the Frostwolf Clan. He would never shut up! I think you just did the world a great service, $n.
text.completed: 去祖达克找痛苦斗兽场的巨魔仆从伍迪。

english.title: The Amphitheater of Anguish: Korrak the Bloodrager!
english.objectives: Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat Korrak the Bloodrager! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.
english.description: You're not gonna believe this, pal. Your next fight is against Korrak the Bloodrager! Looks like the Drakkari trolls are pulling a power play! And let me tell you, buddy, he's been sippin' the animal god juice. He's good and ready to pound you into the ground.$B$BAre you ready?
english.completion: Damn, I remember Korrak from way back in my younger days when I used to work for the Frostwolf Clan. He would never shut up! I think you just did the world a great service, $n.
english.completed: Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant at Amphitheater of Anguish in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 救死扶伤
text.objectives: 使用土质药膏治疗8名倒下的土灵防御者，然后返回布德克拉格庇护所，向塑石者布德克拉格复命。
text.description: 庇护所的卫兵非常勇敢，但他们也抵挡不住铁矮人无休止的冲击。$B$B有了你找来的土壤，我可以制造绷带来治疗受伤的卫兵。被我们救治的卫兵越多，我们所能坚持的时间就越久。$b$b拿上这些药膏，用它们去治疗庇护所外面受伤的卫兵，尽可能多救几个人回来，$n。每一个卫兵的伤亡都是我们的重大损失。
text.progress: Have you healed the fallen defenders?
text.completion: The warriors that you've healed will aid us in holding the line even longer. If we are to truly be free of the iron threat, we must find a way to strike at them behind the lines.
text.completed: Return to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: Relief for the Fallen
english.objectives: Use the Telluric Poultice to heal 8 Fallen Earthen Defenders, then return to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.
english.description: The refuge's defenders fight bravely, but they cannot keep up with the iron onslaught.$B$BWith the earth you collected, I can make bandages to help heal the wounds of some of the fallen. The more defenders we can patch up, the longer we'll last out there.$B$BTake these poultices and use them to heal the wounds of the fallen defenders outside the refuge. Get as many back into the battle as possible, $n. Every casualty is one too many.
english.progress: Have you healed the fallen defenders?
english.completion: The warriors that you've healed will aid us in holding the line even longer. If we are to truly be free of the iron threat, we must find a way to strike at them behind the lines.
english.completed: Return to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge in The Storm Peaks.

objectiveDetails.description: 救治倒下的土灵防御者

text.title: 公爵
text.objectives: 与暗影拱顶的兰克拉尔公爵谈一谈。
text.description: 我们需要你的帮助，$n。眼下我们艰难地保住了暗影拱顶，但是如你所见，巫妖王已经大发雷霆了。$B$B<男爵笑了起来。>$B$B我要你去和兰克拉尔公爵谈一谈，现在他是这里的指挥官。公爵应该就在拱顶里面。$B$B别让他久等。
text.completion: It's a pleasure to finally meet you, $n. We owe you a great deal, but we're not done with you yet.$b$bThere is a vrykul city just over the mountains to the west, a place called Jotunheim.$b$bThe vrykul there are in a constant state of challenge to 'ascend'. The winners go to Ymirheim to serve as the Lich King's elite warrior caste, the Ymirjar, and the losers are reduced to Scourged Vargul.$b$bYou are going to be my instrument to see to it that more Vargul than Ymirjar emerge.

english.title: The Duke
english.objectives: Speak with Duke Lankral at The Shadow Vault.
english.description: We need you focused, $n. We're barely holding The Shadow Vault as it is. As you can see, we've greatly angered the Lich King.$B$B<The baron chuckles.>$B$BI need you to speak with Duke Lankral. He's in charge here now. You'll find him inside the vault building proper.$B$BWere I you, I would not keep him waiting.
english.completion: It's a pleasure to finally meet you, $n. We owe you a great deal, but we're not done with you yet.$b$bThere is a vrykul city just over the mountains to the west, a place called Jotunheim.$b$bThe vrykul there are in a constant state of challenge to 'ascend'. The winners go to Ymirheim to serve as the Lich King's elite warrior caste, the Ymirjar, and the losers are reduced to Scourged Vargul.$b$bYou are going to be my instrument to see to it that more Vargul than Ymirjar emerge.

text.title: 荣耀的挑战
text.objectives: 暗影拱顶的兰克拉尔公爵要你使用挑战之旗向6名尤尔丁格斗者发起挑战，并击败他们。
text.description: 首先，我们要前往尤顿海姆城中一个被称为野蛮之台的地方，就在西边的山上。$B$B维库人战士总是在那里练习格斗技巧，在他们领主的亲信们的指导下不断精进。$B$B我要你带着这面旗帜去向他们挑战，用$r的“小把戏”去挫一挫他们的锐气，如何？$B$B<公爵咧嘴一笑，他那腐烂的牙齿在昏暗的光线中闪闪发光。>
text.progress: Perhaps you could go back and challenge a few more?
text.completion: Already I'm hearing reports of the prowess you displayed on the Savage Ledge. Excellent, $n... excellent!$b$b$b$bAnd now I think it's time to issue a decree to the thane of those vrykul that you so easily defeated.
text.completed: Return to Duke Lankral at The Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

english.title: Honor Challenge
english.objectives: Duke Lankral at The Shadow Vault has asked you to use the Challenge Flag to challenge and defeat 6 Mjordin Combatants.
english.description: The first step we're going to take is at a place in Jotunheim called the Savage Ledge. It's just over the mountains to the west.$B$BOn the ledge the vrykul warriors are always sparring, being instructed in the finer arts of battle by their thane's men.$B$BI want you to take this flag and issue a challenge to a number of them. Let's demoralize them with the 'mere' skills of a $r, shall we?$B$B<The duke grins, his rotting teeth flashing in the dim light of the vault.>
english.progress: Perhaps you could go back and challenge a few more?
english.completion: Already I'm hearing reports of the prowess you displayed on the Savage Ledge. Excellent, $n... excellent!$b$b$b$bAnd now I think it's time to issue a decree to the thane of those vrykul that you so easily defeated.
english.completed: Return to Duke Lankral at The Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

text.title: 黑暗的羽翼
text.objectives: 布伦希尔达村的复仇者伊芬要你去瓦基里安杀死12个初生的瓦格里。
text.description: 叛徒。我们海德尼尔人绝对不会怜悯这种渣滓。$B$B瓦基里安的那帮家伙已经逍遥法外太久了。我们依然忠于托里姆，而她们却成了巫妖王的走狗！$B$B她们把那些接受了巫妖王恩典的人称为“瓦格里”。她们长着羽翼，就像鹰身人一样。$B$B瓦基里安就在遥远的西北方，比风暴神殿更遥远的地方。去杀死那些长着翅膀的母狼吧，姐妹。杀了她们，我会奖励你一件我最珍贵的宝物。
text.progress: Did you punish our wayward brethren?
text.completion: The val'kyr are nothing but the Lich King's lapdogs.  They will be put down like the scum they are.  They've made their choice, now they have to live with the consequences.
text.completed: Return to Iva the Vengeful at Brunnhildar Village in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: Off With Their Black Wings
english.objectives: Iva the Vengeful in Brunnhildar Village wants you to go to Valkyrion and slay 12 Nascent Val'kyr.
english.description: Traitors.  We Hyldnir have little love for them.$B$BThe dwellers of Valkyrion have gone unpunished for far too long.  While we remained loyal to Thorim, they became the Lich King's lapdogs!$B$BThey call the ones who receive his gift val'kyr.  They fly on feathered wings, like the harpies they are.$B$BYou will find Valkyrion far to the northwest, beyond the Temple of Storms.  Slay these winged she-wolves, sister.  Slay them and I will reward you with one of my most prized possessions.
english.progress: Did you punish our wayward brethren?
english.completion: The val'kyr are nothing but the Lich King's lapdogs.  They will be put down like the scum they are.  They've made their choice, now they have to live with the consequences.
english.completed: Return to Iva the Vengeful at Brunnhildar Village in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 暗影拱顶裁决令
text.objectives: 暗影拱顶的兰克拉尔公爵命令你向强大的乌弗朗领主宣读暗影拱顶裁决令，然后杀死他。
text.description: 强大的乌弗朗领主就坐在野蛮之台旁边的大厅里。我研究过他的资料，这是一个极具耐心和战略头脑的维库人。他喜欢等待时机速战速决，不喜欢搞持久战斗。$B$B我要除掉他！$B$B我已经写好了他的裁决令，去当着他的面大声宣读吧。$B$B<公爵开心地扬起了眉毛。>$B$B至少……这样可以让他失去勇气。
text.progress: My scouts inform me that Ufrang yet lives.$B$BDo you not know how to read, $r?
text.completion: <Duke Lankral nods his approval at your report of success.>$b$bWe face a foe that dwarfs us, not only in stature, but also numerically. If we are to win the battle for Icecrown, we must outthink them!$b$bWith Ufrang dead, that gives us an advantage in Jotunheim. Let us see if we can capitalize on it.
text.completed: Return to Duke Lankral at The Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

english.title: Shadow Vault Decree
english.objectives: Duke Lankral at The Shadow Vault has ordered you to read the Shadow Vault Decree in the presence of Thane Ufrang the Mighty, and then to slay him.
english.description: Thane Ufrang the Mighty sits within his hall overlooking the Savage Ledge. I've studied him. The thane is a patient vrykul, with a head for strategy and warfare. He's also shown a penchant for biding his time and not wanting to overplay his hand in the ongoing battle.$B$BI need him dead!$B$BI've written a decree. Stand before the thane and read it aloud.$B$B<The duke arches his eyebrow in amusement.>$B$BIt should... unnerve him at the least.
english.progress: My scouts inform me that Ufrang yet lives.$B$BDo you not know how to read, $r?
english.completion: <Duke Lankral nods his approval at your report of success.>$b$bWe face a foe that dwarfs us, not only in stature, but also numerically. If we are to win the battle for Icecrown, we must outthink them!$b$bWith Ufrang dead, that gives us an advantage in Jotunheim. Let us see if we can capitalize on it.
english.completed: Return to Duke Lankral at The Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

text.title: 痛苦斗兽场的冠军
text.objectives: 进入痛苦斗兽场，击败屠夫乌拉多弗！回到巨魔仆从伍迪那里领取你的奖励。
text.description: 最后一场了，我的朋友！你的最后一个对手将是你最大的挑战。他是来自冰冠冰川平原上的维库人战士，对鲜血充满着渴求！打败他，痛苦斗兽场冠军的桂冠就是你的啦！这场战斗会让我们两个都大发横财的！$B$B等你准备好了之后就告诉我吧！
text.completion: You did it, $n! That was the most exciting fight yet! What are you going to do with your winnings? Me? I'm going to Dalaran and blowing it all in the Underbelly. Lot of hot action going on down there!
text.completed: 去祖达克找痛苦斗兽场的巨魔仆从伍迪。

english.title: The Champion of Anguish
english.objectives: Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat Vladof the Butcher! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.
english.description: This is the end, my friend! Your last opponent is going to be your greatest challenge. He's a vrykul champion from the steppes of Icecrown and he's out for blood! Defeat him and you'll be crowned the champion of the Amphitheater of Anguish! This fight is going to make us both rich!$B$BLet me know when you're ready and we'll start.
english.completion: You did it, $n! That was the most exciting fight yet! What are you going to do with your winnings? Me? I'm going to Dalaran and blowing it all in the Underbelly. Lot of hot action going on down there!
english.completed: Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant at Amphitheater of Anguish in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 夺取钥匙
text.objectives: 乌弗朗之厅里面的被折磨的维林要求你去夺取维林的锁链钥匙。
text.description: $C，解开这副枷锁的钥匙就挂在教官霍加尔的脖子上，他就在外面。$B$B你能去把钥匙拿过来给我吗？
text.progress: Do you have it?
text.completion: Thank you, $r. Just hand me the key, I'll take care of it myself.
text.completed: Return to Vaelen the Flayed at The Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

english.title: Get the Key
english.objectives: Vaelen the Flayed at Ufrang's Hall has asked you to retrieve the Key to Vaelen's Chains.
english.description: $C, the key to my shackles is hanging around the neck of Instructor Hroegar outside.$B$BPerhaps you could retrieve it by separating his head from his shoulders?
english.progress: Do you have it?
english.completion: Thank you, $r. Just hand me the key, I'll take care of it myself.
english.completed: Return to Vaelen the Flayed at The Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

text.title: 通知男爵
text.objectives: 与暗影拱顶的斯利文男爵谈一谈。
text.description: 你现在最重要的任务就是返回暗影拱顶，把我失败的消息告诉斯利文男爵。$B$B你看到了，这些维库恶棍抓住的不止我一个人。我的整个死亡骑士小队都被抓了。$B$B我本该在陷阱发动前就发现异常的，但现在后悔也来不及了。$B$B快跑吧，别像我们一样被抓住了！
text.completion: What?! We can ill-afford to lose one death knight, let alone an entire contingent!!!

english.title: Let the Baron Know
english.objectives: Speak with Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault.
english.description: The most important thing that you can do right now is to return to The Shadow Vault and let Baron Sliver know that I've failed.$B$BYou see, I wasn't the only one captured by these vrykul devils. My entire contingent of death knights was also taken.$B$BI should have seen the trap before it was sprung, but there's no use crying over spilled milk now is there?$B$BGo on before you get captured, too! I'll see you back at the vault.
english.completion: What?! We can ill-afford to lose one death knight, let alone an entire contingent!!!

text.title: Gem Perfection
text.objectives: Return two Huge Citrines, two Dark Jade and two Shadow Crystals to Carter Tiffens in Vengeance Landing.
text.description: My skills are going to waste in this wretched place.   I spent many years learning to cut gems into their perfect form and have nothing to work on!   You look like the type who may be able to find me some gems and if you do I can teach you the skill of gem perfection.   This will allow you to sometimes cut a perfect gem with increased bonuses when cutting a uncommon quality gem from Northrend.
text.progress: These will do. I shall teach you the skills of gem perfection.
text.completion: These will have to do. I can teach you the art of gemcutting perfection, and give you proof of my skills as well.
text.completed: Return to Carter Tiffens at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.

This will allow you to sometimes cut a perfect gem with increased bonuses when cutting a uncommon quality gem from Northrend.

english.completion: These will have to do. I can teach you the art of gemcutting perfection, and give you proof of my skills as well.
