english.completion: Lissen up, mon. Dere be dangerous work ta be done!

text.title: For Posterity
text.objectives: Chronicler Bah'Kini at Dubra'Jin wants you to enter Gundrak and collect 6 Drakkari History Tablets.
text.description: Gundrak be doomed, mon.$b$bHistory be repeatin' itself before our eyes. When trolls be turnin' on their own gods, the end be certain. It just be a matter of time.$b$bPerhaps if we can record the events clearly, we might prevent future generations from traveling down da same path.$b$bIf you be havin' the courage, enter Gundrak and search for clues to what brought the Drakkari Empire to such an end as dis.
text.progress: You find da Drakkari history tablets, mon?
text.completion: <Bah'Kini scans the engraved tablets for a moment, then turns her attention back to you.>$b$bDese be authentic, $r. I'll be placin' dem in their proper place in my collection.$b$bPerhaps we can finally be puttin' an end to dis behavior.
text.completed: Return to Chronicler Bah'Kini at Dubra'Jin in Zul'Drak.

english.objectives: Chronicler Bah'Kini at Dubra'Jin wants you to enter Gundrak and collect 6 Drakkari History Tablets.
english.description: Gundrak be doomed, mon.$b$bHistory be repeatin' itself before our eyes. When trolls be turnin' on their own gods, the end be certain. It just be a matter of time.$b$bPerhaps if we can record the events clearly, we might prevent future generations from traveling down da same path.$b$bIf you be havin' the courage, enter Gundrak and search for clues to what brought the Drakkari Empire to such an end as dis.
english.progress: You find da Drakkari history tablets, mon?
english.completion: <Bah'Kini scans the engraved tablets for a moment, then turns her attention back to you.>$b$bDese be authentic, $r. I'll be placin' dem in their proper place in my collection.$b$bPerhaps we can finally be puttin' an end to dis behavior.
english.completed: Return to Chronicler Bah'Kini at Dubra'Jin in Zul'Drak.

text.title: Just Checkin'
text.objectives: To'kini wants you to speak to Bah'kini at Dubra'Jin.
text.description: There have been fearsome sounds echoing from Gundrak. They have been increasing in volume and frequency of late.$b$bMy long-time student is currently recording events from her post just west of Gundrak. Perhaps you could find the time to check in on her for me?
text.completion: Long-time student? Hah!$b$bIf by long-time ya mean my whole life, den I suppose dat be accurate.$b$bTo'kini be my cowardly father - too fearful to take up a position so near Gundrak... so he sent me!

english.title: Just Checkin'

text.title: 魔法蘑菇肉片
text.objectives: 将2块冰冷的肉和采自达拉然下水道的4枚魔法蘑菇放在你的煎肉锅中，烹制成一份魔法蘑菇肉片，然后将其带到达拉然的鲁因广场，交给摩尔珍品店中的奥尔顿·本内特。
text.description: 我们手上有一份重要的订单！摩尔珍品店的奥尔顿·本内特点了一份蘑菇肉片。$B$B到达拉然下水道里去，采集几枚魔法蘑菇，然后把它们跟一些冰冷的肉放在一起烘烤，做好之后立即把它给奥尔顿送去。
text.progress: Do you have any food for me?$B$BI never seem to be able to get away from the shop, even for a minute.
text.completion: This looks great!  Thanks!
text.completed: Speak to Orton Bennet at Curiosities & Moore in Dalaran.

english.title: Infused Mushroom Meatloaf
english.objectives: Use your Meatloaf Pan to cook 4 Infused Mushrooms and 2 Chilled Meats and bring the finished Mushroom Meatloaf to Orton Bennet in Curiosities & Moore, located in Runeweaver Square in Dalaran.
english.description: We have an important order that needs to go out!  Orton Bennet in Curiosities & Moore needs a mushroom meatloaf.$B$BGet some infused mushrooms found in the Dalaran sewers, chilled meat, and cook them in this meatloaf pan.  When you're done, deliver the cooked meatloaf to Orton.
english.progress: Do you have any food for me?$B$BI never seem to be able to get away from the shop, even for a minute.
english.completion: This looks great!  Thanks!
english.completed: Speak to Orton Bennet at Curiosities & Moore in Dalaran.

text.title: 魔术旅馆的集会
text.objectives: 将4份诺森德炖肉和从一壶达拉然的奶酪店中取来的葡萄酒带到达拉然的鲁因广场，交给魔术旅馆中的埃里雷。
text.description: 魔术旅馆的埃里雷正在筹备一场集会，还要摆出筵席来款待他的客人！$B$B你要为他准备一些诺森德炖肉和一壶来自达拉然市中心的“再来一杯”奶酪店的酒，那里的店主欠我一瓶酒，你应该可以在奶酪店里的某处找到酒。$B$B把酒和炖肉一起交给埃里雷。
text.progress: Where is my food, I will have conventioneers here any minute!
text.completion: This is plenty of food for everyone!  I am sure the customers will be pleased.
text.completed: Speak to Arille Azuregaze at Legerdemain Lounge in Dalaran.

english.title: Convention at the Legerdemain
english.objectives: Bring 4 Northern Stew that you use your cooking skill to make and a Jug of Wine from the cheese shop in Dalaran to Arille Azuregaze at the Legerdemain Lounge found in Runeweaver Square in Dalaran.
english.description: Arille Azuregaze at the Legerdemain Lounge has a convention coming in and needs a feast pronto!$B$BYou need to provide some Northern Stew and a Jug of Wine from the cheese shop "One More Glass" in central Dalaran.  The owner of the cheese shop owes me the wine and you should find it somewhere around the shop.$B$BBring the wine and stews to Arille.
english.progress: Where is my food, I will have conventioneers here any minute!
english.completion: This is plenty of food for everyone!  I am sure the customers will be pleased.
english.completed: Speak to Arille Azuregaze at Legerdemain Lounge in Dalaran.

text.title: 下水道炖肉
text.objectives: 将4根采自晶歌森林的晶歌胡萝卜与4块冰冷的肉放在炖肉锅里进行烹饪。$B$B炖好之后，将萝卜炖肉交给达拉然下水道的旅店老板埃因·格林。
text.description: 达拉然下水道的旅店中食物短缺，该店的老板埃因·格林需要一份萝卜炖肉来款待他的顾客。$B$B到晶歌森林去采集4根晶歌胡萝卜，把它们和4块冰冷的肉一起炖了。$B$B你可以通过鲁因广场东边的传送间前往晶歌森林。$B$B等你准备好了萝卜炖肉之后，就把它交给埃因。
text.progress: I've got hungry people down here!  We need some stew.
text.completion: This will be consumed in no time!   Thanks!
text.completed: Speak to Ajay Green at Cantrips & Crows in the Underbelly of Dalaran.

english.title: Sewer Stew
english.objectives: Cook 4 Crystalsong Carrots from Crystalsong Forest with 4 Chilled Meat in the Cookpot.$B$BOnce it is ready bring the Vegetable Stew to the Dalaran sewers Innkeeper Ajay Green.
english.description: Ajay Green the innkeeper in the Dalaran sewers needs a vegetable stew for his customers as they are running low on food down there.$B$BCollect 4 Crystalsong Carrots from the Crystalsong Forest and cook them together with 4 Chilled Meat.$B$B You can get to the Crystalsong Forest from the portal chamber in the eastern corner of Runeweaver Square.$B$BOnce the vegetable stew is ready, bring it to Ajay.
english.progress: I've got hungry people down here!  We need some stew.
english.completion: This will be consumed in no time!   Thanks!
english.completed: Speak to Ajay Green at Cantrips & Crows in the Underbelly of Dalaran.

text.title: Cheese for Glowergold
text.objectives: Combine the Empty Cheese Platter with Aged Dalaran Limburger from the cheese shop "One More Glass" and with 6 Half Full Dalaran Wine Glasses found on tables around Dalaran.$B$BBring the Wine and Cheese platter to Ranid Glowergold at the Leatherworkers in the Magus Commerce Exchange.
text.description: Ranid Glowergold in the Leatherworkers shop in Dalaran has had a sudden craving for wine and cheese.$B$BCollect cheese which is on the shelf at "One More Glass" in central Dalaran and half full wine glasses found on tables all over the city.  Pour the wine together into a bottle and serve it with the cheese to Ranid.$B$BWe don't think he will know the difference.
text.progress: Have you seen a servant with my wine and cheese platter.   I am quite peckish!
text.completion: Aha, this appears to be a fine vintage!
text.completed: Speak to Ranid Glowergold at Legendary Leathers in Dalaran.

text.title: 再次前往突破口吧，英雄
text.objectives: 前往回音谷，向突破口外面的黑锋观察者报到。
text.description: 前线基地很安全，朋友。我们再次掌握了回音谷的控制权，并摧毁了封住突破口的层层蛛网。现在，是时候攻下天灾城，在冰冠冰川内建起我们的营地了。战线正在向前推进！$B$B我已经向黑锋观察者发出请求，让他协助我们攻打天灾城。他对天灾军团非常了解，这对战事是至关重要的。$B$B往西北方走，到突破口外面的帐篷处向他报到吧。
text.completion: My knowledge of Scourge tactics is without equal.$B$B<The Ebon Watcher peers at you.>$B$BBefore the battle for Light's Hope Chapel, my knights and I served under the Lich King - his icy grasp controlling our every action. The light of dawn changed everything...

english.title: Once More Unto The Breach, Hero
english.objectives: Report to the Ebon Watcher in the Valley of Echoes just outside the Breach.
english.description: The Vanguard is secure, ally. We have reclaimed the Valley of Echoes and taken down the web walls blocking entry to the Breach. Now is the time to strike at Scourgeholme and establish our presence inside Icecrown. The battlefront moves on!$B$BI have asked the Ebon Watcher for his assistance with our assault upon Scourgeholme. His intimate knowledge of the Scourge will be invaluable in our effort.$B$BGo now and report to him at the tent outside of the Breach, northwest of here.
english.completion: My knowledge of Scourge tactics is without equal.$B$B<The Ebon Watcher peers at you.>$B$BBefore the battle for Light's Hope Chapel, my knights and I served under the Lich King - his icy grasp controlling our every action. The light of dawn changed everything...

Koltira aids the Horde upon the gunship, Orgrim's Hammer, while Thassarian assists the Alliance aboard the Skybreaker. The Ebon Blade will soon wash over Icecrown and leave the armies of the Lich King in ruin.

text.title: 黑色观察站
text.objectives: 前往黑色观察站，与黑暗骑士阿尔蕾谈一谈。
text.description: 天灾军团设立了一处名叫缝合场的大型实验地，专门用来制造憎恶和血肉巨人。如果我们摧毁了缝合场，巫妖王的军队数量就能锐减。$B$B我已经派黑暗骑士阿尔蕾去了那里。她在科雷萨以西一处俯瞰缝合场的山脊上建立了一座小营地，黑色观察站。据说银色北伐军也派了专员去那里协调事务，但是黑暗骑士知道该怎么做。去找她吧。
text.completion: Good. We'll need all the help we can get. Olakin here is the Argent Crusade's contribution to our effort. Let's cut the chatter and get down to the business of denying the Scourge their armies of the flesh.

english.title: Blackwatch
english.objectives: Speak to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch in Icecrown.
english.description: The Scourge has a large facility called the Fleshwerks, dedicated to producing abominations and flesh giants. If we can shut it down, we can deprive the Lich King of a large component of his armies.$B$BI've sent Darkrider Arly to the area. She has a small base, Blackwatch, on a ridge overlooking the Fleshwerks and to the west of Corp'rethar. I'm told the Argent Crusade is sending someone to coordinate their efforts there, but the darkrider will know what to do. Find and assist her.
english.completion: Good. We'll need all the help we can get. Olakin here is the Argent Crusade's contribution to our effort. Let's cut the chatter and get down to the business of denying the Scourge their armies of the flesh.

text.title: 荠菜热狗！
text.objectives: 在空午餐篮里装入你烹制的4份犀牛热狗，外加你在达拉然草地上找到的4片野芥菜。$B$B将芥菜热狗篮交给达拉然城克拉苏斯平台的大法师伯塔鲁斯。
text.description: 大法师伯塔鲁斯正准备去观看他最喜爱的战球比赛，不过他需要一些供旅途中享用的食物。$B$B你要准备4份犀牛热狗，然后从达拉然的草地上摘4片野荠菜，把它们放进他的午餐篮里。$B$B把午餐篮交给他，这样他就可以出发去观看精彩的比赛了。
text.progress: I am almost ready to go, I just need the food and for my mates... er... my fellow mages to arrive.
text.completion: Perfect!  I just hope the Dalaran Destroyers finally win one!
text.completed: Speak to Archmage Pentarus at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran.

english.title: Mustard Dogs!
english.objectives: Fill the Empty Picnic Basket with 4 Rhino Dogs that you cook with your cooking skill and 4 Wild Mustard that you find in the grassy areas of Dalaran.$B$BBring the Picnic Basket to Archmage Pentarus at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran.
english.description: Archmage Pentarus likes to watch the occasional game of battle ball and is preparing to go, but needs food for the trip.$B$BYou need to fill his picnic basket with 4 rhino dogs that you cook and then 4 wild mustard that are found in grassy areas of the city.$B$BBring him his picnic basket so he can be ready to go see the big game.
english.progress: I am almost ready to go, I just need the food and for my mates... er... my fellow mages to arrive.
english.completion: Perfect!  I just hope the Dalaran Destroyers finally win one!
english.completed: Speak to Archmage Pentarus at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran.

text.title: Whatever it Takes!
text.objectives: King Jokkum in Dun Niffelem wants you to enter the Halls of Lightning and defeat Loken. You are then to return to King Jokkum with Loken's Tongue.
text.description: One way or another, Loken shall fall.$b$bIf I have to rip him limb from limb myself, he soon shall pay for his wretched deeds.$b$bShould you meet with him before I do, the honor and glory of his defeat shall be yours.$b$bReturn to me with his lying tongue, and earn my blessing and gratitude.
text.progress: Has justice been brought to Loken?
text.completion: That vile worm is dead?$b$bYou have turned out to be a great boon to my people, little $r.$b$bPlease accept this gift in return for your loyal friendship.
text.completed: Return to King Jokkum at Dun Niffelem in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: Diametrically Opposed
text.objectives: King Jokkum at Dun Niffelem wants you to enter the Halls of Lightning and defeat Volkhan.
text.description: I shall speak plainly to you, little $r. My people have not been the same since our ties with Thorim were severed.$b$bAs their leader, I wish nothing more than for their hearts to be mended and our friendship with the Stormlord to be renewed. In your defeat of Fjorn, a step has been taken down that path. I would have you bring us a step further...$b$bIn the Halls of Lightning, one even greater than Fjorn sits in opposition to our existence. Volkhan will not rest until either he, or we, are no more.
text.progress: Has Volkhan been extinguished, little $r?
text.completion: Volkhan shall haunt the dreams of my people no more.$b$bContinue your efforts, little $r. In time, I am certain my people will grow to forgive Thorim.
text.completed: Return to King Jokkum at Dun Niffelem in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 永不安息的亡者
text.objectives: 冰冠冰川回音谷的古斯塔夫神父要你对复活的北伐军战士的尸体使用圣水，解放10个永不安息的灵魂。
text.description: 并非所有的北伐军战士都活着走出了天灾城。很多人被杀害了，变成了扭曲的怪物。这就是天灾军团的行事方法。被诅咒的灵魂永远也无法享受安宁，除非我们想办法让他们安息。$B$B穿过突破口，进入天灾城，杀死那些被天灾军团复活的北伐军战士。然后将圣水撒在他们的骸骨上，以此解放他们的灵魂。
text.progress: It is a grim task, $N, but it must be done.
text.completion: The path of the righteous crusader is one beset by inequity and evil. To cut through the middle is the only salvation. You have done that on this day and much more.
text.completed: Return to Father Gustav at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown.

english.title: The Restless Dead
english.objectives: Father Gustav at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown wants you to use Holy Water on the corpses of Reanimated Crusaders to free 10 restless souls.
english.description: Not all of our soldiers made it out of Scourgeholme. Many were slain and turned into twisted reflections of their former selves. Such is the way of the Scourge. For those damned souls, there is no eternal peace. We must provide their souls rest.$B$BTravel through the Breach into Scourgeholme and slay the skeletal reanimated crusaders. Sprinkle this holy water on their bones so that their spirits may be freed.
english.progress: It is a grim task, $N, but it must be done.
english.completion: The path of the righteous crusader is one beset by inequity and evil. To cut through the middle is the only salvation. You have done that on this day and much more.
english.completed: Return to Father Gustav at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown.

text.title: One of a Kind
text.objectives: Chronicler Bah'Kini at Dubra'Jin wants you to enter Gundrak and recover a piece of the Drakkari Colossus.
text.description: Lissen, mon.$b$bAt first glance, it be lookin' like da same old story here - trolls tappin' into forbidden powah by destroyin' da very beings dey should be worshippin'.$b$bWhile dis be true, dere be somethin' special about dese Drakkari. If what I learned be true, den inside Gundrak dere be a special golem - one like nuthin' created before!$b$bYa want adventure, mon? Go inside Gundrak and bring me back a piece from dat golem ta study.
text.progress: You get me a piece of dat golem, mon?
text.completion: Ahh, yeah mon! Dat be what I'm lookin' for.$b$bHere ya go - take somethin' nice for your troubles.
text.completed: Return to Chronicler Bah'Kini at Dubra'Jin in Zul'Drak.

text.progress: Do you have something for me?  I so rarely get away from my shop.
text.completion: Is this food from Awilo?  Can you promise me there isn't any gnome in it?
text.completed: Speak to Orton Bennet at Curiosities & Moore in Dalaran.
