english.objectives: Use your Meatloaf Pan to cook 4 Infused Mushrooms and 2 Chilled Meats and bring the finished Mushroom Meatloaf to Orton Bennet in Curiosities & Moore, located in Runeweaver Square in Dalaran.
english.description: Orton Bennet in Curiosities & Moore be needin' a mushroom meatloaf.$B$BGet ya some infused mushrooms found in the Dalaran sewers, chilled meat, and cook 'em in the meatloaf pan.  When ye be done, bring that meatloaf to Orton.$B$BIf only de council would let me serve me gnome specialty, I would show dem a real treat!
english.progress: Do you have something for me?  I so rarely get away from my shop.
english.completion: Is this food from Awilo?  Can you promise me there isn't any gnome in it?
english.completed: Speak to Orton Bennet at Curiosities & Moore in Dalaran.

text.title: 魔术旅馆的集会
text.objectives: 将4份诺森德炖肉和从一壶达拉然的奶酪店中取来的葡萄酒带到达拉然的鲁因广场，交给魔术旅馆中的埃里雷。
text.description: 你能相信吗？部落竟然宣布吃人是非法的……我告诉你，这是不对的！不过，在有订单的时候，我还是应该把注意力放在完成订单上。$B$B魔术旅馆的埃里雷那里来了许多客人。你要向他提供一些诺森德炖肉和一壶来自达拉然市中心的“再来一杯”奶酪店的酒。$B$B把酒和炖肉一起交给埃里雷。
text.progress: Where is my food?  My guests will be here soon!
text.completion: My guests should find this acceptable.  Just don't tell them it came from Awilo.
text.completed: Speak to Arille Azuregaze at Legerdemain Lounge in Dalaran.

english.title: Convention at the Legerdemain
english.objectives: Bring 4 Northern Stews and a Jug of Wine from the cheese shop in Dalaran to Arille Azuregaze at the Legerdemain Lounge found in Runeweaver Square in Dalaran.
english.description: Can you believe da horde has outlawed cannibalism...it just ain't right I tell ya!  I guess I should keep me mind on me work when we gots an order to fill.$B$BArille Azuregaze at the Legerdemain Lounge has many a guest a'comin to his place, mon.  You gots to be providin' some Northern Stew and a Jug of Wine from the cheese shop in central Dalaran.$B$BBring the wine and stew to Arille.
english.progress: Where is my food?  My guests will be here soon!
english.completion: My guests should find this acceptable.  Just don't tell them it came from Awilo.
english.completed: Speak to Arille Azuregaze at Legerdemain Lounge in Dalaran.

text.title: 下水道炖肉
text.objectives: 将4根采自晶歌森林的晶歌胡萝卜与4块冰冷的肉放在炖肉锅里进行烹饪。$B$B炖好之后，将萝卜炖肉交给达拉然下水道的旅店老板埃因·格林。
text.description: 我们又有订单啦，达拉然下水道的旅店老板需要一份萝卜炖肉来款待顾客。$b$b由于他并不满意上一次我送去的炖侏儒，这次他特意要了一份萝卜炖肉。到晶歌森林去采集4根晶歌胡萝卜，把它们和4块冰冷的肉一起炖了。$B$B你可以通过鲁因广场东边的传送间前往晶歌森林。$B$B等你准备好了萝卜炖肉之后，就把它交给埃因。
text.progress: Make sure there isn't any gnome in the stew this time!
text.completion: Stew looks good.  Thanks for your help.
text.completed: Speak to Ajay Green at Cantrips & Crows in the Underbelly of Dalaran.

english.title: Sewer Stew
english.objectives: Cook 4 Crystalsong Carrots from Crystalsong Forest with 4 Chilled Meat in the Cookpot.$B$BThen bring the Vegetable Stew to the Dalaran sewers Innkeeper Ajay Green.
english.description: We be havin' another order to fill.  Da innkeeper in da Dalaran sewers needs a vegetable stew as his customers dey don't have so much to eat, mon.$B$BHe asked for a vegetable stew as he didn't appreciate da gnome that was in the last stew I sent.  Get 4 Crystalsong Carrots from the Crystalsong Forest and cook them together with 4 Chilled Meat and bring it to Ajay.$B$BYou can be gettin' to da Forest from da portal chamber in da eastern corner of Runeweaver Square.
english.progress: Make sure there isn't any gnome in the stew this time!
english.completion: Stew looks good.  Thanks for your help.
english.completed: Speak to Ajay Green at Cantrips & Crows in the Underbelly of Dalaran.

text.title: 兰尼德的奶酪
text.objectives: 把空的奶酪盘、“再来一杯”奶酪店的陈年达拉然干酪、以及在达拉然的桌子上找到的6只半满的达拉然酒杯放在一起。$B$B将美酒和奶酪盘交给魔法商业区制皮店中的兰尼德·怒金。
text.description: 制皮店的兰尼德·怒金想要一些酒和奶酪。为什么他不想尝尝我这里的美味侏儒呢？$B$B从达拉然市中心的奶酪店中收集奶酪，然后从城市各个角落收集一些半满的酒杯。把酒和奶酪一起交给兰尼德。$B$B你可以把这酒称作“混合美酒”，朋友。
text.progress: Have you seen a servant with my wine and cheese platter?  I am quite peckish!
text.completion: This wine is quite amazing!  I must know where it's from.
text.completed: Speak to Ranid Glowergold at Legendary Leathers in Dalaran.

english.title: Cheese for Glowergold
english.objectives: Combine the Empty Cheese Platter with Aged Dalaran Limburger from the cheese shop "One More Glass" and with 6 Half Full Dalaran Wine Glasses found on tables around Dalaran.$B$BBring the Wine and Cheese platter to Ranid Glowergold at the Leatherworkers in the Magus Commerce Exchange.
english.description: Ranid Glowergold in da Leatherworkers shop be havin' a need for wine and cheese.  Why he don't want some tasty gnome is beyond me.$B$BCollect da cheese from da cheese shop in central Dalaran and da half full wine glasses found on tables around da city.  Bring da wine and serve it with the cheese to Ranid.$B$BYou can call da wine a Wine Medley, mon'.
english.progress: Have you seen a servant with my wine and cheese platter?  I am quite peckish!
english.completion: This wine is quite amazing!  I must know where it's from.
english.completed: Speak to Ranid Glowergold at Legendary Leathers in Dalaran.

text.title: Mustard Dogs!
text.objectives: Fill the Empty Picnic Basket with 4 Rhino Dogs that you be cookin' with your skill and 4 Wild Mustard that you find in the grassy areas of Dalaran.$B$BBring the Picnic Basket to Archmage Pentarus at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran.
text.description: Da Archmage Pentarus likes to be watchin' his crazy battle ball game, but he be needin' some food for da game.$B$BYou be needin' to fill his picnic basket with 4 cooked rhino dogs and then 4 wild mustard that are found in da grassy corners of de city.$B$BFill up his basket with the mustard dog goodies, mon'.
text.progress: Make sure the wild mustard dogs are 100% rhino and have no gnome in them!
text.completion: Perfect!  I just hope the Dalaran Destroyers finally win one!
text.completed: Speak to Archmage Pentarus at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran.

english.title: Mustard Dogs!
english.objectives: Fill the Empty Picnic Basket with 4 Rhino Dogs that you be cookin' with your skill and 4 Wild Mustard that you find in the grassy areas of Dalaran.$B$BBring the Picnic Basket to Archmage Pentarus at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran.
english.description: Da Archmage Pentarus likes to be watchin' his crazy battle ball game, but he be needin' some food for da game.$B$BYou be needin' to fill his picnic basket with 4 cooked rhino dogs and then 4 wild mustard that are found in da grassy corners of de city.$B$BFill up his basket with the mustard dog goodies, mon'.
english.progress: Make sure the wild mustard dogs are 100% rhino and have no gnome in them!
english.completion: Perfect!  I just hope the Dalaran Destroyers finally win one!
english.completed: Speak to Archmage Pentarus at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran.

text.title: 它们从哪儿来的？
text.objectives: 调查缝合场东部的召唤祭坛，然后返回黑色观察站，向黑暗骑士阿尔蕾汇报情况。
text.description: 下面的缝合场里聚集了大群巫妖王的爪牙，这帮不知疲倦的怪物正在夜以继日地制造憎恶和血肉巨人。$B$B不仅如此，骷髅构造体的数量也越来越多，大大加快了制造的速度。$B$B如果我们不能查明它们的来历以及高效作业的缘由，那么我们很快就会落败，连采取行动的机会都没有。我要你去东南方调查这些骷髅的来历。
text.progress: Have you found the source of the skeletons?
text.completion: <You tell the darkrider about your discoveries at the summoning altar.>$b$bI suspected such. We can't let this continue. Our first priority is to destroy those summoning altars and then deal with the mess the Scourge has already created here.
text.completed: Return to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch in Icecrown.

english.title: Where Are They Coming From?
english.objectives: Investigate a Summoning Altar in the eastern part of the Fleshwerks, then report back to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch.
english.description: The Lich King's tireless minions labor away night and day to assemble scores of abominations and flesh giants down there in the Fleshwerks.$B$BYet, that is not enough. More and more skeletal constructors keep appearing to increase the pace of work.$B$BIf we do not discover where they're coming from and how they're able to work so quickly, we'll be overrun before we can act in force. Search to the southeast and see if you can find the source of these skeletons.
english.progress: Have you found the source of the skeletons?
english.completion: <You tell the darkrider about your discoveries at the summoning altar.>$b$bI suspected such. We can't let this continue. Our first priority is to destroy those summoning altars and then deal with the mess the Scourge has already created here.
english.completed: Return to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch in Icecrown.

text.title: 净化天灾城
text.objectives: 冰冠冰川回音谷的黑锋观察者要你去杀死3名遗忘深渊高阶祭司、3只遗忘深渊虫王和8名复活的北伐军战士。
text.description: 天灾军团对银色北伐军发动了数次攻击，但是都被击退了。眼下他们正在进行“生产部队”的勾当。天灾城中的俘虏全都会被处死，然后复活成巫妖王的仆从。$B$B毫无疑问，银色北伐军会请求你让他们的战士体面地死去，但是我不会对你提出这样的要求。要想获得胜利，我们必须毫不留情地杀死所有天灾军团的成员。$B$B穿过突破口，前往西北方的天灾城，消灭所有胆敢阻挡你的去路的家伙。
text.progress: Do not waste time, $N.
text.completion: You have done well, $N. Keeping their numbers down will give the Argent Crusade the time that they need to set a foundation.
text.completed: Return to The Ebon Watcher at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown.

english.title: The Purging Of Scourgeholme
english.objectives: The Ebon Watcher at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown wants you to kill 3 Forgotten Depths High Priests, 3 Forgotten Depths Underkings, and 8 Reanimated Crusaders.
english.description: The Scourge have sent their armies at the Argent Crusade and have been repelled. What they do now is called a 'slash and burn.' All prisoners that they hold at Scourgeholme will be executed and raised as servants of the Lich King.$B$BUndoubtedly the Argent Crusade will request that you give their soldiers a proper farewell. I'll ask no such thing of you. To succeed we must kill Scourge indiscriminately.$B$BVenture to Scourgeholme, northwest through the Breach, and lay waste to all that stand in your way.
english.progress: Do not waste time, $N.
english.completion: You have done well, $N. Keeping their numbers down will give the Argent Crusade the time that they need to set a foundation.
english.completed: Return to The Ebon Watcher at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown.

text.title: 摧毁祭坛
text.objectives: 杀死召唤大师扎洛德，用他的法杖摧毁第一座、第二座、第三座和第四座召唤祭坛。完成任务后返回黑色观察站，向黑暗骑士阿尔蕾复命。
text.description: 这么说，他们在祭坛中召唤劳工和战士？$B$B我们必须先解决这件事。召唤大师手中应该有一根法杖，用来激活传送门。如果你能杀死他并夺取那根法杖，就可以利用它使传送门过载，最终摧毁祭坛。$B$B把四座召唤祭坛都搞定，然后回来向我复命。
text.progress: Are the summoning altars in ruins?
text.completion: <Darkrider Arly nods in approval.>$b$bGood. Now, we can focus our efforts on shutting down the rest of the Fleshwerks.
text.completed: Return to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch in Icecrown.

english.title: Destroying the Altars
english.objectives: Kill Master Summoner Zarod and use his Summoning Stave to destroy the First, Second, Third, and Fourth Summoning Altars. When you've completed this task, report to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch.
english.description: So they're summoning in their workers and warriors at those altars?$B$BThey'll need to be the first thing to go. The master summoner should have a staff which allows him to activate the portal. If you kill the master summoner and take the staff, you can use it to overload the summoning portal and destroy its altar.$B$BDo this at all four of the altars and return to me once they've been destroyed.
english.progress: Are the summoning altars in ruins?
english.completion: <Darkrider Arly nods in approval.>$b$bGood. Now, we can focus our efforts on shutting down the rest of the Fleshwerks.
english.completed: Return to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch in Icecrown.

text.title: 死亡的凝视
text.objectives: 使用死亡凝视宝珠，将宝珠放置在憎恶装配台宝珠支架、血肉巨人装配台宝珠支架和天灾之锅区域宝珠支架上，然后返回黑色观察站，向黑暗骑士阿尔蕾复命。
text.description: 缝合场是一处庞大的工地，我们很难对所有情况一览无余，不过好在我已经想到了一个办法。$B$B<阿尔蕾从斗篷里取出一枚宝珠。>$B$B这是死亡凝视宝珠。有了它，我们就可以观察天灾军团的动向，寻找最佳的进攻时机。$B$B将这些宝珠放置在缝合场三处关键位置的支架上——西南方的憎恶装配台和血肉巨人装配台，以及西方那口巨大的绿色天灾之锅附近。
text.progress: Have you placed those orbs?
text.completion: <Darkrider Arly closes her eyes and seems to focus on something far away.>$b$bWith the eyes of death itself, I watch our enemy. With this knowledge, we will utterly destroy them.
text.completed: Return to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch in Icecrown.

english.title: Death's Gaze
english.objectives: Use the Death's Gaze Orb to place orbs on the Abomination Lab Orb Stand, the Flesh Giant Lab Orb Stand, and the Cauldron Area Orb Stand, then return to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch.
english.description: The Fleshwerks is a vast operation, and it will be difficult to keep an eye on all that transpires there. Fortunately, I have a plan.$B$B<Arly produces an orb from the folds of her cloak and shows it to you.>$B$BThis is a death's gaze orb. With it, we can observe the Scourge's actions and decide how best to strike.$B$BPlace these orbs on the stands at three crucial areas -- the abomination lab and the flesh giant lab to the southwest, along with the area surrounding the green cauldron far to the west.
english.progress: Have you placed those orbs?
english.completion: <Darkrider Arly closes her eyes and seems to focus on something far away.>$b$bWith the eyes of death itself, I watch our enemy. With this knowledge, we will utterly destroy them.
english.completed: Return to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch in Icecrown.

objectiveDetails.description: 在憎恶装配台放置宝珠
在血肉巨人装配台放置宝珠
将宝珠放置在天灾之锅区域

text.title: 巫妖王之眼
text.objectives: 约尔达村的白骨女巫要你使用巫妖王之眼获取情报。
text.description: 接下来，我们必须借助巫妖王的工具才能制定出对付他的下一步计划。$B$B越过西南方的山岭，就能抵达库尔加拉要塞。那里居住着尤顿海姆的神谕者，他们执行着主人的命令并通过巫妖王之眼监视他人。$B$B你必须设法靠近巫妖王之眼。虽然它不能穿透冰冠堡垒，但是我相信你能获取到有用的信息，这样我们就能制订出最佳的策略了。
text.progress: You return with no information at all! Is this how you repay my help to you and the Knights of the Ebon Blade?$B$BBegone and do not return until you have the knowledge which I seek!
text.completion: Perfect! It's true that Iskalder is rumored to have been the finest vrykul warrior ever to live. And Vardmadra herself is going to come her to judge him!$b$bWe must move quickly if we are to get to this ancient hero before they do!
text.completed: Return to The Bone Witch at Njorndar Village in Icecrown.

english.title: Through the Eye
english.objectives: The Bone Witch in Njorndar Village has tasked you with using the Eye of the Lich King to gain information.
english.description: We must use the Lich King's tools against him if we are to decide our next step.$B$BOver the mountain to the southwest lies Kul'galar Keep. Within it reside the oracles of Jotunheim who receive orders from their master and scry upon others through the Eye of the Lich King.$B$BIt is the eye that you must fight your way to. While it cannot be used to pierce the veil within Icecrown Citadel, you should be able to use it to discern something of value so that we will know how best to proceed.
english.progress: You return with no information at all! Is this how you repay my help to you and the Knights of the Ebon Blade?$B$BBegone and do not return until you have the knowledge which I seek!
english.completion: Perfect! It's true that Iskalder is rumored to have been the finest vrykul warrior ever to live. And Vardmadra herself is going to come her to judge him!$b$bWe must move quickly if we are to get to this ancient hero before they do!
english.completed: Return to The Bone Witch at Njorndar Village in Icecrown.

text.title: 天灾石
text.objectives: 将15块天灾石交给冰冠冰川回音谷的黑锋观察者。
text.description: 天灾军团的成员在诞生或是被创造出来时，都会得到一块天灾石。它可以增强持有者的力量，更重要的是，军团的头目可以用它观测到所有作战单位的位置和行动。$B$B只要有足够多的天灾石，我们就能掌握天灾军团在冰冠冰川的一举一动。$B$B当你在天灾城中杀敌时，顺便收集一些天灾石吧。装满你的背包，然后再回来找我。
text.progress: Scourgestones will help us find our enemy.
text.completion: Now let me see if there's something that I can do with these stones to give us a little bit of insight.
text.completed: Return to The Ebon Watcher at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown.

english.title: The Scourgestone
english.objectives: The Ebon Watcher at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown wants you to bring him 15 Scourgestones.
english.description: A Scourgestone is an item given to all Scourge upon birth or creation. It provides certain benefits to the holder, but more importantly it allows Scourge leaders visibility into the location and movement of all of their units.$B$BWith enough Scourgestones, I might be able to track the movement of other Scourge units across Icecrown.$B$BAs you slaughter Scourge in Scourgeholme, gather all of the Scourgestones that you find. Return to me when your bags are full.
english.progress: Scourgestones will help us find our enemy.
english.completion: Now let me see if there's something that I can do with these stones to give us a little bit of insight.
english.completed: Return to The Ebon Watcher at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown.

text.title: WotLK Collector's Edition: - DEM - E - FLAG

english.title: WotLK Collector's Edition: - DEM - E - FLAG

text.title: 战斗仍在继续
text.objectives: 莱洛拉斯希望你进入魔环，营救贝加里斯塔兹与他的同伴。
text.description: 玛里苟斯和他的手下日益强大，而我们最新派遣的突击队也被俘虏，关押在了魔环之中。$B$B我们必须想办法把他们救出来！贝加里斯塔兹和他的朋友对我们来说非常重要。
text.completion: Listen well, $r.$b$bYour work here has just begun!

english.title: The Struggle Persists
english.objectives: Raelorasz wants you to rescue Belgaristrasz and his companions in the Oculus.
english.description: Malygos and his underlings grow stronger in power with each passing day. And now, our latest assault team has been captured and is being held in the Oculus.$b$bWe must attempt a rescue! Belgaristrasz and his companions are invaluable to our cause.
english.completion: Listen well, $r.$b$bYour work here has just begun!

text.title: 凝固的空气
text.objectives: 冰冠冰川回音谷的黑锋观察者要你去杀死撕裂者萨兰纳克斯、虫王塔洛诺克斯和高阶祭司亚萨尔蒙。
text.description: 想要将这片土地从天灾军团手中拯救出来，就必须击败天灾城中的几位领主。$B$B撕裂者萨兰纳克斯驻守在天灾城第一层的神殿中，高阶祭司亚萨尔蒙就在第二层的灵魂塔里布道，而虫王塔洛诺克斯则负责管辖北边的邪魔之坑。$B$B他们非常强大，你必须小心应付。如果你需要帮助，就吹响这只号角。阿彻鲁斯的死亡骑士将闻声而来。
text.progress: Finish them, $N!
text.completion: A hard fought victory, $N! The lieutenants will be replaced, but at least for today the air about Scourgeholme stands still.
text.completed: Return to The Ebon Watcher at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown.

english.title: The Air Stands Still
english.objectives: The Ebon Watcher at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown wants you to kill Salranax the Flesh Render, Underking Talonox and High Priest Yath'amon.
english.description: You must defeat the lords of Scourgeholme if this place is to be free of the Scourge's grasp.$B$BSalranax the Flesh Render lords over the temple on the first tier of Scourgeholme. Nearby Salranax you'll find High Priest Yath'amon preaching at the spirit tower on the second tier. Underking Talonox holds court at the Pit of Fiends, up the high road.$B$BThese are formidable opponents and must be approached with caution. Use this war horn should you require aid. The death knights of Acherus will come.
english.progress: Finish them, $N!
english.completion: A hard fought victory, $N! The lieutenants will be replaced, but at least for today the air about Scourgeholme stands still.
english.completed: Return to The Ebon Watcher at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown.

text.title: 协同作战
text.objectives: 贝加里斯塔兹要求你摧毁10台离心构造体，以此关闭瓦尔洛斯的护盾。然后击败瓦尔洛斯·云击。
text.description: 从现在开始，我们必须齐心协力，才能继续前进。$B$B就在我们上方，瓦尔洛斯躲在一道固若金汤的魔法护盾后面。为了击败他，你必须干掉那些向他的护盾提供能量的离心构造体。$B$B我们可以分别提供自己军团的幼龙，供你们骑乘。你们必须凭借这些幼龙的帮助才能击败瓦尔洛斯。
text.progress: So, it is done!
text.completion: It is as I had hoped, $r. We work well together.$b$bMay our continued cooperation be enough to overcome the challenges that yet await!
text.completed: Return to Image of Belgaristrasz inside the Oculus.

english.title: A Unified Front
english.objectives: Belgaristrasz wants you to destroy 10 Centrifuge Constructs to bring down Varos' shield. You then must defeat Varos Cloudstrider.
english.description: From here, it will take our combined efforts to proceed.$b$bAbove us, Varos hides behind an impenetrable shield. To reach him, you must defeat the Centrifuge Constructs that power his shield.$b$bWe can each provide you with drakes from our respective flights to help you reveal him.
english.progress: So, it is done!
english.completion: It is as I had hoped, $r. We work well together.$b$bMay our continued cooperation be enough to overcome the challenges that yet await!
english.completed: Return to Image of Belgaristrasz inside the Oculus.

text.title: 法师领主伊洛姆
text.objectives: 贝加里斯塔兹要求你击败魔环的法师领主伊洛姆。
text.description: 在我们达成最终目标的路上，只剩下最后一个障碍了。他叫伊洛姆。$B$B伊洛姆守护着我们上方的第三道魔环。朋友，你要小心他强大的召唤法术。$B$B打倒他，让他为自己的背信弃义付出代价！
text.progress: Has Mage-Lord Urom been dealt with?
text.completion: Victory is in reach, friend.$b$bFocus, for now comes the true test.
text.completed: Return to Image of Belgaristrasz inside the Oculus.

english.title: Mage-Lord Urom
english.objectives: Belgaristrasz wants you to defeat Mage-Lord Urom in the Oculus.
english.description: Only one obstacle stands between us and our ultimate goal here. His name is Urom.$b$bHe guards the third ring above us. Beware his powerful conjurings, friend.$b$bBring him down. Make him pay for his treacherous allegiance to the enemy!
english.progress: Has Mage-Lord Urom been dealt with?
english.completion: Victory is in reach, friend.$b$bFocus, for now comes the true test.
english.completed: Return to Image of Belgaristrasz inside the Oculus.

text.title: 龙翼之力
text.objectives: 贝加里斯塔兹要求你击败魔环的埃雷苟斯。
text.description: 与埃雷苟斯正面交锋的时候到了，朋友。$B$B他监守自盗，从守护巨龙玛利苟斯的能量之井里抽取了不少能量。$B$B不过，在法师领主倒下之后，我们的幼龙已经可以发挥全部的战力了。好好驱使它们，你们一定可以击败埃雷苟斯。
text.progress: Do you bring news of Belgaristrasz?
text.completion: I can already feel their defenses weakening!$b$bNot since the onset of this conflict have we dealt a blow of this magnitude to the Lord of Magic.$b$bDo not forget to visit Eregos' cache. Surely some of his treasures will interest you.
text.completed: Return to Image of Belgaristrasz inside the Oculus.

english.title: A Wing and a Prayer
english.objectives: Belgaristrasz wants you to kill Eregos in the Oculus.
english.description: The time has come to face Eregos.$b$bHe draws strength from the energies he is charged with defending - sipping from the well of the great aspect Malygos.$b$bHowever, defeating the Mage-Lord has allowed us to unlock the full power of our drakes. Use them wisely and Eregos shall surely fall.
english.progress: Do you bring news of Belgaristrasz?
english.completion: I can already feel their defenses weakening!$b$bNot since the onset of this conflict have we dealt a blow of this magnitude to the Lord of Magic.$b$bDo not forget to visit Eregos' cache. Surely some of his treasures will interest you.
english.completed: Return to Image of Belgaristrasz inside the Oculus.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败魔网守护者埃雷苟斯

text.title: 智力游戏
text.objectives: 达克萨隆要塞的库塞尔希望你对召唤者诺沃斯的尸体使用库塞尔的布片。然后把沾满腐液的布片交给她。
text.description: <库塞尔从她的衣服上撕下一条布料交给你。>$B$B拿着这个，$c。用它抹一抹召唤者诺沃斯的尸体。$B$B我们要找出是什么在驱使天灾首领。
text.progress: <hic>$b$bWhutcha got there, $g pal:missy;?
text.completion: Hopefully we can find somebody willing to examine this sample.
text.completed: Return to Kurzel inside Drak'Tharon Keep.

english.title: Head Games
english.objectives: Kurzel wants you to use Kurzel's Blouse Scrap at the corpse of Novos the Summoner, then take the Ichor-Stained Cloth to her inside Drak'Tharon Keep.
english.description: <Kurzel rips a long strip of material from her blouse and hands it to you.>$b$bHere, $r, take this. Dip it in the remains of Novos the Summoner.$b$bWe're going to figure out what makes the Scourge leaders tick.
english.progress: <hic>$b$bWhutcha got there, $g pal:missy;?
english.completion: Hopefully we can find somebody willing to examine this sample.
english.completed: Return to Kurzel inside Drak'Tharon Keep.

text.title: 公正堡的基石
text.objectives: 冰冠冰川回音谷的北伐军建筑师西拉斯要你去收集10根水晶心木和10块古代精灵石砖。
text.description: 目前天灾城还是腐臭肮脏的一片狼藉，但是总有一天，它会变成光辉荣耀的净土。弗丁大人下令将它改造成“公正堡”。$B$B嗯，哪怕是固若金汤的冰冠堡垒，也是由一小块石头开始建起的。那么，就让天灾城的救赎之路也从第一块石头开始吧！$B$B我要你前往南方的晶歌森林，抵达森林东部的自由之林后，在那里的灌木丛中收集水晶心木，再从杉达拉废墟中收集一些古代精灵石砖。
text.progress: Are you lost?
text.completion: Heartwood by nature is resistant to disease, rot and plague. This heartwood, however, goes so far as to repel such things! The masonry, affected by the fallout of the Unbound Thicket, will work in much the same way.$B$BSoon we will break ground.
text.completed: Return to Crusade Architect Silas at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown.

english.title: The Stone That Started A Revolution
english.objectives: Crusade Architect Silas at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown wants you to retrieve 10 Trunks of Crystalline Heartwood and 10 pieces of Ancient Elven Masonry.
english.description: You may look at Scourgeholme now and see a rancid pit of decay, but one day it will be a place of glory and honor. Highlord Fordring has deemed it "Justice Keep."$B$BAlas, even an impregnable fortress like Icecrown Citadel began with but a single stone. So begins our search for the stone to start a revolution.$B$BTravel to Crystalsong, south of here, and seek out the Unbound Thicket in the east. Once there gather crystalline heartwood from the thicket floor and elven masonry from the Ruins of Shandaral.
english.progress: Are you lost?
english.completion: Heartwood by nature is resistant to disease, rot and plague. This heartwood, however, goes so far as to repel such things! The masonry, affected by the fallout of the Unbound Thicket, will work in much the same way.$B$BSoon we will break ground.
english.completed: Return to Crusade Architect Silas at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown.

text.title: 宝箱中的垃圾
text.objectives: 乌特加德之巅的布雷格要你帮他收集5块失去光泽的银锭、3枚闪亮的饰物、2只黄金酒杯和1座碧玉雕像。
text.description: 看呐！我的钱箱从来没像现在这样空空如也过。$b$b我的同伴在看见那堆财宝时都跳了起来，可是现在，你看看他们！他们都变成了骷髅！$b$b你瞧，那里有一大堆宝藏，而且没有受到诅咒，我向你保证。$b$b去帮我把它弄出来，我会好好酬谢你的，伙计。
text.progress: How'd yeh fare in thar, matey?
text.completion: Brilliant! Ye've gone and done it, matey.$b$bNow I can show me face to the Cap'n without fearin' fer me life, thanks be ta you and yer mates.$b$bHere's a little booty fer you in return.
text.completed: Return to Brigg Smallshanks in Utgarde Pinnacle.

english.title: Junk in My Trunk
english.objectives: Brigg in Utgarde Pinnacle wants you to find 5 Untarnished Silver Bars, 3 Shiny Baubles, 2 Golden Goblets, and a Jade Statue.
english.description: Just look at it! Me trunk never been so empty.$b$bMe mates jumped at the sight o' all that booty, and now look at 'em! Rattlin' bones, they be!$b$bSay, thar be plenty o' loot farther in, an' not the cursed kind I'll wager.$b$bFetch it fer me an' I'll be rewardin' ya handsomely, matey.
english.progress: How'd yeh fare in thar, matey?
english.completion: Brilliant! Ye've gone and done it, matey.$b$bNow I can show me face to the Cap'n without fearin' fer me life, thanks be ta you and yer mates.$b$bHere's a little booty fer you in return.
english.completed: Return to Brigg Smallshanks in Utgarde Pinnacle.

text.title: 我要复仇！
text.objectives: 乌特加德之巅的布雷格要你去杀死伊米隆国王。
text.description: 我比较幸运，没有和我的同伴落得同样的下场。$B$B在扑向金币的路上，我摔了一跤——大约是有点喝醉了。结果呢，我抬头一看，就目睹了他们变成亡灵……$b$b这里有一个家伙管着所有的守卫。他们称他为伊米隆……如果杀了他，或许就能解救我的同伴？
text.progress: Ya find the one in charge here, $r? Did ya make 'em suffer?
text.completion: Splendid! Mebbe now me mateys be able ta rest in peace.$b$bHere ya go, $g lad:lass;. Don't let it be said that ol' Brigg weren't generous ta those who showed 'im a kindness.$b$bGood doin' business wit yeh.
text.completed: Return to Brigg Smallshanks in Utgarde Pinnacle.

english.title: Vengeance Be Mine!
english.objectives: Brigg in Utgarde Pinnacle wants you to kill King Ymiron.
english.description: Only luck spared me from the same fate as me mates.$B$BIn the scurry I got knocked down - was a wee bit tipsy to begin with. Looked up ta see the first of 'em turn.$b$bThere was a big ol' fella watchin' with a whole mess o' guards. They were chantin' Ymiron... maybe killin' him will free me mates?
english.progress: Ya find the one in charge here, $r? Did ya make 'em suffer?
english.completion: Splendid! Mebbe now me mateys be able ta rest in peace.$b$bHere ya go, $g lad:lass;. Don't let it be said that ol' Brigg weren't generous ta those who showed 'im a kindness.$b$bGood doin' business wit yeh.
english.completed: Return to Brigg Smallshanks in Utgarde Pinnacle.

text.title: 找到古代英雄
text.objectives: 约尔达村的白骨女巫要你将伊斯卡德尔带回来。
text.description: $n，我要你立即前往西南方的先祖大厅！$B$B你可以在那里找到休眠的尤尔丁人。将他们逐个叫醒，直到你找到伊斯卡德尔为止。然后你要对他使用这枚护符，将他带回来见我。$B$B快去吧，时间非常紧迫！
text.progress: Where is the ancient hero?$B$BWe do not have time to chat. Go to the Halls of the Ancestors and find him before it is too late!
text.completion: He's a fine specimen and will serve us well.$B$BNow, we have to make sure to use him properly to trap Vardmadra!
text.completed: Return to The Bone Witch at Njorndar Village in Icecrown.

english.title: Find the Ancient Hero
english.objectives: The Bone Witch at Njorndar Village wants you to return with Iskalder.
english.description: Quickly, $n, head southwest to the Halls of the Ancestors!$B$BWithin you will find slumbering mjordin. Wake them until you find Iskalder. When you do, use this amulet upon him and bring him back to me.$B$BNow go. There is no time to waste!
english.progress: Where is the ancient hero?$B$BWe do not have time to chat. Go to the Halls of the Ancestors and find him before it is too late!
english.completion: He's a fine specimen and will serve us well.$B$BNow, we have to make sure to use him properly to trap Vardmadra!
english.completed: Return to The Bone Witch at Njorndar Village in Icecrown.

objectiveDetails.description: 将伊斯卡德尔带到白骨女巫面前

text.title: 抛洒它们的血
text.objectives: 黑色观察站的黑暗骑士阿尔蕾要你去摧毁5桶防腐液和5枚鲜血宝珠。
text.description: 要制造血肉怪物，天灾军团就必须用到大量的血液以及防腐剂，这样才能保存肢体，并确保其机能正常。如果破坏这些材料，它们的血肉怪兽就会四分五裂，那样我们就能轻松地摧毁它们了。$B$B在天灾军团装配血肉巨人和憎恶的台子周围，你可以找到装有防腐剂的大桶以及盛满鲜血的球体。摧毁这些材料，如果有谁敢阻拦你，就将它们一并除掉！
text.progress: Have you done as I asked?
text.completion: <A dark, hollow laugh greets you as you report to the darkrider.>$b$bYou reek of victory, $n, and that is good news, indeed.
text.completed: Return to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch in Icecrown.

english.title: Spill Their Blood
english.objectives: Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch wants you to destroy 5 vats of Embalming Fluid and 5 Blood Orbs.
english.description: The Scourge cannot create their flesh monsters without blood and embalming fluid to preserve the parts and keep them functioning. If we can deny them these materials, their army will fall apart and we can easily destroy their creations.$B$BThroughout the labs where the flesh giants and abominations are cobbled together, you will find vats of embalming fluid and large orbs filled with blood. Destroy these, and bring death to any who would stop you!
english.progress: Have you done as I asked?
english.completion: <A dark, hollow laugh greets you as you report to the darkrider.>$b$bYou reek of victory, $n, and that is good news, indeed.
english.completed: Return to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch in Icecrown.

text.title: 危险的能量
text.objectives: 冰冠冰川回音谷的北伐军技师斯比帕提克要你去收集8块结晶能量。
text.description: 此地东南方，就在晶歌森林的东部边缘，有一处名叫自由之林的地方，里面生活着各种生物。受自由之林的影响，这些生物有一个共同点，就是它们对魔法能量的亲和力。它们体内拥有纯净的晶化能量，这种能量一旦爆发，其威力足以杀死我们所有人！$B$B前往自由之林猎杀这些生物，从它们身上获取结晶能量。我们需要燃料，而它们需要死亡，我们管这个叫“双赢”。
text.progress: Did you get the crystallized energy?
text.completion: Ah, this is perfect. The bomber should be up and running in no time.
text.completed: Return to Crusade Engineer Spitzpatrick at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown.

english.title: It Could Kill Us All
english.objectives: Crusade Engineer Spitzpatrick at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown wants you to retrieve 8 pieces of Crystallized Energy.
english.description: Southeast of here, at the eastern reaches of Crystalsong Forest, is an area known as the Unbound Thicket. Within that thicket creeps all manner of life. One thing all of the affected creatures of the thicket share in common is their affinity for magical energy. Each of them holds pure, crystallized energy. Enough to kill us all should it ever destabilize!$B$BTravel to the Unbound Thicket and kill its denizens for crystallized energy. We need fuel and they need to die. We call that a "win-win."
english.progress: Did you get the crystallized energy?
english.completion: Ah, this is perfect. The bomber should be up and running in no time.
english.completed: Return to Crusade Engineer Spitzpatrick at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown.

starters.name: 北伐军技师斯比帕提克

enders.name: 北伐军技师斯比帕提克

text.title: 粗糙的碎片
text.objectives: 将10块粗糙的碎片交给黑色观察站的北伐军战士欧尔拉金·萨利斯。
text.description: 你从食尸鬼的尸体上拔出了一块不规则的黑色金属碎片。它的边缘凹凸不平，说明锻造者的技术很差，又或者这是某个机械大件上的碎片。$B$B你突然想起，缝合场的食尸鬼尸体上都能找到相似的碎片。你很好奇，为什么它们的制造者要不厌其烦地加入金属碎片呢？如果你能多收集一些这种碎片的话，或许北伐军战士欧尔拉金·萨利斯知道些什么。
text.progress: What is that vile thing?
text.completion: <Olakin handles the shards of metal gingerly.>$b$bYou saw these on all of the ghouls down there? I've never seen anything like this in all my battles against the Scourge.
text.completed: Return to Crusader Olakin Sainrith at Blackwatch in Icecrown.

english.title: Jagged Shards
english.objectives: Bring 10 Jagged Shards to Crusader Olakin Sainrith at Blackwatch.
english.description: You pulled this jagged, dark brittle shard from the body of a ghoul. The metal blade lacks a smooth edge, suggesting it was forged by an unskilled hand, or was broken from a larger piece.$B$BYou recall seeing similar shards embedded in the bodies of all the ghouls you've encountered at the Fleshwerks, leading you to wonder why their creators bothered to include the metal at all. Perhaps Crusader Olakin Sainrith would have some insight if you brought him the shards from several ghouls.
english.progress: What is that vile thing?
english.completion: <Olakin handles the shards of metal gingerly.>$b$bYou saw these on all of the ghouls down there? I've never seen anything like this in all my battles against the Scourge.
english.completed: Return to Crusader Olakin Sainrith at Blackwatch in Icecrown.

enders.name: 北伐军战士欧尔拉金·萨利斯

text.title: 不那么光彩的战斗
text.objectives: 约尔达村的白骨女巫要你在战痕尖塔击败伊斯卡德尔。
text.description: 在西南方那片俯瞰尤顿海姆的群山中，战痕尖塔是最高的一座。它是维库人心目中仅次于瓦哈拉斯的神圣决斗场。$B$B但是我们要在那里打一场不那么光彩的战斗。$B$B召集你的同伴，飞上那座山峰。你准备好以后，就发出烽火信号，我会操控伊斯卡德尔的躯体出现在决斗场中。$B$B我们会“决斗”，而你将获得胜利。瓦尔德玛达肯定会去观看这场精彩的比赛！
text.progress: You have yet to defeat the ancient hero!
text.completion: I've put Vardmadra aside for the moment. She's someplace safe until we can enact our final revenge!
text.completed: Return to The Bone Witch at Njorndar Village in Icecrown.

english.title: Not-So-Honorable Combat
english.objectives: The Bone Witch in Njorndar Village wants you to defeat Iskalder upon Battlescar Spire.
english.description: Atop the tallest peak to the southwest overlooking Jotunheim is Battlescar Spire. It is a place of reverence for the vrykul, second only to Valhalas in terms of where they prefer to do honorable combat.$B$BWe shall visit not-so-honorable combat upon it.$B$BGather your companions and fly to the spire. When you are ready, light the signal fire and I will appear within the body of Iskalder.$B$BWe will fight, you will win, and Vardmadra is sure to come to witness the battle!
english.progress: You have yet to defeat the ancient hero!
english.completion: I've put Vardmadra aside for the moment. She's someplace safe until we can enact our final revenge!
english.completed: Return to The Bone Witch at Njorndar Village in Icecrown.

text.title: 熔炼碎片
text.objectives: 在玛雷卡里斯底层的熔炉附近使用一包粗糙的碎片。将熔炼过的金属锭交给黑色观察站的北伐军战士欧尔拉金·萨利斯。
text.description: <欧尔拉金将碎片放在掌心翻转，听着它与铠甲护手的碰撞声。>$B$B如果力道足够的话，这些碎片足以刺穿护甲。我们必须搞清楚它们的成分以及巫妖王制作它们的意图。$B$B此地以东是玛雷卡里斯，就在冰冠堡垒旁边。根据我们获得的一点点情报，那里到处都是熔炼和锻造设备。将这些碎片带去那里，在玛雷卡里斯底层的熔炉附近熔化并进行重铸，这样我们就能对其成分进行分析了。
text.progress: Have you smelted those fragments yet?
text.completion: There is no doubt, this is raw saronite. We've seen weapons made from it in the hands of the Lich King's chosen before, but this is the first time it's been used to arm anything else. The scale of that mining operation must be huge.
text.completed: Return to Crusader Olakin Sainrith at Blackwatch in Icecrown.

english.title: I'm Smelting... Smelting!
english.objectives: Use the Bag of Jagged Shards near one of the bottom level Malykriss furnaces. Return to Crusader Olakin Sainrith at Blackwatch with the Smelted Metal Bar.
english.description: <Olakin turns one of the shards over in an armored fist.>$B$BThese could pierce armor with enough force. We have to find out what they're made of and what the Lich King intends to do with them.$B$BTo the east, nestled next to Icecrown Citadel itself, lies Malykriss. From the few reports we have, it's full of smelting and smithing equipment. Bring these shards there, and smelt them in one of the open furnaces on the bottom level of Malykriss. Once the metal has been reformed, we can identify it.
english.progress: Have you smelted those fragments yet?
english.completion: There is no doubt, this is raw saronite. We've seen weapons made from it in the hands of the Lich King's chosen before, but this is the first time it's been used to arm anything else. The scale of that mining operation must be huge.
english.completed: Return to Crusader Olakin Sainrith at Blackwatch in Icecrown.

starters.name: 北伐军战士欧尔拉金·萨利斯

enders.name: 北伐军战士欧尔拉金·萨利斯

text.title: 进入诺森德的冰冷腹地
text.objectives: 将古斯塔夫神父的报告交给冰冠冰川银色前线基地的大领主提里奥·弗丁。
text.description: 西拉斯和斯比帕提克已经就公正堡建造计划所需的原料和燃料达成了一致意见。多亏了你和黑锋骑士团的帮助，天灾城的驻军遭遇重创，他们的军官也败在你手中。$B$B我已经确定了建设地点，但是这份报告需要呈送大领主提里奥·弗丁审核，你替我跑一趟吧。只要他一声令下，我们就挥师北上，进入冰冠冰川。
text.progress: Stand easy, $N. What have you to report?
text.completion: Your assistance has been integral in securing the front. The first true victory of this war is close at hand - which is why our next step is the most crucial.$B$BRest assured, $N, the Scourge will not give up without a fight. Your most difficult challenge awaits.
text.completed: Return to Highlord Tirion Fordring at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown.

english.title: Into The Frozen Heart Of Northrend
english.objectives: Deliver Father Gustav's Report to Highlord Tirion Fordring at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown.
english.description: Silas and Spitzpatrick have signed off on the materials and fuel needed to begin construction of Justice Keep. Thanks to you and the Ebon Blade the Scourge presence within Scourgeholme has been decimated and their lieutenants have been defeated.$B$BI have chosen the site at which we will break ground, but first you must deliver my report to Highlord Tirion Fordring. We will begin our march into Icecrown on his command.
english.progress: Stand easy, $N. What have you to report?
english.completion: Your assistance has been integral in securing the front. The first true victory of this war is close at hand - which is why our next step is the most crucial.$B$BRest assured, $N, the Scourge will not give up without a fight. Your most difficult challenge awaits.
english.completed: Return to Highlord Tirion Fordring at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown.

text.title: 玛雷卡里斯的符文锻造师
text.objectives: 将5块符文萨隆邪铁板交给黑色观察站的北伐军战士欧尔拉金·萨利斯。
text.description: 你发现的那些碎片只可能来自玛雷卡里斯。那里是巫妖王的冶金基地，就在恐惧之门科雷萨以东。$B$B但是无论是缝合到憎恶和血肉巨人，还是召唤骷髅仆从，都用不到萨隆邪铁啊。杀入玛雷卡里斯底层，找到那些骷髅符文锻造师，夺取它们正在加工的金属板。我们必须查明缝合场为什么需要用到这种金属。
text.progress: Were you able to capture those rune plates?
text.completion: These plates match the shards almost exactly. They must be using cuttings from them to "enhance" the ghouls produced here. The Scourge is desperate enough to make a weapon of anything, it seems. All the more reason to hasten our destruction of this abominable place!
text.completed: Return to Crusader Olakin Sainrith at Blackwatch in Icecrown.

english.title: The Runesmiths of Malykriss
english.objectives: Bring 5 Runed Saronite Plates to Crusader Olakin Sainrith at Blackwatch.
english.description: Those shards you recovered can only have come from one place, Malykriss. It's the seat of the Lich King's metalworking operations, to the east of Corp'rethar.$B$BWhat's puzzling is that metal isn't needed to stitch together abominations or flesh giants, or to summon skeletal servants. Find the skeletal runesmiths working on the bottom level of Malykriss and capture the plates they're working on. We need to find out why this metal is finding its way to the Fleshwerks.
english.progress: Were you able to capture those rune plates?
english.completion: These plates match the shards almost exactly. They must be using cuttings from them to "enhance" the ghouls produced here. The Scourge is desperate enough to make a weapon of anything, it seems. All the more reason to hasten our destruction of this abominable place!
english.completed: Return to Crusader Olakin Sainrith at Blackwatch in Icecrown.

starters.name: 北伐军战士欧尔拉金·萨利斯

enders.name: 北伐军战士欧尔拉金·萨利斯

text.title: 北伐军之峰的战斗
text.objectives: 前往北伐军之峰，在北伐军祭坛上使用北伐军的神圣军旗。保护旗帜，直到北伐军之峰得到净化，然后向冰冠冰川回音谷的古斯塔夫神父复命。
text.description: <大领主弗丁手持银色北伐军的旗帜。>$B$B这面旗帜与众不同，$n。它拥有神圣的力量，可以净化大片被污染的土地。$B$B带上它往西北方走，穿过突破口，就能抵达此行的目的地——北伐军之峰。那里有一个北伐军的祭坛，将这面旗帜插在祭坛上，并抵御天灾军团的攻击，直到北伐军之峰得到净化。完成任务后就向古斯塔夫神父复命吧。$B$B出发，$n，不要心怀恐惧。
text.completion: Blessed Light! We have taken the pinnacle! Finally, construction of Justice Keep can begin. Highlord Fordring and the knights are already en route to our new base. You must meet them there, $N!
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找回音谷的古斯塔夫神父。

english.title: The Battle For Crusaders' Pinnacle
english.objectives: Venture to Crusaders' Pinnacle and use the Blessed Banner of the Crusade atop the Pile of Crusader Skulls. Defend the banner against Scourge attack until the land atop the pinnacle is sanctified and then return to Father Gustav at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown.
english.description: <Highlord Fordring holds a banner of the Argent Crusade.>$B$BThis banner is like no other, $n. It carries with it a powerful blessing, able to sanctify large tracts of blighted land.$B$BYou must take it northwest, through the Breach, to an area the Scourge have mockingly named Crusaders' Pinnacle. Plant the banner atop the skulls of our fallen brethren at Crusaders' Pinnacle and defend it against attack. Once the land is sanctified, return to Father Gustav.$B$BGo now, $n. Hold no fear in your heart.
english.completion: Blessed Light! We have taken the pinnacle! Finally, construction of Justice Keep can begin. Highlord Fordring and the knights are already en route to our new base. You must meet them there, $N!
english.completed: Return to Father Gustav at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown.

text.title: 女妖的复仇
text.objectives: 约尔达村的白骨女巫要你挑战并击败大领主巴拉加德，为她复仇。
text.description: 时机已经成熟，$n。你和你的朋友必须向大领主巴拉加德发起挑战，他既是巴拉加德堡垒的领主，也是尤顿海姆的统治者。$B$B巴拉加德堡垒位于尤顿海姆的西南边缘，在堡垒顶部有一支号角。你要吹响它，让挑战的号角响彻这片土地。$B$B如此一来，巴拉加德就必须接受你的挑战了。而我……不，瓦尔德玛达将仲裁这场战斗。$B$B<被女妖附身的维库人发出恐怖的笑声。>
text.progress: Overthane Balargarde is not dead. Did you have problems finding his fortress?
text.completion: Words cannot describe what I'm feeling at the moment, $N. My revenge is complete and there is naught else for me to do.$B$BIf only I could be there when the Lich King is finally taken down.$B$BDon't fool yourself though, Jotunheim is far from 'dealt' with. I will remain in possession of this witch until such time as the vrykul are no longer a threat.$B$BLook around, there are many items of value in this cave. Take your pick.
text.completed: Return to The Bone Witch at Njorndar Village in Icecrown.

english.title: Banshee's Revenge
english.objectives: The Bone Witch at Njorndar Village has asked you to exact her revenge by challenging and defeating Overthane Balargarde.
english.description: The time has come, $n. You and your friends must challenge the lord of Balargarde Fortress, the master of Jotunheim, Overthane Balargarde.$B$BAtop the fortress, which is on the southwestern edge of Jotunheim, you will find a horn. Blow into it. Allow your challenge to resound throughout the steadfast.$B$BBalargarde will have no choice but to face you. And I... excuse me, Vardmadra will be there to adjudicate the challenge.$B$B<The banshee-possessed vrykul lets out a bellowing cackle.>
english.progress: Overthane Balargarde is not dead. Did you have problems finding his fortress?
english.completion: Words cannot describe what I'm feeling at the moment, $N. My revenge is complete and there is naught else for me to do.$B$BIf only I could be there when the Lich King is finally taken down.$B$BDon't fool yourself though, Jotunheim is far from 'dealt' with. I will remain in possession of this witch until such time as the vrykul are no longer a threat.$B$BLook around, there are many items of value in this cave. Take your pick.
english.completed: Return to The Bone Witch at Njorndar Village in Icecrown.

text.title: 新兵
text.objectives: 苦难高地的狡诈者维雷斯要你驯服一只轻盈追迹者，然后把它带到苦难高地东北方的岩石上。
text.description: 重要的事情优先解决吧。我在东边的城墙上发现了一些轻盈追迹者，在我们和阿尔萨斯彻底决裂之前，那些家伙曾是我们的仆从，而且堪比世界上最优秀的斥候……只要通过统御之眼控制它们就可以运用它们的能力为我们做事。$B$B我要你飞上城墙，稍微教训一下某个轻盈追迹者，然后使用这枚黑锋魔印强迫它臣服于你，它一定还认得这东西。接着，你就把它带回此地东北方的岩石上，它自己就能回到我身边来。
text.progress: I'm sure their masters don't go easy on them, but there's no way these things would forget the lessons we lashed into their skins. They'll fear those sigils for as long as they crawl this land.
text.completion: I've chained the wretch to the post over there and I'll look into getting my hands on more of them.$B$BNow let's make some use of that eye.
text.completed: Return to Vereth the Cunning at Rise of Suffering in Icecrown.

english.title: New Recruit
english.objectives: Vereth the Cunning on the Rise of Suffering has requested that you bring a subdued Lithe Stalker to the top of the rocks northeast of the Rise of Suffering.
english.description: First things first. I saw some Lithe Stalkers on the ramparts just east of us. They used to serve us before we broke with Arthas, and they're about as perfect a scout as you can get... with a little prodding from an eye of dominion.$B$BFly up, find one of the stalkers, beat it down a bit, and then use this Sigil of the Ebon Blade to command its obedience. It will recognize the sigil, guaranteed. Lead it back to the top of the rocks northeast of here and it will find its way to me.
english.progress: I'm sure their masters don't go easy on them, but there's no way these things would forget the lessons we lashed into their skins. They'll fear those sigils for as long as they crawl this land.
english.completion: I've chained the wretch to the post over there and I'll look into getting my hands on more of them.$B$BNow let's make some use of that eye.
english.completed: Return to Vereth the Cunning at Rise of Suffering in Icecrown.

objectiveDetails.description: 交还被驯服的轻盈追迹者

text.title: 一举两得
text.objectives: 黑色观察站的黑暗骑士阿尔蕾要你借助燃烧的骷髅消灭3只被锁住的憎恶。
text.description: 缝合场的憎恶装配台那里已经制造出了大量的成品。现在，这些怪物都被锁在装配台附近的柱子上。如果我们还不采取行动，它们就要随着巫妖王的部队出征了。$B$B缝合场的白骨堆里有一些骷髅手臂在扭动，这些手臂的原主呢，就是那些可以操纵火焰的骷髅。你要去找到并释放那些骷髅，把它们带到缝合完毕的憎恶附近，然后就等着看好戏吧！
text.progress: Have you destroyed the completed abominations?
text.completion: Ah, good. There's nothing like the smell of roasted putrid flesh in the morning. That's the smell of victory over the Scourge.
text.completed: Return to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch in Icecrown.

english.title: Killing Two Scourge With One Skeleton
english.objectives: Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch wants you to destroy 3 Chained Abominations with Burning Skeletons.
english.description: The workers in the Fleshwerks abomination lab have already completed a number of their creations. For now, the creatures are chained to the pillars around the edge of the lab, but if we do not act, they will march with the Lich King's armies.$B$BGrasping arms reach out of the bone piles spread throughout the Fleshwerks. These arms belong to skeletons enchanted with the power of fire. Find and free these skeletons, then take them near the completed abominations and watch the show!
english.progress: Have you destroyed the completed abominations?
english.completion: Ah, good. There's nothing like the smell of roasted putrid flesh in the morning. That's the smell of victory over the Scourge.
english.completed: Return to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch in Icecrown.

text.title: 邪恶城堡
text.objectives: 苦难高地的狡诈者维雷斯要你使用轻盈追迹者的能力，侦察玛雷卡里斯。
text.description: 首先，我们需要搞清楚敌人的底细。$B$B使用统御之眼控制一只轻盈追迹者，对这一地区进行侦察。我在飞来这里的路上留意到几处特别的地方，希望你能重点调查一下：东北方的高地、东南方的工作区、中央的大熔炉以及西南方的祭祀场。$B$B追迹者拥有惊人的跳跃能力，从高处摔落也不会受伤——你可以利用这一点，在城墙间上跳下窜。
text.progress: Flying may be a bit more graceful, but there's no way we could get in as close as the stalker without being detected.
text.completion: Excellent work. It seems more death knights remained loyal to Arthas than I initially thought.$B$BHe certainly is sparing nothing in his attempt to replace Acherus. A pure saronite citadel would be hard to destroy indeed. There's no need to destroy it though... we can halt production and put down these death knight leaders here and now, before they become a real threat.$B$BMost importantly, we need to disrupt them enough to get those death knights away from from the leaders so that we can make our strike.
text.completed: Return to Vereth the Cunning at Rise of Suffering in Icecrown.

english.title: The Vile Hold
english.objectives: Vereth the Cunning at the Rise of Suffering has requested that you use a Lithe Stalker to scout out Malykriss.
english.description: We need to know what we're up against.$B$BUse the eye of dominion to assume control of a lithe stalker and scout out the area. There are a few spots in particular I saw when flying in that I want you to get a closer look at: the overlook in the northeast, the work area in the southeast, the large forge near the center, and the ritual area in the southwest.$B$BThe stalker can leap far and won't be hurt by large falls - use that to your advantage to get up and down from those ramparts.
english.progress: Flying may be a bit more graceful, but there's no way we could get in as close as the stalker without being detected.
english.completion: Excellent work. It seems more death knights remained loyal to Arthas than I initially thought.$B$BHe certainly is sparing nothing in his attempt to replace Acherus. A pure saronite citadel would be hard to destroy indeed. There's no need to destroy it though... we can halt production and put down these death knight leaders here and now, before they become a real threat.$B$BMost importantly, we need to disrupt them enough to get those death knights away from from the leaders so that we can make our strike.
english.completed: Return to Vereth the Cunning at Rise of Suffering in Icecrown.

text.title: 深信不疑
text.objectives: 狡诈者维雷斯要你使用轻盈追迹者的铁链，将天灾炸弹拖到玛雷卡里斯的4个笨拙的凶尸身边。
text.description: 我们要制造一些麻烦……只要能让这些死亡骑士离开他们的头目身边就行了。如果能设法干掉他们手下的那些爪牙，他们就不得不投入大量精力去监督玛雷卡里斯的工作进展。$B$B憎恶是这次行动的完美猎物——它们行动迟缓、头脑简单，而且相当相当地愚蠢。利用它们对追迹者的信任，将散落在工地上的天灾炸弹拖到它们身边去。在它们反应过来之前，你有足够的时间跑到远处，然后引爆炸弹。
text.progress: Did they even see it coming?
text.completion: They didn't even think to lay a hand on you, did they? At least they're predictable.
text.completed: Return to Vereth the Cunning at Rise of Suffering in Icecrown.

english.title: Generosity Abounds
english.objectives: Vereth the Cunning wants you to use the Lithe Stalker's Iron Chain to drag Scourge Bombs to 4 Lumbering Atrocities inside Malykriss.
english.description: We need to cause some disruption to bring those death knights away from their leaders. If we lay waste to their minions below, I suspect they'll have to devote more attention to keeping a close eye on operations.$B$BAbominations are easy prey - slow, predictable, and most importantly, stupid. Take advantage of their trust of the stalkers to drag them near some of the Scourge bombs scattered throughout the construction area. You'll be able to light the bombs far before they figure out what's going on.
english.progress: Did they even see it coming?
english.completion: They didn't even think to lay a hand on you, did they? At least they're predictable.
english.completed: Return to Vereth the Cunning at Rise of Suffering in Icecrown.

text.title: Matchmaker
text.objectives: Vereth the Cunning at the Rise of Suffering wants you to use a Lithe Stalker to throw rocks at Umbral Brutes as they near lesser undead in Malykriss. Return after you've started 5 fights.
text.description: The major difference between vargul and lesser undead minions is that vargul still possess enough of their minds to despise being used for labor. Never will a vargul be pleased to be working aside skeletons or ghouls.$B$BLets take advantage of this inevitable animosity and start some fights between the umbral brutes and the other undead in Malykriss. That should serve to slow production and bring the death knights down to babysit.$B$BShould be simple - throw rocks at the brutes as they near lesser undead.
text.progress: Predictable louts.
text.completion: No need to sacrifice our own men when they are this easily manipulated, eh?
text.completed: Return to Vereth the Cunning at Rise of Suffering in Icecrown.

english.title: Matchmaker
english.objectives: Vereth the Cunning at the Rise of Suffering wants you to use a Lithe Stalker to throw rocks at Umbral Brutes as they near lesser undead in Malykriss. Return after you've started 5 fights.
english.description: The major difference between vargul and lesser undead minions is that vargul still possess enough of their minds to despise being used for labor. Never will a vargul be pleased to be working aside skeletons or ghouls.$B$BLets take advantage of this inevitable animosity and start some fights between the umbral brutes and the other undead in Malykriss. That should serve to slow production and bring the death knights down to babysit.$B$BShould be simple - throw rocks at the brutes as they near lesser undead.
english.progress: Predictable louts.
english.completion: No need to sacrifice our own men when they are this easily manipulated, eh?
english.completed: Return to Vereth the Cunning at Rise of Suffering in Icecrown.

text.title: 修理项链
text.objectives: 用一颗玉髓石对项链进行修补，然后把它还给达拉然魔法商业区珠宝店的提莫斯·琼斯。
text.description: 这根损坏的项链上附着一张发货单，上面写着：“达拉然 - 魔法商业区 - 卡蒂亚珠宝店 - 提莫斯·琼斯的财产”。$B$B或许你应该把它修好，然后交还给他。
text.progress: What brings you here?
text.completion: How did you find this!  Many of these necklaces were looted from one of my shipments a few weeks ago!  Let me repay you with this Jewelcrafter's Token.
text.completed: Return to Timothy Jones at Cartier & Co. Fine Jewelry in Dalaran.

english.title: Necklace Repair
english.objectives: Repair the necklace with a single Chalcedony and return it to Timothy Jones in at the Jewelcrafters Shop in the Magus Commerce Exchange in Dalaran.
english.description: This damaged necklace has an invoice with it that reads "Property of Timothy Jones - Cartier and Co Fine Jewelry - Magus Commerce Exhange - Dalaran".$B$BPerhaps you should repair it and return it to him.
english.progress: What brings you here?
english.completion: How did you find this!  Many of these necklaces were looted from one of my shipments a few weeks ago!  Let me repay you with this Jewelcrafter's Token.
english.completed: Return to Timothy Jones at Cartier & Co. Fine Jewelry in Dalaran.

text.title: 驱除幻象
text.objectives: 克罗米要你对往日的斯坦索姆内的可疑箱子使用奥术干扰器，然后到斯坦索姆的入口附近去见她。
text.description: 永恒之龙正试图欺骗阿尔萨斯王子，扰乱我们所知的历史。$b$b如果他们骗过了他，让他以为这里的粮食并没有携带瘟疫，那他就不会做出清洗斯坦索姆的决定了。$b$b去找到那些可疑的谷物箱，对它们使用这个奥术干扰器，揭露它们的真面目。
text.completion: You have done well, friend. The plagued grain was exposed to Arthas' troops.$b$bListen carefully, now. There remains more to be done.
text.completed: Return to Chromie in The Culling of Stratholme.

english.title: Dispelling Illusions
english.objectives: Chromie wants you to use the Arcane Disruptor on the suspicious crates in Stratholme Past, then speak to her near the entrance to Stratholme.
english.description: The infinite dragonflight seek to disrupt history by deceiving Prince Arthas.$b$bIf they can convince him that none of the grain here carries the plague, then he'll never have to make the fateful decision to cull Stratholme.$b$bUse this arcane disruptor on any suspicious crates of grain you find.
english.completion: You have done well, friend. The plagued grain was exposed to Arthas' troops.$b$bListen carefully, now. There remains more to be done.
english.completed: Return to Chromie in The Culling of Stratholme.

objectiveDetails.description: 驱散瘟疫谷物箱的伪装

text.title: ZZOLDLost: Widget
text.objectives: Repair the whatsit and return it to Timothy Jones at the Jewelcrafting shop in Dalaran.
text.description: Attached to the bottom of the widget is an invoice that indicates the owner is "Timothy Jones - Jewelershop Name, District Name" in Dalaran.   Perhaps if you fixed it and returned it to him, he would have a reward for you.

english.title: ZZOLDLost: Widget
english.objectives: Repair the whatsit and return it to Timothy Jones at the Jewelcrafting shop in Dalaran.
english.description: Attached to the bottom of the widget is an invoice that indicates the owner is "Timothy Jones - Jewelershop Name, District Name" in Dalaran.   Perhaps if you fixed it and returned it to him, he would have a reward for you.

text.title: 皇家护卫
text.objectives: 克罗米要你陪伴阿尔萨斯完成清洗斯坦索姆的任务。击败玛尔加尼斯后再去见她。
text.description: 阿尔萨斯很快就会陷入绝望的两难境地，并作出那个重大的决定。$b$b我请求你，在王子净化斯坦索姆时，你一定要陪在他身边。$b$b阿尔萨斯必须活着走出斯坦索姆，你一定要帮助他打败玛尔加尼斯！
text.completion: You have done well, $n.$b$bThe Infinites have been foiled and this thread of history remains intact.$b$bI thank you for your invaluable assistance, as does the entire Bronze Dragonflight.
text.completed: Return to Chromie in The Culling of Stratholme.

english.title: A Royal Escort
english.objectives: Chromie has asked you to accompany Arthas in the Culling of Stratholme. You are to speak with her again after Mal'Ganis is defeated.
english.description: Arthas will soon face a desperate dilemma, and make a momentous decision.$b$bI must call upon you to accompany the prince in his culling.$b$bArthas must make it through Stratholme alive and you must see to it that he defeats Mal'Ganis!
english.completion: You have done well, $n.$b$bThe Infinites have been foiled and this thread of history remains intact.$b$bI thank you for your invaluable assistance, as does the entire Bronze Dragonflight.
english.completed: Return to Chromie in The Culling of Stratholme.

text.title: 看医生
text.objectives: 黑色观察站的黑暗骑士阿尔蕾要你进入复生密室，摧毁囚禁“补丁”的金属桩，并且帮助它击败萨布诺克博士。
text.description: 这么说来，它们在复生密室里将邪铁碎片植入食尸鬼体内？我们必须阻止它们，不能让这些新型食尸鬼变成天灾军团对付我们的利器。$B$B前往缝合场，在血肉巨人装配台一带找到复生密室的入口。食尸鬼的首脑萨布诺克博士将他最可怕的造物“补丁”关押在那里。解开“补丁”的锁链，这对你控制天灾生物是非常有用的。
text.progress: Have you unleashed the doctor's creation against him?
text.completion: <Dakrider Arly throws her head back and laughs darkly.>$B$BA fitting end for the 'good' doctor, wouldn't you say?
text.completed: Return to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch in Icecrown.

english.title: A Visit to the Doctor
english.objectives: Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch wants you to destroy the Metal Stake imprisoning Patches in the Sanctum of Reanimation and help him get his revenge on Doctor Sabnok.
english.description: So they've been embedding these ghouls with broken shards of saronite down in the Sanctum of Reanimation? We must put a stop to this, before these ghouls can be deployed against our troops.$B$BFind the entrance to the Sanctum of Reanimation in the flesh giant lab area of the Fleshwerks. There, the ghoul mastermind, Doctor Sabnok, keeps the most fearsome of his creations, Patches. Free Patches from his chains and help him take his revenge on the doctor. Let his own creation be his undoing.
english.progress: Have you unleashed the doctor's creation against him?
english.completion: <Dakrider Arly throws her head back and laughs darkly.>$B$BA fitting end for the 'good' doctor, wouldn't you say?
english.completed: Return to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch in Icecrown.

objectiveDetails.description: 帮助“补丁”击败萨布诺克博士

text.title: 保护士兵
text.objectives: 冬拥堡垒的女巫凯兰娜要你前往冰川瀑布，从部落玩家身上收集10套灌魔的部落护甲。
text.description: 很高兴见到你，$n。虽然战斗暂时告一段落了，但是我们必须立即开始准备足够的军用物资。经过调查，我发现死在冰川瀑布附近的士兵身上的护甲都因为当地的特殊环境的关系，被附上了巨大的能量。部落已经在那里收集这种护甲了。$B$B到冰川瀑布去，杀死你所遇到的部落成员。把他们手中那些灌魔的护甲拿来给我。$B$B如果你找不到部落的士兵，也许可以在那里的元素生物身上发现被它们杀死的冒险者的护甲。
text.progress: So, did you find the armor?
text.completion: Augh. It's still dripping. Couldn't you have at least dried it off first?
text.completed: Return to Sorceress Kaylana in Wintergrasp.

english.title: Warding the Warriors
english.objectives: Sorceress Kaylana at Wintergrasp Fortress wants you to retrieve 10 sets of Imbued Horde Armor from Horde players at the Glacial Falls.
english.description: $n, good to see you. While the battle has subsided for now, we must hurry and replenish our stocks. My research indicates that the armor of soldiers recently slain in the Glacial Falls becomes imbued with an incredible amount of energy. The Horde has been seen collecting armor in the area.$B$BHead to the Glacial Falls and slay any of the Horde you find there. Return their imbued armor to me.$B$BIf you cannot find any of the Horde, you might find the armor of an adventurer slain by the elementals.
english.progress: So, did you find the armor?
english.completion: Augh. It's still dripping. Couldn't you have at least dried it off first?
english.completed: Return to Sorceress Kaylana in Wintergrasp.

text.title: 骨头和箭矢
text.objectives: 冬拥堡垒的制弓师兰多尔弗要你前往阴影森林，从部落玩家那里抢夺10支龙骨箭。
text.description: 龙这种生物真是个奇迹！好吧，至少它们的骨头是个奇迹！我给弓箭手们配备了龙骨制作的箭头。可惜，自从安加萨发生大屠杀以后，就很难从龙骨荒野弄到龙骨了。$B$B不过冬拥湖西边的阴影森林里也有不少龙骨，足够我们用的了。$B$B你现在就到阴影森林去，把你能找到的所有骨片都拿回来！$B$B有人看见部落也在那个地区收集骨片。去杀了那些部落渣滓！
text.progress: How was the hunting? I've heard rumors the place is haunted, though I never venture out there myself.
text.completion: Excellent! This will help fuel the flames of war for days to come.
text.completed: Return to Bowyer Randolph in Wintergrasp.

english.title: Bones and Arrows
english.objectives: Bowyer Randolph at Wintergrasp Fortress wants you to retrieve 10 Quivers of Dragonbone Arrows from Horde players at the Forest of Shadows.
english.description: Dragons are incredible! Well, their bones at least! I've been equipping our archers with arrowheads made of Dragonbone. Unfortunately, since the massacre at Angrathar, it has become almost impossible to get bone from Dragonblight.$B$BHowever, the Forest of Shadows on the western edge of Wintergrasp has enough bones to tide us over.$B$BHead to the Forest of Shadows and bring back any bone splinters you can find!$B$BThe Horde have been seen collecting bone splinters in the area. Slay them!
english.progress: How was the hunting? I've heard rumors the place is haunted, though I never venture out there myself.
english.completion: Excellent! This will help fuel the flames of war for days to come.
english.completed: Return to Bowyer Randolph in Wintergrasp.

text.title: 狡诈者维雷斯
text.objectives: 向苦难高地的狡诈者维雷斯报到。
text.description: 我听到了一些关于玛雷卡里斯和阿尔萨斯组建新的死亡骑士团的传闻，我曾以为他不过是想填补黑锋骑士团的损失而已。但是各种数据都表明，阿尔萨斯想要发展壮大这支新的骑士团。$B$B不久之前，我们派了狡诈者维雷斯前往玛雷卡里斯探查敌情。你可以在玛雷卡里斯以西，白骨之庭内的苦难高地找到他。$B$B你去的时候，尽量不要引起别人的注意。
text.completion: The Vile Hold... a testament to how much Arthas hates losing. Let's drive the blade deep.

english.title: Vereth the Cunning
english.objectives: Report to Vereth the Cunning on the Rise of Suffering in Icecrown.
english.description: I've already heard some rumors regarding Malykriss and Arthas's new death knight order, but I assumed it nothing more than filling the void. These numbers suggest he's trying to take it up a notch though.$B$BWe dispatched one of our best to Malykriss not long ago - Vereth the Cunning. You should be able to find him on the Rise of Suffering, just west of Malykriss, and inside the Court of Bones.$B$BTry not to draw too much attention on your way in.
english.completion: The Vile Hold... a testament to how much Arthas hates losing. Let's drive the blade deep.

text.title: 稀有的草药
text.objectives: 冬拥堡垒的学者特尔萨要你前往生命草原，收集10只部落草药包。
text.description: 天啊，这里可真冷！让我想起了阿古斯上的风雪交加的凯因努斯雪山。在这冰天雪地中，我们的士兵很容易感冒。$B$B到冬拥湖西南方的生命草原去，帮我弄10株生长在那里的红色植物来，我会把它们制成抵御寒气的药物。$B$B有人看见部落也在那一地区收集草药。尽管杀了他们，把草药抢过来！
text.progress: I hope you didn't pull up any of the lashers by mistake! They gave Private Doane quite a whipping last week.
text.completion: Excellent! This will help protect our troops against the cold.
text.completed: Return to Anchorite Tessa in Wintergrasp.

english.title: A Rare Herb
english.objectives: Anchorite Tessa in Wintergrasp Fortress wants you to retrieve 10 Horde Herb Pouches from Horde players in the Steppe of Life.
english.description: My, it its quite chilly up here! Reminds me of the stormy peaks of Kaarinos on Argus. However, with all of this snow and ice, our soldiers can easily catch cold.$B$BHead to the Steppe of Life in southwestern Wintergrasp, and bring me back 10 of the Horde herb pouches you find. I will grind them into a medicine to help protect against the cold.$B$BThe Horde have been seen collecting them from the plant life in the area. Do not hesitate to slay them and retrieve the herbs!
english.progress: I hope you didn't pull up any of the lashers by mistake! They gave Private Doane quite a whipping last week.
english.completion: Excellent! This will help protect our troops against the cold.
english.completed: Return to Anchorite Tessa in Wintergrasp.

text.title: 北伐军之峰
text.objectives: 前往冰冠冰川的北伐军之峰，寻找大领主提里奥·弗丁。
text.description: 你帮助银色北伐军在冰冠冰川的高墙内站稳了脚跟。$n，请以此为傲吧。如今，北伐军之峰已然向巫妖王和他的仆从发出了挑战。$B$B弗丁大人和幸存下来的北伐军战士正在北伐军之峰等你呢。再次穿过突破口，去找大领主吧！
text.completion: A long and arduous journey awaits us as we make our way to the gates of Icecrown Citadel. I, and the soldiers of the Argent Crusade, wish to thank you for all that you have done. We rest easier knowing that you will fight alongside us in this cursed place.$B$B<Highlord Tirion Fordring salutes.>

english.title: The Crusaders' Pinnacle
english.objectives: Seek out Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle in Icecrown.
english.description: Stand proud in knowing that it was you who helped establish the Argent Crusade inside the walls of Icecrown, $n. The Crusaders' Pinnacle now stands in direct defiance of the Lich King and his twisted minions.$B$BHighlord Fordring and the crusaders who survived await your arrival at Crusaders' Pinnacle. Travel once more through the Breach and seek out the highlord!
english.completion: A long and arduous journey awaits us as we make our way to the gates of Icecrown Citadel. I, and the soldiers of the Argent Crusade, wish to thank you for all that you have done. We rest easier knowing that you will fight alongside us in this cursed place.$B$B<Highlord Tirion Fordring salutes.>

text.title: Discretion is Key
text.objectives: Rhonin wants you to go to the Violet Hold in Dalaran and speak with Warden Alturas.
text.description: Listen to me, $r.$b$bIt's just been brought to my attention that there's been an incident at the Violet Hold. It would appear that the blues are launching a full scale invasion of Dalaran!$b$bI need you to get to the prison and speak with Warden Alturas at once. He'll give you the details.$b$bThat is not all. I need this handled with utmost discretion. We mustn't alarm the citizens of Dalaran if it can possibly be avoided. Do I make myself clear?$b$bVery well. Now, go!
text.completion: Not a moment too soon.$b$bAre you prepared to defend Dalaran, $c?

english.title: Discretion is Key
english.objectives: Rhonin wants you to go to the Violet Hold in Dalaran and speak with Warden Alturas.
english.description: Listen to me, $r.$b$bIt's just been brought to my attention that there's been an incident at the Violet Hold. It would appear that the blues are launching a full scale invasion of Dalaran!$b$bI need you to get to the prison and speak with Warden Alturas at once. He'll give you the details.$b$bThat is not all. I need this handled with utmost discretion. We mustn't alarm the citizens of Dalaran if it can possibly be avoided. Do I make myself clear?$b$bVery well. Now, go!
english.completion: Not a moment too soon.$b$bAre you prepared to defend Dalaran, $c?

text.title: Containment
text.objectives: Warden Alturas wants you to enter the Violet Hold and put an end to the blue dragon invasion force. You are to report back to him once Cyanigosa is slain.
text.description: Here is the prison key.$b$bMy men and I will stay here as a last line of defense in the event that you are unable to overcome the assault.$b$bBe sure to speak with Lieutenant Sinclari. She'll provide you with access to the prison's defenses.$b$bHurry, $r. There is little time. The few I left inside won't last long without your help. Report back to me once the invasion forces have been successfully dealt with.
text.progress: Is it over? Were you able to withstand the assault?
text.completion: The crisis is averted, then?$b$bThat is good news indeed. I will forward the news on to Rhonin.$b$bPlease, accept this with the gratitude of Dalaran.
text.completed: Return to Warden Alturas at the Violet Hold in Dalaran.

english.title: Containment
english.objectives: Warden Alturas wants you to enter the Violet Hold and put an end to the blue dragon invasion force. You are to report back to him once Cyanigosa is slain.
english.description: Here is the prison key.$b$bMy men and I will stay here as a last line of defense in the event that you are unable to overcome the assault.$b$bBe sure to speak with Lieutenant Sinclari. She'll provide you with access to the prison's defenses.$b$bHurry, $r. There is little time. The few I left inside won't last long without your help. Report back to me once the invasion forces have been successfully dealt with.
english.progress: Is it over? Were you able to withstand the assault?
english.completion: The crisis is averted, then?$b$bThat is good news indeed. I will forward the news on to Rhonin.$b$bPlease, accept this with the gratitude of Dalaran.
english.completed: Return to Warden Alturas at the Violet Hold in Dalaran.

text.title: Stunning View
text.objectives: Vereth the Cunning at the Rise of Suffering wants you to use a Lithe Stalker's heave ability to destroy 12 sleeping Iceskin Sentries.
text.description: Gargoyles make effective scouts and can be deadly if left to rain attacks from the air, but they have a very obvious weakness. Most of them have to go through long periods resting as stone to maintain the energy they need to carry their heavy bodies through the air.$B$BAs I peered through the eye you were using, I noticed dozens of iceskin sentries resting on the eastern and southern walls inside. Use the stalker to leap up to their ledges and devastate them while they sleep.
text.progress: Almost too easy.
text.completion: Not so much of a threat when they're sleeping.
text.completed: Return to Vereth the Cunning at Rise of Suffering in Icecrown.

english.title: Stunning View
english.objectives: Vereth the Cunning at the Rise of Suffering wants you to use a Lithe Stalker's heave ability to destroy 12 sleeping Iceskin Sentries.
english.description: Gargoyles make effective scouts and can be deadly if left to rain attacks from the air, but they have a very obvious weakness. Most of them have to go through long periods resting as stone to maintain the energy they need to carry their heavy bodies through the air.$B$BAs I peered through the eye you were using, I noticed dozens of iceskin sentries resting on the eastern and southern walls inside. Use the stalker to leap up to their ledges and devastate them while they sleep.
english.progress: Almost too easy.
english.completion: Not so much of a threat when they're sleeping.
english.completed: Return to Vereth the Cunning at Rise of Suffering in Icecrown.

text.title: 邪恶骑士
text.objectives: 苦难高地的狡诈者维雷斯要你杀死洛基尔，邪恶骑士。
text.description: 我们该去拿走这些野兽的徽记了。$B$B我曾在洛基尔身边侍卫许久。他运用邪恶灵气的能力比我见过的其他死亡骑士要高出许多，而且他还是个非常残忍的家伙。$B$B当你在洛基尔的地盘上与他交战时，他的力量会发挥到极限。悲哀的是，我们没有办法避开这种不利局面，不过只要你躲开他的亡灵爪牙，获胜也不是不可能。$B$B要保持灵活，$c。不要有丝毫的轻敌之念。
text.progress: Is it done?
text.completion: The world will be a much better place without Rokir in it - trust me.
text.completed: Return to Vereth the Cunning at Rise of Suffering in Icecrown.

english.title: The Rider of the Unholy
english.objectives: Vereth the Cunning on the Rise of Suffering wants you to kill Rokir, the Rider of the Unholy.
english.description: It's time that we start cutting off the heads of the beast.$B$BI served beside Rokir for quite some time. He knows the unholy arts better than most any other death knight I've met and he's equally as ruthless.$B$BRokir's strengths are most apparent when you are fighting him on his own ground. Sadly, we don't have much option in those regards, but stay on your feet to avoid his undead minions and you should come out victorious.$B$BBe nimble, $c, and do not take him lightly.
english.progress: Is it done?
english.completion: The world will be a much better place without Rokir in it - trust me.
english.completed: Return to Vereth the Cunning at Rise of Suffering in Icecrown.

text.title: 冰霜骑士
text.objectives: 苦难高地的狡诈者维雷斯要你杀死萨芙，冰霜骑士。
text.description: 萨芙……这位死亡骑士和别人不同。她会对你花言巧语，让你相信她的本性并不邪恶，但是转眼之间，她就会微笑着杀了你。$B$B我相信你要战胜她并非难事，但是千万不要掉以轻心。她的危险之处在于，她会让敌人相信自己胜券在握，然后放松警惕，然后发动迅猛的冰霜攻击将其击溃。$B$B所以，你要注意保持警惕，并且不要低估了她。
text.progress: Are we rid of her?
text.completion: I can't deny, I'll miss her laugh... and that smile that would creep onto her face just before she killed someone. A little less need to watch my back though, so I suppose I can't complain.
text.completed: Return to Vereth the Cunning at Rise of Suffering in Icecrown.

english.title: The Rider of Frost
english.objectives: Vereth the Cunning on the Rise of Suffering wants you to kill Sapph, the Rider of Frost.
english.description: Sapph... Sapph's a death knight like no other. She'll shower you with sweet words and you'll swear that she has no evil within her heart, and then she'll run you through without even breaking her smile.$B$BI have no fear that you'll be able to best Sapph, but do not grow overconfident. Her strength lies in lulling her victims into a false ease, shortly before shattering them with a fierce barrage of frost attacks.$B$BDo not let your guard down, and do not underestimate her.
english.progress: Are we rid of her?
english.completion: I can't deny, I'll miss her laugh... and that smile that would creep onto her face just before she killed someone. A little less need to watch my back though, so I suppose I can't complain.
english.completed: Return to Vereth the Cunning at Rise of Suffering in Icecrown.

text.title: 鲜血骑士
text.objectives: 苦难高地的狡诈者维雷斯要你杀死贝洛克，鲜血骑士。
text.description: 贝洛克是极少数逐步晋级上来的维库人，他的地位完全是靠血淋淋的战功累积而来的。如果你死在他手下，那也算不得是一件遗憾的事情。$B$B当你和他交战的时候，记得与同伴们保持彼此之间的距离，并尽可能远离贝洛克。他会毫不犹豫地榨干你们的生命能量，将其据为己有，所以你要有意识地阻止他使用这种能力。$B$B我对你有信心。去干掉他。
text.progress: Is he dead?
text.completion: So he finally lost? Good to hear.
text.completed: Return to Vereth the Cunning at Rise of Suffering in Icecrown.

english.title: The Rider of Blood
english.objectives: Vereth the Cunning on the Rise of Suffering wants you to kill Baelok, the Rider of Blood.
english.description: Baelok is one of the few vrykul that I've ever seen rise through the ranks, and that was mostly accomplished through sheer brutality. If your competition ends up dead, there's far less to compete against.$B$BWhen you join battle with him, spread out from your companions and keep your distance as much as you reasonably can. He will not hesitate to steal your life force for himself, so you will need to hinder his ability to do so as much as possible.$B$BYou have my confidence. See to it that he dies.
english.progress: Is he dead?
english.completion: So he finally lost? Good to hear.
english.completed: Return to Vereth the Cunning at Rise of Suffering in Icecrown.

text.title: 血毒的命运
text.objectives: 苦难高地的狡诈者维雷斯要你杀死奥尔巴兹·血毒。
text.description: 杀死苦难之主骑士团的几个头目之后，我们就要去对付他们真正的首领——奥尔巴兹·血毒。$B$B在你外出执行任务的时候，莫格莱尼来找过我，他将奥尔巴兹的藏身之处告诉了我。在冰冠堡垒的地下，有一座巨大的深渊——你可以在深渊的边缘找到奥尔巴兹。$B$B我们已经派出了最精锐的黑锋骑士协助你战斗。奥尔巴兹的末日已经到了。
text.progress: Are we finally free of that Arthas want-to-be?
text.completion: Morgraine himself arrived to see the deed done then? I imagine there was some ill blood between those two - no surprise that he wanted a piece of the wretch.$b$bYou've done exceedingly well, $r, and you shall be awarded appropriately. The Ebon Blade thanks you.
text.completed: Return to Vereth the Cunning at Rise of Suffering in Icecrown.

english.title: The Fate of Bloodbane
english.objectives: Vereth on the Rise of Suffering has dispatched you to kill Orbaz Bloodbane.
english.description: With the riders of the Host of Suffering dead, now is the time to put an end to their true leader: Orbaz Bloodbane.$B$BMograine caught up with me while you were off and told me that he found where Orbaz is hiding. Under Icecrown Citadel itself, there is an immense pit - you will find Orbaz just outside its lip.$B$BSome of the Ebon Blade's strongest agents have already been dispatched - gather aid and join the fight. It is time for Bloodbane to die.
english.progress: Are we finally free of that Arthas want-to-be?
english.completion: Morgraine himself arrived to see the deed done then? I imagine there was some ill blood between those two - no surprise that he wanted a piece of the wretch.$b$bYou've done exceedingly well, $r, and you shall be awarded appropriately. The Ebon Blade thanks you.
english.completed: Return to Vereth the Cunning at Rise of Suffering in Icecrown.

text.title: 夺回阿彻鲁斯
text.objectives: 使用你的黑锋之门法术返回阿彻鲁斯：黑锋要塞。抵达阿彻鲁斯之后，向大领主达里安·莫格莱尼报到。
text.description: 迷雾已经散去。就像那天我将灰烬使者插进自己的心脏，以此解除父亲那被诅咒的灵魂时一样，我感到非常清醒。那也是我作为自由之身所保留的最后一丝记忆了。$B$B为了在这个新的世界中继续生存下去，我们必须把阿彻鲁斯从天灾军团手中夺回来。我已经教你学会召唤黑锋之门的方法了。你可以通过黑锋之门返回阿彻鲁斯，$n。现在就打开黑锋之门，到阿彻鲁斯去找我。黑锋骑士团的第一场战斗正在激烈地进行着！让天灾军团去死吧！
text.completion: The Lich King has returned to Northrend, wounded by the Ashbringer, but the second floor still holds the last of his armies.

english.title: Taking Back Acherus
english.objectives: Use your Death Gate spell to return to Acherus: The Ebon Hold. Report to Highlord Darion Mograine once you arrive.
english.description: The haze has been lifted. I can see as clearly now as the day that I plunged the Ashbringer into my own heart to free my father's cursed soul: my last memory as a free man.$B$BWe must take back Acherus from the Scourge if our order is to survive in this new world. I have taught you how to call forth a death gate. The death gate will return you to Acherus when you call upon it, $n. Use it now and meet me at Acherus. The first battle of the Knights of the Ebon Blade is underway! Death to the Scourge!
english.completion: The Lich King has returned to Northrend, wounded by the Ashbringer, but the second floor still holds the last of his armies.

starters.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: 黑锋要塞之战
text.objectives: 杀死10个天灾亡灵，并参与消灭帕奇维克的战斗。成功之后，回去向大领主达里安·莫格莱尼复命。
text.description: 命令大厅已经被我们占领了，但是巫妖王在阿彻鲁斯之心给我们留下了一点小礼物。那个可怕的缝合怪物——帕奇维克和一群憎恶占领了第二层。$B$B使用传送器前往第二层，消灭剩余的天灾部队。不要试图独自挑战帕奇维克！你必须协同阿彻鲁斯的其他死亡骑士，一起攻击那个怪物！$B$B出发吧，$n。我的力量与你同在！
text.progress: Acherus will be ours!
text.completion: Well done, death knight. The remaining Scourge will be dealt with in short order and the rebuilding process will begin anew.$B$BI have but one last task for you.
text.completed: Return to Highlord Darion Mograine in Ebon Hold.

english.title: The Battle For The Ebon Hold
english.objectives: Slay 10 Scourge and help kill Patchwerk. Return to Highlord Darion Mograine should you succeed.
english.description: The Hall of Command has been secured, but the Lich King has left us a little present in the Heart of Acherus. The stitched terror, Patchwerk, and a horde of abominations have taken over the second floor.$B$BUse the teleporter to get to the second floor and destroy the Scourge forces that remain. Do not engage Patchwerk alone! You must fight the monstrosity with other death knights of Acherus!$B$BGo, $n. You have my strength to carry you!
english.progress: Acherus will be ours!
english.completion: Well done, death knight. The remaining Scourge will be dealt with in short order and the rebuilding process will begin anew.$B$BI have but one last task for you.
english.completed: Return to Highlord Darion Mograine in Ebon Hold.
