text.title: Death to the Traitor King
text.objectives: Kilix the Unraveler in the Pit of Narjun has tasked you with defeating Anub'arak in Azjol-Nerub. You are to return to Kilix with Anub'arak's Broken Husk.
text.description: Anub'arak, the traitor king, makes his home in the once proud underland of Azjol-Nerub.$b$bSince his betrayal, he has twisted and perverted our homeland into the wretched squalor it is today. He rules over an army of undead nerubians who, like their leader, have pledged themselves to serving the Lich King.$b$bBring an end to the traitor king's reign, $c. You will be doing a great service to both of our peoples.$b$bIf you manage to succeed where all others have failed, bring me the husk of Anub'arak.
text.progress: Is it done, $c? Has the traitor king finally met his end?
text.completion: <A fierce glow emanantes from all of Kilix's eyes as he stares at the husk.>$b$bIt is DONE!$b$b$R! Your name shall be recorded in the history of our people.$b$bI am in your debt....
text.completed: Return to Kilix the Unraveler at the Pit of Narjun in Dragonblight.

text.title: 离别礼物
text.objectives: 暗影拱顶的克里托斯·血刃要你使用统御之眼控制一只被捕获的幻象观察者。
text.description: 瞧瞧……统御之眼。诅咒教派通常会不遗余力地保护这种东西，不过大概是在自家老巢被血洗时，他们实在无暇他顾。$B$B通过统御之眼，任何拥有相关力量的生物都可以精确地控制某个亡灵奴仆的行动。你可以想象得到，这对你控制食尸鬼或是骷髅是非常有用的。$B$B想试试吗？喏，拿那边的影魔练练手吧。
text.progress: The options of subterfuge made available to us with the eyes are obvious.  These will be very useful tools.
text.completion: Nothing to it, eh? Any intelligent being should have little trouble controlling lesser undead. I suspect only the likes of a true necromancer could use these to sieze control of any of the more powerful undead. That won't be a problem though - I can already think of quite a variety of destruction we can wreak with even the most paltry minions.$B$BShall we have at it then?
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找暗影拱顶的克里托斯·血刃。

english.title: Parting Gifts
english.objectives: Keritose Bloodblade at the Shadow Vault wants you to use an Eye of Dominion to take control of a captured Eidolon Watcher.
english.description: Look what we have here... eyes of dominion. The Cult normally goes to great lengths to keep these things safe, but I suppose their options for retreat are few when we're slaughtering them in their own home.$B$BThe eyes allow a being of any relative power to control an undead minion's actions precisely. As you can imagine, this can be extremely useful when it comes to your typical clumsy ghoul or skeleton.$B$BCare to try your hand at it? Use one of the eyes to control a captured shade.
english.progress: The options of subterfuge made available to us with the eyes are obvious.  These will be very useful tools.
english.completion: Nothing to it, eh? Any intelligent being should have little trouble controlling lesser undead. I suspect only the likes of a true necromancer could use these to sieze control of any of the more powerful undead. That won't be a problem though - I can already think of quite a variety of destruction we can wreak with even the most paltry minions.$B$BShall we have at it then?
english.end: Seize Control of an Eidolon Watcher
english.completed: Return to Keritose Bloodblade at the Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

text.title: 亡灵的好朋友
text.objectives: 暗影拱顶的克里托斯·血刃要你使用幻象观察者给18条饥饿的瘟疫恶犬喂食。
text.description: 按照惯例，西南边那座萨隆邪铁采掘场里的亡灵会故意让瘟疫犬饿着，以保持它们的攻击性。你可以控制影魔去接近那些猎犬，喂它们一点吃的。我敢保证，它们肯定不会冲你乱吠，说不定还会认你做主子呢。$B$B但是在喂饱猎犬之前，不要靠近它们。你的影魔是逃不过它们的鼻子的。
text.progress: No need to be wasteful - those hounds will serve whoever bothers to feed them.
text.completion: Put them right to sleep, didn't it?
text.completed: Return to Keritose Bloodblade at the Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

english.title: An Undead's Best Friend
english.objectives: Keritose Bloodblade at the Shadow Vault wants you to use the Eidolon Watcher to feed 18 Hungering Plaguehounds.
english.description: As is usual practice, the undead at the saronite quarry to the southwest starve plaguehounds to keep them extra aggressive. Use the shade to get up close and feed some of those hounds and I promise you they'll be content to leave you alone, if not side with the hand that fed them.$B$BDon't get too close to those things until you've fed them though. Their noses don't fall victim to your shade's elusiveness.
english.progress: No need to be wasteful - those hounds will serve whoever bothers to feed them.
english.completion: Put them right to sleep, didn't it?
english.completed: Return to Keritose Bloodblade at the Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

objectiveDetails.description: 给饥饿的瘟疫恶犬喂食

text.title: 不择手段
text.objectives: 暗影拱顶的克里托斯·血刃要你去刺杀20名永不休息的斥候。
text.description: 食尸鬼是非常脆弱的东西，西南边萨隆邪铁采掘场里的那些守卫也不例外。我可以肯定，你只消控制一只影魔，就可以潜入那里，悄无声息地放倒那些守卫。$B$B你要用最短的时间干掉最多的守卫……我们要在发动总攻前尽量削减它们的数量。
text.progress: Hard to lookout for what can't be seen.
text.completion: Without even getting your hands dirty.
text.completed: Return to Keritose Bloodblade at the Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

english.title: Honor is for the Weak
english.objectives: Keritose Bloodblade at the Shadow Vault would like you to assassinate 20 Restless Lookouts.
english.description: Ghouls are fragile things when it comes down to it, and the lookouts at the saronite quarry down the path to the southwest are no exception. Using one of the shades, I have no doubt that you can sneak up and put down their lookouts without making a sound.$B$BClear out as many lookouts as you can reach in a reasonable amount of time... we'll want their ranks thinned for our assault to come.
english.progress: Hard to lookout for what can't be seen.
english.completion: Without even getting your hands dirty.
english.completed: Return to Keritose Bloodblade at the Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

text.title: From Whence They Came
text.objectives: Keritose Bloodblade at the Shadow Vault has sent you to banish 10 Scourge Containment Crystals.
text.description: My main concern is the saronite quarry down the path to the southwest. They are pulling up immense amounts of ore from that quarry and I'd like to know what they're building with it. To that end, we'll start by weakening their defenses.$B$BI noticed a series of crystals scattered throughout the base and I assume they are defensive structures of some sort, not unlike ziggurats. Use the eidolon watcher to destroy any of those crystals that you find.
text.progress: Are those crystals out of the way? I don't want them to prove a nasty surprise for my gryphons.
text.completion: Excellent work. We should have little threat in the air then.
text.completed: Return to Keritose Bloodblade at the Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

text.title: Seeds of Chaos
text.objectives: Keritose Bloodblade at the Shadow Vault has dispatched you to slaughter 80 undead in the Weeping Quarry. Speak to him to secure a skeletal gryphon for the assault.
text.description: Effective tool, is it not? Excellent job weakening their defenses, $c. Now we can push the main assault.$B$BThe plan here is straight-foward - we're looking to destroy anything moving, and get in there and steal some information amidst the confusion.$B$BLet me know when you're ready and I'll set you up with a skeletal gryphon.
text.progress: Have some fun of it, eh?
text.completion: Practically defenseless. It doesn't get much easier than that.
text.completed: Return to Keritose Bloodblade at the Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

text.title: Amidst the Confusion
text.description: We got our hands on quite a few workers. They should do nicely.$B$BI want you to use an eye to bring one of these workers back into the quarry. With the entire camp in disarray, there's no way they'll be able to distinguish you from any of the other workers that were scattered by the assault.$B$BFind whoever is in charge of the operation and get to work. With any luck, we'll find out where that Saronite is being shipped off to pretty quickly. I'll watch over your shoulder through the eye.

text.title: Amidst the Confusion
text.objectives: Keritose Bloodblade at the Shadow Vault has requested a Weeping Quarry Document, a Weeping Quarry Ledger, a Weeping Quarry Map, and a Weeping Quarry Schedule.
text.description: Shutting down their operation is just half of the plan. The other important goal here is to find out where all that saronite is being sent. We know of a few places it's been ending up, but the amount they're pulling out suggests to me that there's a bigger project in the works.$B$BOnce you're inside the quarry, get your hands on any of their documents that you can find. If you're assaulting the place with one of the gryphons, you can drop down from it as soon as the wetwork is done.
text.progress: Did you bring back what I requested?
text.completion: Let's see here... what do we have...$B$B<Keritose buries his head in the papers for a bit, seemingly gleaning little that he did not already know. Suddenly he finds what he is looking for...>$B$BMalykriss! The Vile Hold. It seems Arthas did not take the loss of his death knights so well... I'm not exactly sure what he's doing with all of that saronite, but I have a feeling he might be overcompensating for something.$B$BThat boy is not used to losing.
text.completed: Return to Keritose Bloodblade at the Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

text.title: 绝不留情
text.objectives: 冬拥堡垒的指挥官萨纳斯要你去杀死10个部落玩家。
text.description: 欢迎来到冬拥堡垒，$n。你的任务很简单：去杀掉十个最精锐的部落士兵。现在就去！为联盟带来胜利！
text.progress: Well, have you completed your mission?
text.completion: Glorious! Truly, you are among the champions of the Alliance.
text.completed: Return to Commander Zanneth in Wintergrasp.

english.title: No Mercy for the Merciless
english.objectives: Commander Zanneth in Wintergrasp Fortress wants you to slay 10 members of the Horde.
english.description: Welcome to the Wintergrasp Fortress, $n. Your mission is simple. Defeat ten of the Horde's finest. Now, go! Bring victory to the Alliance!
english.progress: Well, have you completed your mission?
english.completion: Glorious! Truly, you are among the champions of the Alliance.
english.completed: Return to Commander Zanneth in Wintergrasp.

text.title: 全都干掉！
text.objectives: 冬拥堡垒的指挥官达尔多什要你去杀死10个联盟玩家。
text.description: 欢迎来到冬拥堡垒，$n。督军加尔鲁什大人只有一个要求：把敌人全都干掉！$B$B杀掉十个最精锐的联盟士兵之后再回来见我。
text.progress: Well, have you completed your mission?
text.completion: Lok'tar! Victory for the Horde!
text.completed: Return to Commander Dardosh in Wintergrasp.

english.title: Slay them all!
english.objectives: Commander Dardosh in Wintergrasp Fortress wants you to slay 10 members of the Alliance.
english.description: Welcome to the Wintergrasp Fortress, $n. Warlord Garrosh demands one thing: Slay them all!$B$BReturn to me when ten of the strongest members of the Alliance are dead.
english.progress: Well, have you completed your mission?
english.completion: Lok'tar! Victory for the Horde!
english.completed: Return to Commander Dardosh in Wintergrasp.

text.title: 绝不留情
text.objectives: 冬拥湖的指挥官萨纳斯要你去杀死10个部落士兵。
text.description: 欢迎来到冬拥湖，$n。你的任务很简单：去干掉十个最精锐的部落士兵。现在就去！为联盟带来胜利！
text.progress: Well, have you completed your mission?
text.completion: Glorious! Truly, you are among the champions of the Alliance.
text.completed: Return to Commander Zanneth in Wintergrasp.

text.title: 冬拥湖的胜利
text.objectives: 取得一场冬拥湖战斗的胜利，然后向冬拥湖的参谋官安布拉米斯复命。你必须亲自参与战斗，才能获得胜利后的奖励。
text.description: 如果你能让指挥官萨纳斯看到一大堆部落士兵的尸体，他或许会感到满意，但是对于无畏远征军而言，控制冬拥湖才是最重要的目标。你一定要保证我们拥有对这个地区的控制权。$B$B但是，不要以为你只需要躲在一边发呆，让你的盟友去冲锋陷阵就行了。如果你在战斗结束的时候没有达到至少第二级的军衔，就别回来见我。
text.progress: Do you bring word of victory?
text.completion: Just what I wanted to hear!  A victory in Lake Wintergrasp - even a temporary one - is crucial to our overall strategy against the Horde.
text.completed: 去找冬拥湖的参谋官安布拉米斯。

english.title: Victory in Wintergrasp
english.objectives: Win a Wintergrasp battleground match and return to Tactical Officer Abrahmis in Wintergrasp. You must have participated in the battle to be credited for the victory.
english.description: Commander Zanneth might be satisfied with a pile of Horde corpses at his feet, but controlling Wintergrasp is of the utmost importance to the Valiance Expedition. Make sure it remains in our control.$B$BHowever, don't think we'll just let you stand around while your allies do your dirty work for you. If you're not at least a second level recruit by the end of the battle, don't come back.
english.progress: Do you bring word of victory?
english.completion: Just what I wanted to hear!  A victory in Lake Wintergrasp - even a temporary one - is crucial to our overall strategy against the Horde.
english.completed: Return to Tactical Officer Ahbramis in Wintergrasp.

text.title: Don't Forget the Eggs!
text.objectives: Kilix the Unraveler in the Pit of Narjun wants you to enter Azjol-Nerub and destroy 6 Nerubian Scourge Eggs.
text.description: Throughout Azjol-Nerub, the scourged nerubians carefully nurture eggs that will soon hatch, providing them even greater numbers.$b$bIt would do little good for the caverns to be cleansed of the undead that stain them if these fouled eggs were left to hatch and take their place.$b$bAs you  explore the expanse that was once Azjol-Nerub, be sure to clear our ancient home of any scourge eggs you find.
text.progress: Were you able to rid our home of the scourged eggs?
text.completion: It saddens me to see that things have come to this. If only we could return our great empire to what it once was...
text.completed: Return to Kilix the Unraveler at the Pit of Narjun in Dragonblight.

text.title: 冬拥湖的胜利
text.objectives: 赢得一场冬拥湖战斗的胜利，然后向冬拥湖的参谋官基尔拉斯复命。你必须亲自参与战斗，才能获得胜利后的奖励。
text.description: 虽然只要你能不断杀敌，达尔多什就会感到满意，但是对于我们来说，控制冬拥堡垒才是最重要的目标。你一定要保证我们拥有对这个地区的控制权。$B$B但是，不要以为你只需要躲在一边发呆，让你的盟友去冲锋陷阵就行了。如果你在战斗结束的时候没有达到至少第二级的军衔，就别回来见我。
text.progress: What news do you bring?
text.completion: It is a truly great thing you have accomplished this day. Be recognized for your sacrifice!
text.completed: 去找冬拥湖的参谋官基尔拉斯。

english.title: Victory in Wintergrasp

english.description: While Dardosh might be content with slaying our foes, it is of the utmost importance that we control Wintergrasp Fortress. Do whatever it takes to ensure Wintergrasp is ours.$B$BHowever, don't think we'll just let you stand around while your allies do your dirty work for you. If you're not at least a second level recruit by the end of the battle, don't come back.
english.progress: What news do you bring?
english.completion: It is a truly great thing you have accomplished this day. Be recognized for your sacrifice!
english.completed: Return to Tactical Officer Kilrath in Wintergrasp.

text.title: 阻止攻城
text.objectives: 冬拥堡垒的莫普中尉要你摧毁3辆联盟攻城器械。
text.description: 我听见了！联盟很快就要来了。去摧毁三辆联盟攻城器械，然后回来向莫普复命。
text.progress: Have you destroyed their siege vehicles?
text.completion: Good job. Murp wish he was there to help.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Murp in Wintergrasp.

english.title: Stop the Siege
english.objectives: Lieutenant Murp in Wintergrasp Fortress wants you to destroy 3 Alliance siege machines.
english.description: I hears dem! The Alliance come soon. Destroy three Alliance siege devices and come back to Murp.
english.progress: Have you destroyed their siege vehicles?
english.completion: Good job. Murp wish he was there to help.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Murp in Wintergrasp.

text.title: 阻止攻城
text.objectives: 冬拥堡垒的资深攻城技师雷格索要你摧毁3辆部落攻城器械。
text.description: 部落迟早会开始对这座堡垒发动攻势的。去摧毁他们的三辆攻城器械，然后回来向我复命。
text.progress: There is no time to waste, have you destroyed their siege vehicles?
text.completion: Excellent. That should slow down their assault.
text.completed: Return to Senior Demolitionist Legoso in Wintergrasp.

english.title: Stop the Siege
english.objectives: Senior Demolitionist Legoso in Wintergrasp Fortress wants you to destroy 3 Horde siege machines.
english.description: It is only a matter of time before this castle is besieged by the forces of the Horde. Destroy three of their siege devices and return to me.
english.progress: There is no time to waste, have you destroyed their siege vehicles?
english.completion: Excellent. That should slow down their assault.
english.completed: Return to Senior Demolitionist Legoso in Wintergrasp.

text.title: 无面者
text.objectives: 安卡赫特的先知伊克塞特要你去杀死传令官沃拉兹和他身边的3个被遗忘的无面者。
text.description: 我的同胞们在对抗亡灵天灾的战斗中，一旦遭到失败，就会采取往深处挖洞的办法躲避敌人。$B$B可他们不经意间放出了一群古神的爪牙，一种名为无面者的生物。$B$B最终，我们无法在遭到两面夹击的情况下坚持战斗，输掉了战争。$B$B但有了你的帮助，我们或许就能彻底消灭无面者。
text.progress: Have you overcome the faceless ones, $c?
text.completion: You have done well, $c.$b$bWith the servants of the Old Gods defeated, the time is upon my people to retake our ancient home.
text.completed: Return to Seer Ixit in Ahn'Kahet.
text.giverWindow: 我们的工作就快完成了。

english.title: The Faceless Ones
english.objectives: Seer Ixit in Ahn'Kahet wants you to kill Herald Volazj and the three Forgotten Ones that accompany him.
english.description: In my peoples' struggle against the forces of the undead, they dug deeper as they lost ground.$b$bThey inadvertently exposed minions of the Old Gods known only as the Faceless.$b$bIn the end, we could not fight a war on two fronts.$B$BWith your aid, perhaps the Faceless will finally fall.
english.progress: Have you overcome the faceless ones, $c?
english.completion: You have done well, $c.$b$bWith the servants of the Old Gods defeated, the time is upon my people to retake our ancient home.
english.completed: Return to Seer Ixit in Ahn'Kahet.

text.title: 王者之城
text.objectives: 前往暴风城的暴风要塞，将信交给联盟的安度因·乌瑞恩国王。
text.description: 你现在是——也永远是——黑锋骑士团的一员了，$n。但是你要记住：你曾经是联盟的英雄。$B$B<达里安凝视着你。>$B$B为了生存下去，我们的骑士团一定要与其他势力建立同盟关系。你将代表黑锋骑士团去与联盟结盟。$B$B在我东南方的平台上，有一道通向暴风城的传送门。拿着这封弗丁大人交给我的介绍信，通过传送门前往暴风城，把它呈给安度因·乌瑞恩国王。
text.progress: You have mere moments to live.
text.completion: <Varian stares off into the distance.>$B$BIndeed old friend... Blood and honor.$B$B<Varian affixes his gaze upon you.>$B$BWere it not for this letter from Tirion, you would be a stain upon my floor. Only an endorsement from one of the greatest paladins to ever live could have ensured your survival.$B$BWe... We will work together against the Scourge. Against the Lich King!$B$BGLORY TO THE ALLIANCE!

english.title: Where Kings Walk
english.objectives: Deliver the letter to King Anduin Wrynn of the Alliance at Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.
english.description: You are now, and forever will be, a Knight of the Ebon Blade, $n, but know this: you were once a hero of the Alliance.$B$B<Darion stares at you.>$B$BThis order must establish allies for itself if it is to survive. You must represent the Knights of the Ebon Blade to the Alliance.$B$BOn the platform, southeast of me, is a portal to Stormwind City. Take this letter, given to me on your behalf by Lord Fordring, and deliver it to King Anduin Wrynn. Use the portal.
english.progress: You have mere moments to live.
english.completion: <Varian stares off into the distance.>$B$BIndeed old friend... Blood and honor.$B$B<Varian affixes his gaze upon you.>$B$BWere it not for this letter from Tirion, you would be a stain upon my floor. Only an endorsement from one of the greatest paladins to ever live could have ensured your survival.$B$BWe... We will work together against the Scourge. Against the Lich King!$B$BGLORY TO THE ALLIANCE!

starters.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: 萨鲁法尔的祝福
text.objectives: 前往奥格瑞玛，将信交给萨鲁法尔大王。
text.description: 你现在是——也永远是——黑锋骑士团的一员了，$n。但是你要记住：你曾经是部落的英雄。$B$B<达里安凝视着你。>$B$B为了生存下去，我们的骑士团一定要与其他势力建立同盟关系。你将代表黑锋骑士团去与部落结盟。$B$B在我东南方的平台上，有一道通向奥格瑞玛的传送门。拿着这封弗丁大人交给我的介绍信，通过传送门前往奥格瑞玛，把它呈给萨鲁法尔大王。
text.progress: An interesting turn of events.
text.completion: Eitrigg is alive because of this paladin. He would have been executed had Lord Fordring not broken him out of Stratholme.$b$bTirion Fordring, to have sacrificed everything to save the life of an orc... I have ever only known one other human to make such a sacrifice.$b$b<Thrall blinks back a tear.>$b$bYou will be in my heart always, Taretha.$b$bYes. For Tirion Fordring and for Eitrigg! We will accept you as a member of the Horde and your order as allies.$b$bBlood and honor! For the Horde!

english.title: Saurfang's Blessing
english.objectives: Deliver the letter to High Overlord Saurfang at Orgrimmar.
english.description: You are now, and forever will be, a Knight of the Ebon Blade, $n, but know this: you were once a hero of the Horde.$B$B<Darion stares at you.>$B$BThis order must establish allies for itself if it is to survive. You must represent the Knights of the Ebon Blade to the Horde.$B$BOn the platform, southeast of me, is a portal to Orgrimmar. Take this letter, given to me on your behalf by Lord Fordring, and deliver it to High Overlord Saurfang. Use the portal.
english.progress: An interesting turn of events.
english.completion: Eitrigg is alive because of this paladin. He would have been executed had Lord Fordring not broken him out of Stratholme.$b$bTirion Fordring, to have sacrificed everything to save the life of an orc... I have ever only known one other human to make such a sacrifice.$b$b<Thrall blinks back a tear.>$b$bYou will be in my heart always, Taretha.$b$bYes. For Tirion Fordring and for Eitrigg! We will accept you as a member of the Horde and your order as allies.$b$bBlood and honor! For the Horde!

starters.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: All Things in Good Time
text.objectives: Kilix the Unraveler in the Pit of Narjun wants you to obtain an Ahn'kahar Watcher's Corpse and place it upon the Ahn'kahet Brazier in Ahn'kahet.$b$bThis quest can only be completed on Heroic Difficulty.
text.description: Ahn'kahet, from whence we came...$b$bOne day, I dream, we shall overcome the death and darkness that hold our ancient home in their grip. To that end, I have a plan to weaken the resolve of our enemies.$b$bTheir precious Watchers must burn!$b$bTake their corpses and place them upon the brazier deep within the city. The scent of their burnt remains will linger in the air, reminding our enemy of their weakness.$b$bBe mindful, $c! Their undead corpses are most fragile and will deteriorate rapidly.
text.progress: Were you able to burn a Watcher's corpse, $r?
text.completion: Ahah!$b$bMay the mocking scent of failure eat at their empty souls!$b$bThank you, $c. Today, you have struck a blow against the unliving.
text.completed: Return to Kilix the Unraveler at the Pit of Narjun in Dragonblight.

The scent of their burnt remains will linger in the air, reminding our enemy of their weakness.$b$bBe mindful, $c! Their undead corpses are most fragile and will deteriorate rapidly.

english.completion: Ahah!$b$bMay the mocking scent of failure eat at their empty souls!$b$bThank you, $c. Today, you have struck a blow against the unliving.

text.title: 战车的燃料
text.objectives: 冬拥堡垒的攻城技师斯托霍夫要你前往烈焰之坑，收集10份永恒灰烬。
text.description: Lok'tar，$n！虽然战事暂时平息了，但我们必须为抵御联盟的攻击做好准备！到冬拥湖东南方的烈焰之坑去，弄一些永恒灰烬回来。$B$B这种灰烬里含有煤炭，可以充当攻城车辆的燃料。$B$B我们得到情报，联盟的猪猡整天都在收集这种灰烬。杀了他们，把他们手里的灰烬抢过来！如果他们撤出了那个地区，你就去干掉一些火元素，夺取灰烬！
text.progress: Well? Did you manage to find the embers or did the Alliance beat you to it and leave you crying?
text.completion: Excellent! This will help us defeat the Alliance in the battles to come!
text.completed: Return to Siegesmith Stronghoof in Wintergrasp.

english.title: Fueling the Demolishers
english.objectives: Siegesmith Stronghoof at Wintergrasp Fortress wants you to retrieve 10 Eternal Embers from Alliance players in the Cauldron of Flames.
english.description: Lok'tar, $n! While the battle may be over, we must prepare for the Alliance's next assault! Travel to the Cauldron of Flames in south eastern Wintergrasp and retrieve ten eternal embers.$B$BThe embers are mixed in with coal to fuel the Demolishers and Siege Engines. $B$BWe've heard reports of Alliance pigs collecting the embers all day. Slay them and take their embers! If they have already abandoned the area, then be prepared to fight the fire elementals there until you find some!
english.progress: Well? Did you manage to find the embers or did the Alliance beat you to it and leave you crying?
english.completion: Excellent! This will help us defeat the Alliance in the battles to come!
english.completed: Return to Siegesmith Stronghoof in Wintergrasp.

text.title: 防卫城墙
text.objectives: 冬拥堡垒的邪咒师弗尔金要你前往冰川瀑布，收集10套灌魔的联盟护甲。
text.description: 嘿，朋友。你知道吗，这个地方简直让我神经衰弱。$B$B这里游荡着太多的幽灵。我想要增强巫毒守卫，但我需要一些灵魂，朋友。但不是任何灵魂都有用的，只有强大战士的灵魂才行。$B$B冬拥湖东边的冰川瀑布那里有一种特别适合抽取灵魂的东西。去杀死那里的联盟士兵，他们身上或许有我们需要的材料。$B$B把死者的护甲给我带来。如果找不到联盟的人，那里元素生物身上或许会有。
text.progress: Did ya bring da armor, mon?
text.completion: Ooh, ya dats da stuff, mon!
text.completed: Return to Hoodoo Master Fu'jin in Wintergrasp.

english.title: Warding the Walls
english.objectives: Hoodoo Master Fu'jin at Wintergrasp Fortress wants you to retrieve 10 Enchanted Alliance Breastplates at the Glacial Falls.
english.description: Hey 'mon. This place be givin' me dah heebie jeebies, don't cha know?$B$BWay too many spirits haunting dis place. I want ta be placing hoodoo wards up, but I be needin' some souls, mon. Not any soul though, only da soul of a strong warrior could do da job.$B$BThe Glacial Falls in east Wintergrasp be havin' dem special properties to extract da soul. Slay the Alliance there, mebbe they be havin' the stuff we need.$B$BBring back da armor of the slain. If there be no Alliance maybe da elementals got 'em, mon.
english.progress: Did ya bring da armor, mon?
english.completion: Ooh, ya dats da stuff, mon!
english.completed: Return to Hoodoo Master Fu'jin in Wintergrasp.

text.title: Bones and Arrows
text.objectives: Lieutenant Vieron Blazefeather at Wintergrasp Fortress wants you to retrieve 10 Quivers of Dragonbone Arrows from Alliance players in the Forest of Shadows.
text.description: Why would they set me to the task of arming our archers? I was a poet, not a ranger! Well, no use complaining. $n, I am in need of dragon bone for our arrowheads.$B$BTravel to the Forest of Shadows on the western side of Wintergrasp. Ever since the last skirmish, the Alliance have been scavenging dragon bones in the area. Slay them and take the bones.$B$BIf that fails, you might be lucky and get one from the spirits in the area. I hear they love to impale their living victims on the bones as they die.
text.progress: Back so soon? Drat, I was hoping to catch a moment's rest.
text.completion: Well, I guess its another night of sharpening bones for me. Why didn't I stay in Silvemoon City like my brother?
text.completed: Return to Vieron Blazefeather in Wintergrasp.

english.objectives: Lieutenant Vieron Blazefeather at Wintergrasp Fortress wants you to retrieve 10 Quivers of Dragonbone Arrows from Alliance players in the Forest of Shadows.

I hear they love to impale their living victims on the bones as they die.

english.completion: Well, I guess its another night of sharpening bones for me. Why didn't I stay in Silvemoon City like my brother?
english.completed: Return to Vieron Blazefeather in Wintergrasp.

text.title: 治疗用的玫瑰
text.objectives: 指挥官莫弗尔特要你前往生命草原，收集10只联盟草药包。
text.description: 在战斗的间隙中，人们或许仍会相信和平终究会降临这片土地。可惜的是，我们注定无法享受和平的生活。$B$B请你到冬拥湖西南部的生命草原去一趟。我需要那里生长的一种玫瑰，它可以用来制作疗伤药膏。$B$B但是，由于联盟的频繁采摘，这种玫瑰已经非常稀有了。杀死生命草原上的联盟成员，从他们身上夺取草药。$B$B如果这不管用，那么你或许还可以找那里的鞭笞者碰碰运气。
text.progress: Were you able to recover the herbs? The sick and wounded increase by the hour.
text.completion: Thank you, this will go far to treat our soldier's wounds.
text.completed: Return to Primalist Mulfort in Wintergrasp.

english.title: Healing with Roses
english.objectives: Primalist Mulfort wants you to retrieve 10 Alliance Herb Pouches from Alliance players at the Steppe of Life.
english.description: Between the battles, one might almost believe that there was hope for peace in this land. Sadly, that is not to be our fate.$B$BTravel to the Steppe of Life in southwestern Wintergrasp. I have need of the roses that grow there for salve to treat the wounded.$B$BSadly, the rose has become scarce due to the Alliance harvesting it too rapidly. Slay them on the Steppe of Life and retrieve their herb pouches from the bodies.$B$BIf that fails, perhaps a lasher or two might have one.
english.progress: Were you able to recover the herbs? The sick and wounded increase by the hour.
english.completion: Thank you, this will go far to treat our soldier's wounds.
english.completed: Return to Primalist Mulfort in Wintergrasp.

text.title: 稀有的草药
text.objectives: 冬拥湖的学者特尔萨要你前往生命草原，收集10只部落草药包。
text.description: 天啊，这里可真冷！让我想起了阿古斯上的风雪交加的凯因努斯雪山。在这冰天雪地中，我们的士兵很容易感冒。$B$B到冬拥湖西南方的生命草原去，帮我从部落的成员手中抢10个部落草药包来，我会把它们制成抵御寒气的药物。$B$B有人看见部落也在那一地区收集草药。尽管杀了他们，把草药抢过来！$B$B那里的鞭笞者身上可能也有这东西。
text.progress: I hope you didn't pull up any of the lashers by mistake! They gave Private Doane quite a whipping last week.
text.completion: Excellent! This will help protect our troops against the cold.
text.completed: Return to Anchorite Tessa in Wintergrasp.

english.title: A Rare Herb
english.objectives: Anchorite Tessa in Wintergrasp wants you to retrieve 10 Horde Herb Pouches from Horde players in the Steppe of Life.
english.description: My, it is quite chilly up here! Reminds me of the stormy peaks of Kaarinos on Argus. However, with all of this snow and ice, our soldiers can easily catch cold.$B$BHead to the Steppe of Life in southwestern Wintergrasp, and bring me back 10 Horde Herb Pouches. I will grind the herbs into a medicine to protect against the cold.$B$BThe Horde have been seen collecting them from the plant life in the area. Do not hesitate to slay them and retrieve the herbs!$B$BYou may also find one on a lasher in the area.
english.progress: I hope you didn't pull up any of the lashers by mistake! They gave Private Doane quite a whipping last week.
english.completion: Excellent! This will help protect our troops against the cold.
english.completed: Return to Anchorite Tessa in Wintergrasp.

text.title: Bones and Arrows
text.objectives: Bowyer Randolph in Wintergrasp wants you to retrieve 10 Quivers of Dragonbone Arrows from Horde players at the Forest of Shadows.
text.description: Dragons are incredible! Well, their bones at least! I've been equipping our archers with arrowheads made of Dragonbone. Unfortunately, since the massacre at Angrathar, it has become almost impossible to get bone from Dragonblight.$B$BHowever, the Forest of Shadows on the western edge of Wintergrasp has enough bones to tide us over.$B$BHead to the Forest of Shadows and bring back any bone splinters you can find!$B$BThe Horde have been seen collecting bone splinters in the area. Slay them!
text.progress: How was the hunting? I've heard rumors the place is haunted, though I never venture out there myself.
text.completion: Excellent! This will help fuel the flames of war for days to come.
text.completed: Return to Bowyer Randolph in Wintergrasp.

english.objectives: Bowyer Randolph in Wintergrasp wants you to retrieve 10 Quivers of Dragonbone Arrows from Horde players at the Forest of Shadows.

Slay them!

english.completion: Excellent! This will help fuel the flames of war for days to come.
english.completed: Return to Bowyer Randolph in Wintergrasp.

text.title: 战车的燃料
text.objectives: 冬拥湖的攻城大师斯托汉德要你前往烈焰之坑，收集10份永恒灰烬。
text.description: $n！你总算来了。虽然我们在上一场战斗中失利了，但还是应该为下一场战斗做好准备！到冬拥湖东南方的烈焰之坑去，弄一些永恒灰烬回来。$B$B这种灰烬里含有煤炭，可以充当攻城车辆的燃料。$B$B哦，对了，如果你在烈焰之坑遇到部落的渣滓，尽管杀了他们，把他们手里的灰烬抢过来。绝对不能让他们占据堡垒！
text.progress: Well? Did you manage to find the embers or did the Horde beat you to it and leave you crying?
text.completion: Excellent! This will help fuel the flames of war for days to come.
text.completed: Return to Siege Master Stouthandle in Wintergrasp.

english.title: Fueling the Demolishers
english.objectives: Siegesmith Stouthandle in Wintergrasp wants you to retrieve 10 Eternal Embers from Horde players at the Cauldron of Flames.
english.description: $n! About time you showed up. While we may have lost the last battle, we should prepare for the next! Travel to the Cauldron of Flames in southeastern Wintergrasp and retrieve several eternal embers.$B$BThe embers are mixed in with coal to fuel the Demolisher and Siege Engines. $B$BOh, and if you happen to see some of the Horde in the Cauldron, don't hesitate to slay them and take their embers. We must prevent them from holding the keep!
english.progress: Well? Did you manage to find the embers or did the Horde beat you to it and leave you crying?
english.completion: Excellent! This will help fuel the flames of war for days to come.
english.completed: Return to Siege Master Stouthandle in Wintergrasp.

text.title: 保护士兵
text.objectives: 冬拥湖的女巫凯兰娜要你要你前往冰川瀑布，收集10套灌魔的部落护甲。
text.description: 很高兴见到你，$n。我们必须为下一波攻势做好准备。经过调查，我发现死在冰川瀑布附近的士兵身上的护甲都因为当地的特殊环境的关系，被附上了巨大的能量。部落已经在那里收集这种护甲了。$B$B到冰川瀑布去，杀死你所遇到的部落成员。把他们手中那些灌魔的护甲拿来给我。$B$B如果你找不到部落的士兵，也许可以在那里的元素生物身上发现被它们杀死的冒险者的护甲。
text.progress: So, did you find the armor?
text.completion: Augh. It's still dripping. Couldn't you have at least dried it off first?
text.completed: Return to Sorceress Kaylana in Wintergrasp.

english.title: Warding the Warriors
english.objectives: Sorceress Kaylana in Wintergrasp wants you to retrieve 10 sets of Imbued Horde Armor at the Glacial Falls.
english.description: $n, good to see you. We must prepare for our next assault on the fortress. My research indicates that the armor of soldiers recently slain in the Glacial Falls becomes imbued with an incredible amount of energy. The Horde has been collecting armor in the area.$B$BHead to the Glacial Falls and slay any of the Horde you find there. Return their imbued armor to me.$B$BIf you cannot find any of the Horde, you might find the armor of an adventurer slain by the elementals.
english.progress: So, did you find the armor?
english.completion: Augh. It's still dripping. Couldn't you have at least dried it off first?
english.completed: Return to Sorceress Kaylana in Wintergrasp.

text.title: 骨头和箭矢
text.objectives: 冬拥湖的维尔隆·火羽要你前往阴影森林，从联盟玩家那里抢夺10支龙骨箭。
text.description: 他们干嘛非要派我来武装弓箭手呢？我是个吟游诗人，不是游侠！唉，抱怨是没有用的。$n，我需要一些制作箭头用的龙骨。$B$B你可以到冬拥湖西边的阴影森林去找。自从上次战斗过后，联盟就在那里搜集龙骨。杀了他们，夺走他们手中的龙骨。$B$B如果这招不管用，你或许可以从那里的幽灵身上得到一些。我听说他们喜欢用龙骨把猎物穿起来。
text.progress: Back so soon? Drat, I was hoping to catch a moment's rest.
text.completion: Well, I guess its another night of sharpening bones for me. Why didn't I stay in Silvemoon City like my brother?
text.completed: Return to Vieron Blazefeather in Wintergrasp.

english.title: Bones and Arrows
english.objectives: Lieutenant Vieron Blazefeather in Wintergrasp wants you to retrieve 10 Quivers of Dragonbone Arrows from Alliance players at the Forest of Shadows.
english.description: Why would they set me to the task of arming our archers? I was a poet, not a ranger! Well, no use complaining. $n, I am in need of dragon bone for our arrowheads.$B$BTravel to the Forest of Shadows on the western side of Wintergrasp. Ever since the last skirmish, the Alliance have been scavenging dragon bones in the area. Slay them and take the bones.$B$BIf that fails, you might be lucky and get one from the spirits in the area. I hear they love to impale their living victims on the bones as they die.
english.progress: Back so soon? Drat, I was hoping to catch a moment's rest.
english.completion: Well, I guess its another night of sharpening bones for me. Why didn't I stay in Silvemoon City like my brother?
english.completed: Return to Vieron Blazefeather in Wintergrasp.

text.title: Fueling the Demolishers
text.objectives: Siegesmith Stronghoof in Wintergrasp wants you to retrieve 10 Eternal Embers from Alliance players at the Cauldron of Flames.
text.description: Lok'tar, $n! While the battle may have subsided, we must prepare to retake the fortress! Travel to the Cauldron of Flames in south eastern Wintergrasp and retrieve ten eternal embers.$B$BThe embers are mixed in with coal to fuel the Demolishers and Siege Engines. $B$BWe've heard reports of Alliance pigs collecting the embers all day. Slay them and take their embers! If they have already abandoned the area, then be prepared to fight the fire elementals there until you find some!
text.progress: Well? Did you manage to find the embers or did the Alliance beat you to it and leave you crying?
text.completion: Excellent! That should put a dent in their war machines!
text.completed: Return to Siegesmith Stronghoof in Wintergrasp.

english.objectives: Siegesmith Stronghoof in Wintergrasp wants you to retrieve 10 Eternal Embers from Alliance players at the Cauldron of Flames.

Slay them and take their embers! If they have already abandoned the area, then be prepared to fight the fire elementals there until you find some!

english.completion: Excellent! That should put a dent in their war machines!
english.completed: Return to Siegesmith Stronghoof in Wintergrasp.

text.title: 治疗用的玫瑰
text.objectives: 冬拥湖的指挥官莫弗尔特要你前往生命草原，收集10只联盟草药包。
text.description: 在战斗中，我们损失了许多勇士。但是如果缺医少药，我们还会失去更多的同胞。$B$B请你到冬拥湖西南部的生命草原去一趟。我需要那里生长的一种玫瑰，它可以用来制作疗伤药膏。$B$B但是，由于联盟的频繁采摘，这种玫瑰已经非常稀有了。杀死生命草原上的联盟成员，从他们身上夺取草药包。$B$B如果这不管用，那么你或许还可以找那里的鞭笞者碰碰运气。
text.progress: Were you able to recover the herbs? The sick and wounded increase by the hour.
text.completion: Thank you, this will go far to treat our soldiers' wounds.
text.completed: Return to Primalist Mulfort in Wintergrasp.

english.title: Healing with Roses
english.objectives: Primalist Mulfort in Wintergrasp wants you to retrieve 10 Alliance Herb Pouches from Alliance players at the Steppe of Life.
english.description: So many of our braves were lost during the battle, but even more shall die if left untreated. $B$BTravel to the Steppe of Life in southwestern Wintergrasp. I have need of the roses that grow there for salve to treat the wounded.$B$BSadly, the rose has become scarce due to the Alliance harvesting it too rapidly. Slay them on the Steppe of Life and retrieve their herb pouches from the bodies.$B$BIf that fails, perhaps a lasher or two might be in bloom.
english.progress: Were you able to recover the herbs? The sick and wounded increase by the hour.
english.completion: Thank you, this will go far to treat our soldiers' wounds.
english.completed: Return to Primalist Mulfort in Wintergrasp.

text.title: Jinxing the Walls
text.objectives: Hoodoo Master Fu'jin in Wintergrasp wants you to retrieve 10 Enchanted Alliance Breastplates from Alliance players at the Glacial Falls.
text.description: Hey 'mon. See dem Alliance sitting comfy in their keep?$B$BI think they be a bit too comfy, ya? I want ta be jinxing the place, but I be needin' some souls, mon. Not any soul though, only da soul of a strong warrior could do da job.$B$BThe Glacial Falls in east Wintergrasp be havin' dem special properties to extract da soul. Slay the Alliance there, they be havin' the stuff we need.$B$BBring back da armor of the slain. If there be no Alliance maybe da elementals got 'em, mon.
text.progress: Did ya bring da armor, mon?
text.completion: Ooh, ya dats da stuff, mon!
text.completed: Return to Hoodoo Master Fu'jin in Wintergrasp.

english.objectives: Hoodoo Master Fu'jin in Wintergrasp wants you to retrieve 10 Enchanted Alliance Breastplates from Alliance players at the Glacial Falls.

english.progress: Did ya bring da armor, mon?
english.completion: Ooh, ya dats da stuff, mon!
english.completed: Return to Hoodoo Master Fu'jin in Wintergrasp.

text.title: Funky Fungi
text.objectives: You are to collect 6 Grotesque Fungus from Savage Cave Beasts in Ahn'kahet and deliver them to Kilix the Unraveler in The Pit of Narjun.
text.description: A misshapen piece of mushroom-like fungus falls from a particularly smelly, ooze-covered patch of the cave beast's flesh. Examining it, you are violently repulsed by its overwhelming stench.$b$bYou wonder to yourself if this is the kind of thing that the nerubians might find appetizing. Placing the sticky organism in your pack, you determine to find out...
text.progress: What in creation are these?!
text.completion: Do you have any idea what you've been carrying around, $c?$b$bThe cave beasts you've been harvesting have no traditional method of excreting their waste. You might want to wash your hands...$b$bThank you for the thought, but if you come across any more of these please keep them for yourself.
text.completed: Return to Kilix the Unraveler at the Pit of Narjun in Dragonblight.

english.completed: Return to Kilix the Unraveler at the Pit of Narjun in Dragonblight.

text.title: Disarmament
text.objectives: Defender Mordun wants you to enter Utgarde Keep and steal 5 Vrykul Weapons
text.description: Take it from me, $g lad:lass;, them vrykul weapons be downright nasty!$b$bI've felt their edge personally, and there be somethin' unnatural about 'em. Deceptively well-balanced, wickedly sharp - just plain deadly.$b$bGet into their stronghold and if nuthin' else, pilfer some o' them weapons! Mebbe we can learn us a thing 'er two about 'em, mebbe not.$b$bBottom line - the fewer axes they be swingin' around, the better.
text.progress: You pinch a load a' them vrykul axes?
text.completion: <Mordun whistles.>$b$bWill ya just look at 'em? Incredible.$b$bI half expected these neanderthals to be swingin' around clubs and throwin' rock.$b$bNo such luck...
text.completed: Return to Defender Mordun in Wyrmskull Village in Howling Fjord.

english.objectives: Defender Mordun wants you to enter Utgarde Keep and steal 5 Vrykul Weapons
