text.title: 追查诺甘农之核
text.objectives: 在布莱恩的营地寻找勘探员克罗娜的便笺和勘探员索雷的地图。
text.description: 既然我们已经拿到了诺甘农之壳，现在就只需要寻找另一半钥匙了。幸运的是，我已经让探险者协会的伙计们四处查探，找到了诺甘农之核的所在之处。$B$B在创世者的图书馆东南方的远端，丹尼芬雷北面的斜坡上，有一处以我的名字命名的营地。探险者协会正在那里寻找另外一半钥匙。帮我把他们整理好的地图和信息带回来，我们应该可以找到另外一半钥匙。
text.progress: Have you recovered those notes?
text.completion: Ruined? What d'you mean, the camp's been ruined?$B$B<Brann clenches his fists in anger.>$B$BThose iron dwarves will pay for this! There's little we can do now, and we have to focus on finishing the key. But once I get into the halls of Ulduar, the irons and their masters will answer for what they've done!
text.completed: Use Brann's Communicator to contact Brann Bronzebeard.$B$BIf you lose Brann's Communicator, speak to Morteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site to replace it.

english.title: Going After the Core
english.objectives: Find Prospector Khrona's Notes and Prospector Soren's Maps at Brann's Base-Camp.
english.description: With Norgannon's Shell in hand, only half of the archive key remains to be found. Luckily, I've had the Explorers' League hard at work chasing down leads about the whereabouts of Norgannon's Core.$B$BFar to the southeast of the Inventor's Library, on the slopes to the north of Dun Niffelem, is a camp bearing my name. The Explorers' League representatives seeking the second half of the key are based there. Bring me the maps and the notes they've made and we should be able to track down the other key half.
english.progress: Have you recovered those notes?
english.completion: Ruined? What d'you mean, the camp's been ruined?$B$B<Brann clenches his fists in anger.>$B$BThose iron dwarves will pay for this! There's little we can do now, and we have to focus on finishing the key. But once I get into the halls of Ulduar, the irons and their masters will answer for what they've done!
english.completed: Use Brann's Communicator to contact Brann Bronzebeard.$B$BIf you lose Brann's Communicator, speak to Morteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site to replace it.

text.title: 诺甘农之核的守护者
text.objectives: 拿到诺甘农之核。
text.description: 勘探员索雷的便笺中提到，诺甘农之核的看管者名叫亚申，它是米米尔制造出来的魔像。$B$B索雷还说亚申所在的地方被称为“洛肯的宝库”。$B$B洛肯，嗯？土灵提到过这个家伙。$B$B据说宝库就在被毁坏的探险者协会营地西南方，它的圆形入口就在俯瞰着上古寒冬山谷的某座山上。$B$B找到这个亚申，从他手里把诺甘农之核拿回来。如果你不得不动手的话，我一点也不会感到吃惊的。
text.progress: Was Prospector Soren right? Did you finally find Norgannon's Core?
text.completion: This is really it! The key is almost within our grasp. All we need now is a way to combine the shell and the core into a single key. Let's see what Prospector Soren had to say about this...
text.completed: Use Brann's Communicator to contact Brann Bronzebeard.$B$BIf you lose Brann's Communicator, speak to Morteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site to replace it.

english.title: The Core's Keeper
english.objectives: Obtain Norgannon's Core.
english.description: Prospector Soren's notes say that Norgannon's Core is in the keeping of a sentinel named Athan, one of Mimir's creations.$B$BSoren says the vault where Athan resides is called "Loken's Bargain" these days.$B$BLoken, eh? The earthen have mentioned him.$B$BThe vault is said to be southwest of the ruined Explorers' League camp, with a round entrance on a mountainside overlooking the Valley of Ancient Winters.$B$BFind this Athan and get the core from him, but I wouldn't be surprised if you were in for a fight.
english.progress: Was Prospector Soren right? Did you finally find Norgannon's Core?
english.completion: This is really it! The key is almost within our grasp. All we need now is a way to combine the shell and the core into a single key. Let's see what Prospector Soren had to say about this...
english.completed: Use Brann's Communicator to contact Brann Bronzebeard.$B$BIf you lose Brann's Communicator, speak to Morteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site to replace it.

text.title: Time to Hide
text.objectives: Matthias Lehner wants you to obtain 3 Faceless One's Blood.
text.description: You shouldn't have touched it.  But now that you did, he's going to come looking for you.$B$BAnd he'll find you.  Unless you hide yourself from him.$B$BBring me blood from the faceless ones if you want to live!
text.progress: Did you get the blood?
text.completion: What are you waiting for? You have to rub it on you!$b$bQuick! Or he'll see you!
text.completed: Return to Matthias Lehner at Naz'anak: The Forgotten Depths in Icecrown.

english.title: Time to Hide
english.objectives: Matthias Lehner wants you to obtain 3 Faceless One's Blood.
english.description: You shouldn't have touched it.  But now that you did, he's going to come looking for you.$B$BAnd he'll find you.  Unless you hide yourself from him.$B$BBring me blood from the faceless ones if you want to live!
english.progress: Did you get the blood?
english.completion: What are you waiting for? You have to rub it on you!$b$bQuick! Or he'll see you!
english.completed: Return to Matthias Lehner at Naz'anak: The Forgotten Depths in Icecrown.

text.title: 你的憎恶伙伴
text.objectives: 奥格瑞姆之锤的库尔迪拉·织亡者要你使用憎恶复活工具包制造一名复活的憎恶，然后利用它杀死15只冰寒食尸鬼、15只残忍的恶鬼和15名复活的联盟士兵。
text.description: 你知道该怎么做吧，$c。$B$B对憎恶的残骸使用这个工具包，制造一只听命于你的憎恶，然后命令它去攻击驻守在死亡之门的敌人。$B$B在我们对死亡之门发动攻击之前，你可以好好地熟悉一下这种战术。
text.progress: Yes, $c?
text.completion: I see your skills with the abominations are developing nicely.$b$bBe diligent, friend, and soon the gate will belong to the Horde.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

english.title: That's Abominable!
english.objectives: Koltira Deathweaver on Orgrim's Hammer wants you to use the Abomination Reanimation Kit to create a Reanimated Abomination, which you are to use to kill 15 Icy Ghouls, 15 Vicious Geists, and 15 Risen Alliance Soldiers.
english.description: You know what to do, $c.$b$bTake this kit and use the guts from their abominations to create one of your own, then command it to attack the enemy forces at the gate.$b$bYou would do well to refine this tactic for when we make our assault on the gate.
english.progress: Yes, $c?
english.completion: I see your skills with the abominations are developing nicely.$b$bBe diligent, friend, and soon the gate will belong to the Horde.
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: 对抗巨人
text.objectives: 奥格瑞姆之锤的库尔迪拉·织亡者要你前往莫德雷萨，从血肉巨人身上取回5根奇特的脊骨给他。
text.description: 尽管击败地面上的天灾士兵至关重要，但我们也不能疏忽了死亡之门的威胁。$B$B城墙上的血肉巨人可以投掷巨大的石块和冰块，对下面的部队造成毁灭性的伤害。$B$B集合一支队伍去干掉那些巨人。我们必须要对敌人有足够的了解。$B$B啊，对了……把它们的脊骨给我带回来。如果我没记错的话，那东西有一些特别的用处。
text.progress: Any success against the giants, $r?
text.completion: Excellent. These look to be usable samples.$b$bTime again to use the enemy's strength against them....
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

english.title: Against the Giants
english.objectives: Koltira Deathweaver on Orgrim's Hammer wants you to bring him 5 Pustulant Spines from the Pustulant Horrors on Mord'rethar.
english.description: While it's going to be crucial to defeat the Scourge on the ground, we mustn't neglect the gate itself.$b$bThe flesh giants on the ramparts are capable of hurling massive boulders and chunks of ice, inflicting devastating damage to enemy infantry below.$b$bMuster a force and defeat these giants. We need to know just what we're up against in terms of their strength.$b$bOh... and bring me their spines. If memory serves, there's a little trick I can share with you.
english.progress: Any success against the giants, $r?
english.completion: Excellent. These look to be usable samples.$b$bTime again to use the enemy's strength against them....
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: 污染者科普洛斯
text.objectives: 奥格瑞姆之锤的库尔迪拉·织亡者要你前往莫德雷萨，杀死污染者科普洛斯。
text.description: 有报告指出死亡之门有一只非常强大的僵尸，$c。$B$B我们必须设法解除它带来的潜在威胁。如果你能亲自与它交手，应该可以了解到更多的有价值的情报。$B$B前往死亡之门西面的大厅，向这只怪物发起挑战，找出它的弱点。
text.progress: Were you able to find the zombie, $c?
text.completion: Well done, $c.$b$bPerhaps with some investigation, we can discover how they are bringing such a creature into existence.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

english.title: Coprous the Defiled
english.objectives: Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer wants you to kill Coprous the Defiled at Mord'rethar.
english.description: Reports of a powerful zombie at the death gate have reached my ears, $c.$b$bWe cannot allow a potential threat such as this to go unchallenged. Any information you are able to glean from engaging it will be better than what we know now.$b$bGo to the western chamber of the gate and find this creature. Fight him, and find a weakness we might exploit.
english.progress: Were you able to find the zombie, $c?
english.completion: Well done, $c.$b$bPerhaps with some investigation, we can discover how they are bringing such a creature into existence.
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: 化学常识
text.objectives: 奥格瑞姆之锤的库尔迪拉·织亡者希望你前往莫德雷萨，将脊骨脓液倒进那里的天灾之锅。
text.description: <库尔迪拉取过脊骨，把里面的脓液倒进瓶子里。>$B$B我们对血肉巨人的特性有一点点了解……$B$B它们的脊骨脓液可以以一种非常有趣的方式与瘟疫病菌溶合，将瘟疫转换成一种腐蚀剂。$B$B虽然说从高高的城墙上泼下腐蚀剂会让下面的士兵非常郁闷，但至少受害者不会变成天灾军团的爪牙。$B$B把这只瓶子里的东西倒进死亡之门西面大厅内的天灾之锅里去。
text.progress: Were you able to neutralize a batch of plague, $c?
text.completion: You have done well, $c.$b$bWhen our armies arrive to march on the Citadel, we will have a solid plan in place for taking the death gate.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

english.title: Basic Chemistry
english.objectives: Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer wants you to use Pustulant Spinal Fluid on a plague cauldron at Mord'rethar.
english.description: <Koltira takes the pustulant spines and drains their fluid into a flask.>$b$bA little-known quality of the flesh giants...$b$bTheir spinal fluid interacts with the plague in a very interesting way, turning it into a corrosive acid.$b$bPoured from the towering ramparts, acid may not be a welcome sight to the troops below, but at least the victims won't rise up and add to the enemy's numbers.$b$bPour the contents of this flask into one of the plague cauldrons in the western chamber of the death gate.
english.progress: Were you able to neutralize a batch of plague, $c?
english.completion: You have done well, $c.$b$bWhen our armies arrive to march on the Citadel, we will have a solid plan in place for taking the death gate.
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: 占山为王
text.objectives: 伊米海姆的弗拉索·磨轮要你使用弗拉索的跳跃机器人，将联盟军旗插到山顶的徽记堆上。
text.description: 瞧见伊米海姆西北方那座陡峭的山峰了么，你只要驾驶我的跳跃机器人尽快爬上山顶就行啦，$n！$B$B布拉斯·炸雷是个懦弱的坏蛋，他正在摆弄自己的破烂机器人呢，大概马上就要完工了吧。我们正在比赛，看谁能抢先占领那座山头！$B$B等你跳上去之后，将我们的军旗插到徽记堆里。让大家知道，联盟才是最棒的！我的工程学技术才是最棒的！
text.progress: Hold on a second... you haven't planted our battle standard yet!$B$BWhat's the hold up?
text.completion: YOU DID IT! YOU DID IT!$b$b<Frazzle jumps and gives you a big hug.>$b$bOh, you're just my favorite hero ever!$b$bYou think you could come back again tomorrow?
text.completed: Return to Frazzle Geargrinder at Ymirheim in Icecrown.

english.title: King of the Mountain
english.objectives: Frazzle Geargrinder in Ymirheim wants you to use her Geargrinder's Jumpbot to plant the Alliance Battle Standard in the skulls at the top of the mountain.
english.description: You've just got to get my jumpbot to the tippy top of the mountain to the northwest here at Ymirheim pronto, $n!$B$BThat dastardly, no-good Blast Thunderbomb is working on his own bot, and I'm afraid he almost has it completed. We're in a race to see who's gonna be king of the mountain!$B$BOnce you jump up there, plant our battle standard in the pile of bones and show everyone that the Alliance, and my engineering skills, are the best!
english.progress: Hold on a second... you haven't planted our battle standard yet!$B$BWhat's the hold up?
english.completion: YOU DID IT! YOU DID IT!$b$b<Frazzle jumps and gives you a big hug.>$b$bOh, you're just my favorite hero ever!$b$bYou think you could come back again tomorrow?
english.completed: Return to Frazzle Geargrinder at Ymirheim in Icecrown.

text.title: Neutralizing the Plague
text.objectives: Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer wants you use Pustulant Spinal Fluid on a blight cauldron at Mord'rethar.$b$bYou can create Pustulant Spinal Fluid by using a Giant Spine collected from a Pustulant Horror.
text.description: You no longer need my assistance in neutralizing the enemy's plague cauldrons, $r.$b$bHunt down the flesh giants at the death gate and use the fluid from their spines to render batches of the plague ineffective.$b$bYou are striking at the heart of the enemy's strategy. This is an important mission - vital to our cause, and should be carried out whenever time permits.$b$bRemember, the giants and the plague cauldrons can be found on Mord'rethar.
text.progress: Greetings, $c.$B$BCan I report that we've rendered another plague cauldron useless?
text.completion: One less plague cauldron to account for when the battle commences.$b$bYour commander will be pleased.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

english.title: Neutralizing the Plague
english.objectives: Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer wants you use Pustulant Spinal Fluid on a blight cauldron at Mord'rethar.$b$bYou can create Pustulant Spinal Fluid by using a Giant Spine collected from a Pustulant Horror.
english.description: You no longer need my assistance in neutralizing the enemy's plague cauldrons, $r.$b$bHunt down the flesh giants at the death gate and use the fluid from their spines to render batches of the plague ineffective.$b$bYou are striking at the heart of the enemy's strategy. This is an important mission - vital to our cause, and should be carried out whenever time permits.$b$bRemember, the giants and the plague cauldrons can be found on Mord'rethar.
english.progress: Greetings, $c.$B$BCan I report that we've rendered another plague cauldron useless?
english.completion: One less plague cauldron to account for when the battle commences.$b$bYour commander will be pleased.
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: Return to the Surface
text.objectives: Return to Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer.
text.description: You should leave now.  You'll find a portal behind me.  It'll take you to the surface.$B$BWe'll meet again.  He'll be looking for you.$B$BIt's only a matter of time until he finds you.
text.completion: $n! We thought you were dead!$b$bWe lost a few men in that explosion... but we sure put a hurt on the Scourge. They're scrambling their forces back to the citadel and leaving big gaps in their defenses. It's time to push forward.

english.title: Return to the Surface
english.objectives: Return to Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer.
english.description: You should leave now.  You'll find a portal behind me.  It'll take you to the surface.$B$BWe'll meet again.  He'll be looking for you.$B$BIt's only a matter of time until he finds you.
english.completion: $n! We thought you were dead!$b$bWe lost a few men in that explosion... but we sure put a hurt on the Scourge. They're scrambling their forces back to the citadel and leaving big gaps in their defenses. It's time to push forward.

text.title: 占山为王
text.objectives: 伊米海姆的布拉斯·炸雷要你使用布拉斯的跳跃机器人，将部落军旗插到山顶的徽记堆上。
text.description: 嘿，你好啊，$n。跟昨天一样，我要你驾驶跳跃机器人尽快爬上伊米海姆东南方那座山峰的顶部！$B$B弗拉索·磨轮这个自以为是的家伙，她老是说她的跳跃机器人比我的好！呸！我们正在比赛，看谁能抢先占领那座山头！$B$B等你跳上去之后，将我们的军旗插到徽记堆里。让大家知道，部落才是最棒的！我的工程学技术才是最棒的！
text.completion: I knew you were the right $r for the job!$b$b$b$bI gotta admit that right now you're my favorite $c of all time!$b$bWhat do you say to a repeat performance again tomorrow? I can make it worth your while!
text.completed: Return to Blast Thunderbomb at Ymirheim in Icecrown.

english.title: King of the Mountain
english.objectives: Blast Thunderbomb in Ymirheim wants you to use his Thunderbomb's Jumpbot to plant the Horde Battle Standard in the skulls at the top of the mountain.
english.description: Yo, $n, I need you to get my jumpbot to the top of this mountain to the southeast, like yesterday!$B$BThat girly, self-righteous Frazzle Geargrinder thinks that her jumpbot's better than mine. Hah! We're in a race to see who's gonna be king of the mountain!$B$BOnce you jump up there, plant our battle standard in the pile of bones and show everyone that the Horde, and my mad engineering skills, are the best!
english.completion: I knew you were the right $r for the job!$b$b$b$bI gotta admit that right now you're my favorite $c of all time!$b$bWhat do you say to a repeat performance again tomorrow? I can make it worth your while!
english.completed: Return to Blast Thunderbomb at Ymirheim in Icecrown.

text.title: 地面突袭
text.objectives: 护送破天号部队抵达伊米海姆的门口。完成任务后返回伊米海姆东面的冰川边缘，向地面指挥官库普复命。
text.description: 你好，$c。$B$B最近我们一直在对伊米海姆发动猛攻，但是这些维库人比我们之前遇到过的要凶残得多。每次部队试图向伊米海姆推进时都会遭到伏击，我们的人员损失非常惨重。$B$B如果你愿意参战，帮助我的小分队安全抵达伊米海姆的大门，我们会好好奖励你的。抵达大门之后，我们就会挖掘壕沟，等待后援部队。
text.progress: Did you get some of my men up safely?
text.completion: You have my thanks.$B$BThis has been a brutal operation, but we haven't had any great options otherwise - they're being equally as unforgiving to our aerial assault. We need to rout these vrykul if we're going to stand any chance of pressing on in Icecrown.$B$BWe're likely to need more help later. Please lend yourself to the battle again should the chance present itself.
text.completed: Return to Ground Commander Koup at the Valley of Lost Hope in Icecrown.

english.title: Assault by Ground
english.objectives: Escort the Skybreaker troops to the gates of Ymirheim. Return to Ground Commander Koup at the edge of the glacier east of Ymirheim for compensation after the task is complete.
english.description: Greetings $c.$B$BOur troops have been attempting to storm Ymirheim for some time, but these vrykul are far more vicious than any we've faced before. They've been ambushing us repeatedly as we try to make it up the pass, and we've lost a lot of men.$B$BIf you want to lend yourself to the battle and help get my squad to the gates of Ymirheim safely, we will gladly reward you for your efforts. Once at the gates, we'll dig in and wait for reinforcements to catch up to us.
english.progress: Did you get some of my men up safely?
english.completion: You have my thanks.$B$BThis has been a brutal operation, but we haven't had any great options otherwise - they're being equally as unforgiving to our aerial assault. We need to rout these vrykul if we're going to stand any chance of pressing on in Icecrown.$B$BWe're likely to need more help later. Please lend yourself to the battle again should the chance present itself.
english.completed: Return to Ground Commander Koup at the Valley of Lost Hope in Icecrown.

objectiveDetails.description: 护送联盟部队前往伊米海姆

text.title: 铸造钥石
text.objectives: 布莱恩·铜须希望你和他在创世神殿碰头，帮助他把诺甘农之壳和诺甘农之核组合起来。等你完成了帮助布莱恩的使命之后，回到格罗玛什坠毁点，向伯克塔·血怒复命。
text.description: 哈哈！就在这里：创世神殿，守护者米米尔的大本营！当然，你得在那里把钥匙的两部分组合起来。$B$B根据勘探员的便笺所记载的内容，创世神殿就在造物者圣台西边的最高点。这就是说，它大概在你们那个格罗玛什坠毁点的东面。$B$B我会和你在神殿碰头，然后我们一起把它们组合起来。
text.completion: <Boktar nods in approval as you tell him how you helped Brann recover the pieces of the keystone and combine them.>$B$BBrann may prove to be just the ally we need to discover what is truly happening in Ulduar. You've done well in aiding him. We need all the help we can get against this Loken and his iron dwarf minions.
text.completed: Return to Boktar Bloodfury at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: Forging the Keystone
english.objectives: Brann Bronzebeard wants you to meet him at the Temple of Invention and help him combine Norgannon's Shell and Norgannon's Core. Once you have helped Brann, report back to Boktar Bloodfury at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site.
english.description: Aha! Here it is: the Temple of Invention, the seat of Keeper Mimir himself! Of course, that's where one would go to join the two parts of the key.$B$BAccording to the prospector's notes, the Temple of Invention is one of the highest points on the western side of the Terrace of the Makers. That means it should be roughly east of your Grom'arsh Crash Site.$B$BI'll meet you at the temple and we'll combine the parts together.
english.completion: <Boktar nods in approval as you tell him how you helped Brann recover the pieces of the keystone and combine them.>$B$BBrann may prove to be just the ally we need to discover what is truly happening in Ulduar. You've done well in aiding him. We need all the help we can get against this Loken and his iron dwarf minions.
english.completed: Return to Boktar Bloodfury at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: ……所有可能的帮助
text.objectives: 破天号的高级指挥官加斯汀·巴雷特要你与萨萨里安谈一谈。
text.description: 时局令人绝望，$c……$B$B我感到异常焦虑，打算接受一切可能的帮助——包括这里的死亡骑士驻军。$B$B和萨萨里安谈一谈吧。看看他能否帮助我们改良对抗天灾军团的战术，确保我们一旦组织起足够的人手，就能够一击而胜。$B$B我们已经走到了这一步……绝对不能功败垂成！
text.completion: It was wise of Captain Bartlett to send you.$b$bWhile he frets over your conflict with the Horde, someone must remain exclusively focused on the real mission here - the march on Icecrown Citadel.$b$bWho better to direct your efforts than a former servant of the Lich King?

english.title: ...All the Help We Can Get.
english.objectives: High Captain Justin Bartlett aboard the Skybreaker wants you to speak to Thassarian.
english.description: Desperate times, $c...$b$bAs uncomfortable as it makes me, I'm prepared to accept assistance from anyone - including our resident death knight.$b$bGo to Thassarian and see if he can help us develop tactics against the Scourge that will ensure victory once we are able to mount another offensive.$b$bWe have come so far... we must not fail here!
english.completion: It was wise of Captain Bartlett to send you.$b$bWhile he frets over your conflict with the Horde, someone must remain exclusively focused on the real mission here - the march on Icecrown Citadel.$b$bWho better to direct your efforts than a former servant of the Lich King?

starters.name: 高级指挥官加斯汀·巴雷特

text.title: 知己知彼
text.objectives: 破天号上的萨萨里安要你前往破碎前线，杀死5名笨重的憎恶、5名邪恶通灵师和5名暗影专家。
text.description: 像你这样拥有丰富作战经验的英雄必定了解这一点：没有什么途径比亲自与敌人交手更能摸清对方底细了。$B$B虽然你渴望获得攻占冰冠堡垒的荣耀，但是我们必须首先突破巫妖王的每一扇大门。所谓知己知彼，百战百胜……$B$B我要你返回破碎前线，与敌人交战。寻找他们的弱点，然后向我汇报详细的情况。
text.progress: You've returned, $c...$B$BAnything to report?
text.completion: Really, $c?$b$bNothing notable to report?$b$b<Thassarian notices the abomination remains splattered across your clothes and smiles.>$b$bI beg to differ...
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: Poke and Prod
english.objectives: Thassarian on the Alliance gunship, Skybreaker, wants you to kill 5 Hulking Abominations, 5 Malefic Necromancers, and 5 Shadow Adepts at the Broken Front.
english.description: As someone of your experience must surely know, there's no better way to familiarize one's self with their enemy than by confronting them in combat.$b$bWhile you no doubt lust for the glory of taking Icecrown Citadel, that cannot happen without taking each of the Lich King's gates first. For now, you must focus your efforts on the first of these...$b$bReturn to the Broken Front. Engage the enemy in battle. Search for a weakness we might exploit and return to me with a detailed report.
english.progress: You've returned, $c...$B$BAnything to report?
english.completion: Really, $c?$b$bNothing notable to report?$b$b<Thassarian notices the abomination remains splattered across your clothes and smiles.>$b$bI beg to differ...
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 你的憎恶伙伴
text.objectives: 破天号上的萨萨里安要你使用憎恶复活工具包制造一名复活的憎恶，然后利用它杀死15只冰寒食尸鬼、15只残忍的恶鬼和15名复活的联盟士兵。
text.description: 憎恶……$b$b可怕的敌人。我不止一次目睹它们迅速地扭转了战局。事实上，它们也可以成为有用的伙伴，这一点倒是鲜为人知。$B$B憎恶并不聪明。只要你了解制造憎恶的秘密，就可以对它们发出简单的指令。相信我，它们会毫不犹豫地执行你的命令。$B$B你很幸运，我恰好知晓其中的奥秘。$B$B对憎恶的残骸使用这个工具包，将其复活。接下来你就可以利用它对付驻守在死亡之门的天灾军团了。
text.progress: Well, $r?$B$BDid your abomination friends prove effective?
text.completion: You see, $c?$b$bIngenuity can sometimes even the odds against a seemingly overwhelming enemy.
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: That's Abominable!
english.objectives: Thassarian on the Skybreaker wants you to use the Abomination Reanimation Kit to create a Reanimated Abomination, which you are to use to kill 15 Icy Ghouls, 15 Vicious Geists, and 15 Risen Alliance Soldiers.
english.description: Abominations...$b$bThey can be a very capable enemy. I've seen them turn the tide of battle more than once. What few realize, is that they can also be very capable friends.$b$bThey are not deep thinkers. If you know the secrets of their creation, you can issue them basic orders that they will not question.$b$bFortunately for you, I know these secrets.$b$bThis kit will reanimate the remains of the abominations you defeat. Take it, and learn to use them against the Scourge on the death gate.
english.progress: Well, $r?$B$BDid your abomination friends prove effective?
english.completion: You see, $c?$b$bIngenuity can sometimes even the odds against a seemingly overwhelming enemy.
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 你的憎恶伙伴
text.objectives: 破天号上的萨萨里安要你使用憎恶复活工具包制造一名复活的憎恶，然后利用它杀死15只冰寒食尸鬼、15只残忍的恶鬼和15名复活的联盟士兵。
text.description: 你知道该怎么做吧，$c。$B$B对憎恶的残骸使用这个工具包，制造一只听命于你的憎恶，然后命令它去攻击驻守在死亡之门的敌人。$B$B在我们对死亡之门再次发动攻击之前，你可以好好地熟悉一下这种战术。
text.progress: Yes, $c?
text.completion: I see your skills with the abominations are developing nicely.$b$bBe diligent, friend, and soon the death gate will belong to the Alliance.
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: That's Abominable!
english.objectives: Thassarian on the Skybreaker wants you to use the Abomination Reanimation Kit to create a Reanimated Abomination, which you are to use to kill 15 Icy Ghouls, 15 Vicious Geists, and 15 Risen Alliance Soldiers.
english.description: You know what to do, $c.$b$bTake this kit and use the guts from their abominations to create one of your own, then command it to attack the enemy forces at the gate.$b$bYou would do well to refine this tactic for when we make another assault on the gate.
english.progress: Yes, $c?
english.completion: I see your skills with the abominations are developing nicely.$b$bBe diligent, friend, and soon the death gate will belong to the Alliance.
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 请留意一下……
text.objectives: 高级指挥官加斯汀·巴雷特要你与破天号的首席技师波尔维克谈一谈。
text.description: 在斩雷号任职期间，首席技师波尔维克凭借卓越的表现赢得了大家的喝彩。如今，他也是破天号不可或缺的关键人物。若不是他，我们的战舰早就被轰成碎片，散落在这片冰原上了。$b$b不过这家伙有个毛病，他喜欢与大家分享所有细微的发明或是发现——而其中大部分都超出了我的理解范围。$b$b我必须集中注意力对抗敌军，不能为这种事分心。$b$b请代我去跟他谈一谈，$n。如果可以的话，最好帮帮他。他就在船舱里。
text.completion: Cappy sent you in his place, did he?$b$bVery well, $c. Roll up those sleeves... time to get to work!

english.title: Your Attention, Please
english.objectives: High Captain Bartlett wants you to speak with Chief Engineer Boltwrench in the Skybreaker.
english.description: Chief Engineer Boltwrench has proven invaluable in his service aboard the Stormbreaker. Were it not for his ingenuity, we'd be sprinkled across half of the glacier several times over by now.$b$bThe thing is, he feels he must share his every miniscule invention or discovery - most of which I don't even understand.$b$bMy focus must be squarely on our enemies right now. I cannot afford any distractions.$b$bPlease visit him in my stead, $n. And if you can, assist him. You'll find him belowdecks.
english.completion: Cappy sent you in his place, did he?$b$bVery well, $c. Roll up those sleeves... time to get to work!

starters.name: 高级指挥官加斯汀·巴雷特

text.title: “借来”的技术
text.objectives: 破天号上的首席技师波尔维克要你在破碎前线使用偷来的液体。$B$B你需要收集被丢弃的头盔、被丢弃的护甲和一堆白骨才能召唤假人，这些材料都可以在破碎前线找到。
text.description: 好吧，我明白了。指挥官没时间关注我的小发现。这是他的损失！$B$B瞧，我设法从敌人那里“得到”了一批液体。尽管我讨厌改造下等的地精科技制品，不过这次就算破例啦。$B$B喏，拿着这份样本。我要你实地测试它的功效，便于让我通过逆向工程来重现它的制作流程。$b$b前往破碎前线，收集制造假人的材料，然后使用液体。
text.progress: Well, how'd it go, $r?
text.completion: Good news!$b$bI've managed to reproduce the solution - hardly an accomplishment, of course.$b$bDoubt I'll live to see the day those neanderthal goblins cook up somethin' a gnome can't recreate in his sleep!
text.completed: Return to Chief Engineer Boltwrench at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: Borrowed Technology
english.objectives: Chief Engineer Boltwrench aboard the Skybreaker wants you to use the Smuggled Solution at the Broken Front.$b$bUsing the solution will require an Abandoned Helm, Abandoned Armor, and Pile of Bones, all found at the Broken Front.
english.description: I get it, I get it. Cappy's too busy to see this for himself. His loss!$b$bSee, I've managed to 'acquire' a certain shipment of solution from the enemy. And as much as I hate tinkerin' with inferior goblin technology, I'm inclined to make an exception here.$b$bTake this sample. I'll need you to run a few field tests, just to prove its usefulness, while I try to do a little reverse engineering to duplicate the creation process.$b$bGo to the front and gather the materials to make a decoy, then use the oil.
english.progress: Well, how'd it go, $r?
english.completion: Good news!$b$bI've managed to reproduce the solution - hardly an accomplishment, of course.$b$bDoubt I'll live to see the day those neanderthal goblins cook up somethin' a gnome can't recreate in his sleep!
english.completed: Return to Chief Engineer Boltwrench at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 偷来的解决方案
text.objectives: 破天号上的首席技师波尔维克要你在破碎前线使用偷来的液体。$B$B你需要收集被丢弃的头盔、被丢弃的护甲和一堆白骨才能召唤假人，这些材料都可以在破碎前线找到。
text.description: 嗯，嗯，再来一次怎么样？训练总是不嫌多的。$b$b我们已经找到了对付冰霜巨龙的法子。$b$b$r，继续削减它们的数量吧。你干掉的冰霜巨龙越多，我们在进攻冰冠堡垒时遇到的阻扰就越少。$B$B祝你好运。记得将没用完的液体带回来给我。
text.progress: Yes, friend?
text.completion: Good show! Good show indeed. You're turning into a regular wyrmslayer!$b$bCome back when you're ready to thin their numbers even further.
text.completed: Return to Chief Engineer Boltwrench at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: The Solution Solution
english.objectives: Chief Engineer Boltwrench aboard the Skybreaker wants you to use the Smuggled Solution at the Broken Front.$b$bUsing the solution will require an Abandoned Helm, Abandoned Armor, and Pile of Bones, all found at the Broken Front.
english.description: Oh, yes, yes. Back again, are we? Never enough practice, I suppose.$b$bHere we are, the solution to that pesky frostwyrm problem.$b$bMake them scarce, $r. The more you take out now, the less we face when we are again ready to attempt our march on the citadel.$b$bBest of luck, now. And do bring back whatever you don't use.
english.progress: Yes, friend?
english.completion: Good show! Good show indeed. You're turning into a regular wyrmslayer!$b$bCome back when you're ready to thin their numbers even further.
english.completed: Return to Chief Engineer Boltwrench at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 前往伊米海姆！
text.objectives: 与伊米海姆的布拉斯·炸雷谈一谈。
text.description: 伊米海姆坐落在冰冠冰川的中心地带，我要你潜入这座冰霜维库人的大型城市。$B$B布拉斯·炸雷已经抵达城市西侧，代表战歌远征军与联盟展开了竞赛。他要使用跳跃机器人与对方进行抢占山头的比赛！$B$B别让我们失望，$n。地精工程学的尊严就靠你来维护了！此外，这里的士兵都指望着你呢。$B$B我们都下了注，赌你一定能胜过那些蠢货！
text.completion: Oh man, am I glad to see you! Did the chief send you down from the Hammer?

english.title: Get to Ymirheim!
english.objectives: Speak with Blast Thunderbomb in Ymirheim.
english.description: You need to get down to Ymirheim, that big frost vrykul town in the middle of Icecrown.$B$BOur boy, Blast Thunderbomb, is down there on the west side of town representing the Warsong Offensive in a competition against the Alliance. It's his jumpbot versus theirs in a king of the mountain contest!$B$BDon't let us down, $n. Goblin engineering pride is on the line! Besides, all the boys here in the hold are counting on you.$B$BThat and we've got money riding on it that you can kick those cowards in the pants!
english.completion: Oh man, am I glad to see you! Did the chief send you down from the Hammer?

text.title: 对抗巨人
text.objectives: 破天号上的萨萨里安要你前往莫德雷萨，从起脓的血肉巨人身上取回5根起脓的脊骨给他。
text.description: 尽管击败地面上的天灾士兵至关重要，但我们也不能疏忽了死亡之门的威胁。$B$B城墙上的血肉巨人可以投掷巨大的石块和冰块，对下面的部队造成毁灭性的伤害。$B$B集合一支队伍去干掉那些巨人。我们必须要对敌人有足够的了解。$B$B啊，对了……把它们的脊骨给我带回来。如果我没记错的话，那东西有一些特别的用处。
text.progress: Any success against the giants, $r?
text.completion: Excellent. These look to be usable samples.$b$bTime again to use the enemy's strength against them....
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: Against the Giants
english.objectives: Thassarian on the Skybreaker wants you to bring him 5 Pustulant Spines from the Pustulant Horrors on Mord'rethar.
english.description: While it's going to be crucial to defeat the Scourge on the ground, we mustn't neglect the gate itself.$b$bThe flesh giants on the ramparts are capable of hurling massive boulders and chunks of ice, inflicting devastating damage to enemy infantry below.$b$bMuster a force and defeat these giants. We need to know just what we're up against in terms of their strength.$b$bOh... and bring me their spines. If memory serves, there's a little trick I can share with you.
english.progress: Any success against the giants, $r?
english.completion: Excellent. These look to be usable samples.$b$bTime again to use the enemy's strength against them....
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 化学常识
text.objectives: 破天号上的萨萨里安希望你前往莫德雷萨，将脊骨脓液倒进那里的天灾之锅。
text.description: <萨萨里安取过脊骨，把里面的脓液倒进瓶子里。>$B$B我们对血肉巨人的特性有一点点了解……$B$B它们的脊骨脓液可以以一种非常有趣的方式与瘟疫病菌溶合，将瘟疫转换成一种腐蚀剂。$B$B虽然说从高高的城墙上泼下腐蚀剂会让下面的士兵非常郁闷，但至少受害者不会变成天灾军团的爪牙。$B$B把这只瓶子里的东西倒进死亡之门西面大厅内的天灾之锅里去。
text.progress: Were you able to neutralize a batch of plague, $c?
text.completion: You have done well, $c.$b$bWhen our armies arrive to march on the Citadel, we will have a solid plan in place for taking the death gate.
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: Basic Chemistry
english.objectives: Thassarian aboard the Skybreaker wants you to use Pustulant Spinal Fluid on a plague cauldron at Mord'rethar.
english.description: <Thassarian takes the pustulant spines and drains their fluid into a flask.>$b$bA little-known quality of the flesh giants...$b$bTheir spinal fluid interacts with the plague in a very interesting way, turning it into a corrosive acid.$b$bPoured from the towering ramparts, acid may not be a welcome sight to the troops below, but at least the victims won't rise up and add to the enemy's numbers.$b$bPour the contents of this flask into one of the plague cauldrons in the western chamber of the death gate.
english.progress: Were you able to neutralize a batch of plague, $c?
english.completion: You have done well, $c.$b$bWhen our armies arrive to march on the Citadel, we will have a solid plan in place for taking the death gate.
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 前往伊米海姆！
text.objectives: 与伊米海姆的弗拉索·磨轮谈一谈。
text.description: 伊米海姆坐落在冰冠冰川的中心地带，我要你潜入这座冰霜维库人的大型城市。$B$B弗拉索·磨轮已经抵达城市南侧，代表无畏远征军与部落展开了竞赛。她要使用跳跃机器人与对方进行抢占山头的比赛！$B$B别让我们失望，$n。侏儒工程学的尊严就靠你来维护了！此外，这里的士兵都指望着你呢。$B$B我们都下了注，赌你一定能胜过那些蠢货！
text.completion: Did the chief send you down from the Skybreaker? Isn't that thing sweet?!

english.title: Get to Ymirheim!
english.objectives: Speak with Frazzle Geargrinder in Ymirheim.
english.description: I need you down in Ymirheim, that big frost vrykul town in the middle of Icecrown.$B$BFrazzle Geargrinder is down there on the south side of town representing the Valiance Expedition in a competition against the Horde scum. It's her jumpbot versus theirs in a king of the mountain contest!$B$BDon't let us down, $n. Gnomish engineering pride is on the line! Besides, all the boys here in the hold are counting on you.$B$BThat and we've got money riding on it that you can kick those idiots in the pants!
english.completion: Did the chief send you down from the Skybreaker? Isn't that thing sweet?!

text.title: 中和瘟疫
text.objectives: 破天号上的萨萨里安希望你前往莫德雷萨，将脊骨脓液倒进那里的天灾之锅。$B$B你可以使用从起脓的血肉巨人身上收集而来的脊骨制造脓液。
text.description: 没有我的帮助，你也可以中和敌人的天灾之锅了，$r。$B$B去消灭死亡之门一带的血肉巨人，用它们脊骨中的脓液中和瘟疫。$B$B你所打击的是敌军最重要的核心部分。这是一个重要的任务——对我们的事业而言生死攸关的任务。只要时间允许，就应该尽力去完成。$B$B记住，你可以在莫德雷萨找到血肉巨人和天灾之锅。
text.progress: Greetings, $c.$B$BCan I report that we've rendered another plague cauldron useless?
text.completion: One less plague cauldron to account for when the battle commences.$b$bYour captain will be highly pleased.
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: Neutralizing the Plague
english.objectives: Thassarian aboard the Skybreaker wants you use Pustulant Spinal Fluid on a plague cauldron at Mord'rethar.$b$bYou can create Pustulant Spinal Fluid by using a Giant Spine collected from a Pustulant Horror.
english.description: You no longer need my assistance in neutralizing the enemy's plague cauldrons, $r.$b$bHunt down the flesh giants at the death gate and use the fluid from their spines to render batches of the plague ineffective.$b$bYou are striking at the heart of the enemy's strategy. This is an important mission - vital to our cause, and should be carried out whenever time permits.$b$bRemember, the giants and the plague cauldrons can be found on Mord'rethar.
english.progress: Greetings, $c.$B$BCan I report that we've rendered another plague cauldron useless?
english.completion: One less plague cauldron to account for when the battle commences.$b$bYour captain will be highly pleased.
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 污染者科普洛斯
text.objectives: 破天号上的萨萨里安要你前往莫德雷萨，杀死污染者科普洛斯。
text.description: 有报告指出死亡之门有一只非常强大的僵尸，$c。$B$B我们必须设法解除它带来的潜在威胁。如果你能亲自与它交手，应该可以了解到更多的有价值的情报。$B$B前往死亡之门西面的大厅，向这只怪物发起挑战，找出它的弱点。
text.progress: Were you able to find the zombie, $c?
text.completion: Well done, $c.$b$bPerhaps with some investigation, we can discover how they are bringing such a creature into existence.
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: Coprous the Defiled
english.objectives: Thassarian aboard the Skybreaker wants you to kill Coprous the Defiled at Mord'rethar.
english.description: Reports of a powerful zombie at the death gate have reached my ears, $c.$b$bWe cannot allow a potential threat such as this to go unchallenged. Any information you are able to glean from engaging it will be better than what we know now.$b$bGo to the western chamber of the gate and find this creature. Fight him, and find a weakness we might exploit.
english.progress: Were you able to find the zombie, $c?
english.completion: Well done, $c.$b$bPerhaps with some investigation, we can discover how they are bringing such a creature into existence.
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: ZZOLDWisp Cloak
text.completed: Return to Charles Worth at The Decrepit Flow in Crystalsong Forest.

english.title: ZZOLDWisp Cloak
english.completed: Return to Charles Worth at The Decrepit Flow in Crystalsong Forest.

text.title: 萨隆邪铁的奴隶
text.objectives: 破天号上的虔诚的阿布萨兰要你去营救10名萨隆邪铁矿洞奴隶。
text.description: 维库人将他们的俘虏送去位于冰冠冰川中心的伊米海姆，迫使他们进入那座城市的萨隆邪铁矿洞做苦工。巫妖王命令他们日夜不停地挖掘这种邪恶的矿石。$B$B我答应过弗丁大人，一定要将他们活着救出来。这就是我们眼下的任务。$B$B但是作为无畏远征军的使者，我不得不奉命待在这艘飞艇上。你能替我去救他们吗，$n？
text.progress: I haven't received many reports of our men returning to the Argent Vanguard.$B$BAre you sure you've been to Ymirheim to free them?
text.completion: They're being driven insane? Voices in their heads?$B$BVoices in your head?!$B$BI want you to clear your mind of the taint that has crept into that place, $g boy : girl;.$B$BWe'll try to get the remainder of them out of there again tomorrow when you've had a chance to rest.
text.completed: Return to Absalan the Pious at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: Slaves to Saronite
english.objectives: Absalan the Pious aboard the Skybreaker wants you to rescue 10 Saronite Mine Slaves.
english.description: Our people are being captured and put to work as slaves in the saronite mines of Ymirheim, the vrykul stronghold in the middle of Icecrown. The Lich King has them mining that unholy ore day and night.$B$BI made a promise to Highlord Fordring that we would get those wretches out of there alive, and that's exactly what we will do.$B$BUnfortunately, I've been ordered to stay on this gunship and serve as an ambassador to the Valiance Expedition. Will you please rescue them in my stead, $n?
english.progress: I haven't received many reports of our men returning to the Argent Vanguard.$B$BAre you sure you've been to Ymirheim to free them?
english.completion: They're being driven insane? Voices in their heads?$B$BVoices in your head?!$B$BI want you to clear your mind of the taint that has crept into that place, $g boy : girl;.$B$BWe'll try to get the remainder of them out of there again tomorrow when you've had a chance to rest.
english.completed: Return to Absalan the Pious at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

objectiveDetails.description: 营救萨隆邪铁矿洞奴隶

text.title: 地面突袭
text.objectives: 护送库卡隆部队抵达伊米海姆的大门。完成任务后返回伊米海姆北面的冰川边缘，向地面指挥官科特亚复命。
text.description: 你好，$c。$B$B最近我们一直在对伊米海姆发动猛攻，但是这些维库人比我们之前遇到过的要凶残得多。每次部队试图向伊米海姆推进时都会遭到伏击，我们的人员损失非常惨重。$B$B如果你愿意参战，帮助我的小分队安全抵达伊米海姆的大门，我们会好好奖励你的。抵达大门之后，我们就会挖掘壕沟，等待后援部队。
text.progress: Did you get some of my men up safely?
text.completion: You have my thanks.$b$bThis has been a brutal operation, but we haven't had any great options otherwise - they're being equally as unforgiving to our aerial assault. We need to route these vrykul if we're going to stand any chance of pressing on in Icecrown.$b$bWe're likely to need more help later. Please lend yourself to the battle again should the chance present itself.
text.completed: Return to Ground Commander Xutjja at the Bombardment in Icecrown.

english.title: Assault by Ground
english.objectives: Escort the Kor'kron troops to the gates of Ymirheim. Return to Ground Commander Xutjja at the edge of the glacier north of Ymirheim for compensation after the task is complete.
english.description: Greetings $c.$B$BOur troops have been attempting to storm Ymirheim for some time, but these vrykul are far more vicious than any we've faced before. They've been ambushing us repeatedly as we try to make it up the pass, and we've lost a lot of men.$B$BIf you want to lend yourself to the battle and help get my squad to the gates of Ymirheim safely, we will gladly reward you for your efforts. Once at the gates, we'll dig in and wait for reinforcements to catch up to us.
english.progress: Did you get some of my men up safely?
english.completion: You have my thanks.$b$bThis has been a brutal operation, but we haven't had any great options otherwise - they're being equally as unforgiving to our aerial assault. We need to route these vrykul if we're going to stand any chance of pressing on in Icecrown.$b$bWe're likely to need more help later. Please lend yourself to the battle again should the chance present itself.
english.completed: Return to Ground Commander Xutjja at the Bombardment in Icecrown.

objectiveDetails.description: 护送部落部队前往伊米海姆

text.title: 萨隆邪铁的奴隶
text.objectives: 奥格瑞姆之锤的凯尔坦修士要你去营救10名萨隆邪铁矿洞奴隶。
text.description: 维库人将他们的俘虏送去位于冰冠冰川中心的伊米海姆，迫使他们进入那座城市的萨隆邪铁矿洞做苦工。巫妖王命令他们日夜不停地挖掘这种邪恶的矿石。$B$B我答应过弗丁大人，一定要将他们活着救出来。这就是我们眼下的任务。$B$B但是作为战歌远征军的使者，我不得不奉命待在这艘飞艇上。你能替我去救他们吗，$n？
text.progress: I haven't received many reports of our men returning to the Argent Vanguard.$B$BAre you sure you've been to Ymirheim to free them?
text.completion: Their being driven insane? Voices in their heads?$b$bVoices in your head?!$b$bI want you to clear your mind of the taint that has crept into that place, boy.$b$bWe'll try to get the remainder of them out of there again tomorrow when you've had a chance to rest.
text.completed: Return to Brother Keltan at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

english.objectives: Brother Keltan aboard Orgrim's Hammer wants you to rescue 10 Saronite Mine Slaves.
english.description: Our people are being captured and put to work as slaves in the saronite mines of Ymirheim, the vrykul stronghold in the middle of Icecrown. The Lich King has them mining that unholy ore day and night.$B$BI made a promise to Highlord Fordring that we would get those wretches out of there alive, and that's exactly what we will do.$B$BUnfortunately, I've been ordered to stay on this gunship and serve as an ambassador to the Warsong Offensive. Will you please rescue them in my stead, $n?
english.progress: I haven't received many reports of our men returning to the Argent Vanguard.$B$BAre you sure you've been to Ymirheim to free them?
english.completion: Their being driven insane? Voices in their heads?$b$bVoices in your head?!$b$bI want you to clear your mind of the taint that has crept into that place, boy.$b$bWe'll try to get the remainder of them out of there again tomorrow when you've had a chance to rest.
english.completed: Return to Brother Keltan at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: The Panchurian Candidate
text.completed: Return to Jonathan LeCraft.

english.title: The Panchurian Candidate
english.completed: Return to Jonathan LeCraft.

text.title: 战地维修
text.objectives: 奥格瑞姆之锤的库尔迪拉·织亡者从食腐的恶鬼身上收集5块攻城车零件，然后将它们带去失落希望之谷的损毁的攻城车旁。
text.description: 天灾军团还没有从我们的这次攻势中缓过气来，$n。你顺利地完成了引爆任务，极大地鼓舞了大家的士气，我们要一鼓作气，继续战斗。$B$B位于我们下方的开阔山谷是一处战略要地。我们在失落希望之谷的东南角发现了一辆瘫痪的攻城车，似乎还可以使用。$B$B如果你能从食腐的恶鬼手里抢回丢失的零件，或许能让它重新运转起来。一辆攻城车就足以对敌人的地面单位造成重创了。
text.progress: The demolisher has suffered much damage.
text.completion: The Demolisher has seen better days, but the structure hasn't suffered any permanent damage. The parts you obtained should be enough to get it running again, at least temporarily.
text.completed: Return to Wrecked Demolisher at The Valley of Lost Hope in Icecrown.

english.title: Field Repairs
english.objectives: Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer wants you to collect 5 Demolisher Parts from the Scavenging Geists in the Valley of Lost Hope and take them to the Wrecked Demolisher.
english.description: The Scourge is still reeling from our attack, $n.  Now is the time to capitalize on our momentum.$B$BThe strategically important valley below us is wide open.  We've located a disassembled demolisher vehicle in what we believe is working condition in the southeastern corner of the Valley of Lost Hope area.$B$BIf you can get the remaining parts from the Scourge scavengers, you should be able to get it running again.  A single working demolisher can wreak havoc on the enemy's ground units.
english.progress: The demolisher has suffered much damage.
english.completion: The Demolisher has seen better days, but the structure hasn't suffered any permanent damage. The parts you obtained should be enough to get it running again, at least temporarily.
english.completed: Return to Wrecked Demolisher at The Valley of Lost Hope in Icecrown.

text.title: Do Your Worst
text.objectives: Use the Refurbished Demolisher to destroy 150 Decomposed Ghouls, 20 Frostskull Mages and 2 Bone Giants in the Valley of Lost Hope.  Speak to Matthias Lehner at the First Legion Forward Camp when you've completed this task.
text.description: You're going to use this machine against the Scourge?  You're not going to win against them like that.$B$BYou can destroy hundreds... even thousands of them.  But you won't win.  Not out here.$B$BWhen you're done playing with your machine, meet me to the north.  There is an old army encampment.  What I will show you will teach you a little bit about who you're up against.
text.progress: Are you done playing with your war machines?
text.completion: You see? You killed your fair share, but for every one you destroyed, another rose from the dirt to take its place$b$bYou don't know what you're up against, $n. Let me show you.
text.completed: Return to Matthias Lehner at The Valley of Lost Hope in Icecrown.

english.title: Do Your Worst
english.objectives: Use the Refurbished Demolisher to destroy 150 Decomposed Ghouls, 20 Frostskull Mages and 2 Bone Giants in the Valley of Lost Hope.  Speak to Matthias Lehner at the First Legion Forward Camp when you've completed this task.
english.description: You're going to use this machine against the Scourge?  You're not going to win against them like that.$B$BYou can destroy hundreds... even thousands of them.  But you won't win.  Not out here.$B$BWhen you're done playing with your machine, meet me to the north.  There is an old army encampment.  What I will show you will teach you a little bit about who you're up against.
english.progress: Are you done playing with your war machines?
english.completion: You see? You killed your fair share, but for every one you destroyed, another rose from the dirt to take its place$b$bYou don't know what you're up against, $n. Let me show you.
english.completed: Return to Matthias Lehner at The Valley of Lost Hope in Icecrown.

text.title: 构建路障
text.objectives: 奥格瑞姆之锤的库尔迪拉·织亡者要你使用路障搭设工具建造8处路障。
text.description: 一旦我们的部队开始动身穿越奥尔杜萨，他们就很容易遭到来自铁墙壁垒和广袤的冰川平原地区的攻击。$B$B我们没有时间和资源去建造防御工事，但可以搭建一些临时性的路障，抵御天灾军团的远程火力和突击，以保护我们的士兵。$B$B带着这只工具箱到奥尔杜萨西面的陨落英雄之谷去。按照我在那里做好的记号，用这只工具箱制造一些路障。
text.progress: Have you constructed those barricades?
text.completion: <Koltira nods curtly.>$b$bGood. It's not much protection, but it's better than nothing. That gate is still the perfect choke point if the Scourge commanders know what they're doing. We must gain control of as much of the surrounding area as possible.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

english.title: Raise the Barricades
english.objectives: Koltira Deathweaver, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to construct 8 Barricades using your Barricade Construction Kit.
english.description: When our forces begin to move beyond Aldur'thar, they will be vulnerable to attack from the Ironwall Rampart and the broad glacier below.$B$BWe have neither the time nor the materials to build fortifications, but we can put up some barricades to shield our men from fire and break up Scourge charges.$B$BTake this barricade kit to the Valley of Fallen Heroes, on the west side of Aldur'thar. Locate the markers I've placed there and use this kit to construct your barricades there.
english.progress: Have you constructed those barricades?
english.completion: <Koltira nods curtly.>$b$bGood. It's not much protection, but it's better than nothing. That gate is still the perfect choke point if the Scourge commanders know what they're doing. We must gain control of as much of the surrounding area as possible.
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: 溅血的旗帜
text.objectives: 奥格瑞姆之锤的库尔迪拉·织亡者要你去杀死5个天灾旗手、5个天灾转化者和20个被转化的英雄。
text.description: 天灾军团正在奥尔杜萨西面的陨落英雄之谷和冰冠冰川里搜寻死者，想要用他们来对付我们。天灾军团的军官已经复活了山谷中的一些死者，并赋予了他们可怕的力量和狂热的忠诚。天灾军团首领所携带的旗帜是这种力量的源泉，去杀死那些旗手，以此减少他们所控制的被转化英雄的数量。$B$B你必须帮我们除去这个障碍，并且在大部队开拔之前帮助我们削弱天灾军团的抵抗力度。
text.progress: Have you killed the banner-bearers and stopped their attempt to use the fallen against us?
text.completion: You have removed the Scourge banner-bearers and their minions? Good. Our preparations must continue.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

english.title: Bloodspattered Banners
english.objectives: Koltira Deathweaver, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to kill 5 Scourge Banner-Bearers, 5 Scourge Converters, and 20 Converted Heroes.
english.description: In the Valley of Fallen Heroes and Icecrown Glacier, to the west of Aldur'thar, the Scourge seeks to use the fallen against us. Scourge lieutenants have woken the valley's dead and imbued them with fearsome strength and fervor. The banners carried by the Scourge leaders in the glacier area are the source of these powers. Kill the banner-bearers, and you will weaken the converted heroes they lead.$B$BIt falls to you to rid us of this obstacle, and thin the resistance before the main body can advance.
english.progress: Have you killed the banner-bearers and stopped their attempt to use the fallen against us?
english.completion: You have removed the Scourge banner-bearers and their minions? Good. Our preparations must continue.
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: 思维诡计
text.objectives: 萨隆邪铁矿洞的黑暗低语者阿克希姆要你去找到工头的钥匙，帮它打开镣铐。
text.description: <你的脑海中响起了这个怪物的声音，它似乎在痛苦中挣扎，显得格外诡异。>$B$B$R，我需要你的帮助。和你那些被俘虏的朋友一样，我也被巫妖王手下的巨人给抓起来的。我从地下世界一路往上，想要调查从这座洞穴中传来的噪音，结果就被他们抓住并囚禁了起来。$B$B你愿意帮我吗？镣铐的钥匙就在矿洞中的工头身上。杀死他！$B$B<你感到一股压力冲击着你的思维，似乎这个怪物正在迫使你执行它的命令。>
text.progress: You will be richly rewarded for your service to me.$B$B<The darkspeaker projects soothing feelings into your mind.>$B$BYou will not regret unfettering me.
text.completion: <Another wave of euphoria, mixed with some pain, crashes through your mind as you approach the creature.>$B$BGood... good! So that you know I am being fair, I will first give you your reward as promised.$B$BAnd then you will willingly hand me the key.
text.completed: Return to Darkspeaker R'khem at the Saronite Mines in Icecrown.

english.title: Mind Tricks
english.objectives: Darkspeaker R'khem in the Saronite Mines wants you to recover the Foreman's Key to his chains.
english.description: <The creature speaks directly into your mind, its thoughts painful and strange.>$B$B$R-thing, I am in need of your assistance. Like your enslaved friends, I am a victim of the Lich King's ymirjar and their avarice. When I rose from below to investigate the noises coming from this cavern they captured and chained me.$B$BWill you please help me? The foreman of these mines holds the key to my chains. Kill him!$B$B<You can feel a pushing against your mind as if the creature is trying to coerce you.>
english.progress: You will be richly rewarded for your service to me.$B$B<The darkspeaker projects soothing feelings into your mind.>$B$BYou will not regret unfettering me.
english.completion: <Another wave of euphoria, mixed with some pain, crashes through your mind as you approach the creature.>$B$BGood... good! So that you know I am being fair, I will first give you your reward as promised.$B$BAnd then you will willingly hand me the key.
english.completed: Return to Darkspeaker R'khem at the Saronite Mines in Icecrown.

text.title: 空中突袭
text.objectives: 伊米海姆北面冰川边缘的地面指挥官库普命令你使用破天号压制炮台，保证破天号运兵机安全降落并卸下所有部队。
text.description: 我已经选出了合适的士兵，准备将他们送进伊米海姆。你的任务就是保证他们的安全。$B$B维库人在围墙内设置了一些自动矛枪，已经打下我们好几架运兵机了。我们的工程师建造了一座压制炮台，可以让那些矛枪哑火。只要向矛枪周围扫射一通，炮弹产生的烟雾就可以挡住它的视线，阻塞它的机关。$B$B跳上这座炮台吧，保证我的士兵们都能安全着陆。
text.progress: Did you get my boys inside?
text.completion: Excellent work, soldier. We could use more able bodies like you around here - stop by another day if the operation hasn't wrapped up.
text.completed: Return to Ground Commander Koup at the Valley of Lost Hope in Icecrown.

english.title: Assault by Air
english.objectives: Ground Commander Koup at the edge of the glacier east of Ymirheim has ordered you to use the Skybreaker Suppression Turret to keep the Skybreaker Troop Transport alive long enough to make all of its drops.
english.description: I've got some boys suited and ready for their drops inside of Ymirheim. I could use you to see them there safely.$B$BInside the walls, the vrykul have set up some kind of automated spear guns that have been tearing up our transports. We had our engineers install a Suppression Turret to shut down those spear guns - just fire a round near any gun and the smoke should block its sight and clog its gears.$B$BHop on the turret and see to it that all my boys make it to their drops in one piece.
english.progress: Did you get my boys inside?
english.completion: Excellent work, soldier. We could use more able bodies like you around here - stop by another day if the operation hasn't wrapped up.
english.completed: Return to Ground Commander Koup at the Valley of Lost Hope in Icecrown.

objectiveDetails.description: 破天号潜入者安全着陆

text.title: 空中突袭
text.objectives: 伊米海姆北面冰川边缘的地面指挥官科特亚命令你使用库卡隆压制炮台，保证库卡隆运兵机安全降落并卸下所有部队。
text.description: 正好有事情可以交给你这个废物去做，省得你整天游手好闲的。$B$B我们正准备将一队训练有素的士兵空投到伊米海姆去。但是维库人在围墙内设置了自动鱼叉炮，用于摧毁我们的运兵机。于是，我们请奥格瑞姆之锤的工程师建造了一座压制炮台。$B$B你要充当炮手，对维库人的鱼叉炮进行扫射，遮挡它们的视线，并摧毁它们的传动装置。你必须在确保运兵机完整的情况下让所有士兵都安全降落。
text.progress: Get the job done?
text.completion: Only partly useless then. Good work.
text.completed: Return to Ground Commander Xutjja at the Bombardment in Icecrown.

english.title: Assault by Air
english.objectives: Ground Commander Xutjja at the edge of the glacier north of Ymirheim has ordered you to use the Kor'kron Suppression Turret to keep the Kor'kron Troop Transport alive long enough to make all of its drops.
english.description: Alright scrub, I've got something to keep you from being a complete waste.$B$BA unit of highly trained infiltrators is ready to be dropped inside of Ymirheim. The vrykul inside have automated spear guns that have been ripping our transports to shreds, so we had the engineers on Orgrim's Hammer whip us up a suppression turret.$B$BYou're the gunner. Launch rounds at their spear guns to obscure their vision and clog their gears. See to it that my men all make their drops and the transport stays in one piece.
english.progress: Get the job done?
english.completion: Only partly useless then. Good work.
english.completed: Return to Ground Commander Xutjja at the Bombardment in Icecrown.

objectiveDetails.description: 库卡隆潜入者安全着陆

text.title: 恶魔套牌
text.objectives: 使用恶魔套牌召唤一位暗月占卜师，并把套牌交给占卜师。
text.description: 你现在已经收集到了恶魔套牌的所有卡片，一张新的卡片神秘地出现在你手中。卡面上描绘着一位占卜师，无论你把卡片转动到何种角度，占卜师似乎都在盯着你。$B$B你觉得似乎可以用这张卡片来联络某些人，或某些事物。
text.progress: I see that you have managed to complete a deck of Demons!  Congratulations!
text.completion: You are quickly becoming a master of the quill. The tarot cards are of great interest to the Darkmoon Faire, so do not hesitate to call upon us if you manage to create more. We are not without our own skilled tradesmen, so please allow us to offer something in trade for the cards.
text.completed: Return to Darkmoon Fortune Teller.

english.title: Demons Deck
english.objectives: Use the Demons Deck to summon a Darkmoon Fortune Teller and give the deck to them.
english.description: Now that you have gathered all of the Demon cards together into a deck, another card appears on top.  It depicts a fortune teller that seems to stare at you no matter how you hold the card.$b$bYou feel the card could be used to communicate with someone or something.
english.progress: I see that you have managed to complete a deck of Demons!  Congratulations!
english.completion: You are quickly becoming a master of the quill. The tarot cards are of great interest to the Darkmoon Faire, so do not hesitate to call upon us if you manage to create more. We are not without our own skilled tradesmen, so please allow us to offer something in trade for the cards.
english.completed: Return to Darkmoon Fortune Teller.

text.title: 铁墙壁垒
text.objectives: 击败邪恶的格姆克尔，然后向奥格瑞姆之锤的库尔迪拉·织亡者复命。
text.description: 铁墙壁垒位于奥尔杜萨的西面，俯瞰陨落英雄之谷。它可以全方位控制下方的开阔地区。如果不攻下铁墙壁垒，我们就没办法继续前进，但是邪恶的格姆克尔和他所率领的诅咒教派信徒控制着壁垒。$B$B如果你能削弱格姆克尔的力量，我们的部队在开进那一地区时就可以应付突发状况了。带上这枚扭曲符文，到铁墙壁垒的最深处去，在格姆克尔的宝珠附近使用它，把那个通灵师引出来。
text.progress: Have you completed your mission?
text.completion: So Grimkor has fallen by your hand? Excellent work. With him out of the way, our chances of taking and holding the rampart during the assault are greatly improved.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

english.title: The Ironwall Rampart
english.objectives: Defeat Grimkor the Wicked and return to Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer.
english.description: The Ironwall Rampart overlooks the Valley of Fallen Heroes, west of Aldur'thar. The rampart dominates the fields below on all sides. We will not be able to advance if the rampart cannot be taken, but it is held by Grimkor the Wicked and his Cult of the Damned disciples.$B$BIf you can weaken Grimkor, our forces know what to expect as we advance. Take this rune of distortion. Unleashing its power near Grimkor's orb at the end of the rampart should be enough to get the necromancer's attention.
english.progress: Have you completed your mission?
english.completion: So Grimkor has fallen by your hand? Excellent work. With him out of the way, our chances of taking and holding the rampart during the assault are greatly improved.
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: Blinding the Eyes in the Sky
text.objectives: Use the SGM-3 to destroy 6 Skybreaker Recon Fighters, then report back to Sky-Reaver Korm Blackscar aboard Orgrim's Hammer.
text.description: The Alliance has somehow managed to field a squadron of recon vehicles over the Valley of Fallen Heroes and Icecrown Glacier, the broad areas west of Aldur'thar.$B$BThey cannot be permitted to take the lead in this fight. Chief Engineer Copperclaw has supplied me with the perfect weapon to deal with this threat -- he calls his new missile the SGM-3. I have his assurances that it will take out the Alliance flying machines in a single hit. Go and use this weapon to give us the upper hand.
text.completion: Good. Fewer Alliance pests to stand in our way. We'll show them what true warriors look like.
text.completed: Return to Sky-Reaver Korm Blackscar at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

english.title: Blinding the Eyes in the Sky
english.objectives: Use the SGM-3 to destroy 6 Skybreaker Recon Fighters, then report back to Sky-Reaver Korm Blackscar aboard Orgrim's Hammer.

I have his assurances that it will take out the Alliance flying machines in a single hit. Go and use this weapon to give us the upper hand.
english.completion: Good. Fewer Alliance pests to stand in our way. We'll show them what true warriors look like.
english.completed: Return to Sky-Reaver Korm Blackscar at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: Get the Message
text.objectives: Capture 6 Orgrim's Hammer Dispatches from Orgrim's Hammer Scouts and bring them to High Captain Justin Bartlett aboard the Skybreaker.
text.description: The Horde is up to something and I don't like it. After the stunt they pulled on the Broken Front, they're capable of anything, and it's up to us to stop it.$B$BThere's been a flurry of activity in the skies over the Icecrown Glacier, to the west of Aldur'thar and the Ironwall Rampart. Horde scouts and messengers streak in and out on dragonhawks, carrying reports and orders. Take this dart gun and use it to kill the Orgrim's Hammer Scouts. It'll probably work best if you're flying, too.
text.progress: Have you intercepted those dispatches?
text.completion: It's good to have someone competent running missions, $N. If only we had an army of $cs like you, we could show the Horde what we're made of. These captured reports will help us to maintain the upper hand in this fight. We may be down, but we're far from out.
text.completed: Return to High Captain Justin Bartlett at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

starters.name: 高级指挥官加斯汀·巴雷特

enders.name: 高级指挥官加斯汀·巴雷特

text.title: 预览
text.objectives: 破天号的萨萨里安希望你飞往荒凉之门，调查荒凉之门的南部、中部、北部和西北部。
text.description: 事情有了一些进展。我们已经想到了一个很有希望成功的战术，可以让我们获得死亡之门的控制权。巨大的人员伤亡是不可避免的，但我们应该能够取得最终的胜利——只要那些你成天嚷嚷着要去收拾掉的部落不给我们造成什么麻烦的话。$B$B不管怎样，荒凉之门奥尔杜萨将是我们的下一个目标。飞去那里去熟悉一下地形，了解敌人的兵力部署。$B$B等你回来之后，我会交给你一些任务去办。
text.progress: Have you scouted the gate of desolation, $c?
text.completion: Well and good, $c.$b$bNow that you've seen firsthand what we're up against, it's time to get to work...
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: Sneak Preview
english.objectives: Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to fly down to the gate of desolation, visiting the south, central, north, and northwest regions of the gate.
english.description: Progress is being made. We have a promising array of tactics that should gain us control of the death gate. There will doubtlessly be many casualties, but in the end,  we should be able to prevail - barring any interference from those Horde you insist on contending with...$b$bAt any rate, our next focus will be the gate of desolation. Fly down and become familiar with it and with the enemies posted there.$b$bWhen you return, I will have your missions prepared.
english.progress: Have you scouted the gate of desolation, $c?
english.completion: Well and good, $c.$b$bNow that you've seen firsthand what we're up against, it's time to get to work...
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: The Guardians of Corp'rethar
text.objectives: Koltira Deathweaver, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to kill 5 Harbingers of Horror and 5 Corp'rethar Guardians.
text.description: Corp'rethar, called the Horror Gate. It is the last barrier between us and the Icecrown Citadel. It waits to the south of the Ironwall Rampart, beyond the glacier and the Conflagration. By the time our troops reach it, they will be exhausted and worse.$B$BWe must weaken its defenses, or our army's strength will break upon its walls.$B$BIts battlements are manned by some of the Lich King's fiercest and most zealous servants. Do all you can to destroy these guardians and hope it is enough.
text.progress: Have you crippled Corp'rethar's defenders?
text.completion: I hope your success at Corp'rethar will prove an omen of the battle ahead. The Lich King cannot sit idly by as we march to the very gates of his stronghold.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: 从天而“降”
text.objectives: 破天号上的萨萨里安希望你从奥尔杜萨的苦痛新兵身上夺取幻象宝珠，然后对那里的3名黑暗压制者使用。
text.description: 诅咒教派控制着荒凉之门，是吗？一点都不出我的意料。$B$B我们来跟他们玩一个小游戏吧。你之前已经注意到了，新来的教徒在荒凉之门的南端接受训练。他们之中的绝大部分人应该都持有一件特殊的物品——幻象宝珠。$B$B这种宝珠可以用来伪装诅咒教徒，使他们能够安全地自由行动，渗透或是完全伪装成敌人的模样。$B$B去干掉那些蠢货，从他们身上收集幻象宝珠，然后对黑暗压制者使用它。
text.progress: Yes, $r?
text.completion: An effective tool, given the circumstances, wouldn't you say?$b$bThat one never gets old....
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: Drag and Drop
english.objectives: Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to collect Orbs of Illusion from Bitter Initiates at Aldur'thar and use them on 3 Dark Subjugators there.
english.description: The Cult of the Damned hold the gate of desolation, eh? No surprise there.$b$bTime to have a little fun. At the southern end of the gate, you mentioned there were new cultists being trained. They're almost certain to be holding a special item given to all initiates - an Orb of Illusion.$b$bThese artifacts are used to disguise a cult member, allowing them to gain safe passage, infiltrate, or simply blend in with an enemy.$b$bKill the fools until you find one, $c, then use it on a subjugator.
english.progress: Yes, $r?
english.completion: An effective tool, given the circumstances, wouldn't you say?$b$bThat one never gets old....
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 指挥体系
text.objectives: 破天号的萨萨里安要你前往荒凉之门奥尔杜萨，击败工头法埃迪斯、工头沙维尔、工头维拉恩和工头夏克尔。
text.description: 根据你的报告以及我对诅咒教派的认识，他们在荒凉之门一带的每座营地中都会有一个工头负责管理各项事务。$B$B虽然干掉他们的首领只会让他们暂时受挫，但至少这样可以拖延他们的工作进度，并让他们应接不暇。而且就目前来说，这也是一个足够有价值的成果了。$B$B去找到那些工头，消灭他们之后回来向我报告。
text.progress: Yes, $c?
text.completion: Well done, $r. But don't break your arm patting yourself on the back. They'll have those overseers replaced in no time...
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: Chain of Command
english.objectives: Thassarian aboard the Skybreaker wants you to go to Aldur'thar and defeat Overseer Faedris, Overseer Savryn, Overseer Veraj, and Overseer Jhaeqon.
english.description: Based on your report, and my knowledge of the Cult, they have an overseer managing the operation of each encampment on the gate.$b$bWhile taking their leaders down will only be a temporary setback, it will at least slow them down and keep them off-balance. And that, $r, is a worthy enough goal for now.$b$bSeek out these overseers and return to me when they have been dispatched.
english.progress: Yes, $c?
english.completion: Well done, $r. But don't break your arm patting yourself on the back. They'll have those overseers replaced in no time...
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 无法复制
text.objectives: 破天号上的萨萨里安希望你前往荒凉之门奥尔杜萨，在那里的3处诅咒教徒的大锅中使用分离的药瓶，然后将其交给首席技师波尔维克。
text.description: 我在这里都闻到了他们的大锅散发出的气味，不过锅里煮的并不是瘟疫病菌。$B$B所有宣誓为诅咒教派效力的人都必须饮下一种可以夺走他们的意愿、使他们永远效忠巫妖王的药剂。$B$B有人说，这种药剂中封存着那些受到残酷折磨、并被无情屠杀的生物的扭曲之魂，不过我从来就没能成功地复制过这种药水……$B$B从荒凉之门西北区域的三处大锅里各采集一些样本，装进这只瓶子里，然后把它交给首席技师波尔维克。
text.progress: Whatdya got there, $r?
text.completion: <Boltwrench pours the contents of the flask into his tetrahydroparticle analyzer.>$b$bWhat we have here is a simple failure to conglomerate...
text.completed: Return to Chief Engineer Boltwrench at The Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: Cannot Reproduce
english.objectives: Thassarian aboard the Skybreaker wants you to use the Partitioned Flask at each of the 3 Cultists' Cauldrons at Aldur'thar, then bring it to Chief Engineer Boltwrench.
english.description: I smell their cauldrons from here, but that's not plague they're cooking.$b$bPledges to the cult are forced to drink a concoction that steals their will and enslaves them forever to the Lich King.$b$bSome say the potion contains the twisted soul of a being who was tormented before being mercilessly slaughtered, but I've never been able to reproduce it...$b$bFill this flask with a sample from each of the three cauldrons in the northwest region of the gate and bring it to Chief Engineer Boltwrench.
english.progress: Whatdya got there, $r?
english.completion: <Boltwrench pours the contents of the flask into his tetrahydroparticle analyzer.>$b$bWhat we have here is a simple failure to conglomerate...
english.completed: Return to Chief Engineer Boltwrench at The Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 重新考验
text.objectives: 破天号上的首席技师波尔维克希望你把沸腾的魔质扔进奥尔杜萨的天灾之锅里。
text.description: 这法子应该有效！$B$B那些扭曲的诅咒教徒想要把别人的灵魂放进他们的饮料里？那么让我们来帮他们一把吧！$B$B把这东西喝下去——不用担心，我已经对它进行了稀释……现在它唯一的作用只是让在你干掉诅咒教徒时可以发现他们的精华。$B$B等你收集到一些精华之后，把那些充满扭曲灵魂怨念的沸腾魔质扔进他们的天灾之锅里。$B$B看看他们尝到自己的药剂之后会怎样！
text.progress: Well, $c?$B$BWe have a few less cultists to worry about?
text.completion: Wahoo!$b$bThat'll teach 'em!
text.completed: Return to Chief Engineer Boltwrench at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: Retest Now
english.objectives: Chief Engineer Boltwrench aboard the Skybreaker wants you to throw a Writhing Mass into a cauldron at Aldur'thar.
english.description: This should do the trick!$b$bThose twisted hooligans are looking for souls to put in their crazy-juice? Then I say we help 'em out a bit!$b$bTake a swig of this - don't worry, I've diluted it plenty... I'm almost positive that its only effect will be to detect any cultist's essence once you've defeated them.$b$bWhen you've collected a bunch of them, throw the writhing mass of twisted souls into any of their cauldrons.$b$bLet's see how they like a taste of their own medicine!
english.progress: Well, $c?$B$BWe have a few less cultists to worry about?
english.completion: Wahoo!$b$bThat'll teach 'em!
english.completed: Return to Chief Engineer Boltwrench at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 重新考验
text.objectives: 破天号上的首席技师波尔维克希望你喝下稀释过的诅咒教徒滋补剂，杀死奥尔杜萨一带的任意诅咒教徒，从他们身上收集被污染的精华。然后将10份被污染的精华组合成沸腾的魔质，把它扔进奥尔杜萨的天灾之锅里。
text.description: 那些扭曲的诅咒教徒想要把别人的灵魂放进他们的饮料里？那么让我们来帮他们一把吧！$B$B把这东西喝下去——不用担心，我已经对它进行了稀释……现在它唯一的作用只是让在你干掉诅咒教徒时可以发现他们的精华。$B$B等你收集到一些精华之后，把那些充满扭曲灵魂怨念的沸腾魔质扔进他们的天灾之锅里。$B$B看看他们尝到自己的药剂之后会怎样！
text.progress: Well, $c?$B$BWe have a few less cultists to worry about?
text.completion: Wahoo!$b$bThat'll teach 'em!
text.completed: Return to Chief Engineer Boltwrench at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: Retest Now
english.objectives: Chief Engineer Boltwrench aboard the Skybreaker wants you to drink the Diluted Cult Tonic, kill any Cultists at Aldur'thar and take their Tainted Essences. You are then to combine 10 of the essences into a Writhing Mass and throw it into any of their cauldrons.
english.description: Those twisted cultists are looking for souls to put in their crazy-juice? Then let's help 'em out a bit!$b$bTake a swig of this - don't worry, I've diluted it plenty... I'm almost positive that its only effect will be to detect any cultist's essence.$b$bOnce you've collected a bunch of 'em, throw the writhing mass of twisted souls in one of their cauldrons.$b$bLet's see how they like a taste of their own medicine!
english.progress: Well, $c?$B$BWe have a few less cultists to worry about?
english.completion: Wahoo!$b$bThat'll teach 'em!
english.completed: Return to Chief Engineer Boltwrench at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.description: 看来那些新教徒的数量又增加了。你知道该怎么做吧……$B$B新来的教徒在荒凉之门的南端接受训练。他们之中的绝大部分人应该都持有一件特殊的物品——幻象宝珠。$B$B这种宝珠可以用来伪装诅咒教徒，使他们能够安全地自由行动，渗透或是完全伪装成敌人的模样。$B$B去干掉那些蠢货，从他们身上收集幻象宝珠，然后对黑暗压制者使用它。
text.progress: Yes, $r?
text.completion: An effective tool, given the circumstances, wouldn't you say?$b$bThat one never gets old....
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: Drag and Drop
english.objectives: Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to collect Orbs of Illusion from Bitter Initiates at Aldur'thar and use them on 3 Dark Subjugators there.
english.description: Looks like those initiates are increasing in number again. You know what to do...$b$bAt the southern portion of the gate, the new cultists are being trained. They're certain to be holding a special item given to all initiates - an Orb of Illusion.$b$bThese artifacts are used to disguise a cult member, allowing them to gain safe passage, infiltrate, or simply blend in with an enemy.$b$bSlay the fools until you find some, then use them on the subjugators there.
english.progress: Yes, $r?
english.completion: An effective tool, given the circumstances, wouldn't you say?$b$bThat one never gets old....
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 暗月棱镜套牌
text.objectives: 当暗月马戏团来到镇上的时候，把棱镜套牌交给他们。
text.description: 你现在已经收集到了棱镜套牌的所有卡片，与前8张的背面图案完全一样的第9张卡片神秘地出现在你手中。在这张卡片上写着，“将这些卡片拿到暗月马戏团去，你就将获得奖励。”你听说每个月暗月马戏团的入口都会出现在莫高雷和闪金镇。
text.progress: I see that you have managed to complete a deck of Prisms!  Congratulations!
text.completion: So you have put together a deck of Prisms.  Your gesture of returning it to us will create a tie between you and the Darkmoon that will not soon be forgotten.  Allow me to present you with one of the greater Darkmoon cards as a small token of our appreciation.
text.completed: Return to Professor Thaddeus Paleo.

english.title: Darkmoon Prisms Deck
english.objectives: Return the Prisms Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
english.description: Now that you have gathered all of the Prism cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight.   On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded."  You have heard that the entrance to this faire appears near Mulgore and Goldshire every month.
english.progress: I see that you have managed to complete a deck of Prisms!  Congratulations!
english.completion: So you have put together a deck of Prisms.  Your gesture of returning it to us will create a tie between you and the Darkmoon that will not soon be forgotten.  Allow me to present you with one of the greater Darkmoon cards as a small token of our appreciation.

text.title: 暗月高尚套牌
text.objectives: 当暗月马戏团来到镇上的时候，把高尚套牌交给他们。
text.description: 你现在已经收集到了高尚套牌的所有卡片，与前8张的背面图案完全一样的第9张卡片神秘地出现在你手中。在这张卡片上写着，“将这些卡片拿到暗月马戏团去，你就将获得奖励。”你听说每个月暗月马戏团的入口都会出现在莫高雷和闪金镇。
text.progress: I see that you have managed to complete a deck of Nobles!  Congratulations!
text.completion: So you have put together a deck of Nobles.  Your gesture of returning it to us will create a tie between you and the Darkmoon that will not soon be forgotten.  Allow me to present you with one of the greater Darkmoon cards as a small token of our appreciation.
text.completed: Return to Professor Thaddeus Paleo.

english.title: Darkmoon Nobles Deck
english.objectives: Return the Nobles Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
english.description: Now that you have gathered all of the Nobles cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight.   On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded."  You have heard that the entrance to this faire appears near Mulgore and Goldshire every month.
english.progress: I see that you have managed to complete a deck of Nobles!  Congratulations!
english.completion: So you have put together a deck of Nobles.  Your gesture of returning it to us will create a tie between you and the Darkmoon that will not soon be forgotten.  Allow me to present you with one of the greater Darkmoon cards as a small token of our appreciation.
english.completed: Return to Professor Thaddeus Paleo.

text.description: 你现在已经收集到了死灵套牌的所有卡片，与前8张的背面图案完全一样的第9张卡片神秘地出现在你手中。在这张卡片上写着，“将这些卡片拿到暗月马戏团去，你就将获得奖励。”你听说每个月暗月马戏团的入口都会出现在莫高雷和闪金镇。

text.title: Shatter the Shards
text.objectives: Bring the Broken Shard of Horror, the Broken Shard of Despair, and the Broken Shard of Suffering to Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer.
text.description: Atop the battlements of Corp'rethar, the Lich King's minions have erected three crystals, the shards of horror, despair, and suffering. Should our men reach the walls of Corp'rethar, he will unleash these weapons on our army.$B$BIn full effect, the crystals will afflict the minds of our men with paralyzing pain and fear. Then, the Scourge will be able to slaughter them at will.$B$BFind these shards, destroy them, and bring me their broken remains. We cannot allow the Lich King to deploy these weapons!
text.progress: Have you shattered the Lich King's new weapons?
text.completion: <Koltira takes the crystal shards from you and speaks in a quiet voice.>$b$bI remember these...$b$bLesser men would easily crumble beneath their assault. You have done well in removing their threat.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: Before the Gate of Horror
text.objectives: Koltira Deathweaver, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to use the Volatile Acid to dissolve the remains of 6 Skeletal Reavers.
text.description: The Conflagration, the ground before Corp'rethar, south of the Ironwall Rampart, is where the Lich King's elite soldiers have formed up to defend the citadel.$B$BLed by a contingent of death knights, a legion of skeletal reavers bars the way. I fear that even when these reavers fall, the Scourge will simply reconstitute them and send them back at us.$B$BI've come up with a plan to stop this, but I have no way of knowing if it will work. Take this solution and use it to dissolve the remains of the reavers.
text.completion: <Koltira listens to your report.>$b$bGood. I'll have the engineers mix up as much of that acid as they can before we prepare to assault Corp'rethar with the main force.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.
