text.title: 伊米亚之血
text.objectives: 奥格瑞姆之锤的战争使者达沃斯·里赫要你进入伊米海姆，杀死20个维库人。
text.description: 那些博得巫妖王宠爱的维库人自称为伊米亚，他们居住在位于冰冠冰川中心的伊米海姆。在进攻冰冠堡垒之前，我们还有很多准备工作要做。眼下，我们的任务就是消灭这些所谓的巫妖王的“选民”。$B$B进入伊米海姆，杀死那些维库人。让他们明白，我们远比他们更强大。
text.progress: Have you done what I've asked of you?
text.completion: Not so strong after all, it seems. The Lich King will get what's coming to him.
text.completed: Return to Warbringer Davos Rioht at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

english.title: Blood of the Chosen
english.objectives: Warbringer Davos Rioht on Orgrim's Hammer has sent you to kill 20 vrykul in Ymirheim.
english.description: Those vrykul that have gained the favor of the Lich King call themselves the Ymirjar. They inhabit a city in the center of Icecrown. We have a lot of preparations to make before we assault Icecrown Citadel, and the one that stands before us now is routing these so-called "Chosen" of the Lich King.$B$BGo to their city, Ymirheim, and slaughter them in their home. Let there be no questions as to who the stronger combatants are here.
english.progress: Have you done what I've asked of you?
english.completion: Not so strong after all, it seems. The Lich King will get what's coming to him.
english.completed: Return to Warbringer Davos Rioht at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: Keeping the Alliance Blind
text.objectives: Use the SGM-3 to destroy 6 Skybreaker Recon Fighters, then report back to Sky-Reaver Korm Blackscar aboard Orgrim's Hammer.
text.description: The Alliance is tenacious, I'll give them that, but it'll take more than that to stop us. Take this SGM-3 with you and shoot down the Skybreaker's recon fighters once again.$B$BI doubt the message will get through their thick skulls, but there are enough missiles to keep trying to get our point across. Go and find their fighters flying above the Valley of Fallen Heroes, west of Aldur'thar, and don't come back until you've made wreckage of them.
text.completion: Well done, once again. Horde superiority is assured, at least until those Alliance pukes decide to challenge us again.
text.completed: Return to Sky-Reaver Korm Blackscar at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: Raise the Barricades
text.objectives: Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to construct 8 Barricades using your Barricade Construction Kit.
text.description: When our forces begin to move beyond Aldur'thar, they will be vulnerable to attack from the Ironwall Rampart and the broad glacier below.$B$BWe have neither the time nor the materials to build fortifications, but we can put up some barricades to shield our men from fire and break up Scourge charges.$B$BTake this barricade kit to the Valley of Fallen Heroes, on the west side of Aldur'thar. Locate the markers I've placed there and use this kit to construct your barricades there.
text.progress: Have you constructed those barricades?
text.completion: <Thassarian nods.>$B$BGood. It's not much protection, but it's better than nothing. That gate is still the perfect choke point if the Scourge commanders know what they're doing. We must gain control of as much of the surrounding area as possible.
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 抢夺急件
text.objectives: 从奥格瑞姆之锤斥候身上截获6份奥格瑞姆之锤急件，把它们交给破天号上的高级指挥官加斯汀·巴雷特。
text.description: 不仅我们在努力，部落也在不断向铁墙壁垒和奥尔杜萨西面的冰冠冰川派出斥候。$B$B不能让部落通过这种方法领先我们。再带上这把镖枪，不要对那些奥格瑞姆之锤斥候手软！把你截获的急件都给我带回来。$B$B部落的损失就是我们的成果。
text.progress: Have you intercepted those dispatches?
text.completion: <The high captain accepts the dispatches.>$b$bThis is just what we need. Not even the Horde is so stupid as to charge in blindly against the Scourge. With their reports in hand, we'll be well prepared.
text.completed: Return to High Captain Justin Bartlett at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: Capture More Dispatches
english.objectives: Capture 6 Orgrim's Hammer Dispatches from Orgrim's Hammer Scouts and bring them to High Captain Justin Bartlett aboard the Skybreaker.
english.description: Despite our efforts, the Horde continues to send scouts to the area of the Icecrown Glacier, to the west of the Ironwall Rampart and Aldur'thar.$B$BWe can't afford to let the Horde gain the upper hand with this scouting operation. Take the dart gun with you again and show the Orgrim's Hammer scouts no mercy! Bring the captured dispatches to me.$B$BThe Horde's wasted efforts will be our gain.
english.progress: Have you intercepted those dispatches?
english.completion: <The high captain accepts the dispatches.>$b$bThis is just what we need. Not even the Horde is so stupid as to charge in blindly against the Scourge. With their reports in hand, we'll be well prepared.
english.completed: Return to High Captain Justin Bartlett at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

starters.name: 高级指挥官加斯汀·巴雷特

enders.name: 高级指挥官加斯汀·巴雷特

text.title: 溅血的旗帜
text.objectives: 破天号的萨萨里安要你去杀死5个天灾旗手、5个天灾转化者和20个被转化的英雄。
text.description: 天灾军团正在奥尔杜萨西面的陨落英雄之谷和冰冠冰川里搜寻死者，想要用他们来对付我们。天灾军团的军官已经复活了山谷中的一些死者，并赋予了他们可怕的力量和狂热的忠诚。天灾军团首领所携带的旗帜是这种力量的源泉，去杀死那些旗手，以此减少他们所控制的被转化英雄的数量。$B$B你必须帮我们除去这个障碍，并且在大部队开拔之前帮助我们试探一下天灾军团的抵抗力度。
text.progress: You have removed the Scourge banner-bearers and their minions? Good. Our preparations must continue.
text.completion: You have removed the Scourge banner-bearers and their minions? Good. Our preparations must continue.
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: Bloodspattered Banners
english.objectives: Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to kill 5 Scourge Banner-Bearers, 5 Scourge Converters, and 20 Converted Heroes.
english.description: In the Valley of Fallen Heroes and Icecrown Glacier, to the west of Aldur'thar, the Scourge seeks to use the fallen against us. Scourge lieutenants have woken the valley's dead and imbued them with fearsome strength and fervor. The banners carried by the Scourge leaders in the glacier area are the source of these powers. Kill the banner-bearers, and you will weaken the converted heroes they lead.$B$BIt falls to you to rid us of this obstacle, and test the resistance before the main body can advance.
english.progress: You have removed the Scourge banner-bearers and their minions? Good. Our preparations must continue.
english.completion: You have removed the Scourge banner-bearers and their minions? Good. Our preparations must continue.
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 在恐惧之门前
text.objectives: 破天号的萨萨里安要你使用强酸溶解6具冰冠劫掠者的尸体。
text.description: 战火平原位于科雷萨的前方，铁墙堡垒的南方。巫妖王在这里布置了精锐部队以守卫冰冠堡垒。$B$B一队死亡骑士率领着大群的冰冠劫掠者守住了道路。我担心就算我们打倒了这些劫掠者，天灾军团也能复活它们，并把它们再次投入战场。$B$B我已经有了一个解决方案，不过尚不知道能否奏效。带着这瓶溶液，用它去溶解那些冰冠劫掠者的残骸。
text.progress: Have you tested the solution out on the reavers?
text.completion: <Thassarian listens as you describe your successful tests.>$B$BSo the acid worked? Good. We'll need it when the army goes up against the reavers in force.
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: Before the Gate of Horror
english.objectives: Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to use the Volatile Acid to dissolve the corpses of 6 Skeletal Reavers.
english.description: The Conflagration, the ground before Corp'rethar, south of the Ironwall Rampart, is where the Lich King's elite soldiers have formed up to defend the citadel.$B$BLed by a contingent of death knights, a legion of skeletal reavers bars the way. I fear that even when these reavers fall, the Scourge will simply reconstitute them and send them back at us.$B$BI've come up with a plan to stop this, but I have no way of knowing if it will work. Take this solution and use it to dissolve the remains of the reavers.
english.progress: Have you tested the solution out on the reavers?
english.completion: <Thassarian listens as you describe your successful tests.>$B$BSo the acid worked? Good. We'll need it when the army goes up against the reavers in force.
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

objectiveDetails.description: 溶解冰冠劫掠者的残骸

text.title: 伊米亚之血
text.objectives: 破天号的骑士队长德洛斯彻要你前往伊米海姆，杀死20个维库人。
text.description: 那些博得巫妖王宠爱的维库人自称为伊米亚，他们居住在位于冰冠冰川中心的伊米海姆。在进攻冰冠堡垒之前，我们还有很多准备工作要做。眼下，我们的任务就是消灭这些所谓的巫妖王的“选民”。$B$B进入伊米海姆，杀死那些维库人。让他们明白谁才是最强大的人。
text.completion: The traitor king will fall. Of that I have no doubt.
text.completed: Return to Knight-Captain Drosche at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: Blood of the Chosen
english.objectives: Knight-Captain Drosche on the Skybreaker has sent you to kill 20 vrykul in Ymirheim.
english.description: Those vrykul that have gained the favor of the Lich King call themselves the Ymirjar. They inhabit a city in the center of Icecrown. We have a lot of preparations to make before we assault Icecrown Citadel, and the one that stands before us now is routing these so-called "Chosen" of the Lich King.$B$BGo to their city, Ymirheim, and slaughter them in their home. Let there be no questions as to who the stronger combatants are here.
english.completion: The traitor king will fall. Of that I have no doubt.
english.completed: Return to Knight-Captain Drosche at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 铁墙壁垒
text.objectives: 击败邪恶的格姆克尔，然后向破天号的萨萨里安复命。
text.description: 铁墙壁垒位于奥尔杜萨的西面，俯瞰陨落英雄之谷。它可以全方位控制下方的开阔地区。如果不攻下铁墙壁垒，我们就没办法继续前进，但是邪恶的格姆克尔和他所率领的诅咒教派信徒控制着壁垒。$B$B如果你能削弱格姆克尔的力量，我们的部队在开进那一地区时就可以应付突发状况了。带上这枚扭曲符文，到铁墙壁垒的最深处去，在格姆克尔的宝珠附近使用它，把那个通灵师引出来。
text.progress: Have you completed your mission?
text.completion: So Grimkor has fallen by your hand? Excellent work. With him out of the way, our chances of taking and holding the rampart during the assault are greatly improved.
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: The Ironwall Rampart
english.objectives: Defeat Grimkor the Wicked and return to Thassarian aboard the Skybreaker.
english.description: The Ironwall Rampart overlooks the Valley of Fallen Heroes, west of Aldur'thar. The rampart dominates the fields below on all sides. We will not be able to advance if the rampart cannot be taken, but it is held by Grimkor the Wicked and his Cult of the Damned disciples.$B$BIf you can weaken Grimkor, our forces will know what to expect as we advance. Take this rune of distortion. Unleashing its power near Grimkor's orb at the end of the rampart should be enough to get the necromancer's attention.
english.progress: Have you completed your mission?
english.completion: So Grimkor has fallen by your hand? Excellent work. With him out of the way, our chances of taking and holding the rampart during the assault are greatly improved.
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 科雷萨的守卫者
text.objectives: 破天号的萨萨里安要你去杀死5个恐惧先驱和5个科雷萨守卫者。
text.description: 科雷萨又被称为恐惧之门，它是挡在我们与冰冠堡垒之间的最后一道屏障。它位于铁墙壁垒的南方，要越过冰川和战火平原才能抵达。当我们的部队开进那里以后，他们可能会遭到严重减员，甚至更糟。$B$B我们一定要削弱科雷萨的防御力量，不然我们的部队只会在它的城墙上撞得头破血流。$B$B科雷萨的城头上布署着巫妖王手下最凶狠、最狂热的仆从。你要尽量消灭这些守卫，希望这么做能有点用。
text.completion: I hope your success at Corp'rethar will prove an omen of the battle ahead. The Lich King cannot sit idly by as we march to the very gates of his stronghold.
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: The Guardians of Corp'rethar
english.objectives: Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to kill 5 Harbingers of Horror and 5 Corp'rethar Guardians.
english.description: Corp'rethar, called the Horror Gate. It is the last barrier between us and the Icecrown Citadel. It waits to the south of the Ironwall Rampart, beyond the glacier and the Conflagration. By the time our troops reach it, they will be exhausted and worse.$B$BWe must weaken its defenses, or our army's strength will break upon its walls.$B$BIts battlements are manned by some of the Lich King's fiercest and most zealous servants. Do all you can to destroy these guardians and hope it is enough.
english.completion: I hope your success at Corp'rethar will prove an omen of the battle ahead. The Lich King cannot sit idly by as we march to the very gates of his stronghold.
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 击破碎片
text.objectives: 将破损的绝望碎片、破损的恐惧碎片和破损的苦难碎片交给破天号的萨萨里安。
text.description: 巫妖王的手下在科雷萨的墙头安装了三种水晶，分别是绝望碎片、恐惧碎片和苦难碎片。一旦我们的部队抵达科雷萨城下，他就会使用这三种水晶进行攻击。$B$B如果让这些水晶完全发动，士兵们的精神就会被痛苦和恐惧压垮。这样一来，天灾军团就可以轻易消灭他们。$B$B去找到那些碎片，摧毁它们，把水晶给我带回来。我们不能让这些武器留在巫妖王手里！
text.progress: Have you shattered the Lich King's new weapons?
text.completion: <Thassarian takes the crystal shards from you and speaks in a quiet voice.>$B$BI remember these...$B$BLesser men would easily crumble beneath their assault. You have done well in removing their threat.
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: Shatter the Shards
english.objectives: Bring the Broken Shard of Horror, the Broken Shard of Despair, and the Broken Shard of Suffering to Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker.
english.description: Atop the battlements of Corp'rethar, the Lich King's minions have erected three crystals, the shards of horror, despair, and suffering. Should our men reach the walls of Corp'rethar, he will unleash these weapons on our army.$B$BIn full effect, the crystals will afflict the minds of our men with paralyzing pain and fear. Then, the Scourge will be able to slaughter them at will.$B$BFind these shards, destroy them, and bring me their broken remains. We cannot allow the Lich King to deploy these weapons!
english.progress: Have you shattered the Lich King's new weapons?
english.completion: <Thassarian takes the crystal shards from you and speaks in a quiet voice.>$B$BI remember these...$B$BLesser men would easily crumble beneath their assault. You have done well in removing their threat.
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 协助突袭
text.objectives: 向伊米海姆北面冰川边缘的地面指挥官科特亚报到。
text.description: 我们需要更多人手来执行针对伊米海姆的作战计划。$B$B凡是有点脑子的战士都会告诉你，维库人非常凶猛，不可轻视。伊米亚更是维库人中的佼佼者。伊米亚会不遗余力地向我们证明，为什么巫妖王更加看重他们。$B$B伊米海姆位于冰冠冰川的中心，这场战斗由地面指挥官科特亚负责。他的部队就驻扎在伊米海姆北面，靠近冰川边缘一带。
text.completion: More meat for the grinder. Welcome to hell, soldier.$b$bMy men are leading the assault on the gate from this position, and we're dropping some infiltrators in the city via air - we need more people on both fronts. I have a feeling that this attack will be going on for some time.

english.title: Joining the Assault
english.objectives: Report to Ground Commander Xutjja at the edge of the glacier north of Ymirheim.
english.description: We need more men to join the main assault on Ymirheim.$B$BAny warrior with half a brain can tell you that vrykul are fierce fighters and should not be taken lightly. That goes two-fold for the Ymirjar. They have shown us no restraint in proving why the Lich King deemed them worthy.$B$BGround Commander Xutjja is overseeing the assault. The city itself is located in the center of Icecrown - Xutjja's troops are positioned near the edge of the glacier, north of the city.
english.completion: More meat for the grinder. Welcome to hell, soldier.$b$bMy men are leading the assault on the gate from this position, and we're dropping some infiltrators in the city via air - we need more people on both fronts. I have a feeling that this attack will be going on for some time.

text.title: 协助突袭
text.objectives: 向伊米海姆东面冰川上的地面指挥官库普报道。
text.description: 我们需要更多人手来参加对伊米海姆的进攻。$B$B凡是有点脑子的战士，都会告诉你维库人是凶猛的战士，不可轻侮。伊米亚战士更是如此。他们总是不遗余力地向我们证明，为什么巫妖王更看重他们。$B$B这场战斗由地面指挥官库普指挥。伊米海姆位于冰冠冰川的中心，库普的部队就驻扎在城市东面，靠近冰川的边缘的地方。
text.completion: Welcome to hell, soldier.$B$BMy men are leading the assault on the gate from this position, and we're dropping some infiltrators in the city via air - we need more people on both fronts. I have a feeling that this attack will be going on for some time.

english.title: Joining the Assault
english.objectives: Report to Ground Commander Koup at the edge of the glacier east of Ymirheim.
english.description: We need more men to join the main assault on Ymirheim.$B$BAny warrior with half a brain can tell you that vrykul are fierce fighters and should not be taken lightly. That goes two-fold for the Ymirjar. They have shown no restraint in proving to us why the Lich King deemed them worthy.$B$BGround Commander Koup is overseeing the assault. The city itself is located in the center of Icecrown - Koup's troops are positioned near the edge of the glacier, east of the city.
english.completion: Welcome to hell, soldier.$B$BMy men are leading the assault on the gate from this position, and we're dropping some infiltrators in the city via air - we need more people on both fronts. I have a feeling that this attack will be going on for some time.

text.title: 活动窃听器
text.objectives: 破天号上的萨萨里安希望你去收集5份黑暗物质，然后在奥尔杜萨召唤出一名黑暗信使。
text.description: 好吧，$g朋友:女士;，是时候给他们装个窃听器了。$B$B放松一点，我并不说要真的去装一个窃听器，不过大概也就是那么回事。$B$B在奥尔杜萨的北部区域，有许多诅咒教派的虚空召唤师带着恶魔爪牙游来荡去。用这根魔棒从那些被奴役的爪牙的尸体上吸取一些黑暗物质，然后使用诅咒教派的召唤水晶，召唤出我们的小间谍。$B$B除非它被发现，否则信使将一直作为我们的耳目，小心地观察敌人的行动。
text.progress: Yes, $c?
text.completion: You have done well, $c.$b$bThe messenger has already turned up some valuable information.
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: Not a Bug
english.objectives: Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to collect 5 Dark Matters and summon a Dark Messenger at Aldur'thar.
english.description: Alright, $g friend:missy;, time to plant a bug.$b$bRelax, it's not a bug exactly, but it'll serve our purposes.$b$bIn the northern portion of Aldur'thar the cult's void summoners enslave demonic minions. Use this rod to siphon the dark matter from the corpses of these enslaved minions, and then use their summoning crystal to bring our little spy into being.$b$bUntil it is discovered, the messenger will serve as our eyes and ears, discreetly observing the actions of our enemy.
english.progress: Yes, $c?
english.completion: You have done well, $c.$b$bThe messenger has already turned up some valuable information.
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 永恒之龙的秘密，再来一次
text.objectives: 龙眠神殿顶层的克罗米要你再次返回青铜巨龙圣地。$B$B进入圣地后，将永恒沙漏放在地上，和过去的你一起保护沙漏，令它免遭永恒之龙的破坏。
text.description: 你来了！呃，刚刚我是不是已经和你谈过了？$B$B<克罗米思考着时间流的可能性。>$B$B不管这些啦，永恒之龙正在追杀你！别紧张，不是现在的你。他们正在追踪过去的你，就在你保卫永恒沙漏的那个时间流里。你还记得这件事吧？$B$B那是过去的你，当然也是现在的你。哎呀，这不重要。你必须返回青铜巨龙圣地，抵御他们的攻击，保护你自己，当然还有保护永恒沙漏，不然你就会从历史上消失！
text.progress: <Chromie looks at you strangely.>$B$BDo I know you? I sense an aura about you as if your very existence is in flux. Either that or you're stuck in a time loop.$B$BWhatever the reason, you'd better fix it fast or you won't exist for very long at all!
text.completion: Oh my goodness, you made it! I was uncertain.$B$BYou flickered in and out of the time stream there for a moment during the fight! I thought for sure that we'd lost you!$B$BBut here you are safe and sound, with your past self rescued, on the other side of the time loop you were in.$B$BYou're quite the temporal $g hero : heroine;, $N!
text.end: 保护永恒沙漏免遭永恒之龙的破坏。
text.completed: 去龙骨荒野找龙眠神殿的克罗米。

english.title: Mystery of the Infinite, Redux
english.objectives: Chromie, at the top of Wyrmrest Temple, has asked you to travel once more to the Bronze Dragonshrine.$B$BOnce inside, place the Hourglass of Eternity on the ground and help your Past Self to protect it from the forces of the Infinite Dragonflight.
english.description: There you are! Or, were we just talking?$B$B<Chromie muses over the temporal possibilities.>$B$BAnyway, the Infinites are after you! Well, not you per-se. Rather, they're after the past version of you that defended the Hourglass of Eternity. You remember, right?$B$BThat was you back then, except it's you now too. Wait, that's not important. What is important is that you head back to the Bronze Dragonshrine and defend yourself and the hourglass from their attacks before you get erased from history!
english.progress: <Chromie looks at you strangely.>$B$BDo I know you? I sense an aura about you as if your very existence is in flux. Either that or you're stuck in a time loop.$B$BWhatever the reason, you'd better fix it fast or you won't exist for very long at all!
english.completion: Oh my goodness, you made it! I was uncertain.$B$BYou flickered in and out of the time stream there for a moment during the fight! I thought for sure that we'd lost you!$B$BBut here you are safe and sound, with your past self rescued, on the other side of the time loop you were in.$B$BYou're quite the temporal $g hero : heroine;, $N!
english.end: Hourglass of Eternity protected from the Infinite Dragonflight.
english.completed: Return to Chromie at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

text.title: 活动窃听器
text.objectives: 破天号上的萨萨里安希望你去收集5份黑暗物质，然后在奥尔杜萨召唤出一名黑暗信使。
text.description: 教徒们已经发现了你上次召唤出来的信使，$r。$B$B虽然我们已经得到了大量的情报，但是能够监控诅咒教派的每一步行动对我们非常重要。$B$B前往奥尔杜萨，用这根魔棒从那些被奴役的爪牙的尸体上吸取一些黑暗物质，然后使用诅咒教派的召唤水晶，再帮我们召唤出一个黑暗信使。$B$B在黑暗信使被发现之前，它将一直作为我们的耳目，小心地观察敌人的行动。
text.progress: Yes, $c?
text.completion: Well done, friend.$b$bThe messenger is up and reporting in as we speak.
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: Not a Bug
english.objectives: Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to collect 5 Dark Matters and summon a Dark Messenger at Aldur'thar.
english.description: The cultists have discovered the last messenger you summoned, $r.$b$bWhile it was quite informative, it's important that we continue to monitor their every move.$b$bUse this rod to siphon the dark matter from the corpses of enslaved minions at Aldur'thar. Then use their summoning crystal to bring another dark messenger into being.$b$bUntil it is discovered, the messenger will serve as our eyes and ears, discreetly observing the actions of our enemy.
english.progress: Yes, $c?
english.completion: Well done, friend.$b$bThe messenger is up and reporting in as we speak.
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 需要更多情报
text.objectives: 破天号上的萨萨里安希望你从奥尔杜萨的诅咒教派研究员身上收集3页诅咒教派研究笔记，然后将它们组合成诅咒教派论文。
text.description: 诅咒教派一直都是以喜欢制订庞大的计划但最终鲜有成功而声明狼藉，但我这次感觉有些不一样……$B$B也许是由于接近巫妖王，提高了他们的热情。不管怎样，它们似乎比以往任何时候都更有信心了。我们必须了解是什么让他们感到自信，并想办法夺走他们的自信！$B$B我相信关键就在他们的研究员身上。去搞清楚他们正在干些什么，然后向我报告具体的细节。
text.progress: Have you determined what their researchers are up to, $r?
text.completion: This is alarming, indeed....
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: Need More Info
english.objectives: Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to collect the 3 pages of Cultists' Research from the Cult Researchers at Aldur'thar and use them to create the Cult of the Damned Thesis.
english.description: The Cult of the Damned are notorious for concocting grandiose plans that in the end, rarely succeed. But something feels different this time....$b$bPerhaps it's the proximity to the Lich King that has their fervor heightened. Whatever it is, they appear to be more confident than ever. We must know what feeds this bravado and then find a way to strip them of it!$b$bI believe the key lies with their researchers. Find out what they're up to and report back to me with the details.
english.progress: Have you determined what their researchers are up to, $r?
english.completion: This is alarming, indeed....
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 片刻不得安宁
text.objectives: 破天号上的萨萨里安希望你前往奥尔杜萨，杀死升腾者奥鲁麦斯。
text.description: 那些蠢货居然碰巧找到了可以对我们造成真正威胁的办法！$B$B这一教区的首领奥鲁麦斯在仪式中牺牲了自己，现在他的手下正在把能量导入他的灵魂中。$B$B如果让他继续这样不受干扰地吸收能量，他很快就会变成一个强大的对手。$B$B在他的大厅附近找到他的精华、徽记、节杖和长袍，将它们组合起来，然后在那里的水晶上面使用他的残骸。$B$B快一点，$r！在他变得更加强大之前消灭他！
text.progress: Well, friend? Were you successful against Alumeth?
text.completion: Alumeth has suffered a sound defeat, but I sense that his spirit still lingers...
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: No Rest For The Wicked
english.objectives: Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to defeat Alumeth the Ascended at Aldur'thar.
english.description: These fools have actually stumbled upon something that could pose a serious threat to our plans!$b$bThe leader of this particular sect, Alumeth, has ritualistically sacrificed himself and now his underlings are channeling power to his soul.$b$bIf he's allowed to rest, their efforts will soon transform him into a mighty adversary.$b$bCombine his heart, skull, scepter and robes from around their chamber and use his remains on the crystal there.$b$bHurry, $r! Destroy him before he becomes any more powerful!
english.progress: Well, friend? Were you successful against Alumeth?
english.completion: Alumeth has suffered a sound defeat, but I sense that his spirit still lingers...
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: Reborn From The Ashes
text.objectives: Gather Fordragon's Shield from the field of battle at Angrathar the Wrath Gate and return it to King Varian Wrynn at Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.
text.description: Our fate is emblazoned upon our souls at birth. Bolvar's fall, while tragic, was unavoidable.$B$BAll that you can do now is honor your hero, $n. Collect Bolvar's shield from the field of battle and return it to your king. When you present the shield to Varian, tell him this: "All is not lost. From the ashes of the fallen will rise a force that will unite nations and purge the evil from this world."$B$BHe mustn't lose faith. Go now, $n. Your people need a hero. They need you.
text.progress: <King Wrynn brushes away a tear.>$b$b<King Wrynn nods.>$b$bThis is my fault.
text.completion: The Dragon Queen is right, $n. All is not lost. I will be the force that rises from the ashes and I will purge the evil of the Horde from this world. The deaths of our brothers and sisters will not have been in vain.
text.completed: Return to King Varian Wrynn at Stormwind Keep in Stormwind.

english.title: Reborn From The Ashes
english.objectives: Gather Fordragon's Shield from the field of battle at Angrathar the Wrath Gate and return it to King Varian Wrynn at Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.
english.description: Our fate is emblazoned upon our souls at birth. Bolvar's fall, while tragic, was unavoidable.$B$BAll that you can do now is honor your hero, $n. Collect Bolvar's shield from the field of battle and return it to your king. When you present the shield to Varian, tell him this: "All is not lost. From the ashes of the fallen will rise a force that will unite nations and purge the evil from this world."$B$BHe mustn't lose faith. Go now, $n. Your people need a hero. They need you.
english.progress: <King Wrynn brushes away a tear.>$b$b<King Wrynn nods.>$b$bThis is my fault.
english.completion: The Dragon Queen is right, $n. All is not lost. I will be the force that rises from the ashes and I will purge the evil of the Horde from this world. The deaths of our brothers and sisters will not have been in vain.
english.completed: Return to King Varian Wrynn at Stormwind Keep in Stormwind.

text.title: Futility
text.objectives: Return to Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer.
text.description: Do you see now?  Sending your men against the prince's armies just swells their numbers.$B$BI don't expect you to understand... you'll probably just end up like the others.  You'd best return to whoever sent you.  They might be worried.
text.completion: There you are. Nice work down in the valley. The carnage was visible all the way up here.$b$bAre you ok? You look like you've seen a ghost.

english.title: Futility
english.objectives: Return to Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer.
english.description: Do you see now?  Sending your men against the prince's armies just swells their numbers.$B$BI don't expect you to understand... you'll probably just end up like the others.  You'd best return to whoever sent you.  They might be worried.
english.completion: There you are. Nice work down in the valley. The carnage was visible all the way up here.$b$bAre you ok? You look like you've seen a ghost.

text.title: 冰霜巨龙的摇篮
text.objectives: 奥格瑞姆之锤的库尔迪拉·织亡者要你前往辛达苟萨之墓，杀死5个巨龙复活者、8个诅咒教派腐蚀者和3个维库通灵领主。
text.description: 我们必须再接再厉，不能给天灾军团任何喘息的机会。$B$B辛达苟萨之墓坐落在失落希望之谷以东。巫妖王的维库人侍从正在密切地监督着诅咒教派在那里的工事。$B$B辛达苟萨之墓蕴含着强大的力量，很可能是蓝龙一族的集体墓地。诅咒教派利用蓝龙的骸骨，召唤可怕的霜巢之龙。$B$B我们要袭击那里，干扰他们培养冰霜巨龙的计划。你愿意接受这项任务吗，$n？
text.progress: Hail, $N.
text.completion: You've done well, $n. You might want to rest for a while. You look a little pale.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

english.title: Cradle of the Frostbrood
english.objectives: Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer wants you to slay 5 Wyrm Reanimators, 8 Cultist Corrupters and 3 Vrykul Necrolords at Sindragosa's Fall.
english.description: We need to keep our momentum going.  Let's not give the Scourge forces any respite.$B$BSindragosa's Fall lies east just beyond the Valley of Lost Hope.  The Cult of the Damned operate there, under close supervision of the Lich King's undead vrykul lackeys.$B$BIt is a place of great power, possibly a blue dragonflight graveyard.  The feared frostbrood are raised there from the bones of blue dragons.$B$BAn attack there would have great impact on the enemy's access to frost wyrms.  Are you up to it, $n?
english.progress: Hail, $N.
english.completion: You've done well, $n. You might want to rest for a while. You look a little pale.
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: 片刻不得安宁
text.objectives: 破天号上的萨萨里安希望你前往奥尔杜萨，杀死升腾者奥鲁麦斯。
text.description: 是奥鲁麦斯……他的力量又开始增强了，我能感觉到。现在他的手下正在把能量导入他的灵魂中。$B$B如果让他继续这样不受干扰地吸收能量，他很快就会变成一个强大的对手。$B$B回到奥尔杜萨的北部，在他的大厅中将他的精华、徽记、节杖和长袍组合起来，然后在那里的水晶上面使用他的残骸。$B$B快一点，$r！在他变得更加强大之前消灭他！
text.progress: Well, friend? Were you successful against Alumeth?
text.completion: Alumeth has suffered a sound defeat, but I sense that his spirit still lingers...
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: No Rest For The Wicked
english.objectives: Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to defeat Alumeth the Ascended at Aldur'thar.
english.description: It's Alumeth... He's growing in power again. I can sense it. Again his underlings are channeling power to his soul.$b$bIf he's allowed to rest, their efforts will soon transform him into a mighty adversary.$b$bReturn to his chamber in the north portion of Aldur'thar. Combine his heart, skull, scepter and robes, then use his remains on the crystal there.$b$bHurry, $r! Destroy him before he becomes any more powerful!
english.progress: Well, friend? Were you successful against Alumeth?
english.completion: Alumeth has suffered a sound defeat, but I sense that his spirit still lingers...
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 预览
text.objectives: 奥格瑞姆之锤的库尔迪拉希望你飞往荒凉之门，调查荒凉之门的南部、中部、北部和西北部。
text.description: 事情有了一些进展。我们已经想到了一个很有希望成功的战术，可以让我们获得死亡之门的控制权。巨大的人员伤亡是不可避免的，但我们应该能够取得最终的胜利——只要那些你成天嚷嚷着要去收拾掉的联盟不给我们造成什么麻烦的话。$B$B不管怎样，荒凉之门奥尔杜萨将是我们的下一个目标。飞去那里去熟悉一下地形，了解敌人的兵力部署。$B$B等你回来之后，我会交给你一些任务去办。
text.progress: Have you scouted the gate of desolation, $c?
text.completion: Well and good, $c.$b$bNow that you've seen firsthand what we're up against, it's time to get to work...
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

english.title: Sneak Preview
english.objectives: Koltira, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to fly down to the gate of desolation, visiting the south, central, north, and northwest regions of the gate.
english.description: Progress is being made. We have a promising array of tactics that should gain us control of the death gate. There will doubtlessly be many casualties, but in the end,  we should be able to prevail - barring any interference from the Alliance.$b$bOur next focus will be Aldur'thar, the gate of desolation. Fly down and become familiar with it and with the enemies posted there.$b$bWhen you return, I will have your missions prepared.
english.progress: Have you scouted the gate of desolation, $c?
english.completion: Well and good, $c.$b$bNow that you've seen firsthand what we're up against, it's time to get to work...
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: Drag and Drop
text.objectives: Koltira, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to collect Orbs of Illusion from Bitter Initiates at Aldur'thar and use them on 3 Dark Subjugators there.
text.description: The Cult of the Damned hold the gate of desolation, eh? No surprise there.$b$bTime to have a little fun. At the southern end of the gate, you mentioned there were new cultists being trained. They're almost certain to be holding a special item given to all initiates - an Orb of Illusion.$b$bThese artifacts are used to disguise a cult member, allowing them to gain safe passage, infiltrate, or simply blend in with an enemy.$b$bKill the fools until you find one, $c, then use it on a subjugator.
text.progress: Yes, $r?
text.completion: An effective tool, given the circumstances, wouldn't you say?$b$bThat one never gets old....
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

english.title: Drag and Drop
english.objectives: Koltira, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to collect Orbs of Illusion from Bitter Initiates at Aldur'thar and use them on 3 Dark Subjugators there.
english.description: The Cult of the Damned hold the gate of desolation, eh? No surprise there.$b$bTime to have a little fun. At the southern end of the gate, you mentioned there were new cultists being trained. They're almost certain to be holding a special item given to all initiates - an Orb of Illusion.$b$bThese artifacts are used to disguise a cult member, allowing them to gain safe passage, infiltrate, or simply blend in with an enemy.$b$bKill the fools until you find one, $c, then use it on a subjugator.
english.progress: Yes, $r?
english.completion: An effective tool, given the circumstances, wouldn't you say?$b$bThat one never gets old....
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: Chain of Command
text.objectives: Koltira aboard Orgrim's Hammer wants you to go to Aldur'thar and defeat Overseer Faedris, Overseer Savryn, Overseer Veraj, and Overseer Jhaeqon.
text.description: Based on your report, and my knowledge of the Cult, they have an overseer managing the operation of each encampment on the gate.$b$bWhile taking their leaders down will only be a temporary setback, it will at least slow them down and keep them off-balance. And that, $r, is a worthy enough goal for now.$b$bSeek out these overseers and return to me when they have been dispatched.
text.progress: Yes, $r?
text.completion: Well done, $r. But don't break your arm patting yourself on the back. They'll have those overseers replaced in no time...
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: Cannot Reproduce
text.objectives: Koltira aboard Orgrim's Hammer wants you to use the Partitioned Flask at each of the 3 Cultists' Cauldrons at Aldur'thar, then bring it to Chief Engineer Copperclaw.
text.description: I smell their cauldrons from here, but that's not plague they're cooking.$b$bPledges to the cult are forced to drink a concoction that steals their will and enslaves them forever to the Lich King.$b$bSome say the potion contains the twisted soul of a being who was tormented before being mercilessly slaughtered, but I've never been able to reproduce it...$b$bFill this flask with a sample from each of the three cauldrons in the northwest region of the gate and bring it to Chief Engineer Copperclaw.
text.progress: Whatdya got there, $c?
text.completion: <Copperclaw pours the contents of the flask into his particle analyzer.>$b$bAhh... I know just the thing!
text.completed: Return to Chief Engineer Copperclaw at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: 重新考验
text.objectives: 奥格瑞姆之锤的首席技师考伯克拉希望你把沸腾的魔质扔进奥尔杜萨的天灾之锅里。
text.description: 这法子应该有效！$B$B那些扭曲的诅咒教徒想要把别人的灵魂放进他们的饮料里？那么让我们来帮他们一把吧！$B$B把这东西喝下去——不用担心，我已经对它进行了稀释……现在它唯一的作用只是让在你干掉诅咒教徒时可以发现他们的精华。$B$B等你收集到一些精华之后，把那些充满扭曲灵魂怨念的沸腾魔质扔进他们的天灾之锅里。$B$B看看他们尝到自己的药剂之后会怎样！
text.completion: Wahoo!$b$bThat'll teach 'em!
text.completed: Return to Chief Engineer Copperclaw at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

english.title: Retest Now
english.objectives: Chief Engineer Copperclaw aboard Orgrim's Hammer wants you to throw a Writhing Mass into a cauldron at Aldur'thar.
english.description: This should do the trick!$b$bThose twisted hooligans are looking for souls to put in their crazy-juice? Then I say we help 'em out a bit!$b$bTake a swig of this - don't worry, I've diluted it plenty... Its only effect will be to detect any cultist's essence once you've defeated them.$b$bWhen you've collected a bunch of essences, throw the writhing mass of twisted souls into any of their cauldrons.$b$bLet's see how they like a taste of their own medicine!
english.completion: Wahoo!$b$bThat'll teach 'em!
english.completed: Return to Chief Engineer Copperclaw at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: 活动窃听器
text.objectives: 奥格瑞姆之锤的库尔迪拉希望你去收集5份黑暗物质，然后在奥尔杜萨召唤出一名黑暗信使。
text.description: 好吧，$g朋友:女士;，是时候给他们装个窃听器了。$B$B放松一点，我并不说要真的去装一个窃听器，不过大概也就是那么回事。$B$B在奥尔杜萨的北部区域，有许多诅咒教派的虚空召唤师带着恶魔爪牙游来荡去。用这根魔棒从那些被奴役的爪牙的尸体上吸取一些黑暗物质，然后使用诅咒教派的召唤水晶，召唤出我们的小间谍。$B$B除非它被发现，否则信使将一直作为我们的耳目，小心地观察敌人的行动。
text.progress: Yes, $c?
text.completion: You have done well, $c.$b$bThe messenger has already turned up some valuable information.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

english.title: Not a Bug
english.objectives: Koltira, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to collect 5 Dark Matters and summon a Dark Messenger at Aldur'thar.
english.description: Alright, $g friend:missy;, time to plant a bug.$b$bRelax, it's not a bug exactly, but it'll serve our purposes.$b$bIn the northern portion of Aldur'thar, the cult's void summoners enslave demonic minions. Use this rod to siphon the dark matter from the corpses of these enslaved minions, and then use the cultists' summoning crystal to bring our little spy into being.$b$bUntil it is discovered, the messenger will serve as our eyes and ears, discreetly observing the actions of our enemy.
english.progress: Yes, $c?
english.completion: You have done well, $c.$b$bThe messenger has already turned up some valuable information.
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: Where Dragons Fell
text.objectives: Matthias Lehner at Sindragosa's Fall wants you to obtain 6 Whelp Bone Dusts.
text.description: A whole brood of blue dragons fell here.  And now, one by one, they're being raised by his servants.$B$BHe raised the biggest of them all himself.  Bring me some bone dust from the whelps and I'll show you exactly how he did it.
text.progress: Did you get the dust, $N?
text.completion: Even the mighty wyrms had to heed his call. How is a simple mortal like you going to resist him?
text.completed: Return to Matthias Lehner at Sindragosa's Fall in Icecrown.

text.title: Time for Answers
text.objectives: Speak to Matthias Lehner at the Court of Bones.
text.description: You have a lot of questions, $n.  You're the only one who can see me because you touched something that once belonged to him... don't you remember?$B$BYou don't know what it is?  Well I can't just tell you... that would make him really mad.  He's not just a prince anymore... he's the king!$B$BMeet me at the Court of Bones, north of Icecrown Citadel and you can see for yourself.
text.completion: There you are. I started to wonder whether you'd show up.

text.title: The Hunter and the Prince
text.objectives: Matthias Lehner in the Court of Bones wants you to look for a Bloodstained Stone and complete the Prince's Destiny.
text.description: Before the prince became a king, he fought many battles... but only one where he came close to dying.$B$BIt was fought right here.  After you let me show you what happened, you'll understand everything.$B$BFind a bloodstained stone and pick it up from the floor.  You'll see what happened.
text.progress: Did you see, $N? Did you?
text.completion: After that fight, the prince realized what was holding him back was that he was still human... he could still feel... he could still bleed. He still had a heart.$b$bThe first thing he did when he became king was to rid of himself of it. He threw it down the pit where we first met. And you, $n, were the first person to touch it since.
text.completed: Return to Matthias Lehner at the Court of Bones in Icecrown.

text.title: 知识是可怕的负担
text.objectives: 向奥格瑞姆之锤的库尔迪拉复命。
text.description: 现在你该明白自己面对的是怎样的敌人了，$n。他不会感到痛苦……悔恨……他完全没有人性。他为达目的，不择手段。$B$B这颗心就是他的弱点，现在他已经知道你发现了它。$B$B如果你要回去找那颗心，最好带一些帮手去。他不会再任由它全不设防地躺在那里了。
text.completion: Little kid's ghost... Arthas's heart... you'd better slow down... you're making my head spin.

english.title: Knowledge is a Terrible Burden
english.objectives: Report back to Koltira aboard Orgrim's Hammer.
english.description: Now you know what you're up against, $n.  An opponent who no longer knows pain... remorse... or humanity.  An opponent who will do anything to get what he wants.$B$BThe heart was his weakness and now he knows you've found it.$B$BIf you're going to go back for it, you'd best bring help.  He will not leave it unguarded again.
english.completion: Little kid's ghost... Arthas's heart... you'd better slow down... you're making my head spin.

text.title: Argent Aid
text.objectives: Speak to Highlord Tirion Fordring at the Crusader's Pinnacle.
text.description: There were rumors about the events you speak of among the death knights.  I always expected the story to be more... symbolic.$B$BWe must warn others, but we must be discreet.  As soon as the Lich King knows we're making our move, he'll move the location of the heart -- we'll never get a chance like this again.$B$BThe Horde and the Alliance have been infiltrated by the Cult of the Damned before.  The Ebon Blade operates too close to the Scourge.$B$BWe have to speak to Tirion Fordring and his Argent Crusade.
text.completion: Heavy words, $n. If it were somebody else saying them, I'd be likely to judge them insane.

text.title: 提里奥的尝试
text.objectives: 北伐军之峰的提里奥·弗丁要你想办法获取一件诅咒教徒的兜帽，穿上它，然后前往冰冠堡垒西北方的黑暗大教堂入口处与他汇合。
text.description: 就在今天早上，我的斥候报告说，有一队诅咒教派的教徒带着一样东西离开冰冠堡垒，前往黑暗大教堂了。$B$B现在我明白了，那恐怕就是阿尔萨斯的心脏……里面残留着他的最后一点尚未泯灭的人性。$B$B这是圣光的启示。只要这颗心脏仍然存在，阿尔萨斯·米奈希尔就有可能变回人类！$B$B我们到大教堂的入口处汇合吧。记得带一件教徒的兜帽来，我们要乔装混进去。
text.progress: Light be with you, $N.
text.completion: I do not view what we just went through as a failure, $n... quite the opposite.$b$bBy allowing me to peer into his heart, you allowed me to confirm what I needed to know. There is no Arthas Menethil anymore -- there is only the Lich King.
text.completed: Return to Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle in Icecrown.

english.title: Tirion's Gambit
english.objectives: Tirion Fordring, at the Crusader's Pinnacle, wants you to obtain and wear a Cultist Acolyte's Hood and meet him at the entrance of the Cathedral of Darkness, northwest of Icecrown Citadel.
english.description: Just this morning, my scouts informed me of a Cult of the Damned procession leaving from Icecrown Citadel to the Cathedral of Darkness, bearing an artifact.$B$BAnd now I learn that it might be Arthas's own heart... a thing containing the last bit of his remaining humanity.$B$BThis is a sign of the Light.  As long as such an artifact exists, there is a chance that Arthas Menethil can become a man again!$B$BMeet me at the cathedral's entrance.  Be sure to bring a cultist's hood -- we're going incognito.
english.progress: Light be with you, $N.
english.completion: I do not view what we just went through as a failure, $n... quite the opposite.$b$bBy allowing me to peer into his heart, you allowed me to confirm what I needed to know. There is no Arthas Menethil anymore -- there is only the Lich King.
english.completed: Return to Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle in Icecrown.

text.title: Not a Bug
text.objectives: Koltira, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to collect 5 Dark Matters and summon a Dark Messenger at Aldur'thar.
text.description: The cultists have discovered the last messenger you summoned, $r.$b$bWhile it was quite informative, it's important that we continue to monitor the cult's every move.$b$bUse this rod to siphon the dark matter from the corpses of enslaved minions at Aldur'thar. Then use their summoning crystal to bring another dark messenger into being.$b$bUntil it is discovered, the messenger will serve as our eyes and ears, discreetly observing the actions of our enemy.
text.progress: Yes, $c?
text.completion: Well done, friend.$b$bThe messenger is up and reporting in as we speak.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: 需要更多情报
text.objectives: 奥格瑞姆之锤的库尔迪拉希望你从奥尔杜萨的诅咒教派研究员身上收集3页诅咒教派研究笔记，然后将它们组合成诅咒教派论文。
text.description: 诅咒教派一直都是以喜欢制订庞大的计划但最终鲜有成功而声明狼藉，但我这次感觉有些不一样……$B$B也许是由于接近巫妖王，提高了他们的热情。不管怎样，它们似乎比以往任何时候都更有信心了。我们必须了解是什么让他们感到自信，并想办法夺走他们的自信！$B$B我相信关键就在他们的研究员身上。去搞清楚他们正在干些什么，然后向我报告具体的细节。
text.progress: Have you discovered what their researchers are up to, $c?
text.completion: This is alarming, indeed....
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

english.title: Need More Info
english.objectives: Koltira, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to collect the 3 pages of Cultists' Research from the Cult Researchers at Aldur'thar and use them to create the Cult of the Damned Thesis.
english.description: The Cult of the Damned are notorious for concocting grandiose plans that in the end, rarely succeed. But something feels different this time....$b$bPerhaps it's the proximity to the Lich King that has their fervor heightened. Whatever it is, they appear to be more confident than ever. We must know what feeds this bravado and then find a way to strip them of it!$b$bI believe the key lies with their researchers. Find out what they're up to and report back to me with the details.
english.progress: Have you discovered what their researchers are up to, $c?
english.completion: This is alarming, indeed....
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: 片刻不得安宁
text.objectives: 奥格瑞姆之锤的库尔迪拉希望前往奥尔杜萨，杀死升腾者奥鲁麦斯。
text.description: 那些蠢货居然碰巧找到了可以对我们造成真正威胁的办法！$B$B这一教区的首领奥鲁麦斯在仪式中牺牲了自己，现在他的手下正在把能量导入他的灵魂中。$B$B如果让他继续这样不受干扰地吸收能量，他很快就会变成一个强大的对手。$B$B在他的大厅附近找到他的精华、徽记、节杖和长袍，将它们组合起来，然后在那里的水晶上面使用他的残骸。$B$B快一点，$r！在他变得更加强大之前消灭他！
text.progress: Well, $r? Were you able to stop Alumeth?
text.completion: Alumeth has suffered a sound defeat, but I sense that his spirit still lingers...
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

english.title: No Rest For The Wicked
english.objectives: Koltira, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to slay Alumeth the Ascended at Aldur'thar.
english.description: These fools have actually stumbled upon something that could pose a serious threat to our plans!$b$bThe leader of this particular sect, Alumeth, has ritualistically sacrificed himself and now his underlings are channeling power to his soul.$b$bIf he's allowed to rest, their efforts will soon transform him into a mighty adversary.$b$bCombine his heart, skull, scepter and robes from around their chamber and use his remains on the crystal there.$b$bHurry, $r! Destroy him before he becomes any more powerful!
english.progress: Well, $r? Were you able to stop Alumeth?
english.completion: Alumeth has suffered a sound defeat, but I sense that his spirit still lingers...

text.objectives: Koltira, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to slay Alumeth the Ascended at Aldur'thar.

text.title: Fate, Up Against Your Will
text.objectives: Assist Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Orgrimmar. Speak to the Warchief of the Horde, Thrall, at Orgrimmar on the continent of Kalimdor.
text.description: At the behest of Lady Proudmoore, I will allow a diplomatic mission to Orgrimmar to question the Horde's Warchief, Thrall. You will assist her in this journey and keep her safe from harm. Return to me with news from Orgrimmar.$B$BSpeak to Jaina when you are ready to leave.
text.completion: The Horde does not want war, $r. Listen well...

text.title: A Royal Coup
text.objectives: Use the portal in Grommash Hold to return to Stormwind Keep and deliver Thrall's message to King Varian Wrynn.
text.description: Your champion, Bolvar, died in defense of our world. The Horde is saddened by the loss of such a great hero, but the Horde was not responsible for the cowardly attacks made by Putress at the Wrath Gate. We have also lost mighty heroes because of this betrayal.$B$BTell your king that we will do everything in our power to bring the perpetrators of this cowardly act to justice. We will do all that we can to avoid conflict with the Alliance, but we will not hesitate to defend ourselves if provoked.
text.completion: They have lost the Undercity? Then the time to strike is now. We will deal with Putress ourselves and retake the Ruins of Lordaeron for the Alliance!

text.title: 聚焦之虹的钥匙
text.objectives: 前往龙骨荒野的龙眠神殿，将聚焦之虹的钥匙交给阿莱克丝塔萨，生命的缚誓者。
text.description: 从萨菲隆的爪中掉下了一枚眼球形状的珠宝，里面发出了魔法能量的震荡，你可以听到并感觉到这种声音。对凡人的耳朵来说，这块石头发出的声音甚至可以说是令人感到痛楚难当的。$B$B如此重要的物品显然只能交给红龙女王阿莱克丝塔萨，生命的缚誓者。前往龙骨荒野的龙眠神殿去请求她的指点吧。
text.progress: $N, you have come into contact with a key to the focusing iris! Do you have it upon your person?$B$B<The queen glances at her consort, Krasus, with eyes full of concern.>$B$BHow did you ever come into its possession? Oh, Sapphiron still had his?
text.completion: These keys are held by the most ancient members of the blue dragonflight. Only they are entrusted with them by their master, Malygos.$B$BThis is the break that we've been waiting for to strike at the Aspect of Magic!$B$B<The queen of dragons studies you for a brief moment.>$B$BYou are not able to use the key as-is to access the Focusing Iris, but I can imbue you with a portion of my power; enough to enable you to use it to open the iris a fraction.$B$BIt will be enough to draw Malygos's ire!
text.completed: Return to Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at The Dragon Wastes in Dragonblight.

english.title: The Key to the Focusing Iris
english.objectives: Deliver the Key to the Focusing Iris to Alexstrasza the Life-Binder atop Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight.
english.description: A potent thrumming of magical nature can be heard and felt emanating from the eye-shaped jewel dropped from Sapphiron's clutches. To mortal ears it is nearly painful to be in the presence of the stone.$B$BSurely such a powerful item of import can only be taken to the queen of the dragons, Alexstrasza the Life-Binder. Seek her counsel atop Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight.

text.title: Fringe Science Benefits
text.objectives: Fringe Engineer Tezzla wants you to kill 40 Bombardment Infantry, 8 Bombardment Captains and 15 Gargoyle Ambushers.
text.description: I installed our infra-green technology into commandeered bombers; it'll protect you on your first mission into enemy territory!  Speak with Rizzy Ratchwiggle to get a bomber, then fly into The Bombardment!$B$BYou'll have bombs and rockets and shields.  Keep the shields charged and use bombs on the ground Scourge at The Bombardment.  Come back after you hit your targets, and more work will await you.
text.progress: You haven't reached your target quota, $N. Are the bombers too hard to handle?
text.completion: Hah, you got them! How did you like the bomber? I hope you got the hang of it, because I have more missions for you...
text.completed: Return to Fringe Engineer Tezzla at Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate in Icecrown.

text.description: $n, only our best pilots are given a mission like this, one deep, deep into enemy territory with only the power of infra-green technology to protect you!$B$BRequest another bomber from Rizzle, and this time fly it through the Valley of Lost Hope. text.title: Total Ohmage: The Valley of Lost Hope!
text.objectives: Fringe Engineer Tezzla wants you to kill 50 Bombardment Infantry, 20 Gargoyle Ambushers, 12 Frostbrood Sentries and 12 Scourge War Machines.
text.description: $n, the struggle continues.  Lucky for us, we're stocked up on bombs and rockets!  Time for another bombing mission  --  this one's a long one, through the Bombardment and into the Valley of Lost Hope.  Head back out with an infra-green bomber and blow those Scourge into little scourge-lets!
text.progress: What are you waiting for? We have the hardware and the ordinance... we just need brave gunners like you to apply them.
text.completion: Great work, $n. While you were out, I heard other gunners talking about you... I think you have a real future in air offense!
text.completed: Return to Fringe Engineer Tezzla at Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate in Icecrown.

text.title: The Battle For The Undercity
text.objectives: Assist King Varian Wrynn and Lady Jaina Proudmoore in bringing Grand Apothecary Putress to justice! Report to King Varian Wrynn should you succeed.
text.description: Deep inside the bowels of the Undercity hides the assassin responsible for the deaths of Bolvar and our brave soldiers at the Wrath Gate.$B$BVarian has brought the full might of the Alliance with him to assist in the take down. Join him and Lady Proudmoore in the manhunt and earn your place among the greatest champions of the Alliance!$B$BSpeak to King Varian Wrynn when you are ready.
text.completion: For too long have the Horde been left unchecked. We allowed their territories to prosper and in return for our generosity they plotted and planned our demise.$b$bPeace? Useless... It's gotten us nowhere. We have lost some of our greatest heroes to "peace." Let us see what battle brings...$b$bReturn to Northrend, $n. Conquer it for your king - FOR THE ALLIANCE!
text.completed: Return to King Varian Wrynn at Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.

text.title: Green Technology
text.objectives: Speak with Fringe Engineer Tezzla.
text.description: Tezzla is the one you want to meet, yes she is... she mastered a new wavelength, infra-green, and used it to hide herself near the Scourge!  Near enough to bomb them!$B$BI'll give you infra-green vision so you can find her hiding above Aldur'thar, the Desolation Gate.  Go, go... I know she has work for brave heroes eager to blow up!  I mean... eager to blow up the Scourge!$B$BAnd $n, the Alliance has stolen our technology and has their own hidden airport nearby.  Avoid the dome with the Alliance banners!
text.completion: Yes, yes! You found me! And just in time!

text.title: Leading the Charge
text.objectives: Kibli Killohertz wants you to kill 40 Bombardment Infantry, 8 Bombardment Captains and 15 Gargoyle Ambushers.
text.description: Infra-green technology allows us to stay hidden here, right over the Scourge's nose!  What's more, we installed infra-green in specially constructed bombers... but not to hide them, no!  We use infra-green tech to shield them!$B$BSpeak with Karen No and request a bomber.  Fly it over the Bombardment... use its shields and turret to protect yourself, and use the bomb launcher to hit Scourge targets.  Practice well, then return to me and I'll have an even more vital mission for you!
text.progress: $N, the bombers are difficult to use, but you must master them if we're to win our struggles against the Scourge.
text.completion: I could hear your explosions from here, $N.  How did the shields work?  Did they keep your bomber intact?$B$BI hope they did, because now I have more missions for you....
text.completed: Return to Kibli Killohertz at Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate in Icecrown.

text.title: 永恒之眼的审判
text.objectives: 龙骨荒野龙眠神殿的克拉苏斯要你取回魔法之心。$B$B该任务必须在普通模式下的10人永恒之眼中完成。
text.description: 是时候使用聚焦之虹的钥匙了。$B$B虽然我很希望玛里苟斯能够悬崖勒马，但是目前看来这是不可能的事。局势相当严峻，其他守护巨龙一致认为应该击败织法者。$B$B<克拉苏斯的语调中带着一丝惊惶。>$B$B$n，请你进入永恒之眼，击败玛里苟斯，把魔法之心带回来。
text.progress: Only Malygos carries the Heart of Magic. It is his most prized possession.
text.completion: This is a very sad day, not only for dragonkind, but for all of the living creatures of Azeroth. We have lost one of our most thoughtful, intelligent and ancient friends. Magic is now without its guardian.$b$bLet us hope that this was a wise decision in the coming years, $n. A storm is still brewing on the horizon and now we are without one of our most powerful defenders.
text.completed: Return to Krasus at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

english.title: Judgment at the Eye of Eternity
english.objectives: Krasus atop Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight wants you to return with the Heart of Magic.$B$BThis quest is for the Normal mode, 10-person version of The Eye of Eternity.
english.description: Now that you have access to the focusing iris it's time to put that key to use.$B$BAs much as I would like to see Malygos brought back into the fold, that's just not going to happen at this point. With everything that's at stake, it is the judgment of the other Dragon Aspects that the Spell-Weaver needs to be put down.$B$B<Krasus says this last with a great deal of trepidation.>$B$B$n, travel to the Eye of Eternity, confront Malygos and return with the Heart of Magic.
english.progress: Only Malygos carries the Heart of Magic. It is his most prized possession.
english.completion: This is a very sad day, not only for dragonkind, but for all of the living creatures of Azeroth. We have lost one of our most thoughtful, intelligent and ancient friends. Magic is now without its guardian.$b$bLet us hope that this was a wise decision in the coming years, $n. A storm is still brewing on the horizon and now we are without one of our most powerful defenders.
english.completed: Return to Krasus at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

With everything that's at stake, it is the judgment of the other Dragon Aspects that the Spell-Weaver needs to be put down.$B$B<Krasus says this last with a great deal of trepidation.>$B$B$n, travel to the Eye of Eternity, confront Malygos and return with the Heart of Magic.

text.title: 缺口
text.objectives: 与冰冠堡垒下面的肯达尔上尉谈一谈。
text.description: 我有一项有趣的任务要交给你，$n。如果你喜欢挑战的话，那么眼下就有个好机会。$B$B我们得知，冰冠堡垒下面有一处入口。工程师的研究结果表明，那里属于堡垒构造上的弱点。$B$B肯达尔上尉奉命带领一队士兵，连同他们“借来”的萨隆邪铁炸弹去了入口附近。$B$B只要再得到一些帮助，我们就能把天灾军团炸上天。你觉得怎么样，$n？
text.completion: Hail, $N.  Thassarian mentioned you'd be dropping by.  Any friend of Thassarian's is my friend.  Well, any living friend of Thassarian, that is...  He does keep odd company.

english.title: Exploiting an Opening
english.objectives: Speak to Captain Kendall below Icecrown Citadel.
english.description: I've got an interesting assignment for you, $n.  If you're up for a challenge, that is.$B$BWe've been tipped off about an opening below Icecrown Citadel.  Our engineers have studied the layout and have decided it's a structural weakness.$B$BWe've sent some men there along with some "borrowed" saronite bombs.  They're under Captain Kendall's command.$B$BWith a little help we could deal a huge blow to the forces of the Scourge.  What do you say, $n?
english.completion: Hail, $N.  Thassarian mentioned you'd be dropping by.  Any friend of Thassarian's is my friend.  Well, any living friend of Thassarian, that is...  He does keep odd company.

text.title: 保护现场
text.objectives: 冰冠堡垒的肯达尔上尉要你去杀死10只笨重的恐尸。
text.description: 萨隆邪铁炸弹已经安装完毕，$n。但是我们只有一次机会，千万别搞砸了。$B$B为了确保安全爆破，我们必须夺得这片区域的临时控制权。先去削减天灾士兵的数量吧。
text.progress: For the Alliance!
text.completion: You're as good as Thassarian said.  Good job!
text.completed: Return to Captain Kendall at Icecrown Citadel in Icecrown.

english.title: Securing the Perimeter
english.objectives: Captain Kendall at Icecrown Citadel wants you to slay 10 Hulking Horrors.
english.description: The saronite bombs are in place, $n.  We're only going to get one shot at this, however.  Let's make it count.$B$BWe need temporary control of the area for a safe detonation.  Let's try to put a dent in the Scourge's numbers.
english.progress: For the Alliance!
english.completion: You're as good as Thassarian said.  Good job!
english.completed: Return to Captain Kendall at Icecrown Citadel in Icecrown.

text.title: Set it Off!
text.objectives: Captain Kendall, below Icecrown Citadel, wants you to go to the nearby Saronite Bomb Stack to light the fuse.
text.description: Things are looking good.  Let's do this.$B$BThe stack of bombs is right near the pit.  I'll start to evacuate the men.
text.completion: These bombs look pretty potent.  They should at least put a dent in the surrounding structure.

english.title: Set it Off!
english.objectives: Captain Kendall, below Icecrown Citadel, wants you to go to the nearby Saronite Bomb Stack to light the fuse.
english.description: Things are looking good.  Let's do this.$B$BThe stack of bombs is right near the pit.  I'll start to evacuate the men.
english.completion: These bombs look pretty potent.  They should at least put a dent in the surrounding structure.

text.title: A Short Fuse
text.objectives: Look for clues wherever the fall takes you.
text.description: As you light the fuse, you notice that it is consumed by fire far quicker than you would expect.$B$BThe bombs are about to go off and your best chance at surviving is to lean towards the pit and hope the fall doesn't kill you.
text.completion: This pulsing object is covered in a thick layer of ice.  It shimmers strangely beneath the water.

english.description: As you light the fuse, you notice that it is consumed by fire far quicker than you would expect.$B$BThe bombs are about to go off and your best chance at surviving is to lean towards the pit and hope the fall doesn't kill you.
english.completion: This pulsing object is covered in a thick layer of ice.  It shimmers strangely beneath the water.

text.title: A Voice in the Dark
text.objectives: Investigate the nearby voice in Naz'anak, the Forgotten Depths.
text.description: The object is not a crystal at all, but some form of organ, encased in ice.$B$BAs you touch it, your hand reels in horrible pain.  You feel as if your hand has been cut, yet there is no visible wound.$B$BAs you collect your thoughts, you hear a young boy's voice nearby.$B$B"You really shouldn't have done that."
text.completion: I saw him get rid of it, you know?  He threw it all the way down here.$B$BSaid he wouldn't need it anymore.  Said it made him weak.

english.completion: I saw him get rid of it, you know?  He threw it all the way down here.$B$BSaid he wouldn't need it anymore.  Said it made him weak.

text.title: Time to Hide
text.objectives: Matthias Lehner wants you to obtain 3 Faceless One's Blood.
text.description: You shouldn't have touched it.  But now that you did, he's going to come looking for you.$B$BAnd he'll find you.  Unless you hide yourself from him.$B$BBring me blood from the faceless ones if you want to live!
text.progress: Did you get the blood?
text.completion: What are you waiting for?  You have to rub it on you!$B$BQuick!  Or he'll see you!
text.completed: Return to Matthias Lehner at Naz'anak: The Forgotten Depths in Icecrown.

english.completion: What are you waiting for?  You have to rub it on you!$B$BQuick!  Or he'll see you!
english.completed: Return to Matthias Lehner at Naz'anak: The Forgotten Depths in Icecrown.

text.title: Return to the Surface
text.objectives: Return to Thassarian aboard the Skybreaker.
text.description: You should leave now.  You'll find a portal behind me.  It'll take you to the surface.$B$BWe'll meet again.  He'll be looking for you.$B$BIt's only a matter of time until he finds you.
text.completion: It's you, $N!  We thought you were a goner.$B$BThat explosion of yours put quite a bit of hurt on the Scourge.  Nearly took Captain's Kendall's eyebrows off in the process...

english.title: Return to the Surface
english.objectives: Return to Thassarian aboard the Skybreaker.

text.title: 战地维修
text.objectives: 破天号上的萨萨里安要你从食腐的恶鬼身上收集5块攻城车零件，然后将它们带去失落希望之谷的损毁的攻城车旁。
text.description: 好吧，现在还不到庆功的时候。你顺利地完成了引爆任务，极大地鼓舞了部队的士气，我们要一鼓作气，继续战斗。$B$B士兵们在下面的旷野中发现了一架部落的大型攻城车，似乎还可以使用。恶鬼们好像正在拆卸它的零件。$B$B如果能将它重新组装起来，我们一定能重创山谷里的天灾军团。$B$B当然，你可以要面对为数众多的敌人，但是我对你有信心！
text.progress: The demolisher has suffered much damage.
text.completion: The demolisher has seen better days, but the structure hasn't suffered any permanent damage.  The parts you obtained should be enough to get it running again, at least temporarily.
text.completed: Return to Wrecked Demolisher at The Valley of Lost Hope in Icecrown.

english.title: Field Repairs
english.objectives: Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to collect 5 Demolisher Parts from the Scavenging Geists and take them to the Wrecked Demolisher in the Valley of Lost Hope.
english.description: All right.  Let's not celebrate just yet.  We need to capitalize on the momentum we've gathered with our little bombing mission.$B$BWe've spotted a workable Horde demolisher-class catapult in the field below.  The geist seem to be taking it apart.$B$BIf you can put it back together, we'll be able to do some serious damage to the Scourge's armies in the Valley.$B$BSure, you'll be a little outnumbered, but I've a lot of faith in you!
english.progress: The demolisher has suffered much damage.
english.completion: The demolisher has seen better days, but the structure hasn't suffered any permanent damage.  The parts you obtained should be enough to get it running again, at least temporarily.
english.completed: Return to Wrecked Demolisher at The Valley of Lost Hope in Icecrown.

text.title: Do Your Worst
text.objectives: Use the Refurbished Demolisher to destroy 150 Decomposed Ghouls, 20 Frostskull Mages and 2 Bone Giants in the Valley of Lost Hope.  Speak to Matthias Lehner at the First Legion Forward Camp when you've completed this task.
text.description: You're going to use this machine against the Scourge?  You're not going to win against them like that.$B$BYou can destroy hundreds... even thousands of them.  But you won't win.  Not out here.$B$BWhen you're done playing with your machine, meet me to the north.  There is an old army encampment.  What I will show you will teach you a little bit about who you're up against.
text.progress: Are you done playing with your war machines?
text.completion: You see?  You killed your fair share, but for every one you destroyed, another rose from the dirt to take its place.$B$BYou don't know what you're up against, $N.  Let me show you.
text.completed: Return to Matthias Lehner at The Valley of Lost Hope in Icecrown.

Not out here.$B$BWhen you're done playing with your machine, meet me to the north.  There is an old army encampment.  What I will show you will teach you a little bit about who you're up against.

text.title: 召唤大军
text.objectives: 第一军团前线营地的米斯希尔萨·阿奈尔要在幻境中向你演示巫妖王如何召唤一支由101个食尸鬼奴仆组成的部队。
text.description: 你可能觉得自己已经很强大了，足以横扫这些亡灵，驾驶你的战争机器轻易地击败它们。$B$B但是创造出这些亡灵生物的力量更为强大，与之相比，你的力量不值一提。$B$B我见过那位王子本人这样做过。我可以营造一个幻境，向你演示他是怎么做到这一点的……如果你愿意领略一下的话。
text.progress: Did you see, $N?
text.completion: The prince's true power wasn't his ability to make armies out of corpses... that was easy.$B$BBut killing his own men, with whom he'd shared many battles... the prince's true power was his ability to do what had to be done.
text.completed: Return to Matthias Lehner at The Valley of Lost Hope in Icecrown.

english.title: Army of the Damned
english.objectives: Matthias Lehner at the First Legion Forward Camp wants you to raise an army of 100 Ghoulish Minions.
english.description: You probably think you're quite strong -- fighting these undead and crushing their bones beneath your war machines.$B$BThat is nothing compared to the strength it took to create them.$B$BI saw the prince do it himself.  I can show you how it happened... if you'd like.
english.progress: Did you see, $N?
english.completion: The prince's true power wasn't his ability to make armies out of corpses... that was easy.$B$BBut killing his own men, with whom he'd shared many battles... the prince's true power was his ability to do what had to be done.
english.completed: Return to Matthias Lehner at The Valley of Lost Hope in Icecrown.

text.title: Futility
text.objectives: Return to Thassarian aboard the Skybreaker.
text.description: Do you see now?  Sending your men against the prince's armies just swells their numbers.$B$BI don't expect you to understand... you'll probably just end up like the others.  You'd best return to whoever sent you.  They might be worried.
text.completion: Nice shooting, $N.  The Scourge never had a chance.$B$BAre you feeling okay?  You look like you've seen a ghost.  Not that it would be an unusual thing around these parts, now that I think about it.

english.objectives: Return to Thassarian aboard the Skybreaker.

text.title: 辛达苟萨之墓
text.objectives: 破天号上的萨萨里安要你前往辛达苟萨之墓，杀死5个巨龙复活者、8个诅咒教派腐蚀者和3个维库通灵领主。
text.description: 你真是一颗耀眼的新星，$n。你瞧，我派别的士兵去执行任务时，他们成功的几率是对半开，而他们活着回来的几率……那可就更低了。$B$B但是你每次都能顺利地完成任务，就像侏儒制造的钟表一样精确！$B$B好啦，我还有一项任务要交给你。山谷东边就是辛达苟萨之墓，最近，诅咒教徒在那里的活动愈发猖獗起来，比如搞些复活冰霜巨龙之类的勾当。我要你去狠狠地教训他们一顿。$B$B我讨厌诅咒教徒。
text.progress: $N, you're back!
text.completion: Nice job, $N.  You make the rest of us look bad!
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

english.title: Sindragosa's Fall
english.objectives: Thassarian aboard the Skybreaker wants you to slay 5 Wyrm Reanimators, 8 Cultist Corrupters and 3 Vrykul Necrolords at Sindragosa's Fall.
english.description: You're a real star, $n.  See, when I give one of these other soldiers an assignment, the odds of them getting it done are about fifty-fifty.  The odds of them coming back... well, slightly worse.$B$BBut with you, it's always a guaranteed thing.  Like gnomish clockwork!$B$BAnyway, I have another one for you.  Sindragosa's Fall, east of the valley.  There is some serious cultist activity, including and not limited to, the raising of frost wyrms.  I need you to go kick their teeth in.$B$BI hate cultists.
english.progress: $N, you're back!
english.completion: Nice job, $N.  You make the rest of us look bad!
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: Where Dragons Fell
text.objectives: Matthias Lehner at Sindragosa's Fall wants you to obtain 6 Whelp Bone Dusts.
text.description: A whole brood of blue dragons fell here.  And now, one by one, they're being raised by his servants.$B$BHe raised the biggest of them all himself.  Bring me some bone dust from the whelps and I'll show you exactly how he did it.
text.progress: Did you get the dust, $n?
text.completion: Even the mighty wyrms had to heed his call. How is a simple mortal like you going to resist him?
text.completed: Return to Matthias Lehner at Sindragosa's Fall in Icecrown.

english.objectives: Matthias Lehner at Sindragosa's Fall wants you to obtain 6 Whelp Bone Dusts.
english.description: A whole brood of blue dragons fell here.  And now, one by one, they're being raised by his servants.$B$BHe raised the biggest of them all himself.  Bring me some bone dust from the whelps and I'll show you exactly how he did it.
english.progress: Did you get the dust, $n?
english.completion: Even the mighty wyrms had to heed his call. How is a simple mortal like you going to resist him?
english.completed: Return to Matthias Lehner at Sindragosa's Fall in Icecrown.

text.title: 寻求答案
text.objectives: 前往白骨之庭，与米斯希尔萨·阿奈尔谈一谈。
text.description: 你有很多疑问，$n。你是唯一能看见我的人，因为你碰过那件曾经属于他的东西……你不记得了吗？$B$B你还不知道那是什么吗？嗯……我可不能就这么告诉你……那样会让他变得非常愤怒。他已经不再只是个王子了……他是国王！$B$B到冰冠堡垒北边的白骨之庭来找我吧，你可以自己搞明白这一切。
text.completion: There you are. I started to wonder whether you'd show up.

english.title: Time for Answers
english.objectives: Speak to Matthias Lehner at the Court of Bones.
english.description: You have a lot of questions, $n.  You're the only one who can see me because you touched something that once belonged to him... don't you remember?$B$BYou don't know what it is?  Well I can't just tell you... that would make him really mad.  He's not just a prince anymore... he's the king!$B$BMeet me at the Court of Bones, north of Icecrown Citadel and you can see for yourself.
english.completion: There you are. I started to wonder whether you'd show up.

text.title: 猎人与王子
text.objectives: 白骨之庭的米斯希尔萨·阿奈尔要你去寻找一块染血的石头，并目睹王子的命运。
text.description: 在王子成为国王之前，他经历过很多战斗……但其中只有一场战斗使他差点丢掉性命。$B$B那场战斗就发生在这里。等你看过我向你展示的场景以后，你就都明白了。$B$B从地上拣起一块染血的石头，然后你就可以看到当时的情景了。
text.progress: Did you see, $N? Did you?
text.completion: After that fight, the prince realized what was holding him back was that he was still human... he could still feel... he could still bleed. He still had a heart.$b$bThe first thing he did when he became king was to rid of himself of it. He threw it down the pit where we first met. And you, $n, were the first person to touch it since.
text.completed: Return to Matthias Lehner at the Court of Bones in Icecrown.

english.title: The Hunter and the Prince
english.objectives: Matthias Lehner in the Court of Bones wants you to look for a Bloodstained Stone and complete the Prince's Destiny.
english.description: Before the prince became a king, he fought many battles... but only one where he came close to dying.$B$BIt was fought right here.  After you let me show you what happened, you'll understand everything.$B$BFind a bloodstained stone and pick it up from the floor.  You'll see what happened.
english.progress: Did you see, $N? Did you?
english.completion: After that fight, the prince realized what was holding him back was that he was still human... he could still feel... he could still bleed. He still had a heart.$b$bThe first thing he did when he became king was to rid of himself of it. He threw it down the pit where we first met. And you, $n, were the first person to touch it since.
english.completed: Return to Matthias Lehner at the Court of Bones in Icecrown.

text.title: 知识是可怕的负担
text.objectives: 向破天号上的萨萨里安复命。
text.description: 现在你该明白自己面对的是怎样的敌人了，$n。他不会感到痛苦……悔恨……他完全没有人性。他为达目的，不择手段。$B$B这颗心就是他的弱点，现在他已经知道你发现了它。$B$B如果你要回去找那颗心，最好带一些帮手去。他不会再任由它全不设防地躺在那里了。
text.completion: Slow down, $n. Why don't you start again... from the beginning?

english.title: Knowledge is a Terrible Burden
english.objectives: Report back to Thassarian aboard the Skybreaker.
english.description: Now you know what you're up against, $n.  An opponent who no longer knows pain... remorse... or humanity.  An opponent who will do anything to get what he wants.$B$BThe heart was his weakness and now he knows you've found it.$B$BIf you're going to go back for it, you'd best bring help.  He will not leave it unguarded again.
english.completion: Slow down, $n. Why don't you start again... from the beginning?

text.title: 提里奥的帮助
text.objectives: 与北伐军之峰的大领主提里奥·弗丁谈一谈。
text.description: 阿尔萨斯和他的心脏……这个故事我已经听过不知道多少遍了……但我总以为那是编出来吓唬我们的。$B$B我们必须立即采取行动。不幸的是，只能是秘密行动。$B$B阿尔萨斯的密探无处不在，如果让他有所察觉，我们的计划就要付之东流了。$B$B我们要把这个消息告诉银色北伐军。那支部队里的每一名圣骑士都是提里奥亲自挑选的，如果说还有什么组织能够避免被诅咒教派渗透，那就只能是银色北伐军了。
text.completion: Heavy words, $n. If it were somebody else saying them, I'd be likely to judge them insane.

english.title: Tirion's Help
english.objectives: Speak to Highlord Tirion Fordring at the Crusader's Pinnacle.
english.description: It's not the first time I've heard that story about Arthas and his heart... always thought it was some made-up tale to impress the rank and file.$B$BWe must act on this information immediately.  Unfortunately, we must do so in secret.$B$BArthas's agents are everywhere and if he finds out, our plan is dead in the water.$B$BWe need to take this to the Argent Crusade.  Every single paladin in that order was hand-picked by Tirion himself.  If there's anyone free of cultist infiltration, it's those guys.
english.completion: Heavy words, $n. If it were somebody else saying them, I'd be likely to judge them insane.

text.title: 提里奥的尝试
text.objectives: 北伐军之峰的提里奥·弗丁要你想办法获取一件诅咒教徒的兜帽，穿上它，然后前往冰冠堡垒西北方的黑暗大教堂入口处与他汇合。
text.description: 就在今天早上，我的斥候报告说，有一队诅咒教派的教徒带着一样东西离开冰冠堡垒，前往黑暗大教堂了。$B$B现在我明白了，那恐怕就是阿尔萨斯的心脏……里面残留着他的最后一点尚未泯灭的人性。$B$B这是圣光的启示。只要这颗心脏仍然存在，阿尔萨斯·米奈希尔就有可能变回人类！$B$B我们到大教堂的入口处汇合吧。记得带一件教徒的兜帽来，我们要乔装混进去。
text.progress: Light be with you, $N.
text.completion: I do not view what we just went through as a failure, $n... quite the opposite.$b$bBy allowing me to peer into his heart, you allowed me to confirm what I needed to know. There is no Arthas Menethil anymore -- there is only the Lich King.
text.completed: Return to Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle in Icecrown.

english.title: Tirion's Gambit
english.objectives: Tirion Fordring, at the Crusader's Pinnacle, wants you to obtain and wear a Cultist Acolyte's Hood and meet him at the entrance of the Cathedral of Darkness, northwest of Icecrown Citadel.
english.description: Just this morning, my scouts informed me of a Cult of the Damned procession leaving from Icecrown Citadel to the Cathedral of Darkness, bearing an artifact.$B$BAnd now I learn that it might be Arthas's own heart... a thing containing the last bit of his remaining humanity.$B$BThis is a sign of the Light.  As long as such an artifact exists, there is a chance that Arthas Menethil can become a man again!$B$BMeet me at the cathedral's entrance.  Be sure to bring a cultist's hood -- we're going incognito.
english.progress: Light be with you, $N.
english.completion: I do not view what we just went through as a failure, $n... quite the opposite.$b$bBy allowing me to peer into his heart, you allowed me to confirm what I needed to know. There is no Arthas Menethil anymore -- there is only the Lich King.
english.completed: Return to Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle in Icecrown.

text.title: Static Shock Troops: the Bombardment
text.objectives: Kibli Killohertz wants you to kill 50 Bombardment Infantry, 10 Bombardment Captains and 20 Gargoyle Ambushers.
text.description: This is a short-ranged mission, over The Bombardment.  A good warm up.  Ready?
text.progress: Keep at the, $N. The air battle won't win itself!
text.completion: Welcome back, $n. A short mission, but invigorating, yes? Take a rest for now. But come back when you have fresh orders.
text.completed: Return to Kibli Killohertz at Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate in Icecrown.

english.objectives: Kibli Killohertz wants you to kill 50 Bombardment Infantry, 10 Bombardment Captains and 20 Gargoyle Ambushers.
