english.completed: Return to Kibli Killohertz at Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate in Icecrown.

text.title: 战斗的召唤：远古海滩
text.objectives: 在远古海滩战场中获得一场胜利，然后向任意联盟主城、冬拥湖、达拉然或沙塔斯城中的联盟准将复命。
text.description: 诺森德的战斗并不仅仅是对抗巫妖王的部队，我们还要与那些部落交锋。$B$B最近我们在远古海滩发现了一件强大的泰坦神器。你应该知道，我们矮人向来都是这类神器的保管者，因此我们也同样有资格获得这件新发现的神器。$B$B眼下，部落对这件神器表现出了极大的兴趣，他们很显然想要盗取神器，并用它来对付我们。联盟必须不惜一切代价阻止他们！
text.progress: What news do you bring from the front, $N?
text.completion: Excellent job, $n! With your help the Strand of the Ancients will be under complete Alliance control.
text.completed: 去找联盟准将。

english.title: Call to Arms: Strand of the Ancients
english.objectives: Win a Strand of the Ancients battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
english.description: The fight in Northrend is not only against the armies of the Lich King, but also against those of the Horde.$B$BA powerful titan relic has been found in the Strand of the Ancients.  As you might know, we dwarves have been custodians of such artifacts for years and as such we're their rightful keepers.$B$BIn this case, the Horde has developed a keen interest in pilfering the relic from the titan ruins.  They're certain to use it as a weapon against us; we must do whatever we can to stop them.
english.progress: What news do you bring from the front, $N?
english.completion: Excellent job, $n! With your help the Strand of the Ancients will be under complete Alliance control.
english.end: Victory in Strand of the Ancients
english.completed: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

text.title: Riding the Wavelength: The Bombardment
text.objectives: Fringe Engineer Tezzla wants you to kill 50 Bombardment Infantry, 10 Bombardment Captains and 20 Gargoyle Ambushers.
text.description: Ready to warm up with a short bombing mission?  You have your orders, and we have our bombers stocked and ready.
text.progress: You haven't reached your target quota, $N. Get out there and blow stuff up!
text.completion: Hah, you got them! I could hear their scourge parts clatter off the mountain walls. Good work. We'll have more for you soon...
text.completed: Return to Fringe Engineer Tezzla at Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate in Icecrown.

english.title: Riding the Wavelength: The Bombardment
english.objectives: Fringe Engineer Tezzla wants you to kill 50 Bombardment Infantry, 10 Bombardment Captains and 20 Gargoyle Ambushers.

text.title: 战斗的召唤：远古海滩
text.objectives: 在远古海滩战场中获得一场胜利，然后向任意部落主城、冬拥湖、达拉然或沙塔斯城中的部落战争使者复命。
text.description: 虽然说我们开进诺森德是为了扫平天灾军团，但这并不代表我们应该对联盟不闻不问。$B$B探险者协会的矮人已经发现了一件强大的泰坦圣物的所在地，如果让联盟拿到它的话，我们就没好日子过了。$B$B去吧，$n，消灭我们的敌人。让他们明白，无论在哪里相遇，他们永远都是我们不共戴天的死敌。
text.progress: You're back! Were you victorious, $n?
text.completion: You bring great honor to us, $n! The Alliance weaklings must be crushed under the heel of the mighty Horde!
text.completed: 去找部落战争使者。

english.title: Call to Arms: Strand of the Ancients
english.objectives: Win a Strand of the Ancients battleground match and return to a Horde Warbringer at any Horde capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
english.description: Just because we march into Northrend to smash the Scourge, doesn't mean we get to take a break from crushing the Alliance.$B$BThose Explorers' League dwarves have found the location of a powerful titan relic and we'll be damned if we let the Alliance take control of it.$B$BGo, $n, and destroy our enemies.  Make them see that no matter where we meet, they remain our sworn enemies.
english.progress: You're back! Were you victorious, $n?
english.completion: You bring great honor to us, $n! The Alliance weaklings must be crushed under the heel of the mighty Horde!
english.end: Victory in Strand of the Ancients
english.completed: Return to Horde Warbringer.

text.title: 地狱火半岛的工事
text.objectives: 占领瞭望台、竞赛场和碎石岭，然后向地狱火半岛上荣耀堡内的委任官翠希·普罗维尔复命。
text.description: 地狱火堡垒与我们的军队一直有着小规模的冲突与交战。目前，我们自己的领地大多守备稳固，但一直没能对他们发动真正的进攻。为了筹备进攻，我们要首先占领地狱火堡垒外围的战略要地。$B$B我们的斥候目前确定了三处互成犄角之势的工事，希望你能协助这三处的防守。占领所有工事之后回来向我报告。$B$B愿你能在接下来的战斗中有好运气，$n，毫无疑问，你得面对部落的威胁，他们也同样想占领这三处重要的工事。
text.progress: $N, return to me when you have aided in the capture of each of the forts!
text.completion: Well done, $N.  Your actions in the field are instrumental in our battle for Hellfire Peninsula.
text.completed: Return to Warrant Officer Tracy Proudwell at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Hellfire Fortifications
english.objectives: Capture the Overlook, the Stadium and Broken Hill, then return to Warrant Officer Tracy Proudwell in Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.
english.description: The Hellfire Citadel wages constant battles with our forces.  We are holding our own so far, but we can't yet launch a real offensive against them.  To do that, we need forward staging areas.$B$BOur scouts identified three fortifications near Hellfire Citadel.  We want you to help secure these forts.  Capture each fort, and then report back to me.$B$BMay fortune shine upon you in the conflicts ahead, $n, for you will no doubt clash with Horde forces eager to gain these same fortifications.
english.progress: $N, return to me when you have aided in the capture of each of the forts!
english.completion: Well done, $N.  Your actions in the field are instrumental in our battle for Hellfire Peninsula.
english.completed: Return to Warrant Officer Tracy Proudwell at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 地狱火半岛的工事
text.objectives: 占领瞭望台、竞赛场和碎石岭，然后向地狱火半岛上萨尔玛的传令官布莱肯·黑眼复命。
text.description: 在我们的故乡肆虐的所有地狱火堡垒邪兽人都必须要消灭干净！但要想攻击地狱火堡垒，我们必须首先占领堡垒外围的几处战略要地。$B$B巡逻队发现有三处工事正好适合我们的目的。但联盟竟与我们不谋而合，现在已经派出部队占领了那里！$B$B我要求你立刻阻止联盟的行动，并占领这些工事。协助我军占领工事之后，立刻回来向我报告。$B$B为了部落！
text.progress: Return to me after you have helped capture each fort!
text.completion: Nice work, $n. I could almost hear the battles waged at those forts. I wish I was there to see them!
text.completed: Return to Battlecryer Blackeye at Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Hellfire Fortifications
english.objectives: Capture the Overlook, the Stadium and Broken Hill, then return to Battlecryer Blackeye in Thrallmar.
english.description: The fel orcs of Hellfire Citadel must be scoured from our birthland!  To attack them, we must first secure forward staging points near the Citadel.$B$BOur outrunners found three fortifications that will suit this purpose, but the Alliance has the same idea and even now sends forces to take them!$B$BWe want you to stop the Alliance and capture these forts.  Aid in the capture of each fort and then return to me.$B$BFor the Horde!
english.progress: Return to me after you have helped capture each fort!
english.completion: Nice work, $n. I could almost hear the battles waged at those forts. I wish I was there to see them!
english.completed: Return to Battlecryer Blackeye at Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 科拉丝塔萨
text.objectives: 图书馆员塞尔拉要你去跟考达拉的科拉斯塔萨谈一谈。
text.description: 你好，$c。能请你帮个忙吗？$b$b红龙莱洛拉斯负责驻守这座岗哨，他有个妹妹叫作科拉丝塔萨。科拉丝塔萨不顾莱洛拉斯的反对，到魔枢上层侦察蓝龙的活动去了。$b$b他虽然嘴上不说，但是心里还是很牵挂自己的妹妹。如果能得到科拉丝塔萨的消息，他肯定会很高兴的。$b$b请你去找到她，叫她放下自尊，给她的兄弟捎个消息回来。
text.completion: It's quite presumptuous of you to interfere in the personal affairs of a dragon, don't you think, $r?$b$bThat aside, it would be wrong of me not to let my brother know that I am well. You may tell your meddling friend that I will keep my brother abreast of my actions.

english.title: Corastrasza
english.objectives: Librarian Serrah wants you to speak to Corastrasza in Coldarra.
english.description: Greetings, $c. Might I impose on you for a favor?$b$bCorastrasza is the sister of Raelorasz - the red dragon in charge of our outpost here. Against his will, she has ascended to one of the upper rings of the Nexus to observe some frighteningly powerful blue drakes.$b$bThough he will never say it, he worries about her, and would welcome any news of her well-being.$b$bPlease seek her out. Ask her to put her pride aside and send word to her brother.
english.completion: It's quite presumptuous of you to interfere in the personal affairs of a dragon, don't you think, $r?$b$bThat aside, it would be wrong of me not to let my brother know that I am well. You may tell your meddling friend that I will keep my brother abreast of my actions.

text.title: 展翅高飞！
text.objectives: 考达拉魔枢上层的科拉丝塔萨要你骑着她的幼龙杀死5名鳞誓精英。
text.description: 凡人，你居然有勇气靠近玛里苟斯的巢穴？还是说你只是因为无知才闯进这里的？答案很快就可以揭晓了……$b$b我是一名经验丰富的训练师，专门为红龙军团训练优雅的幼龙。我来这里研究敌人的作战手段，并向我珍爱的宠物们传授有效的御敌手段，以便将来能对付蓝龙军团的主子。$b$b为了让你有机会证明自己的勇气和实力，我可以让你骑着我的幼龙去对付敌人的爪牙。$b$b只要你开口，就可以得到这个宝贵的机会……
text.progress: Well, mortal, what do you think of my pets?
text.completion: My drake tells me that with practice, you might become a capable combatant.$b$bVery well, then. In the interest of our war on Malygos, I shall allow you to practice with my pets at your leisure.$b$bMake ready, $r, for he is a fierce and unforgiving opponent.
text.completed: Return to Corastrasza at the Nexus in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Aces High!
english.objectives: Corastrasza on the upper ring of the Nexus in Coldarra wants you to ride her drake and kill 5 Scalesworn Elites.
english.description: You possess the courage to draw so near to Malygos' lair, mortal? Or is it simply ignorance? Soon we shall know....$b$bI am a seasoned trainer of the graceful drakes of the red dragonflight. My business here is to study the enemy and teach my precious pets the tactics that will be most effective when we face the master of the blues.$b$bTo demonstrate your nerve and ability, I will allow you to ride one of my drakes against the enemy's minions.$b$bThe opportunity is yours for the asking...
english.progress: Well, mortal, what do you think of my pets?
english.completion: My drake tells me that with practice, you might become a capable combatant.$b$bVery well, then. In the interest of our war on Malygos, I shall allow you to practice with my pets at your leisure.$b$bMake ready, $r, for he is a fierce and unforgiving opponent.
english.completed: Return to Corastrasza at the Nexus in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 展翅高飞！
text.objectives: 考达拉魔枢上层的科拉丝塔萨要你骑着她的幼龙杀死5名鳞誓精英。
text.description: 我们又见面了，$r。我要承认，我对你越来越感兴趣了。$b$b如果我没猜错的话，你是来练习空战技巧的吧？$b$b像平时一样，我的宠物已经做好准备，随时可以去消灭敌人。$b$b只要你开口，就可以随意调遣它们。
text.progress: Yes, $r?
text.completion: I noticed some improvement today, $c. At moments, it was as if you were one with the drake.$b$bYou are welcome to practice with my precious pets at your leisure.
text.completed: Return to Corastrasza at the Nexus in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Aces High!
english.objectives: Corastrasza on the upper ring of the Nexus in Coldarra wants you to ride her drake and kill 5 Scalesworn Elites.
english.description: Again we meet, $r. I confess, your presence is beginning to grow on me.$b$bAm I correct in assuming that you've come to hone your aerial combat skills?$b$bAs always, my pets stand ready to bring fiery destruction to the enemy.$b$bSpeak, and they shall be at your disposal.
english.progress: Yes, $r?
english.completion: I noticed some improvement today, $c. At moments, it was as if you were one with the drake.$b$bYou are welcome to practice with my precious pets at your leisure.
english.completed: Return to Corastrasza at the Nexus in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 图书馆的控制台
text.objectives: 拿着创世者的圆盘，前往创世者的图书馆内的控制台。
text.description: $n，诺甘农之壳近在咫尺，唾手可得。拿上创世者的圆盘前往图书馆的内部，你应该可以在那里找到一个用来激活圆盘的控制台。我想米米尔储存在那里的东西远比诺甘农之壳更多，甚至可能包括能让铁炉堡的工程师们忙上许多年的结构图！$B$B不管怎样，用圆盘来恢复诺甘农之壳。希望米米尔没有给我们设置什么棘手的障碍。
text.progress: The console appears to have an opening for the inventor's disk.
text.completion: <You insert the disk into the console. Suddenly, lights on its surface illuminate and a mechanical voice speaks.>$b$bInventor's disk authenticated. Welcome back, Keeper Mimir.
text.completed: Return to Inventor's Library Console at The Foot Steppes in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: The Library Console
english.objectives: Take the Inventor's Disk to the Inventor's Library Console inside the Inventor's Library.
english.description: Norgannon's shell is within our reach, $n. Take the inventor's disk into the library's interior. There should be a console there that you can activate with the disk. I imagine Mimir stored more there than just Norgannon's shell. There are probably enough schematics stored there to keep Ironforge's engineers occupied for years!$B$BAnyway, use the disk to recover the shell. Hopefully, Mimir hasn't decided to put any more obstacles in our way.
english.progress: The console appears to have an opening for the inventor's disk.
english.completion: <You insert the disk into the console. Suddenly, lights on its surface illuminate and a mechanical voice speaks.>$b$bInventor's disk authenticated. Welcome back, Keeper Mimir.
english.completed: Return to Inventor's Library Console at The Foot Steppes in The Storm Peaks.

enders.name: 创世者的图书馆控制台

text.title: The Brothers Bronzebeard
text.objectives: Accompany Brann Bronzebeard and his flying machine to Frosthold.
text.description: That does it! We finally have the keystone... It's beautiful! I've been around the world more than once, but this thing's got me all jittery with excitement again. I suppose now's not the time to stop and admire though, we need to get the heck out of here.$B$BHop on my flying machine and help keep us covered from those iron dwarves on the way out!
text.progress: King Stormheart sends his most sincere thanks for reuniting him with his brothers. It seems he's off to settle a score now - perhaps you'll meet with him again on Arthas's doorstep.
text.completed: Return to Velog Icebellow at Frosthold in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 作战准备
text.objectives: 与军官范恩·罗希姆对话，前往冰冠冰川的破天号。抵达之后，向高级指挥官加斯汀·巴雷特报到。
text.description: 喂！$B$B你看起来是个聪明人。冰冠冰川战事吃紧，我们就需要你这样有能力的人。$B$B你或许已经听说了一些传言，说是我们进攻冰冠冰川的行动已告失败，但你可别信以为真。现在，我们正在艾泽拉斯史上最先进的工程学奇迹——破天号上对冰冠冰川发起进攻。部落毫无机会，阿尔萨斯也一样。$B$B如果你准备好了，就告诉我一声。
text.completion: Welcome to the Skybreaker.$B$BFrom here we are laying our groundwork for the assault on Arthas. There's a lot of work to be done, but before we can get into the real meat of it, we want to make sure that the Argent Crusade is adequately reinforced - we're going to need their help later.$B$BIf you have not already, speak to Absalan the Pious on the main deck.

english.title: Preparations for War
english.objectives: Speak to Officer Van Rossem to secure passage to the Skybreaker in Icecrown, and then report to High Captain Justin Bartlett.
english.description: You there!$B$BYou look like you have some wits about you. We could use some more able bodies in Icecrown.$B$BYou may have heard rumors of our failure in assaulting the glacier from the ground, but let me set those concerns to rest. We're now mounting our assault from one of the most advanced pieces of engineering known to Azeroth, the Skybreaker. The Horde don't stand a chance, and neither does Arthas.$B$BSpeak to me when you're ready to depart.
english.completion: Welcome to the Skybreaker.$B$BFrom here we are laying our groundwork for the assault on Arthas. There's a lot of work to be done, but before we can get into the real meat of it, we want to make sure that the Argent Crusade is adequately reinforced - we're going to need their help later.$B$BIf you have not already, speak to Absalan the Pious on the main deck.

enders.name: 高级指挥官加斯汀·巴雷特

text.title: 作战准备
text.objectives: 与掠天者科鲁姆对话，前往冰冠冰川的奥格瑞姆之锤。抵达之后，向掠天者考尔姆·黑痕报到。
text.description: 喂！$B$B你看起来是个聪明人。冰冠冰川战事吃紧，我们就需要你这样有能力的人。$B$B联盟的混蛋抢先进入了冰冠冰川，但他们没有做好准备，所以被打得丢盔弃甲，真是活该。而我们从容不迫，准备周全。很快，我们就将在艾泽拉斯史上最先进的工程学奇迹——奥格瑞姆之锤上发起真正的进攻。联盟毫无机会，阿尔萨斯也一样。$B$B如果你准备好了，就告诉我一声。
text.completion: Welcome to Orgrim's Hammer.$B$BFrom here we are laying our groundwork for the assault on Arthas. There's a lot of preparation to be done, but before we can get into the real meat of it, we want to make sure that the Argent Crusade is adequately reinforced - we're going to need their help later.$B$BIf you have not already, speak to Brother Keltan on the main deck.

english.title: Preparations for War
english.objectives: Speak to Sky-Reaver Klum to secure passage to Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown, and then report to Sky-Reaver Korm Blackscar.
english.description: You there!$B$BYou look like you have some wits about you. We could use some more able bodies in Icecrown.$B$BThe Alliance scum rushed into Icecrown ahead of us, unprepared, and got just what they deserved for their impatience. We took our time, we made ready, and soon we will mount a true assault from one of the most advanced pieces of engineering known to Azeroth - Orgrim's Hammer. The Alliance don't stand a chance, and neither does Arthas.$B$BSpeak to me when you're ready to depart and lend a hand.
english.completion: Welcome to Orgrim's Hammer.$B$BFrom here we are laying our groundwork for the assault on Arthas. There's a lot of preparation to be done, but before we can get into the real meat of it, we want to make sure that the Argent Crusade is adequately reinforced - we're going to need their help later.$B$BIf you have not already, speak to Brother Keltan on the main deck.

text.title: 永冻之冰
text.objectives: 返回丹尼芬雷，向卡尔德询问关于永冻之冰的事。
text.description: 这块冰已经在巨大的压力下剥离，暴露在来自地底深处的自然魔法中。这两种力量结合在一起，已经损伤了这块永不融化的坚冰。$b$b你对这种东西一无所知，但是你决定带一块样品到丹尼芬雷去，那里肯定有人熟悉它的特性。
text.completion: <The reflection of the everfrost sparkles in Calder's eye as he holds it aloft.>$b$bAhh, everfrost. The symbol of the heart of our people...$b$bEverfrost was once plentiful in this region. Over the ages, though, the jormungar have devoured nearly all of it. It is now very rare and very precious to my people.$b$bAs you roam these lands, keep a lookout for more pieces of everfrost. Return to me with any that you find and we will be most grateful.

english.title: Everfrost
english.objectives: You are to return to Dun Niffelem and ask Calder about the piece of Everfrost.
english.description: This piece of ice has been submitted to immense pressures and exposed to natural magics from deep beneath the world's surface. In combination, these effects have yielded an ice that will never melt.$b$bKnowing little of these things, you resolve to bring the sample back to Dun Niffelem. Someone there is bound to be familiar with its properties.
english.completion: <The reflection of the everfrost sparkles in Calder's eye as he holds it aloft.>$b$bAhh, everfrost. text.progress: Have you discovered any more everfrost, little $r?

It is now very rare and very precious to my people.$b$bAs you roam these lands, keep a lookout for more pieces of everfrost. Return to me with any that you find and we will be most grateful.

text.title: 维持纪律
text.objectives: 布伦希尔达村的仲裁者格蕾塔要你进入荒弃矿洞，对6名筋疲力尽的维库人使用训诫之杖。
text.description: 你完成了别人做不到的壮举。但是你不能满足于眼前的荣耀。$B$B一定要向别人展示力量与责任的真谛。$B$B荒弃矿洞里那些不听话的苦工又该受到教训了。让他们明白……不听话的下场。
text.progress: Hail, $gbrother:sister;.
text.completion: You continue to lead by example.  We look up to you, sister.
text.completed: Return to Gretta the Arbiter at Brunnhildar Village in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: Maintaining Discipline
english.objectives: Gretta the Arbiter in Brunnhildar Village wants you to use the Disciplining Rod on 6 Exhausted Vrykul inside the Forlorn Mine.
english.description: You've succeeded where others have failed.  Yet you cannot rest on your laurels.$B$BYou must show others what strength and commitment really mean.$B$BThe male insubordinates inside the Forlorn Mine need to be disciplined once again.  Show them sister... show them what it means to disobey us.
english.progress: Hail, $gbrother:sister;.
english.completion: You continue to lead by example.  We look up to you, sister.
english.completed: Return to Gretta the Arbiter at Brunnhildar Village in The Storm Peaks.

objectiveDetails.description: 教训筋疲力尽的维库人

text.title: 卫冕战
text.objectives: 布伦希尔达村的仲裁者格蕾塔要你击败6个获胜的挑战者。
text.description: 你的表现令大家印象深刻，好姐妹。但是不要放松警惕——那些狂妄的挑战者随时都想要摘取你这海德比武会冠军的头衔。$B$B让这些井底之蛙见识一下你的实力吧。
text.completion: You continue to prove yourself worthy. We are honored by your presence.

english.title: Defending Your Title
english.objectives: Gretta the Arbiter in Brunnhildar Village wants you to defeat 6 Victorious Challengers.
english.description: Everyone's impressed by your performance, sister.  But do not let your guard down -- every new challenger with delusions of grandeur is going to come out swinging for your title of Hyldskvinnar.$B$BShow these upstarts what you're made of.
english.completion: You continue to prove yourself worthy. We are honored by your presence.

text.title: Back to the Pit
text.objectives: Gretta the Arbiter, in Brunnhildar Village, wants you to use the Reins of the Icemaw Matriarch inside the Pit of the Fang and defeat 6 Hyldsmeet Warbears.
text.description: To truly stay in your best riding shape you'll want to test yourself against the other Hyldnir every day.$B$BHead back into the Pit of the Fang and show them what you're capable of.  They'll appreciate suffering defeat to one as skilled as yourself.
text.completion: You continue to demonstrate your prowess.  Your sisters have not lost their respect for you.

english.title: Back to the Pit
english.objectives: Gretta the Arbiter, in Brunnhildar Village, wants you to use the Reins of the Icemaw Matriarch inside the Pit of the Fang and defeat 6 Hyldsmeet Warbears.
english.description: To truly stay in your best riding shape you'll want to test yourself against the other Hyldnir every day.$B$BHead back into the Pit of the Fang and show them what you're capable of.  They'll appreciate suffering defeat to one as skilled as yourself.
english.completion: You continue to demonstrate your prowess.  Your sisters have not lost their respect for you.

text.title: 消灭那些怪胎！
text.objectives: 布伦希尔达村的仲裁者格蕾塔要你前往瓦基里安，从瓦基里安候选者身上夺取冰霜油膏，并用冰霜油膏摧毁30枚瘟疫始祖龙卵。
text.description: 向你的同胞展示力量还不够。你还去要和我们的敌人作战，好姐妹。$B$B瓦基里安叛徒仍然在培养瘟疫始祖幼龙，侮辱我们高贵的骑龙传统。$B$B请你去夺取她们身上的冰霜油膏，并用它冰冻那些讨厌的瘟疫龙蛋。
text.progress: Did you destroy the blighted eggs?
text.completion: A leader in more ways than one.  We thank you, sister.
text.completed: Return to Gretta the Arbiter at Brunnhildar Village in The Storm Peaks.

english.title: The Aberrations Must Die
english.objectives: Gretta the Arbiter in Brunnhildar Village wants you to go to Valkyrion and obtain Vials of Frost Oil from the Valkyrion Aspirants.  Use the Vials of Frost Oil to destroy 30 Plagued Proto-Drake Eggs.
english.description: It is not enough to demonstrate your prowess among your peers.  You must also fight our enemies, dear sister.$B$BThe Valkyrion traitors continue to mock our noble drake-riding traditions by rearing plagued proto-drakes.$B$BSeize the frost oil they wield and use it to freeze their abominable plagued eggs.
english.progress: Did you destroy the blighted eggs?
english.completion: A leader in more ways than one.  We thank you, sister.
english.completed: Return to Gretta the Arbiter at Brunnhildar Village in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 见证者夏拉托尔
text.objectives: 与唐卡洛营地的夏拉托尔谈一谈。
text.description: 看来我们不是这个地区唯一的访客。一个名叫夏拉托尔的牛头人托信使捎来了一封信，说他正在拜访一处被称为唐卡洛营地的牦牛人村庄。信里有些东西写得含糊其辞，不过这个夏拉托尔应该是专程来风暴峭壁了解牦牛人传说的。$B$B$n，去和他碰面吧，看看他能否向我们提供一些帮助。根据他的描述，唐卡洛营地就在这里的东边，越过造物者圣台，在丹尼芬雷的北面。
text.completion: So Boktar received my note? That's excellent news. I doubted the taunka longrunner who carried it would reach anyone.

english.title: Xarantaur, the Witness
english.objectives: Speak with Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.
english.description: It seems we're not the only visitors to this area. A courier relayed a message from a tauren named Xarantaur, who said he was visiting a taunka village called Camp Tunka'lo. The note was somewhat cryptic, but it seems this Xarantaur has come to Storm Peaks to learn the history of a taunka legend.$B$BMeet up with him, $n. See if what he knows can help us in any way. From his description, Camp Tunka'lo is far to the east, beyond the Terrace of the Makers and north of Dun Niffelem.
english.completion: So Boktar received my note? That's excellent news. I doubted the taunka longrunner who carried it would reach anyone.

text.title: Call to Arms: Alterac Valley
text.objectives: Win an Alterac Valley battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran or Shattrath.
text.description: The reality of fighting on multiple fronts, $g lad : lass;, is that we cannot spread our forces too thin or we risk losing it all!$B$BCritical troop deployments are necessary on a day by day basis.  Today it is the battle for Alterac Valley that's in most need of brave combatants.$B$BGo now, $n, and aid the Stormpike Expedition.  We cannot allow the Frostwolf Clan to get away with the violence they've inflicted on our brethren!
text.progress: Tell me, $N. What news do you bring from the front?
text.completion: Just what I wanted to hear! A victory in Alterac Valley - even a temporary one - is crucial to our overall strategy against the Horde.
text.completed: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

english.completed: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

text.title: 战斗的召唤：奥特兰克山谷
text.objectives: 在奥特兰克山谷战场中获得一场胜利，然后向任意部落主城、达拉然、冬拥湖或沙塔斯城中的部落战争使者复命。
text.description: 我们就快要把雷矛入侵者从奥特兰克山谷赶走了，因此我们必须调动一切可能的增援力量来帮助霜狼氏族。$B$B一场决定性的胜利可以让我们腾出足够的资源在其它战场上消灭联盟的那些混蛋。$B$B出发吧，$n。听从霜狼氏族的号令，去赢得无上的荣耀吧！
text.progress: You're back! Do you bring news of victory?
text.completion: There is no greater honor than driving invaders from Horde territories. We salute your great courage in aiding our forces today!
text.completed: 去找部落战争使者。

english.title: Call to Arms: Alterac Valley
english.objectives: Win an Alterac Valley battleground match and return to a Horde Warbringer at any Horde capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran or Shattrath.
english.description: We've recently come extremely close to driving the Stormpike invaders from Alterac Valley.  As a result we're redirecting all our reinforcements to aid the Frostwolf Clan.$B$BA decisive victory there would free up the resources we need to crush the Alliance scum on all the other battlefronts.$B$BGo, $n.  Earn great honor by heeding the call of the brave Frostwolf warriors.
english.progress: You're back! Do you bring news of victory?
english.completion: There is no greater honor than driving invaders from Horde territories. We salute your great courage in aiding our forces today!
english.completed: Return to Horde Warbringer.

text.title: 帮助阿卡玛
text.objectives: 在克希利的军队发动佯攻之后，保护阿卡玛和玛维进入影月谷内的黑暗神殿。
text.description: <克希利身上发出阵阵淡泊的光芒，而他身边的奥尔多和占星者军队也回应着他的命令。克希利的军团已经完全准备好了，随时可以将伊利丹的军队压制住，并为阿卡玛吸引敌人的注意力。现在，这位纳鲁正等待着你给出进攻开始的信号。>
text.completion: <Xi'ri pulses with energy as you feel an object materialize in your hands. It is the medallion you gave to A'dal on Akama's behalf, its power augmented by the naaru's magic. The Sha'tar have entrusted you with the Medallion of Karabor, and with it access to the Black Temple.>
text.end: 帮助阿卡玛和玛维进入黑暗神殿。
text.completed: 去找影月谷的克希利。

english.title: A Distraction for Akama
english.objectives: Ensure that Akama and Maiev enter the Black Temple in Shadowmoon Valley after Xi'ri's forces create a distraction.
english.description: <Xi'ri pulses with lights as the Aldor and Scryer forces around him respond to his orders.  Xi'ri's army is ready to push Illidan's forces back and create a distraction for Akama.  The naaru awaits your request to begin the attack.>
english.completion: <Xi'ri pulses with energy as you feel an object materialize in your hands. It is the medallion you gave to A'dal on Akama's behalf, its power augmented by the naaru's magic. The Sha'tar have entrusted you with the Medallion of Karabor, and with it access to the Black Temple.>
english.end: Help Akama and Maiev enter the Black Temple.
english.completed: Return to Xi'ri at Ruins of Baa'ri in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 纳鲁的试炼：玛瑟里顿
text.objectives: 沙塔斯城的阿达尔要求你杀死玛瑟里顿。
text.description: 想要证明你自己拥有获得风暴钥匙的资格，你必须首先完成四个试炼。$B$B现在，你只需要跨越最后一个障碍了，凡人。聚集一支军队，前往地狱火堡垒深处，在玛瑟里顿的巢穴中杀出一条血路，进入中央的密室，杀死那个邪恶的腐蚀者！
text.completion: You have proven yourself as a being of great power. The naaru approve...
text.completed: Return to A'dal at Lower City in Shattrath City.

english.title: Trial of the Naaru: Magtheridon
english.objectives: A'dal in Shattrath City wants you to slay Magtheridon.
english.description: Four trials you must pass before you are deemed worthy by the naaru.$B$BOnly one obstacle remains, mortal. Gather an army and travel to the lair of Magtheridon, deep inside Hellfire Citadel. Battle your way to the heart of the chamber and destroy the foul corrupter!
english.completion: You have proven yourself as a being of great power. The naaru approve...
english.completed: Return to A'dal at Lower City in Shattrath City.

text.title: 卡达什圣杖
text.objectives: 将土灵徽记和灿烂徽记交给盘牙水库奴隶围栏的异教徒斯卡希斯。
text.description: 将制作圣杖所需的元素徽记给我带回来！$B$B土灵徽记在屠龙者格鲁尔手中，他就躲在刀锋山的巢穴里。$B$B另一枚徽记是夜之魇的心脏，据说这只神秘的野兽居住在先知麦迪文的高塔内。$B$B迅速行动吧！
text.progress: With the cudgel reformed, I shall break free of my bonds and return to Serpentshrine to exact vengeance on Vashj and her minions!
text.completion: At last!$b$bWith these bonds broken and the cudgel in my possession I shall send the sea witch back to the icy depths...
text.completed: Return to Skar'this the Heretic at The Headland in Alterac Mountains.

english.title: The Cudgel of Kar'desh
english.objectives: Skar'this the Heretic in the heroic Slave Pens of Coilfang Reservoir wants you to bring him the Earthen Signet and the Blazing Signet.
english.description: Bring me the elemental signets that the cudgel requires!$B$BThe earthen signet is held by Gruul the Dragonkiller. Gruul can be found inside his lair in the Blade's Edge Mountains.$B$BThe second signet is the blazing heart of a creature known as Nightbane. This mythical beast is said to reside in the hallowed halls of the prophet, Medivh.$B$BMake haste!
english.progress: With the cudgel reformed, I shall break free of my bonds and return to Serpentshrine to exact vengeance on Vashj and her minions!
english.completion: At last!$b$bWith these bonds broken and the cudgel in my possession I shall send the sea witch back to the icy depths...
english.completed: Return to Skar'this the Heretic at The Headland in Alterac Mountains.

text.title: 永恒水瓶
text.objectives: 时光之穴的索莉多米要你从盘牙水库的瓦丝琪那里取回瓦丝琪的水瓶残余，并从风暴要塞的凯尔萨斯·逐日者那里取回凯尔萨斯的水瓶残余。
text.description: 伊利丹从永恒之井中取出了七瓶水。他将其中三瓶倒入海加尔山颠的湖泊中，由此形成了第二口永恒之井。岁月流逝，剩下的四瓶水已不知去向。$B$B黑暗之门开启后，我们得知伊利丹将两瓶水交给了他的副官凯尔萨斯和瓦丝琪。取回残余的永恒之水，我们可以利用它打开通往近代或是远古时期的海加尔山的时光通道。我们必须维持海加尔圣战的事件不被改变。
text.progress: I've asked the impossible of you, yet I expect you to succeed. Much depends on it.
text.completion: The power contained even in this small amount of water from the Well of Eternity is incredible.$b$bI can see clearly into every moment in time linked to Hyjal... the creation of the second Well of Eternity, Illidan's imprisonment, the enchantment of the World Tree and... yes! The Battle of Mount Hyjal.$b$bWe must make haste, the timeline is not safe.
text.completed: Return to Soridormi in Tanaris.

english.title: The Vials of Eternity
english.objectives: Soridormi at Caverns of Time wants you to retrieve Vashj's Vial Remnant from Lady Vashj at Coilfang Reservoir and Kael's Vial Remnant from Kael'thas Sunstrider at Tempest Keep.
english.description: Seven vials were drawn from the Well of Eternity by Illidan.  He poured three into the lake on top of Mount Hyjal and a second Well of Eternity was created.  For years the rest were believed lost.$B$BWith the opening of the Dark Portal, we've come to know that he gave one each to his lieutenants Kael'thas and Vashj.  Retrieve what remains of them; we will need them as foci to open a gateway to any events tied to Mount Hyjal, recent or ancient.  The outcome of the Battle of Mount Hyjal must be preserved.
english.progress: I've asked the impossible of you, yet I expect you to succeed. Much depends on it.
english.completion: The power contained even in this small amount of water from the Well of Eternity is incredible.$b$bI can see clearly into every moment in time linked to Hyjal... the creation of the second Well of Eternity, Illidan's imprisonment, the enchantment of the World Tree and... yes! The Battle of Mount Hyjal.$b$bWe must make haste, the timeline is not safe.
english.completed: Return to Soridormi in Tanaris.

english.completed: Return to Horde Warbringer.

text.title: 无上的荣耀
text.objectives: 在每个战场上都取得1枚荣誉奖章，并将它们交给任意部落主城、沙塔斯、达拉然或冬拥湖的部落战争使者。
text.description: 与联盟作战是为部落效劳的莫大荣耀！那些在各条战线上和联盟作战的士兵是我们最伟大的成员。我们要消灭我们的对手，而不是仅仅进行小规模的遭遇战，我们要打精心准备的大战。$B$B去每一条战线上消灭联盟吧！为了荣耀！为了部落！
text.progress: Arathi is still wet with the blood of great warriors and the clash of steel still rings throughout Alterac. Do not waste my time unless you bring news from the front!
text.completion: Your trials have not been easy, but your courage did not escape you and your strength did not fail. Part with past tokens of victory, $c. None shall need them as a reminder of your worth. Stand up straight, $n. Today you will walk with great pride for you are a hero!
text.completed: Return to Horde Warbringer.

english.title: For Great Honor
english.objectives: Bring a Mark of Honor from each battleground to a Horde Warbringer in any Horde capital city, Shattrath, Dalaran, or Wintergrasp.
english.description: Serving the Horde in one of the great battles against the Alliance is a source of great honor!  The few however, that have served the Horde in ALL of our active battlefronts are our truly great fighters.  We shall vanquish our opponents, not by fighting isolated skirmishes, but by waging a well-coordinated war.$B$BGo forth and crush the Alliance on every front!  For Honor!  For the Horde!
english.progress: Arathi is still wet with the blood of great warriors and the clash of steel still rings throughout Alterac. Do not waste my time unless you bring news from the front!
english.completion: Your trials have not been easy, but your courage did not escape you and your strength did not fail. Part with past tokens of victory, $c. None shall need them as a reminder of your worth. Stand up straight, $n. Today you will walk with great pride for you are a hero!
english.completed: Return to Horde Warbringer.

text.title: Concerted Efforts
text.completed: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

english.title: Concerted Efforts
english.completed: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

text.title: 共同的努力
text.objectives: 在每个战场上都取得1枚荣誉奖章，并将它们交给任意联盟主城、沙塔斯、达拉然或冬拥湖的联盟准将。
text.description: 我们并不是在独自与部落交战，$g小伙子:小姑娘;。$B$B如果我们可以取得胜利，那么我们就可以使用部落的资源来在其它的战场上对抗他们。反之，如果我们输掉了这场战争，那么在其它的战场上，部落将会占有优势。$B$B联盟需要更多你这种身经百战、意志坚定的老兵！$n，当你在所有战场上都与部落交战之后再回到我这里。
text.progress: How are yer travels faring $gladdie:lassy;?
text.completion: You're not one to disappoint, $n! What you've learned goes beyond petty medals and commendations. What you've learned is what can only come with experience and the hardening of one's temper in the field of battle.$b$bYou've done well, $c. You're a true hero of the Alliance!
text.completed: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

english.title: Concerted Efforts
english.objectives: Bring a Mark of Honor from each battleground to an Alliance Brigadier General in any Alliance Capital City, Shattrath, Dalaran, or Wintergrasp.
english.description: We're not fighting isolated battles against the Horde anymore, $g lad:lass;.$B$BVictory in one front means denying the Horde resources they'd use against us in a different battle.  By the same token, abandoning any given battle could give the advantage to our opponent somewhere else around the world.$B$BThe Alliance is in need of more combatants with this sort of worldly understanding... truly seasoned veterans!  $n, come back to me after you've served against the Horde at all of our active battlegrounds.
english.progress: How are yer travels faring $gladdie:lassy;?
english.completion: You're not one to disappoint, $n! What you've learned goes beyond petty medals and commendations. What you've learned is what can only come with experience and the hardening of one's temper in the field of battle.$b$bYou've done well, $c. You're a true hero of the Alliance!
english.completed: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

text.title: 寻蛋
text.objectives: 春季收集者要你去收集20块蛋壳碎片。
text.description: 复活节，赞美生命和春天的庆典！朋友，我希望你喜欢找彩蛋这项娱乐活动，这样你就可以帮上我的忙了。$b$b我不知道那些德鲁伊在制造彩蛋时到底使用了哪些魔法，他们也不打算给我解释。你在收集彩蛋的时候能不能帮我保留一些蛋壳的碎片？蛋里面的东西你可以自己拿去，那些蛋才是我需要的研究样本。
text.progress: Do you have the fragments?
text.completion: Excellent, excellent, thank you! I may need more of a sample to get truly conclusive results, but you've done well today.
text.completed: Return to Spring Gatherer.

english.title: The Great Egg Hunt
english.objectives: The Spring Gatherer wants you to get 20 shell fragments.
english.description: Noblegarden, celebration of life and spring! I hope you've been enjoying the egg hunt, friend, because I could use the services of a capable individual like you.$b$bI'm not certain what form of magic was used in the creation of the eggs, and the druids aren't keen on explaining it to me. Perhaps you could collect some shell fragments for me during your egg collection. You can keep the contents of the eggs; all I require is a sufficient sample of the eggs themselves.
english.progress: Do you have the fragments?
english.completion: Excellent, excellent, thank you! I may need more of a sample to get truly conclusive results, but you've done well today.
english.completed: Return to Spring Gatherer.

text.title: 我们离开这里吧
text.objectives: 护送卡玛洛斯神父逃离险境，然后向奥格瑞姆之锤的凯尔坦修士报告。
text.description: 圣光对我微笑了，我还没死在这个人间地狱中。但是如果我再不逃走的话，天灾军团就会杀了我，把我撕成碎片，用来制作它们的“产品”。$B$B我一个人是没办法逃走的，$c。不过如果有你的帮助，或许我还可以活下来，继续与天灾军团作战。$B$B趁着天灾军团的屠夫还没来杀我，你能帮我逃出去吗？
text.completion: You have done well. We thought Father Kamaros lost, for certain. Your bravery will serve as an example to all those who oppose the Scourge.
text.end: 护送卡玛洛斯神父逃离险境
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川奥格瑞姆之锤号上的凯尔坦修士。

english.title: Let's Get Out of Here!
english.objectives: Escort Father Kamaros to safety and then report to Brother Keltan aboard Orgrim's Hammer.
english.description: The Light smiles upon me. I have not yet died in this living nightmare, but the Scourge will kill me and tear my body apart for use in their 'work' here if I cannot escape.$B$BI cannot make it on my own, $c, but with your help, I may yet live to fight the Scourge again.$B$BWill you help me make my escape before the Scourge's butchers come to finish me off?
english.completion: You have done well. We thought Father Kamaros lost, for certain. Your bravery will serve as an example to all those who oppose the Scourge.
english.completed: Report to Brother Keltan at Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

text.title: 我们离开这里吧
text.objectives: 护送卡玛洛斯神父逃离险境，然后向破天号上的虔诚的阿布萨兰报告。
text.description: 圣光对我微笑了，我还没死在这个人间地狱中。但是如果我再不逃走的话，天灾军团就会杀了我，把我撕成碎片，用来制作它们的“产品”。$B$B我一个人是没办法逃走的，孩子。不过如果有你的帮助，或许我还可以活下来，继续与天灾军团作战。$B$B趁着天灾军团的屠夫还没来杀我，你能帮我逃出去吗？
text.completion: Thank the Light. I'd thought Father Kamaros dead, or worse. Through your bravery and compassion, you have restored a great ally to the Argent Crusade. You have my thanks and those of the crusade.
text.end: 护送卡玛洛斯神父逃离险境
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找破天号上的虔诚的阿布萨兰。

english.title: Let's Get Out of Here
english.objectives: Escort Father Kamaros to safety and then report to Absalan the Pious aboard the Skybreaker.
english.description: The Light smiles upon me. I have not yet died in this living nightmare, but the Scourge will kill me and tear my body apart for use in their 'work' here if I cannot escape.$B$BI cannot make it on my own, my child, but with your help, I may yet live to fight the Scourge again.$B$BWill you help me make my escape before the Scourge's butchers come to finish me off?
english.completion: Thank the Light. I'd thought Father Kamaros dead, or worse. Through your bravery and compassion, you have restored a great ally to the Argent Crusade. You have my thanks and those of the crusade.
english.completed: Report to Absalan the Pious at the Skybreaker in Icecrown.

text.title: 春季收集者
text.objectives: 与剃刀岭、布瑞尔、血蹄村或鹰翼广场的春季收集者谈一谈。
text.description: 如果你想找些活干的话，可以到主城附近的村庄里去看看——比如剃刀岭，布瑞尔，血蹄村或者鹰翼广场。我听说那些地方有几位法师正在搞什么研究工作，希望能找到收集彩蛋的人去帮忙。具体的情况我也不很清楚，不过他们肯定会告诉你的。
text.completion: Yes! Yes, I think I have just the task for you...

english.title: Spring Gatherers
english.objectives: Talk to a Spring Gatherer in Razor Hill, Brill, Bloodhoof Village, or Falconwing Square.
english.description: If you're looking for something to do, I hear there are mages in the settlements near capital cities - Razor Hill, Brill, Bloodhoof Village, and Falconwing Square - who have been recruiting egg hunters for help with some research they're doing. I'm not sure of the particulars, but I'm sure they'd tell you.
english.completion: Yes! Yes, I think I have just the task for you...

text.title: 春季收藏者
text.objectives: 与闪金镇、卡拉诺斯、多兰纳尔或碧蓝岗哨的春季收藏者谈一谈。
text.description: 如果你想找些活干的话，可以到主城附近的村庄里去看看——比如闪金镇，卡拉诺斯，多兰纳尔或者碧蓝岗哨。我听说那些地方有几位法师正在搞什么研究工作，希望能找到收集彩蛋的人去帮忙。具体的情况我也不很清楚，不过他们肯定会告诉你的。
text.completion: Yes! Yes, I think I have just the task for you...

english.title: Spring Collectors

english.description: If you're looking for something to do, I hear there are mages in the settlements near capital cities - Goldshire, Kharanos, Dolanaar, and Azure Watch - who have been recruiting egg hunters for help with some research they're doing. I'm not sure of the particulars, but I'm sure they'd tell you.
english.completion: Yes! Yes, I think I have just the task for you...

text.title: 巧克力甜又甜，全都装进彩蛋篮
text.objectives: 复活节小贩要你收集10块复活节巧克力，并将巧克力和借来的蛋篮一起交还给他。
text.description: 给你……拿着这只彩蛋篮，去寻找鲜艳的彩蛋吧。找到十块复活节巧克力以后，带着篮子回来找我。
text.progress: Do you have the ten Noblegarden Chocolates?
text.completion: Well done! And here, please... keep the basket!$B$BRemember, you can always return with more Noblegarden Chocolates to trade for additional items.
text.completed: Return to Noblegarden Vendor.

english.title: A Tisket, a Tasket, a Noblegarden Basket
english.objectives: The Noblegarden Vendor wants you to collect 10 Noblegarden Chocolates and return them along with the Borrowed Egg Basket.
english.description: Here... take this Egg Basket and go hunting for Brightly Colored Eggs. Return to me with the basket when you've found ten Noblegarden Chocolates.
english.progress: Do you have the ten Noblegarden Chocolates?
english.completion: Well done! And here, please... keep the basket!$B$BRemember, you can always return with more Noblegarden Chocolates to trade for additional items.
english.completed: Return to Noblegarden Vendor.

text.title: 巧克力甜又甜，全都装进彩蛋篮
text.objectives: 复活节商人要你收集10块复活节巧克力，并将巧克力和借来的蛋篮一起交还给他。
text.description: 给你……拿着这只彩蛋篮，去寻找鲜艳的彩蛋吧。找到十块复活节巧克力以后，带着篮子回来找我。
text.progress: Do you have the ten Noblegarden Chocolates?
text.completion: Well done! And here, please... keep the basket!$B$BRemember, you can always return with more Noblegarden Chocolates to trade for additional items.
text.completed: Return to Noblegarden Merchant.

english.title: A Tisket, a Tasket, a Noblegarden Basket
english.objectives: The Noblegarden Merchant wants you to collect 10 Noblegarden Chocolates and return them along with the Borrowed Egg Basket.
english.description: Here... take this Egg Basket and go hunting for Brightly Colored Eggs. Return to me with the basket when you've found ten Noblegarden Chocolates.
english.progress: Do you have the ten Noblegarden Chocolates?
english.completion: Well done! And here, please... keep the basket!$B$BRemember, you can always return with more Noblegarden Chocolates to trade for additional items.
english.completed: Return to Noblegarden Merchant.

text.title: 碎矛劳工
text.objectives: 消灭10名碎矛劳工。
text.description: 北方和东北的废墟里出现了大量进行挖掘工作的碎矛巨魔。我怀疑他们在寻找魔法神器，但我们的斥候报告说没有发现他们出土过类似的物品。也许他们只是在为战争作准备。$B$B但有一点是很肯定的：劳工的减少会延缓他们的进攻态势，这也就是我们即将要做的事情。你干吗？
text.completion: Good work. Thank you, $C.
text.completed: Return to Sentinel Tysha Moonblade at the Ruins of Mathystra.

english.title: Shatterspear Laborers
english.objectives: Kill 10 Shatterspear Laborers.
english.description: There are a large number of Shatterspear trolls picking through the ruins to the north and northeast. I suspect that they're looking for magical artifacts, but none of our scouts have reported the discovery of anything of significance turning up from their digs. They may well just be fueling their war.$B$BOne thing is fairly certain though: less laborers would slow down their offensive, so less laborers is what they're going to get. You in?
english.completion: Good work. Thank you, $C.
english.completed: Return to Sentinel Tysha Moonblade at the Ruins of Mathystra.

text.title: 上层精灵的遗留
text.objectives: 收集8件上层精灵的遗物。
text.description: 黑海岸遍布着许多类似的废墟，大部分游荡着上层精灵的怨灵。出于尊重，我们没打算因为要搜刮废墟里的神器而打扰他们，但这一好意却被巨魔的威胁所打破。$B$B你在废墟里帮哨兵们干活的时候，也请多加留意那些神器，把它们带回来给我，我要尽可能地做好保护工作。
text.progress: Were you able to recover any artifacts?
text.completion: Perfect! Thank you so much. I would hate to lose more records of our culture to war - far too much has been sacrificed already.
text.completed: Return to Balthule Shadowstrike at the Ruins of Mathystra.

english.title: Remnants of the Highborne
english.objectives: Retrieve 8 Highborne Relics.
english.description: There are several ruins similar to these spread through Darkshore, many of them inhabited by the troubled spirits of the Highborne. Out of mild courtesy for their cursed souls, we haven't been overly proactive about stripping the ruins of artifacts, but those hesitancies vanish in light of this new troll threat.$B$BWhile you're aiding the Sentinels in their goals within the ruins, please collect any artifacts that you stumble upon and bring them back to me. I would like to preserve what little I can.
english.progress: Were you able to recover any artifacts?
english.completion: Perfect! Thank you so much. I would hate to lose more records of our culture to war - far too much has been sacrificed already.
english.completed: Return to Balthule Shadowstrike at the Ruins of Mathystra.

text.title: 担心的理由
text.objectives: 将碎矛命令带给玛塞斯特拉废墟的莫拉·星风中尉。
text.description: 这些像是从碎矛战争营地发给废墟里先知们的命令。大部分文件没什么战略价值，但有几行字特别惹眼。$B$B“我们又抓住一个刺探行动的暗夜精灵。已将她押回营地问话。密切注意其他的间谍——行动计划切不可走漏。”$B$B中尉一定对这消息感兴趣。
text.progress: Yes, $C?
text.completion: "Another?" They have more than one. I will not leave any of my people to be tortured, we must act quickly.

english.title: Reason to Worry
english.objectives: Bring the Shatterspear Orders to Lieutenant Morra Starbreeze at the Ruins of Mathystra.
english.description: These appear to be orders dispatched to the overseers at the ruins from a superior in the Shatterspear War Camp. Most of the document contains negligible strategic value, but a couple lines stick out to you.$B$B"We captured another night elf spying on our operation. She has been taken back to the camp to be tortured for more information. Keep an eye out for additional spies - we cannot afford for our operation to be compromised."$B$BThe Lieutenant will surely want this information.
english.progress: Yes, $C?
english.completion: "Another?" They have more than one. I will not leave any of my people to be tortured, we must act quickly.

text.title: 消减人手
text.objectives: 消灭6名部落执行者6名碎矛秘法师。
text.description: 碎矛在北边成立了一个战争营地，搭建他们的投石车。营地由他们的秘法师把守，但我也开始收到报告说兽人和牛头人也在那里出没。$B$B我不想妄加揣测，但我要你在他们对哨兵做出进一步的攻击之前把他们消灭掉。
text.completion: Excellent work. One more threat we can worry a bit less about. We'll continue the offensive while they are still off-guard.
text.completed: Return to Sentinel Tysha Moonblade at the Ruins of Mathystra.

english.title: Denying Manpower
english.objectives: Kill 6 Horde Enforcers and 6 Shatterspear Mystics.
english.description: To the north, the Shatterspear have a war camp where they are constructing their catapults. The camp is guarded by some of their mystics, but I've started receiving reports that there are sightings of orcs and tauren there as well.$B$BI don't want to make any assumptions as to what that suggests, but I do want you to go in and kill them before they can make any further strikes on our Sentinels.
english.completion: Excellent work. One more threat we can worry a bit less about. We'll continue the offensive while they are still off-guard.
english.completed: Return to Sentinel Tysha Moonblade at the Ruins of Mathystra.

text.title: 快速反应
text.objectives: 在碎矛战争营地里找到暗夜精灵囚犯。
text.description: 几天前我们同一个斥候失去了联系。我以为她牺牲了，但现在看来她是被俘了。巨魔表明他们至少抓住了两名俘虏……另一个只可能是奥兰达利亚·夜歌，昨天不听我劝的一个平民。$B$B碎矛在北边有个战争营地——估计多半囚犯都会被押送到那里去。你能够找到他们的话，就请把他们放出来。
text.completion: <Alanndarian looks very pale, though shallow breaths betray the life that remains in her.>$B$BYou're here... to save me? A bit later... than I hoped.

english.title: Swift Response
english.objectives: Locate the night elf prisoners at the Shatterspear War Camp.
english.description: I have a scout that we lost contact with a couple days ago. I assumed her dead, but it appears that she's been captured. The trolls indicate that they have at least two captives though... the only other person that comes to mind is Alanndarian Nightsong, a civilian that was in the area against my advisement early yesterday.$B$BThe Shatterspear have established a war camp to the north - it is almost certainly where any of their prisoners are being taken. Find them and free them if you're able.
english.completion: <Alanndarian looks very pale, though shallow breaths betray the life that remains in her.>$B$BYou're here... to save me? A bit later... than I hoped.

text.title: 战时补给
text.objectives: 摧毁12处碎矛军备。
text.description: 巨魔在北边的战争营地招兵买马。一旦时机成熟，他们就会从那里攻打洛达内尔。灭掉这些乌合之众只是举手之劳，但我不想冒不必要的险。$B$B我要你杀进战争营地，放火烧掉他们的粮草军备。这样可以为我们应对他们的反击争取准备时间。
text.completion: Excellent work. That should slow them down a bit.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Morra Starbreeze at the Ruins of Mathystra.

english.title: War Supplies
english.objectives: Destroy 12 Shatterspear Armaments.
english.description: The trolls are building their forces and supplies at the war camp to the north. When they feel they are ready, they will almost certainly launch their attack on Lor'danel from that location. It shouldn't take us long to rout this rabble, but I'm not one for taking unnecessary risks.$B$BI want you to fight your way into the war camp and set fire to any stockpiles of supplies that you see. The setback should buy us quite a bit of time before they can muster a counterattack.
english.completion: Excellent work. That should slow them down a bit.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Morra Starbreeze at the Ruins of Mathystra.

text.title: 及时赶到
text.objectives: 安全护送哨兵阿娜莎。
text.description: 见到你可真高兴。我可不指望受奥兰达利亚的那份罪，还好你来救人了。$B$B在我被抓之前我已经盯上了巨魔首领，当时还以为那是除掉他的绝佳机会，可他被某种魔法护盾所保护着。必须在莫拉发动进攻前告诉她这件事，但首先，我们得逃出去。$B$B帮我把锁打开——我走水路回洛达内尔，你把情报带回去给莫拉。
text.completion: Some sort of shield you say? We might have a way around that. Balthule had an idea for breaking whatever protective enchantments their shaman had, so it might work on this too. Thank you for saving Aynasha and bringing me this information - it may well make the difference in our battle.
text.end: 安全护送哨兵阿娜莎抵达码头
text.completed: 去找玛塞斯特拉废墟的莫拉·星风。

english.title: Timely Arrival
english.objectives: Escort Sentinel Aynasha to safety.
english.description: It's good to see you. I wasn't looking forward to enduring what Alanndarian did, so the rescue is somewhat welcome.$B$BI saw the troll leader before I was captured, and thought I had the perfect opportunity to kill him, but he's protected by some sort of magic shield. Morra needs to know before she mounts her assault, but first, we need to get out of here.$B$BHelp me to the dock - I'll make my way to Lor'danel via water, and you can go back to Morra with the intel.
english.completion: Some sort of shield you say? We might have a way around that. Balthule had an idea for breaking whatever protective enchantments their shaman had, so it might work on this too. Thank you for saving Aynasha and bringing me this information - it may well make the difference in our battle.
english.end: Escort Sentinel Aynasha to the Dock
english.completed: Report to Morra Starbreeze at the Ruins of Mathystra.

text.title: 悲恨仇怨
text.objectives: 杀死碎矛拷问者力克托。
text.description: 莫拉派你来的？我本该听她的——我想不去小瞧巨魔也挺难的。$B$B<奥兰达利亚虚弱地轻声笑了笑。>$B$B不过已经太迟了。我们现在是凡人……无论如何，这都是我们必须面对的命运。我本有时间来接受这一切的。$B$B我还有一个请求……去杀掉把我折磨成这样的拷问者。他们管他叫力克托……他应该就和其他囚犯在一起。$B$B<奥兰达利亚力不从心地笑了笑，随后身子痛苦地一软，颓然倒下。>
text.completion: Alanndarian is dead then. That saddens me greatly, but it is not entirely unexpected. I expect no mercy from these savages, and will show them none.
text.completed: Report to Lieutenant Morra Starbreeze at the Ruins of Mathystra.

english.title: One Bitter Wish
english.objectives: Kill Rit'ko, the Shatterspear Torturer.
english.description: Morra sent you? I should have listened to her - it's just hard to take trolls seriously I guess.$B$B<Alanndarian lets out a weak chuckle.>$B$BIt's way too late for that anyway. We're mortal now... this is the fate we have to face, one way or another. I've had time to accept that.$B$BI have one request though... kill the torturer that did this to me. They call him Rit'ko... you can find him just ahead with the other prisoner.$B$B<Alanndarian offers a small smile, then winces and slumps back over in pain.>
english.completion: Alanndarian is dead then. That saddens me greatly, but it is not entirely unexpected. I expect no mercy from these savages, and will show them none.
english.completed: Report to Lieutenant Morra Starbreeze at the Ruins of Mathystra.

text.title: 战略打击
text.objectives: 杀死风暴编织者赛雅和洛伦瑟·唤雷。
text.description: 兽多首，斩一而不得其竭。在杀掉他们的首领之前，我们先要杀掉那些等着上位的小头目。现在，他们防御薄弱，你应该无需多少支援就能得手。$B$B带上这支树妖之矛，把他们都干掉。矛尖上的毒可以减缓他们的法咒。我的斥候报告说他们之中的一个在东边废墟的大厅中，另一个在西南方那座塔的背后。
text.completion: You've shown a great deal of talent for one so young. Good work. It seems the final battle is before us.
text.completed: Return to Morra Starbreeze at the Ruins of Mathystra.

english.title: Strategic Strikes
english.objectives: Kill Sheya Stormweaver and Lorenth Thundercall.
english.description: Striking at the head of the beast doesn't work if there's another head to replace it. Before we can kill their leader, we need to kill the subleaders that may try to step up. Right now, they are not as well defended, and you should be able to best them without much support.$B$BTake this dryad spear and hunt them down. The poison on its tip should slow their incantations. My scouts reported one inside the water chamber in the ruins to the east and the other past the remains of the tower to the southwest.
english.completion: You've shown a great deal of talent for one so young. Good work. It seems the final battle is before us.
english.completed: Return to Morra Starbreeze at the Ruins of Mathystra.

text.title: 一触即发
text.objectives: 收集6个碎矛护符。
text.description: 我已经开始研究如何破除他们的保护符咒了。只要借助他们的法力，加上一点点德鲁伊魔法，我们就应该能攻破其护盾。$B$B去东边和东南两处找到他们的萨满，拿几条护符回来。我会把它们准备好，做一支魔箭让你带给桑德娅·月落以备进攻之需。
text.progress: Did you recover the amulets?
text.completion: These will do perfectly. I will prepare them for Sandrya - you are sure to be dispatched to meet with her shortly.
text.completed: Return to Balthule Shadowstrike at the Ruins of Mathystra.

english.title: On the Brink
english.objectives: Retrieve 6 Shatterspear Amulets.
english.description: I've already been working on something for breaking down their protective wards. With a focus based in their power and a bit of druidic magic, we should be able to breach their shields.$B$BFind their shaman to the east and southeast and recover several of their amulets. I will prepare them and imbue an arrow that you can deliver to Sandrya Moonfall for the attack.
english.progress: Did you recover the amulets?
english.completion: These will do perfectly. I will prepare them for Sandrya - you are sure to be dispatched to meet with her shortly.
english.completed: Return to Balthule Shadowstrike at the Ruins of Mathystra.

text.title: 古树的怒火
text.objectives: 调用狂怒的保护者杀死30名碎矛巨魔，并摧毁6处碎矛建筑。
text.description: 是来参加进攻的吗？假如你要找桑德娅·月落，她正带队攻打山谷后面的碎矛首领，你可以去那里找她。$B$B既然都来了，你倒是可以帮我们把他们的残部给清除掉。带上我的一个狂怒的保护者，确保所有的房子都被摧毁，所有的巨魔都格杀勿论。我们可不能让他们卷土重来报复我们，对不对？
text.completion: You performed excellently up there! We are fortunate to have you with us.$B$BI haven't yet received word regarding their leader. If you haven't spoken with Sandrya at the cave in the back of the vale, be sure to do so before you depart.
text.completed: Return to Kerlonian Evershade in Shatterspear Vale.

english.title: The Ancients' Ire
english.objectives: Utilize a Vengeful Protector to kill 30 Shatterspear trolls and destroy 6 Shatterspear Structures.
english.description: Come to join the offensive? If you're looking for Sandrya Moonfall, she's leading the attack on the Shatterspear leader at the cave in the back of the vale, you can meet her there.$B$BWhile you're here though, we could certainly use your help with routing the rest of their tribe. Go ahead and take the company of one of the Vengeful Protectors there and see to it that every last building is destroyed and every last troll killed. We can't have them coming back for revenge when we're less prepared, can we?
english.completion: You performed excellently up there! We are fortunate to have you with us.$B$BI haven't yet received word regarding their leader. If you haven't spoken with Sandrya at the cave in the back of the vale, be sure to do so before you depart.
english.completed: Return to Kerlonian Evershade in Shatterspear Vale.

text.title: 结束威胁
text.objectives: 跟桑德娅·月落交谈以展开进攻，帮她杀掉剥魂者乔基尔。
text.description: 他们的首领和卫队就在前面。我的哨兵们会对付卫队，咱们只等这支箭结果首领的命。$B$B等你准备好进攻了就让我知道，我的哨兵们一旦交火，我就破除那首领的护盾，然后咱们就一起上。行动利落的话，我们就能从这片土地上将这个威胁从此了结。$B$B我们现在只等你了——准备好了就告诉我。
text.completion: We owe a great debt to you for all that you've done to see this battle through.$B$BNot often can we claim victories so decisively, but it seems there's far more to this plot than just the Shatterspear. If you haven't already checked his body for information, make sure to do so before you leave.
text.completed: Return to Huntress Sandrya Moonfall in Shatterspear Vale.
text.giverWindow: 和碎矛氏族的和平时光已经过去了，那么碎矛氏族也将成为历史。

english.title: Ending the Threat
english.objectives: Speak to Sandrya Moonfall to start the attack, and aid her in killing Jor'kil the Soulripper.
english.description: Their leader and his guard are before us. My Sentinels are ready to take care of his guard, we only awaited this arrow to seal their leader's fate.$B$BLet me know when you are prepared to attack. As soon as my Sentinels engage, I will shatter the leader's shield, and we will assault him together. Strike swiftly and we can rout this threat to our lands here and now.$B$BWe await only you - speak to me when ready.
english.completion: We owe a great debt to you for all that you've done to see this battle through.$B$BNot often can we claim victories so decisively, but it seems there's far more to this plot than just the Shatterspear. If you haven't already checked his body for information, make sure to do so before you leave.
english.completed: Return to Huntress Sandrya Moonfall in Shatterspear Vale.
english.giverWindow: The days of peace with the Shatterspear have passed, and so the Shatterspear must pass as well.

text.title: 最后一波幸存者
text.objectives: 找到依然生还的奥伯丁难民。
text.description: 莱尔德太迟了，他没能挺过来。$B$B奥伯丁的最后一波暗夜精灵几个小时前试图逃出来。他们待在老家里，希望还有挽救的余地，但最后似乎他们都被冲了出来。恐怕很多人都没能活下来，就像莱尔德。$B$B快，去西边的海岸尽你所能寻找幸存者。我们将派哨兵和角鹰兽出发，时间紧迫——我们需要知道都有谁挺了过来。
text.progress: Their pride kept them in Auberdine for this long, but none deserve such a cruel fate.
text.completion: Thank you, $c. Some of them surely would not have made it without you.$B$BWe'll be taking the wounded to the main building once we have them all safely back in town. Perhaps you can meet us there later?
text.completed: Return to Priestess Dentaria in Lor'danel.

english.title: The Last Wave of Survivors
english.objectives: Locate any refugees from Auberdine that are still alive.
english.description: It's too late for Laird, he didn't make it in time.$B$BThe last wave of night elves from Auberdine attempted to escape a couple of hours ago. They stayed in their old home, clinging to the hope that it could be salvaged, but it seems they were finally forced out. I fear many of them won't make it, like Laird did not.$B$BQuickly, go down the coast to the west and find any survivors that you can. We're sending Sentinels and Hippogryphs down, but every moment counts - we need to know which ones might make it.
english.progress: Their pride kept them in Auberdine for this long, but none deserve such a cruel fate.
english.completion: Thank you, $c. Some of them surely would not have made it without you.$B$BWe'll be taking the wounded to the main building once we have them all safely back in town. Perhaps you can meet us there later?
english.completed: Return to Priestess Dentaria in Lor'danel.

text.title: 暮光之锤
text.objectives: 击败暮光营地的高阶教徒阿泽林以及10名暮光狂热者。
text.description: 一撮暮光之锤邪教徒在西南边建立了一处营地。他们正在组织水元素部队，以攻打洛达内尔。$B$B其首领高阶教徒阿泽林同黑暗的上古众神达成了协议，被赐予了控制那些元素的力量。去干掉他们，$n，不然就太晚了。$B$B大灾变让元素之灵们混乱不堪……他们要攻破我们的防御只是时间问题。
text.completion: You've done well, $n. The Twilight's Hammer is a dangerous cult. It would be foolish to underestimate the danger they represent.
text.completed: Return to Sentinel Lendra at Lor'danel in Darkshore.
text.giverWindow: 他的死对我们至关重要。

english.title: The Twilight's Hammer
english.objectives: Slay High Cultist Azerynn and 10 Twilight Fanatics in the Twilight Encampment.
english.description: A group of Twilight's Hammer cultists has set up camp southwest of here.  They're preparing an army of water elementals to use against Lor'danel.$B$BTheir leader, High Cultist Azerynn, has pacts with the dark Old Gods that grant his sect power over the elements.  Go and deal with them before it's too late, $n.$B$BThe cataclysm has left the elemental spirits in disarray... it's only a matter of time until they have enough elementals to overcome our defenses.
english.completion: You've done well, $n. The Twilight's Hammer is a dangerous cult. It would be foolish to underestimate the danger they represent.
english.completed: Return to Sentinel Lendra at Lor'danel in Darkshore.
english.giverWindow: His death means a great deal to us.

text.title: 海洋的恩赐
text.objectives: 收集16份带壳蚌肉。
text.description: 很高兴见到你。你就是那个让我们所爱的人们安全回家的关键人物，希望你能再帮帮我们。$B$B像莱尔德一样，这些人伤势严重，大家都饱受海浪和元素的侵袭。我已经尽全力了，但貌似那些元素携带了一种毒素，削弱了他们受到的治疗效果。我相信我可以配制一种药膏，但我需要蚌肉的分泌物才行。你愿意帮我吗？
text.progress: Did you bring muscles from the clams? I worry that our time grows very short.
text.completion: This will do perfectly. Thank you so much!$B$BI suspect they will want to thank you personally should they recover, so perhaps you can stop by later on.
text.completed: Return to Priestess Serendia in Lor'danel.

english.title: The Boon of the Seas
english.objectives: Collect 16 Encrusted Clam Muscles.
english.description: It is good to see you. You were key in ensuring that our loved ones made it home, and I hold some hope that you may yet help us further.$B$BLike Laird, their wounds will be grave - every one of them battered by the coast and assaulted by the elementals. I am doing what I can, but it seems that those elementals hosted a toxin that is weakening their ability to heal. I believe I can concoct a salve, but I will need secretion from the muscles of the clams that inhabit this coast. Can you help me?
english.progress: Did you bring muscles from the clams? I worry that our time grows very short.
english.completion: This will do perfectly. Thank you so much!$B$BI suspect they will want to thank you personally should they recover, so perhaps you can stop by later on.
english.completed: Return to Priestess Serendia in Lor'danel.

text.title: 传声盒413号
text.objectives: 收集4块堕落潮行蟹的肉片，把它们放到传声盒413号里去分析。
text.description: 你好！$B$B我在帮萨纳瑞恩调查究竟是什么腐化了这里的野生动物。我在野外设置了一些机器，可以分析动物的组织以及可能的腐化媒介。要是你能给我弄些样本来，我们很快就能把这次污染查清楚。$B$B第一件机器叫做传声盒413号，我把它设在镇子东边的海滩上了。我要你从附近被腐化的潮行蟹身上收集一些肉片，放到机器里让我好分析。
text.progress: <Buzzbox 413 hums at you expectantly.>
text.completion: <The machine crackles loudly, and then Wizbang's static-ridden voice becomes audible.>$B$BLovely! I hope you didn't kill too many of them. We're not trying to wipe out the population, we just need to get to the source of this corruption quickly! I'm proceeding with the analysis now.
text.completed: Bring the samples to Buzzbox 413 in Mist's Edge.

english.title: Buzzbox 413
english.objectives: Gather 4 Corrupted Tide Crawler Flesh samples and bring them to Buzzbox 413 for analysis.
english.description: Greetings!$B$BI'm helping Tharnariun here try to unravel what's been corrupting the wildlife in the area. I've set up some machines in the field that can analyze animal parts and possible corruption agents. If you can get me some good samples, we can get to the bottom of this affliction quickly.$B$BThe first machine is Buzzbox 413. I set it up on the beach just east of town. I'll need you to gather some flesh from the nearby corrupted tide crawlers and bring it to the machine so that I can analyze it.
english.progress: <Buzzbox 413 hums at you expectantly.>
english.completion: <The machine crackles loudly, and then Wizbang's static-ridden voice becomes audible.>$B$BLovely! I hope you didn't kill too many of them. We're not trying to wipe out the population, we just need to get to the source of this corruption quickly! I'm proceeding with the analysis now.
english.completed: Bring the samples to Buzzbox 413 in Mist's Edge.

text.title: 水的威胁
text.objectives: 杀死8只邪恶喷涌者。
text.description: 有些在奥伯丁生还的幸存者还没有安全抵达海岸。我们只是听说他们在最后一刻才出发。要是我们早点提醒就好了……$B$B西边的海岸线上布满了邪恶喷涌者，一种凶残的水元素。我们必须把它们除掉，不然幸存者们不可能逃到洛达内尔来。立刻出发把你找到的水元素都干掉。
text.completion: Your efforts are very much appreciated. Since the Cataclysm, the elementals have been out of control. We have little hope of taking back Auberdine without extinguishing their presence first.
text.completed: Return to Ranger Glynda Nal'Shea in Lor'danel.

english.title: Threat from the Water
english.objectives: Kill 8 Vile Spray.
english.description: Some of the survivors of this last Auberdine attack are still trying to make it up the coast to safety. We only caught word that they were coming within the last hour. I wish that we had more warning...$B$BThe coastline west of us is swarming with vile spray, vicious little water elementals. We need to clear them out if any of the survivors are to have a chance of making it to Lor'danel. Depart immediately and kill every elemental you see.
english.completion: Your efforts are very much appreciated. Since the Cataclysm, the elementals have been out of control. We have little hope of taking back Auberdine without extinguishing their presence first.
english.completed: Return to Ranger Glynda Nal'Shea in Lor'danel.

text.title: 控潮之力
text.objectives: 对6个被激怒的潮汐之魂的残余使用艾露恩宝珠。
text.description: 别担心我。我的伤很重，不久就要迎来死亡。$B$B现在都要靠你了……你必须阻止暮光之锤。$B$B他们崇拜的上古众神赋予了他们力量来控制不休的水灵……但那力量十分微弱。你要先击败那些元素，然后用这颗宝珠让艾露恩显灵。$B$B用艾露恩的力量永远驱逐那些恶灵。
text.completion: You've succeeded... it hasn't all been in vain...$B$BMy time approaches. Go now, $n, and may Elune protect you.
text.completed: Return to Moon Priestess Tharill in the Twilight Encampment.

english.title: Power Over the Tides
english.objectives: Use the Orb of Elune on the remains of 6 Enraged Tidal Spirits.
english.description: Do not worry about me.  My wounds are deep and death will soon come to me.$B$BIt is all up to you now... you must stop the Twilight's Hammer.$B$BThe Old Gods they worship have granted them power over the restless water spirits... but that power is tenuous.  Channel Elune's presence through this orb once the elementals have been defeated.$B$BUse the power of Elune to banish the spirits permanently.
english.completion: You've succeeded... it hasn't all been in vain...$B$BMy time approaches. Go now, $n, and may Elune protect you.
english.completed: Return to Moon Priestess Tharill in the Twilight Encampment.

text.title: Escape from Silverbrook
text.objectives: Open the Wooden Cage and help the Freed Alliance Scout escape from Silverbrook.  Report to Lieutenant Dumont when you reach Amberpine Lodge.
text.description: You... you're not one of them?  Quick!  Let me out!$B$BWe have to get to Amberpine Lodge immediately!  Once Lieutenant Dumont finds out who these people really are, this town will be reduced to rubble!
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Dumont in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Escape from Silverbrook
english.objectives: Open the Wooden Cage and help the Freed Alliance Scout escape from Silverbrook.  Report to Lieutenant Dumont when you reach Amberpine Lodge.
english.description: You... you're not one of them?  Quick!  Let me out!$B$BWe have to get to Amberpine Lodge immediately!  Once Lieutenant Dumont finds out who these people really are, this town will be reduced to rubble!
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Dumont in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 黑木熊怪怎么了？
text.objectives: 跟黑木要塞的熊怪长者谈一谈。
text.description: 我们的祖先同黑木熊怪世世代代共同生活在一起。可最近我们同森林深处聚居点的他们失去了联系。他们其中一个较大的村庄，黑木要塞，就在南边。$B$B去那里找熊怪长者，问问他为什么他的人要避开我们，假如有必要的话你可以帮帮他们。
text.completion: Why have you come here, outsider?$B$B<You tell the elder that you were sent by Foriel Broadleaf at the Grove of the Ancients. He seems to relax slightly.>$B$BThe elf is right. The forces of Felwood have seeped into Darkshore and sickened my people.

english.title: What's Happening to the Blackwood Furbolg?
english.objectives: Speak with Elder Brolg at Blackwood Hold.
english.description: Our ancestors lived alongside the Blackwood furbolgs for generations. But recently, we have lost contact with their settlements deeper in the forest. One of their larger villages, Blackwood Hold, can be found to the south.$B$BTravel there and find Elder Brolg. Ask him why his people have withdrawn from us and offer your help, if necessary.
english.completion: Why have you come here, outsider?$B$B<You tell the elder that you were sent by Foriel Broadleaf at the Grove of the Ancients. He seems to relax slightly.>$B$BThe elf is right. The forces of Felwood have seeped into Darkshore and sickened my people.

text.title: 熊爪草
text.objectives: 给黑木要塞的熊怪长者带去8株熊爪草。
text.description: 费伍德森林的邪恶萨特把毒下到了黑海岸，下到了我们的土地上。腐化荼毒着大地，扭曲着生活在这里的生物。我的人也不例外。$B$B光靠我们的魔法是不足以把他们恢复原状的。有一种草药，叫做熊爪草，我们曾用来退烧固本。有了它，我们可以阻挡萨特的感染。药草就长在村子附近的野地里。
text.progress: Have you gathered the bear's paw?
text.completion: These are poor, weak stalks, but they are all we have. The corruption spreads quickly, even among the plants of the forest.

english.title: The Bear's Paw
english.objectives: Bring 8 stalks of Bear's Paw to Elder Brolg at Blackwood Hold.
english.description: The foul satyr of Felwood have started to introduce their poison into Darkshore, into our lands. Their corruption kills the land and twists the creatures who live in it. My people are no exception.$B$BOur magic alone is not enough to bring them back to their senses. There is an herb, called bear's paw, that we use to break fevers and fortify the weak. With its help, we may be able to break the influence of the satyr. The herb grows in the wilds around the village.
english.progress: Have you gathered the bear's paw?
english.completion: These are poor, weak stalks, but they are all we have. The corruption spreads quickly, even among the plants of the forest.

text.title: 食性无常
text.objectives: 从传声盒413号东边的腐烂的熊尸上获取一份样本。
text.description: <机器嗡嗡地响了一阵，然后维兹班恩的声音突然传了过来。>$B$B真有意思！腐化的源头肯定是来自外部——这没什么好奇怪的——但这就说明它们多半是吃了什么不洁的东西。也许是一头大型哺乳动物，很可能是熊。$B$B到海滩上去给我找一具熊的尸体来。稍稍往东应该就能找到，就在海滩的内陆方向。把样本带回镇子来。
text.progress: Welcome back! Did you find that bear sample that I was looking for?
text.completion: This definitely looks like the stuff they were eating. Let me take a closer peek...
text.completed: Return to Wizbang Cranktoggle at Lor'danel.

english.title: No Accounting for Taste
english.objectives: Retrieve a sample from a decomposing bear carcass east of Buzzbox 413.
english.description: <The machine buzzes for a few moments  before Wizbang's voice breaks through.>$B$BInteresting! The source of this corruption definitely came from something external--no surprises there--but it appears that in this case they've been eating something foul. A large mammal probably. Most likely a bear.$B$BSearch the beach for a bear carcass for me. Slightly east of there would make the most sense, on the inland side of the beach. Bring me the sample back at town.
english.progress: Welcome back! Did you find that bear sample that I was looking for?
english.completion: This definitely looks like the stuff they were eating. Let me take a closer peek...
english.completed: Return to Wizbang Cranktoggle at Lor'danel.

text.title: 传声盒723号
text.objectives: 收集6份堕落蓟熊的精华，把它们放到传声盒723号里去分析。
text.description: 我们已经确定了其他几种动植物也遭到了感染。事实上知道螃蟹通过熊肉传染，这是一个好消息——它很可能意味着所有的感染都来自于同一病源。我们现在要先把注意力集中在这些熊身上。$B$B传声盒723号就在东边的瀑布附近，这活儿可能挺脏的，不过很有必要——我要你去弄点新鲜的熊精华来，放到传声盒里去分析。你那儿一有消息我就赶过去。
text.progress: <Buzzbox 723 hums at you expectantly.>
text.completion: <Static precedes Wizbang's distorted voice.>$B$BThe results are coming in now. We should have some information on how the bears contracted this in just a moment.
text.completed: Bring the samples to Buzzbox 723 near the falls.

english.title: Buzzbox 723
english.objectives: Gather 6 samples of Corrupted Thistle Bear Guts and bring them to Buzzbox 723 for analysis.
english.description: There are a couple other forms of wildlife that we've verified infected. It's actually good news that the crabs appear to have caught this from the bears - hopefully that means this all stems from one source. We need to focus our attention on those bears now.$B$BBuzzbox 723 is near the waterfalls to the east. It's going to be messy work, but it's necessary - I'll need you to bring some fresh bear guts to that buzzbox for analysis. We'll go from there once I have the information.
english.progress: <Buzzbox 723 hums at you expectantly.>
english.completion: <Static precedes Wizbang's distorted voice.>$B$BThe results are coming in now. We should have some information on how the bears contracted this in just a moment.
english.completed: Bring the samples to Buzzbox 723 near the falls.

text.title: 腐化的源头
text.objectives: 杀掉峭泉洞的赛恩·腐蹄和8名邪劣魔。
text.description: 我一听到维兹班恩的消息就尽快赶过来了。我知道是谁在背后捣鬼了。赛恩·腐蹄。$B$B他因为研习禁断魔法被赶出来后就来到了泰达希尔。他利用腐化的行径不容于我族，而这次他更是变本加厉，或许是为了复仇所致。$B$B赛恩已经被姑息得太久了，这一次我们要惩奸除害。杀掉赛恩和他的爪牙，然后到洛达内尔来找我。
text.completion: It is done then. Thank you. I only hope that the wildlife here will see more peace with his passing.
text.completed: Return to Tharnariun Treetender at Lor'danel.
text.giverWindow: 耐心和美德都就到此为止了。有些底线决不能越过，但赛恩已经多次越界了。

english.title: The Corruption's Source
english.objectives: Kill Zenn Foulhoof and 8 Vile Grell in Cliffspring Hollow.
english.description: I rushed here as soon as I heard the news from Wizbang. I know who's behind this mess now. Zenn Foulhoof.$B$BHe came over from Teldrassil after he was chased out for performing perverse magics. The kinds of corruption he employs are not welcome among my people, and it seems he's taken it a step further this time, perhaps as some form of revenge.$B$BZenn's been given too many chances, it's time we remove this threat to all that is natural. Kill Zenn and his minions, and then find me back in Lor'danel.
english.completion: It is done then. Thank you. I only hope that the wildlife here will see more peace with his passing.
english.completed: Return to Tharnariun Treetender at Lor'danel.
english.giverWindow: Patience and virtue only go so far. Some lines must never be crossed, and Zenn has crossed several of them.

text.title: 尝尝石斑鱼
text.objectives: 使用技能钓4黑海岸石斑鱼。
text.description: 又是乘船又是造房子，我累坏了……也饿极了。你知道什么听上去最美味吗？鱼。鱼听上去特别好吃。$B$B黑海岸盛产石斑鱼，要是你给我弄几条，我不会亏待你的。
text.progress: <Johnathan's belly grumbles as you approach.>$B$BCouldn't have said it better with words.
text.completion: It looks like fishing's your thing. My belly appreciates the gift.$B$BI'm thinking you would get more use out of this pole than I would. Have at it.
text.completed: Return to Johnathan Staats in Lor'danel.

english.title: A Taste for Grouper
english.objectives: Use your fishing skill to obtain 4 Darkshore Grouper.
english.description: Between boat rides and building, I'm exhausted... and hungry. You know what sounds tasty? Fish. Fish sound delicious.$B$BDarkshore is known for its grouper. If you fish me up some, I'll make it worth your time.
english.progress: <Johnathan's belly grumbles as you approach.>$B$BCouldn't have said it better with words.
english.completion: It looks like fishing's your thing. My belly appreciates the gift.$B$BI'm thinking you would get more use out of this pole than I would. Have at it.
english.completed: Return to Johnathan Staats in Lor'danel.

text.title: 南部的塔楼
text.objectives: 摧毁影目塔楼、火光塔楼或冬缘塔楼，然后向冬拥湖的参谋官安布拉米斯复命。
text.description: 冬拥河南边的三座塔楼正在从堡垒中吸取能量！$B$B去摧毁影目塔楼、火光塔楼或冬缘塔楼，然后回来向我报告。记住，只有攻城车辆可以对塔楼造成伤害，所以你要保护好我们的攻城车，别让部落把它们给拆了！
text.progress: Do you bring word from the south?
text.completion: I heard the explosion from here! Excellent job - we've already begun rerouting the power into the Titan relic to super-charge our own forces.
text.completed: Return to Tactical Officer Ahbramis in Wintergrasp.

english.title: Southern Sabotage
english.objectives: Destroy Shadowsight Tower, Flamewatch Tower or Winter's Edge Tower and return to Tactical Officer Ahbramis in Wintergrasp.
english.description: The three towers south of the Wintergrasp river are draining power from the Fortress! $B$BDestroy Shadowsight Tower, Flamewatch Tower or Winter's Edge Tower, then return to me. Remember, only siege vehicles can damage a tower, so make sure to protect them from the Horde!
english.progress: Do you bring word from the south?
english.completion: I heard the explosion from here! Excellent job - we've already begun rerouting the power into the Titan relic to super-charge our own forces.
english.completed: Return to Tactical Officer Ahbramis in Wintergrasp.

objectiveDetails.description: 摧毁南部三座塔楼中的一座

text.title: 摧毁塔楼
text.objectives: 摧毁影目塔楼、火光塔楼或冬缘塔楼，然后向冬拥湖的参谋官基尔拉斯复命。
text.description: 虽然联盟正在围攻我们的城门，但是一名真正的战略家所关注的永远不是眼前的局势，而是更长远的谋划。$B$B“攻其不备，出其不意。”$B$B$n，我要派你越过冬拥河，摧毁南部的塔楼。我们的术士报告说，那些塔楼正在吸取能量，而那些能量本应是我们用来增强自身部队战斗力的。$B$B摧毁一座塔楼，然后回来向我报告。
text.progress: My disgust for Warlocks is only exceeded by my hate for the undead. However, they can both prove useful at times.
text.completion: Now in order to kill the enemy, our men must be roused to anger; that there may be advantage from defeating the enemy, they must have their rewards. I hope that these are sufficient for your service to the Horde.
text.completed: Return to Tactical Officer Kilrath in Wintergrasp.

english.title: Toppling the Towers
english.objectives: Destroy Shadowsight Tower, Flamewatch Tower, or Winter's Edge Tower and return to Tactical Officer Kilrath in Wintergrasp.
english.description: While the Alliance may be pounding on our doors, a true tactician looks beyond the obvious.$B$B"Attack him where he is unprepared, appear where you are not expected."$B$B$n, I need you to travel across the Wintergrasp River and destroy one of the three towers to the south. Our Warlocks report that the towers are draining power we could use to bolster our own troops.$B$BReturn to me once you've destroyed a tower.
english.progress: My disgust for Warlocks is only exceeded by my hate for the undead. However, they can both prove useful at times.
english.completion: Now in order to kill the enemy, our men must be roused to anger; that there may be advantage from defeating the enemy, they must have their rewards. I hope that these are sufficient for your service to the Horde.
english.completed: Return to Tactical Officer Kilrath in Wintergrasp.

objectiveDetails.description: 在冬拥湖南部摧毁一座塔楼

text.title: 对抗暴风
text.objectives: 使用奥伯丁废墟里的月亮井，摧毁8副狂暴飓风的护腕。
text.description: 假如我们想从暮光之锤手里夺回奥伯丁废墟，那就得先对付他们召唤出来的元素。$B$B这就要靠你了。$B$B瞧，我没指望你收复整个镇子，但当我们在这里治疗的时候，你就可以去帮我们削弱一下他们的兵力。$B$B要永远根除狂暴飓风，朝西走，杀掉它们，拿上他们的护腕，把它们放在月井里就行了。这样就会摧毁护腕，阻止元素再度被召唤。
text.completion: I cannot thank you enough, $N. Now we'll have a fighting chance to retake the ruins as soon as we are in better health.
text.completed: Return to Sentinel Selarin at the Auberdine Refugee Camp in Darkshore.

english.title: Against the Wind
english.objectives: Use the moonwell in the Ruins of Auberdine to destroy 8 sets of Frenzied Cyclone Bracers.
