english.description: If we're going to take the Ruins of Auberdine back from the Twilight's Hammer, the elementals that they've summoned must be dealt with on a permanent basis.$B$BThat's where you come in.$B$BLook, I don't expect you to retake the town, but while we're healing up here, you can soften them up for us.$B$BTo permanently deal with the frenzied cyclones, head west, kill them, take their bracers, and put them in the moonwell. That will destroy the bracers and keep those elementals from being resummoned.
english.completion: I cannot thank you enough, $N. Now we'll have a fighting chance to retake the ruins as soon as we are in better health.
english.completed: Return to Sentinel Selarin at the Auberdine Refugee Camp in Darkshore.

text.title: 三柄将碎之锤
text.objectives: 杀死克劳坦莫·蛮鬃、御气大师祖祖和啸天者布纳克斯。
text.description: 我在奥伯丁废墟上飞了一圈作了下侦查。摧毁我们镇子的元素的背后主使正是三名暮光之锤异教徒。$B$B去西边的废墟，杀掉克劳坦莫·蛮鬃、御气大师祖祖和啸天者布纳克斯。$B$B在此之后哨兵塞拉伊和她的部队才有机会夺回我们的家乡。
text.completion: Without those three coaxing them, perhaps the flow of elementals into the Ruins of Auberdine will be stemmed.$B$BThank you, $N.
text.completed: Return to Corvine Moonrise at the Auberdine Refugee Camp in Darkshore.

english.title: Three Hammers to Break
english.objectives: Slay Cloudtamer Wildmane, Windmaster Tzu-Tzu, and Skylord Braax.
english.description: I've flown through the ruins of Auberdine on a scouting mission. There are three Twilight's Hammer cultists that are responsible for the elementals that have overrun the destroyed town.$B$BHead west into the ruins. Seek out and slay Cloudtamer Wildmane, Windmaster Tzu-Tzu, and Skylord Braax.$B$BOnly then will Sentinel Selarin and her forces stand a chance of taking back their home.
english.completion: Without those three coaxing them, perhaps the flow of elementals into the Ruins of Auberdine will be stemmed.$B$BThank you, $N.
english.completed: Return to Corvine Moonrise at the Auberdine Refugee Camp in Darkshore.

text.title: 熊的祝福
text.objectives: 把受祝福的草药包带给黑木要塞的熊怪长者。
text.description: 只有做出完整的草药包并且使其受到祝福之后，熊爪草才能用来净化感染。村子的北边游荡着一只叫做迅足的陆行鸟。你需要用它的尾羽来完成草药包。$B$B找到迅足后继续朝北，把尾羽和一捆熊爪草带到古树之林附近废墟的远古熊雕像处。$B$B在祭坛上，将尾羽和熊爪草合在一起，接受熊灵的祝福。
text.progress: Have you visited the old bear statue?
text.completion: <Elder Brolg accepts the blessed bundle from you and looks over it.>$B$BThis is exactly what we needed. The bear's spirit favors us and there may be hope for my brothers after all.

english.title: The Bear's Blessing
english.objectives: Elder Brolg at Blackwood Hold wants you to bring him the Blessed Herb Bundle.
english.description: Before the bear's paw can be used to cleanse the afflicted, it must be completed and blessed. To the north of the village roams a tallstrider named Fleetfoot. You'll need its tailfeathers to complete the herb bundle.$B$BBring the tailfeathers and the bear's paw bundle to the ancient bear statue in the ruins around the Grove of the Ancient, further north of where you'll find Fleetfoot.$B$BWhile at the shrine, combine the tailfeathers with the bear's paw and receive the bear spirit's blessing.
english.progress: Have you visited the old bear statue?
english.completion: <Elder Brolg accepts the blessed bundle from you and looks over it.>$B$BThis is exactly what we needed. The bear's spirit favors us and there may be hope for my brothers after all.

text.title: 净化感染者
text.objectives: 熊怪长者要你用受祝福的草药包净化7名黑木要塞的熊怪，并杀掉令他们发狂的污染之魂。
text.description: 有了神圣的草药和熊灵的祝福，你就能用它来净化我的兄弟们了。来自费伍德森林的腐化令他们发狂，攻击任何胆敢接近的人。你要做好被黑木攻击的准备，直到你将附身在他们之中的污染之魂铲除为止。$B$B当你把我的弟兄们都解放出来以后，回来告诉我。
text.completion: You have done well. My people have begun to emerge from their madness, but they will fall back into it if we do not deal with the source of the corruption.
text.completed: Return to Elder Brolg at Blackwood Hold.

english.title: Cleansing the Afflicted
english.objectives: Elder Brolg wants you to use the Blessed Herb Bundle to cleanse 7 furbolg of Blackwood Hold and kill the Spirits of Corruption driving them mad.
english.description: With the sacred herbs and the bear's blessing, you must use this herb bundle to cleanse my brothers. The corruption spilling over from Felwood has driven them mad and they will attack any who come near. Expect the afflicted Blackwood to be angry with you until you have slain the spirits of corruption that haunt them.$B$BWhen you have freed my brothers from their madness, return to me.
english.completion: You have done well. My people have begun to emerge from their madness, but they will fall back into it if we do not deal with the source of the corruption.
english.completed: Return to Elder Brolg at Blackwood Hold.

text.title: 污染者
text.objectives: 黑木要塞的熊怪长者要你去击败污染者萨纳克斯。
text.description: 费伍德森林的碧火萨特来到了黑海岸，污染了这里的土地、河水，以及他们所遭遇的生物。你已经见识过腐化对我的人和他们家园的影响了。要是我们不把萨特赶走，所有人都要面临同样的命运。$B$B污染者萨纳克斯，黑木受灾的罪魁祸首就在东边的洞里。杀掉他，$n，把我们从他的手里解放出来。让萨特瞧瞧黑木可不会坐以待毙。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. You are a hero to my people. Without you, we would be doomed to madness and death. May the bear spirit always watch over you.

english.title: The Defiler
english.objectives: Elder Brolg at Blackwood Hold wants you to kill Sharax the Defiler.
english.description: The Jadefire satyrs of Felwood have found their way into Darkshore, tainting the land, water, and creatures they encounter. You've seen what their corruption has done to my people and their homes. If we do not turn back the satyrs, all of us will share that fate.$B$BWithin the cave to the east is Sharax the Defiler, the satyr responsible for the ills of the Blackwood. Slay him, $n, and free us from his influence. Show the satyr that the Blackwood will not lay down and die so easily.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. You are a hero to my people. Without you, we would be doomed to madness and death. May the bear spirit always watch over you.

text.title: 说服灵魂
text.objectives: 说服桑迪斯·织风、艾莉萨·星风、塔尔丹以及凯莱斯·月羽的灵魂。
text.description: 你在难民营的那些朋友对暮光之锤给我们这个世界带来的真正危险浑然不知。$B$B而你，则要对付这日益接近的威胁。在此之前我们必须先得到奥伯丁亡者的帮助。$B$B在镇子的废墟里找到桑迪斯·织风、艾莉萨·星风、塔尔丹以及凯莱斯·月羽的尸体。同他们通灵，然后回到我这里来。
text.completion: So much death and pain. Can there be any doubt that there is more yet to come?$B$BAll I wish to do is move onward into the Goddess's embrace as do these others.$B$BBut first, let us see if we can keep even more misery and destruction from being spread.
text.completed: Return to Yalda at the Ruins of Auberdine in Darkshore.

english.title: Coaxing the Spirits
english.objectives: Coax the spirits from Thundris Windweaver, Elissa Starbreeze, Taldan, and Caylais Moonfeather.
english.description: Your friends back at the refugee camp are unaware of the true and imminent danger that the Twilight's Hammer cultists have already brought into the world.$B$BFor you to deal with that, we'll first need to get some help from the dead of Auberdine.$B$BSearch through the ruins of the town and find the corpses of Thundris Windweaver, Elissa Starbreeze, Taldan, and Caylais Moonfeather. Coax the spirits from their bodies and then return with them to me here.
english.completion: So much death and pain. Can there be any doubt that there is more yet to come?$B$BAll I wish to do is move onward into the Goddess's embrace as do these others.$B$BBut first, let us see if we can keep even more misery and destruction from being spread.
english.completed: Return to Yalda at the Ruins of Auberdine in Darkshore.

objectiveDetails.description: 说服桑迪斯·织风的灵魂
说服艾莉萨·星风的灵魂
说服凯莱斯·月羽的灵魂

text.title: 糖罐
text.completion: Candy buckets like this are located in inns throughout the realms. Go ahead... take some!

english.title: Candy Bucket
english.completion: Candy buckets like this are located in inns throughout the realms. Go ahead... take some!

text.title: 拎尾巴
text.objectives: 希姆托加的记载者图基尼希望你对冰霜豹和冰爪熊使用麻醉飞镖，并给他带回三头雌性冰霜豹和三头雌性冰爪熊。
text.description: 除了达卡莱巨魔的古物之外，我还打算带一些祖达克地区的野生动物回到赞达拉去。我收集了一些雄性冰霜豹和冰爪熊，但是没有雌性怎么行呢？$B$B糟糕的是，我的猎人在一次不幸的事故中死亡了。也许你愿意替代他的位置？$B$B使用这支吹管催眠冰霜豹和冰爪熊，然后拎起它们的尾巴检查一下，如果是雌性的，就把它们带回这里。你可以在伦诺克、奎丝鲁恩和哈克娅的祭坛周围找到它们。
text.progress: No, that just won't do. Please return when you have the female leopards and bears that I'll need for the arduous journey back home.
text.completion: Very fine specimens indeed, $N! These are sure to provide many hours of curious speculation amongst my colleagues back home.
text.completed: Return to Chronicler To'kini at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Tails Up
english.objectives: Chronicler To'kini at Zim'Torga wants you to use To'kini's Blowgun on Frost Leopards and Icepaw Bears. Return to him with 3 females of each.
english.description: Along with the Drakkari artifacts, I'm interested in returning to Zandalar with some of the Zul'Drak wildlife. I have males of both the frost leopards and icepaw bears, but I need females!$B$BToo bad that my trapper was killed in a most unfortunate accident. Perhaps you would be willing to fill in for him?$B$BPut the leopards and bears to sleep with this blowgun then lift their tails and return with some females if you would be so kind. They can be found near the Altars of Rhunok, Quetz'lun, and Har'koa.
english.progress: No, that just won't do. Please return when you have the female leopards and bears that I'll need for the arduous journey back home.
english.completion: Very fine specimens indeed, $N! These are sure to provide many hours of curious speculation amongst my colleagues back home.
english.completed: Return to Chronicler To'kini at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 黑暗中的解药
text.objectives: 从峭泉洞的生物身上收集6份脏污的液体样本。
text.description: <机器里传来阵阵不可理喻的讲话，直到你再次听到维兹班恩的声音。>$B$B暮色鼠！他们在吃暮色鼠！这些小混蛋只能在一个地方找到，东边朝悬崖的一个洞里。找条通向东北的小径，瀑布下应该有一处开口。$B$B暮色鼠不是在那儿沾上了什么脏东西，就是有人故意在它们身上散布病原——不管怎样，给我带些样本回来就成！
text.progress: Did you get to the stuff? The sooner I can start working on a cure, the more animals we can save!
text.completion: This should be plenty! Thanks so much! I'll get working on a cure for this nastiness immediately.
text.completed: Return to Wizbang Cranktoggle at Lor'danel.

english.title: A Cure In The Dark
english.objectives: Retrieve 6 Samples of Foul Ichor from the creatures inside Cliffspring Hollow.
english.description: <Some unintelligible speech spews forth from the machine before you make out Wizbang's voice again.>$B$BDuskrats! They've been eating the duskrats! Those little buggers only come from one place, a cave against the cliff-face to the east. Find a path up to the northeast and look for an opening under the waterfall.$B$BThe duskrats there are either getting into something nasty or someone's intentionally spreading some agent through them - in either case, just bring me back several samples of the stuff!
english.progress: Did you get to the stuff? The sooner I can start working on a cure, the more animals we can save!
english.completion: This should be plenty! Thanks so much! I'll get working on a cure for this nastiness immediately.
english.completed: Return to Wizbang Cranktoggle at Lor'danel.

text.title: 杜布拉金需要迅猛龙卵
text.objectives: 杜布拉金的哈瓦纳希望你去收集12枚古达克迅猛龙卵。
text.description: 最近怎么样啊，朋友？你能不能帮我一个忙？拜基妮想要一些迅猛龙的蛋，用来献祭给杜布拉金。$B$B你以为我们为什么还没有被达卡莱巨魔给踏平？当然是因为杜布拉金的庇护和帮助！$B$B你可以去古达克地区的树木周围收集迅猛龙的蛋。有时候迅猛龙也会把蛋带在身上，好让它保持温暖。
text.progress: Who woulda thought the great Dubra'Jin be wantin' so many eggs? What he gonna do with them anyway?
text.completion: One, two, three,... hehe, that be a good number o' them, mon! Now we be safe for quite some time!
text.completed: Return to Ha'wana at Dubra'Jin in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Eggs for Dubra'Jin
english.objectives: Ha'wana at Dubra'Jin needs you to collect 12 Gundrak Raptor Eggs.
english.description: How ya doin', mon? Thinkin' ya might be helpin' me out? Bah'Kini be needin' lots o' the raptor eggs to be sacrificin' to Dubra'Jin.$B$BHow ya thinkin' we not be overrun yet by the Drakkari? Dubra'Jin be lendin' us his aid!$B$BWe need ya to gather up the raptor eggs from around the trees outside here in Gundrak. Sometimes the raptors carry 'em to keep 'em warm, too.
english.progress: Who woulda thought the great Dubra'Jin be wantin' so many eggs? What he gonna do with them anyway?
english.completion: One, two, three,... hehe, that be a good number o' them, mon! Now we be safe for quite some time!
english.completed: Return to Ha'wana at Dubra'Jin in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 幸运儿
text.objectives: 释放被关在峭泉洞捕兽笼里的8头未堕落的蓟熊或未堕落的暮色鼠。
text.description: 这把钥匙好像是用来打开峭泉洞各处捕兽笼用的。你若是趁此机会放几只未受感染的暮色鼠和蓟熊出来，萨纳瑞恩肯定会感谢你的。
text.progress: Yes, $r?
text.completion: I am pleased to hear that you were able to free some of the remaining wildlife. With a bit of good fortune, we will find the cure for the corruption that the others have faced before any more of them die.
text.completed: Speak to Tharnariun Treetender at Lor'danel.

english.title: Bearer of Good Fortune
english.objectives: Free 8 Uncorrupted Thistle Bears or Uncorrupted Duskrats from the cages in Cliffspring Hollow.
english.description: This key appears to be for the animal cages spread throughout Cliffspring Hollow. Tharnariun would surely appreciate if you took advantage of the situation to free some of the uncorrupted duskrats and thistle bears that are still being held captive.
english.progress: Yes, $r?
english.completion: I am pleased to hear that you were able to free some of the remaining wildlife. With a bit of good fortune, we will find the cure for the corruption that the others have faced before any more of them die.
english.completed: Speak to Tharnariun Treetender at Lor'danel.

text.title: 降雷之术
text.objectives: 用阿瑟里恩的仪式宝珠来获得阿瑟里恩的精华。
text.description: 阿瑟里恩就要来到我们的世界了，不过还来得及对付他！$B$B码头的尽头浮着一颗仪式宝珠，我要你用它把仪式完成，从他的漩涡中把元素领主召唤出来。$B$B相信我，$n，我和你解放的其他灵魂会大大削弱阿瑟里恩。但是，只有你才能把他解决掉，以免黑海岸的卡多雷人民遭受灭顶之灾。$B$B将他的精华交给难民营的柯维恩·月升好让他知道。
text.progress: You have returned. What news do you bring?
text.completion: Yalda? The spirits of others from the Ruins of Auberdine?$B$B<The druid ponders what you've conveyed about your adventure in the ruins.>$B$BI remember them all. They will be dearly missed, but they have moved on into the Goddess's embrace and that is for the best.$B$BAnde'thoras-ethil, may your troubles be diminished, $N!
text.completed: Return to Corvine Moonrise at the Auberdine Refugee Camp in Darkshore.

english.title: Call Down the Thunder
english.objectives: Use Aetherion's Ritual Orb and obtain Aetherion's Essence.
english.description: Aetherion is almost in our world, but he can still be dealt with!$B$BAt the end of the dock floats a ritual orb. I want you to use it to complete the ritual, beckoning the elemental lord down from his vortex.$B$BTrust me, $n, I and the other spirits that you have freed will greatly weaken Aetherion. However, it will be up to you to finish him off for good and save the Kaldorei people of Darkshore from utter destruction.$B$BDeliver his essence to Corvine Moonrise at the refugee camp so he will know.
english.progress: You have returned. What news do you bring?
english.completion: Yalda? The spirits of others from the Ruins of Auberdine?$B$B<The druid ponders what you've conveyed about your adventure in the ruins.>$B$BI remember them all. They will be dearly missed, but they have moved on into the Goddess's embrace and that is for the best.$B$BAnde'thoras-ethil, may your troubles be diminished, $N!
english.completed: Return to Corvine Moonrise at the Auberdine Refugee Camp in Darkshore.

text.title: 霍迪尔的供品
text.progress: No ordinary tributes were good enough for the great Hodir when he walked among the frost giants.$B$BHe might not be with us anymore, but we've kept the tradition of offering tribute to his strength and wisdom.  It would do much for your renown to partake in this tradition, small $c.
text.completion: The Sons of Hodir accept your tribute, small one.  You continue to prove your worth as an ally in more ways than one.

english.title: Hodir's Tribute
english.progress: No ordinary tributes were good enough for the great Hodir when he walked among the frost giants.$B$BHe might not be with us anymore, but we've kept the tradition of offering tribute to his strength and wisdom.  It would do much for your renown to partake in this tradition, small $c.
english.completion: The Sons of Hodir accept your tribute, small one.  You continue to prove your worth as an ally in more ways than one.

text.title: 不那么深的海洋
text.objectives: 洛达内尔的高尔博德·钢手要你去找盖瑞接受进一步指示。
text.description: 你看起来象是个能干的！$B$B瞧见海岸边的那些个船骸了吗……大多数都是老的，有些新的。我琢磨它们好久了，看是不是能弄点值钱的来派派用场，但那些成群出没的鱼人却不这么想。我派了无数的冒险者过去，没一个能回得来。$B$B别担心，我吸取教训了，同样的事不会发生在你的身上。朝正北方游，去找盖瑞，他会跟你解释新计划。其实真的很简单。
text.completion: The decoys worked then? Great to hear it! Don't you worry yourself one bit about the treasures. Me and Gary will take care of the rest this time around.$B$BTruth be told, if something went wrong again and I lost any more of you adventurer types, I'm pretty sure they'd kick me out of town.
text.completed: Return to Gorbold Steelhand in Lor'danel.

english.title: An Ocean Not So Deep
english.objectives: Gorbold Steelhand at Lor'danel wants you to speak to Gary for further instructions.
english.description: You look like an able sort!$B$BThere are a great number of wrecks off of the coast here... most old, some new. For quite some time, I've been trying to get at their holds and put their valuables to more use, but there's a nasty infestation of murlocs that seem to have other ideas. I've sent scores of adventurers and none have returned.$B$BWorry not, I've learned my lesson, and that is not your fate. Swim to the due north and look for Gary. He'll explain the new plan. It's pretty simple really.
english.completion: The decoys worked then? Great to hear it! Don't you worry yourself one bit about the treasures. Me and Gary will take care of the rest this time around.$B$BTruth be told, if something went wrong again and I lost any more of you adventurer types, I'm pretty sure they'd kick me out of town.
english.completed: Return to Gorbold Steelhand in Lor'danel.

text.title: 安抚上层精灵
text.objectives: 杀死6名被诅咒的上层精灵和6名痛苦的上层精灵。
text.description: 我来巴莎兰是为了超度那些上层精灵的孤魂，但我实在是下不了手。要是你能帮我的话，我会非常感激的。
text.completion: You have my thanks. Though they may not be able to show it, you have the thanks of the Highborne spirits as well.$B$BFare safely, traveler.
text.completed: Return to Arya Autumnlight on the road outside of Bashal'Aran.

english.title: Solace for the Highborne
english.objectives: Kill 6 Cursed Highborne and 6 Writhing Highborne.
english.description: I have come to Bashal'Aran to grant peace to the troubled spirits of the Highborne, but I find my hand hesitates with each blow. If you would like to aid me, you would have my gratitude.
english.completion: You have my thanks. Though they may not be able to show it, you have the thanks of the Highborne spirits as well.$B$BFare safely, traveler.
english.completed: Return to Arya Autumnlight on the road outside of Bashal'Aran.

text.title: 巴莎兰的终焉之焰
text.objectives: 熄灭巴莎兰的终焉之焰。
text.description: 尘世如魇，我们不得不驻足审视自己的生存之道。我们现在成了凡人，无论多么不希望，我们终将接受在这个世界中的全新命运。$B$B沿着路往南就到了巴莎兰，一度是我们祖先的城市，如今却是他们被诅咒的灵魂之所。我们抱着被救赎的希望，为他们，也为我们自己，但我们任它们饱受折磨的时间已经太长了。该是熄灭巴莎兰的终焉之焰的时候了。
text.completion: You have our thanks. It is time that we leave the past behind us, and start looking to our future.
text.end: 熄灭巴莎兰的终焉之焰
text.completed: 去找洛达内尔的游侠戈琳达·纳希恩。

english.title: The Final Flame of Bashal'Aran
english.objectives: Extinguish the Final Flame of Bashal'Aran.
english.description: It is in times like these that we are forced to stop and examine our way of life. We are mortal now, and no matter how much we desire otherwise, we are deserving of our new place in this world.$B$BBashal'Aran, down the road to the south, once a city of our ancestors, it now is home to their cursed ghosts. We held hope of salvation for them as with ourselves, but we have left them in torment for too long. It is time to extinguish the Final Flame of Bashal'Aran.
english.completion: You have our thanks. It is time that we leave the past behind us, and start looking to our future.
english.end: Extinguish the Final Flame of Bashal'Aran
english.completed: Return to Ranger Glynda Nal'Shea in Lor'danel.

text.title: 爱别离
text.objectives: 解放安娜雅·晨行者的灵魂，获取她的坠饰。
text.description: 我想对你的救命之恩致以感谢。我本该算是幸运的，但我的爱人，安娜雅，却与世长辞。我孑然一身，忧扰不堪。然而另一件令我悲不自胜的事发生了，我需要你再帮我一次。$B$B得救之后我踱步于黑海岸茂林，恍惚间误入巴莎兰废墟……在那里，我却目睹爱人的灵魂不得安息。$b$b她一定要得到解放，而我却不忍下手。请定要帮我超度她的灵魂。
text.progress: I somehow avoided being inflicted with the same toxin that the other survivors now endure. I cannot help but be envious of them to a degree though... living an eternity alone seems not worth living at all.$B$BI miss you so much, Anaya.
text.completion: Thank you, $n. Perhaps it would have been better... if I had done it myself. But even after these thousands of years, I could not bear to raise my hand against my beloved.$B$BPlease, I would be alone with my grief...
text.completed: Bring Anaya's pendant back to Cerellean Whiteclaw in Lor'danel.
text.giverWindow: 爱别离，怨长久，求不得，放不下。

english.title: A Love Eternal
english.objectives: Free the spirit of Anaya Dawnrunner and retrieve her pendant.
english.description: I would like to extend my gratitude for saving us. I would call myself fortunate, but my beloved, Anaya, lays long dead. I am alone and deeply troubled, and sadly, I require your aid yet again.$B$BWandering the woods of Darkshore after my rescue, I found myself in the ruins of Bashal'Aran... where I saw the haunted spirit of my beloved.$b$bShe must be freed, but I lack the heart to do it. Her spirit must be destroyed.
english.progress: I somehow avoided being inflicted with the same toxin that the other survivors now endure. I cannot help but be envious of them to a degree though... living an eternity alone seems not worth living at all.$B$BI miss you so much, Anaya.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. Perhaps it would have been better... if I had done it myself. But even after these thousands of years, I could not bear to raise my hand against my beloved.$B$BPlease, I would be alone with my grief...
english.completed: Bring Anaya's pendant back to Cerellean Whiteclaw in Lor'danel.
english.giverWindow: For some, letting go is the hardest thing they will ever have to do.

text.title: 失踪的伙伴
text.objectives: 找到锐爪。
text.description: 请帮帮我……我都坐不起来了。$B$B我的朋友，一头叫做锐爪的熊，不在了。离开奥伯丁前我派他去通知哨兵我们启程的消息，可他没能来。我们走的时候就觉得有什么不对，但撤离得匆忙，我没能有机会做什么。$B$B要是他受伤了，他只会去一个地方——枯萎林地，就在奥伯丁北面，从这儿沿着路往南就是。把他替我安全的带回来……他是我唯一的家人了。
text.completion: Greetings, traveler. You seem to have an interest in my friend here. You're here on behalf of his friend Volcor then I imagine? If Volcor didn't come himself, he must be injured as well. I hope he recovers quickly.$B$BGimclaw is too injured to be moved far and he's going to need some immediate treatment. I'm afraid I can't let you take him back just yet, but perhaps you can help me while I tend to him.

english.title: A Lost Companion
english.objectives: Locate Grimclaw.
english.description: Please help... I can barely sit up.$B$BMy friend, a bear named Grimclaw, he's not here. I sent him ahead to let the Sentinels know we were coming before we left Auberdine, but he never arrived. I sensed something might be amiss as we were leaving, but with the evacuation, I never had a chance to act on it.$B$BIf he's injured, there's only one place that he would go - the Withering Thicket, north of Auberdine, down the road to the south from here. Bring him back to me safely... he's my only family.
english.completion: Greetings, traveler. You seem to have an interest in my friend here. You're here on behalf of his friend Volcor then I imagine? If Volcor didn't come himself, he must be injured as well. I hope he recovers quickly.$B$BGimclaw is too injured to be moved far and he's going to need some immediate treatment. I'm afraid I can't let you take him back just yet, but perhaps you can help me while I tend to him.

text.title: 今非昔比
text.objectives: 石化之根召唤6名枯萎的树人，剿除纳迦首领简妮拉女士。
text.description: 我们无法忍受无端的暴力——这不是我们的本性。但是，有时候避而不战带来的后果反而更加严重，纳迦就是个例子。$B$B当山崩地裂之时，一小片废墟在东边浮现。这些废墟一度由艾萨拉女皇忠臣执掌，现如今她的人仿佛回归来寻找什么东西。$B$B带上这石化之根，你可以对他们的阵亡者使用，召唤出树人来帮助你。赶紧把他们和他们的首领消灭掉。
text.completion: Thank you, ally. We shall keep a more vigilant eye should they return.
text.completed: Return to Seraphine at the Withering Thicket.
text.giverWindow: 这些纳迦在黑海岸遗迹中搜寻着失落的宝物，但暗夜精灵已经厌倦于招待这些不速之客了。他们应当为擅闯付出代价。

english.title: Twice Removed
english.objectives: Use the Petrified Root to raise 6 Withered Ents and dispatch the naga leader, Lady Janira.
english.description: We cannot condone reckless violence - it is not our nature. However, there are times when the consequences of avoiding battle are too tangible to ignore, as is the case with these naga.$B$BWhen the earth in the area shattered, a small section of ruins rose to our east. These ruins once housed those loyal to Queen Azshara, and it seems her kind have returned in search of something.$B$BTake this petrified root. You can use it on their fallen to raise ents to aid you. Deal with them and their leader swiftly.
english.completion: Thank you, ally. We shall keep a more vigilant eye should they return.
english.completed: Return to Seraphine at the Withering Thicket.
english.giverWindow: The naga seek something valuable within the ruins of Darkshore, but have long since exhausted the hospitality of the night elves. They shall suffer for their trespass.

text.title: 仪式的材料
text.objectives: 收集3根月夜猛虎之须、3把杂斑母鹿毛以及3块蓟熊毛皮。
text.description: 在我照顾锐爪的当口，我要你从附近的动物身上收集一些仪式用的材料来，但别见血。$B$B我需要的是西边月夜猛虎的胡须——从睡着的身上拔，然后赶紧跑。$B$B还有东边母鹿的毛，不要公鹿的。$B$B最后，我要东北水边熊的毛皮。等他们抓上一条鱼还没吃完的时候迅速动手。$B$B请不要伤着他们。
text.progress: Have you retrieved the materials that I asked for? And please tell me that you did not harm any of the animals in the process...
text.completion: These will do perfectly. These are the final ingredients for an incense I've been working on. I will explain in just a moment, let me mix these in first.
text.completed: Return to Keeper Karithus at the Withering Thicket.

english.title: Ritual Materials
english.objectives: Retrieve 3 Moonstalker Whiskers, 3 Tufts of Mottled Doe Hair, and 3 Thistle Bear Fur.
english.description: While we tend to Grimclaw, I would like you to peacefully gather some ritual materials for me from the nearby wildlife.$B$BI need whiskers from the moonstalkers to the west- pluck them from the sleeping ones and move away quickly.$B$BI need hair from the doe to the east, just avoid the stags.$B$BFinally, I need fur from the bears along the water to the northeast. Wait until they catch a fish, then get the sample quickly and get away before they finish eating.$B$BPlease do not harm any of them.
english.progress: Have you retrieved the materials that I asked for? And please tell me that you did not harm any of the animals in the process...
english.completion: These will do perfectly. These are the final ingredients for an incense I've been working on. I will explain in just a moment, let me mix these in first.
english.completed: Return to Keeper Karithus at the Withering Thicket.

text.title: 雄鹿巨灵
text.objectives: 守护者卡里修斯吩咐你接受雄鹿巨灵的祝福。
text.description: 在这片林子里居住着三位巨灵，雄鹿巨灵、蓟熊巨灵，以及月夜猛虎巨灵。这些巨灵都是强大的盟友，但你只能投靠其中之一。$B$B你若是愿意投靠雄鹿巨灵，便将这焚香带到巴莎兰北面的树林里。在你和巨灵中间点起焚香，在它面前冥想，接受他的试炼，获得他的祝福。成功之后，再来找我。
text.completion: I am the caretaker for my kind, leading not through force, but through wisdom and swift action. Wisdom is what carries us into the deeper forest when danger beckons and swiftness is what leaves our enemies basking in our absence.$B$BIn this wisdom, I see through to your true intentions, and I know that you are deserving of my blessing, the blessing of my swiftness. It can be yours, but know that the other spirits will not welcome you once you proceed - consider this carefully before accepting my boon.

english.title: Spirit of the Stag
english.objectives: Keeper Karithus has instructed you to receive the blessing of the Great Stag Spirit.
english.description: In these woods reside three great spirits, that of the Stag, that of the Thistle Bear, and that of the Moonstalker. These spirits make powerful allies, but you can only align yourself with one of them.$B$BIf you wish to align yourself with the Great Stag Spirit, take this incense to the woods just north of Bashal'Aran. Meditate before the great spirit while burning the incense on the ground between you, and face his trial to earn his blessing. Should you succeed, return to me.
english.completion: I am the caretaker for my kind, leading not through force, but through wisdom and swift action. Wisdom is what carries us into the deeper forest when danger beckons and swiftness is what leaves our enemies basking in our absence.$B$BIn this wisdom, I see through to your true intentions, and I know that you are deserving of my blessing, the blessing of my swiftness. It can be yours, but know that the other spirits will not welcome you once you proceed - consider this carefully before accepting my boon.

text.title: 月夜猛虎巨灵
text.objectives: 守护者卡里修斯吩咐你接受月夜猛虎巨灵的祝福。
text.description: 在这片林子里居住着三位巨灵，雄鹿巨灵、蓟熊巨灵，以及月夜猛虎巨灵。这些巨灵都是强大的盟友，但你只能投靠其中之一。$B$B你若是愿意投靠月夜猛虎巨灵，便将这焚香带到洛雷斯塔废墟南面的大地上。在你和巨灵中间点起焚香，在它面前冥想，接受他的试炼，获得他的祝福。成功之后，再来找我。
text.completion: I share these forests willingly, accepting night elf kind into my home, and on occasion calling them friend. Though they have been tainted greatly in recent memory, I can see in you the same strength, honor, and spirit that first endeared them to me.$B$BIf you place value in the ferocity necessary to overcome all odds, then I am willing to call you my champion. Know now that if you side with my kind, the other spirits will not accept you, so consider your choice carefully.

english.title: Spirit of the Moonstalker
english.objectives: Keeper Karithus has instructed you to receive the blessing of the Great Moonstalker Spirit.
english.description: In these woods reside three great spirits, that of the Stag, that of the Thistle Bear, and that of the Moonstalker. These spirits make powerful allies, but you can only align yourself with one of them.$B$BIf you wish to align yourself with the Great Moonstalker Spirit, take this incense to the land just south of the Ruins of Lornesta. Meditate before the great spirit while burning the incense on the ground between you, and face his trial to earn his blessing. Should you succeed, return to me.
english.completion: I share these forests willingly, accepting night elf kind into my home, and on occasion calling them friend. Though they have been tainted greatly in recent memory, I can see in you the same strength, honor, and spirit that first endeared them to me.$B$BIf you place value in the ferocity necessary to overcome all odds, then I am willing to call you my champion. Know now that if you side with my kind, the other spirits will not accept you, so consider your choice carefully.

text.title: 誓缚仪式
text.objectives: 在守护者卡里修斯之前沐浴于焚香中，然后从雄鹿巨灵、蓟熊巨灵，以及月夜猛虎巨灵的祝福中选择其一。$B$B记住，你只可接受一位巨灵的祝福，因此请务必考虑周全。
text.description: 我要照顾锐爪直到他完全康复——他应该不久之后就能痊愈。在等待期间，我还有一个任务要交给你……事实上，你也看出来了，是一个赐福。$B$B我们周围的动物巨灵等待有人能帮他们阻止这场灭顶之灾。此时此刻，他们正和我们在一起，用你带来的材料，我可以让他们显灵。同这些巨灵交谈，选择一名，然后带着他们的祝福回到我这里来。
text.completion: So it is done. You have received the blessing of a great animal spirit, and I shall now complete the ritual for you. Please stand still.
text.completed: 去找枯萎林地的守护者卡里修斯。

english.title: The Ritual Bond
english.objectives: Breathe in the incense in front of Keeper Karithus, and then choose the blessing of the Great Stag Spirit, the Great Thistle Bear Spirit, or the Great Moonstalker Spirit.$B$BKeep in mind that you can only receive the blessing of one spirit, so choose wisely.
english.description: I will tend to Grimclaw until his rest is done - he will be ready to return very soon. I have one more task for you while we wait... a favor to grant you, really, should you recognize it.$B$BThe great wildlife spirits roam around us waiting and hoping for someone that will aid in stopping the destruction. They are with us as we speak even now, and with the materials  you brought me, I can grant you sight. Speak to these spirits, choose one, and return to me with their blessing.
english.completion: So it is done. You have received the blessing of a great animal spirit, and I shall now complete the ritual for you. Please stand still.
english.end: Receive the blessing of a great animal spirit.
english.completed: Return to Keeper Karithus in the Withering Thicket.

text.title: 失而复得
text.completion: Above the stale, unwashed stench, you catch a whiff of a familiar smell!  It appears as if this once-mighty adventurer has a real love for kungaloosh.$b$bPeeking through the bars, you can barely make out the recipe written on his arm....

english.title: Fletcher's Lost and Found
english.completion: Above the stale, unwashed stench, you catch a whiff of a familiar smell!  It appears as if this once-mighty adventurer has a real love for kungaloosh.$b$bPeeking through the bars, you can barely make out the recipe written on his arm....

text.title: 碧火火盆
text.objectives: 黑木要塞的戈伦·裂皮要你去摧毁8个碧火火盆。
text.description: 费伍德森林的萨特将他们的仇恨和污染带进了我们的土地。他们派了污染者萨纳克斯来征讨我们黑木部落的家园。$B$B除了荼毒大地、动植物以外，他还在村庄到处放置碧火火盆，以控制我们的人。光是摧毁火盆并不足以阻止他，但这能在你和熊怪长者解放我们的弟兄的同时削弱他的影响力。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. With your efforts, we might be able to save the Blackwood who remain.
text.completed: Return to Gren Tornfur at Blackwood Hold.

english.title: Jadefire Braziers
english.objectives: Gren Tornfur at Blackwood Hold wants you to destroy 8 Jadefire Braziers.
english.description: The satyrs of Felwood have started pouring their hate and corruption into our lands. They have sent Sharax the Defiler to subdue parts of the forest that we Blackwood call home.$B$BIn addition to poisoning the land, animals, and plants, he has set up Jadefire braziers throughout the village to help extend his control over our people. Destroying the braziers alone won't be enough to stop him, but it will help lessen his influence while you work with Elder Brolg to free our brothers.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. With your efforts, we might be able to save the Blackwood who remain.
english.completed: Return to Gren Tornfur at Blackwood Hold.

text.title: 玛法里奥的回归
text.objectives: 去找黑海岸难民营东南边漩涡之眼的玛法里奥·怒风
text.description: 最近，就在大灾变发生之前，我们才听说玛法里奥苏醒的消息。$B$B他一清醒就预言说若不采取行动，大地将被一分为二，而所有冲击波会如何汇聚在黑海岸。$B$B然后据说他就来到了这附近。我被派来找他，但光是帮助难民就让我分身乏术。$B$B也许你可以到东南边去帮我们找到他。
text.completion: There is no time to waste, $c.  It is taking every ounce of my power to keep Darkshore's entire landmass from being shattered and swept into the ocean... you must listen to me very carefully.

english.title: Malfurion's Return
english.objectives: Look for Malfurion Stormrage at the Eye of the Vortex southeast of the Refugee Camp in Darkshore.
english.description: It was only recently that we heard the news of Malfurion's awakening, mere moments before the Cataclysm occurred.$B$BAs soon as he regained consciousness, he gave a cryptic warning about the land splitting in two if something wasn't done and how all the shockwaves were converging here on Darkshore.$B$BHe then reportedly set off for somewhere in this vicinity.  I was sent here to find him, but I've found my hands full helping the refugees.$B$BPerhaps you could look for him to the southeast for us.
english.completion: There is no time to waste, $c.  It is taking every ounce of my power to keep Darkshore's entire landmass from being shattered and swept into the ocean... you must listen to me very carefully.

text.title: Peering Into the Vortex (DEPRECATED)
text.description: There is no time to waste, $r!  It is taking every ounce of my power to keep Darkshore's entire landmass from being shattered and swept into the ocean... you must listen to me very carefully.$B$BOn that hippogryph there is an orb.  Take the hippogryph to the top of the vortex and use the orb to sample the energy surrounding it.  Hurry, $n.  I don't know how much longer I can hold!

english.title: Peering Into the Vortex (DEPRECATED)
english.description: There is no time to waste, $r!  It is taking every ounce of my power to keep Darkshore's entire landmass from being shattered and swept into the ocean... you must listen to me very carefully.$B$BOn that hippogryph there is an orb.  Take the hippogryph to the top of the vortex and use the orb to sample the energy surrounding it.  Hurry, $n.  I don't know how much longer I can hold!

text.title: 大地的血脉
text.objectives: 跟漩涡之眼西南黑木营地的棕掌长者谈一谈。
text.description: 若是想要平复这股自然的破坏力量，我们需要尽可能的争取任何帮助。黑木部落的熊怪长期居住在这里，他们同这片土地有着深厚的联系。$B$B熊怪的萨满长老棕掌长者，拥有着强大的元素之力——他的援助将是无可取代的。去看看你是不是能得到他们的帮助。
text.completion: I have much respect for the great Malfurion Stormrage.  I cannot, however, leave my people in their time of need.  Maybe there is a way we can both help each other.

english.title: The Land Is in Their Blood
english.objectives: Speak to Elder Brownpaw at the Blackwood Camp southwest of the Eye of the Vortex.
english.description: If we're to stabilize the forces of nature, we'll need every little bit of help we can get.  The furbolg of the Blackwood tribe have long inhabited the area and have strong ties to the land.$B$BTheir elder Shaman, Elder Brownpaw, wields great power over the elements -- his assistance would be invaluable.  See if you can obtain their aid.
english.completion: I have much respect for the great Malfurion Stormrage.  I cannot, however, leave my people in their time of need.  Maybe there is a way we can both help each other.

text.title: 互惠互助
text.objectives: 使用抚慰图腾吸收8名肆掠的火元素的残余。
text.description: 我们的弟兄因为腐化而疯狂，我们别无选择只能借助你的力量，$r。我们愿意帮你……只要你能帮我们。$B$B你也看到了，我的人饱受火元素的滋扰。打退它们，用这根图腾消灭它们的残余。$B$B我们将把它们送回它们的来处……无论它们是否愿意。
text.completion: The element of fire is unique in that attacking it indiscriminately can often lead it to spreading further... succeeding only in agitating its flames.$B$BWe are wiser than that, $N.  We are going to dispose of it properly.
text.completed: Return to Elder Brownpaw at Blackwood Camp in Darkshore.

english.title: Mutual Aid
english.objectives: Use the Soothing Totem to absorb the remains of 8 Unbound Fire Elementals.
english.description: With most of our brethren losing their way to madness or corruption, it would seem that we have little choice but to ally with you, $r.  You can count on our aid... once you've proven we can count on yours.$B$BAs you can see, my people are having a bit of a problem with the fire elementals.  Help fight them and use this totem on their fiery remains.$B$BWe will return them to where they belong... whether they like it or not.
english.completion: The element of fire is unique in that attacking it indiscriminately can often lead it to spreading further... succeeding only in agitating its flames.$B$BWe are wiser than that, $N.  We are going to dispose of it properly.
english.completed: Return to Elder Brownpaw at Blackwood Camp in Darkshore.

text.title: 最后的枭兽
text.objectives: 跟漩涡之眼北方沐月兽穴的阿隆姆谈一谈。
text.description: 黑海岸的枭兽一度为数众多，他们与这片土地羁绊深厚。大灾变撕裂了黑海岸，同时也让他们濒临灭绝。$B$B枭兽阿隆姆是他们部落中的最后一员，同时也是一名强大的长老，同艾露恩有着紧密的联系。他的帮助将大大有益于大地的痊愈——你可以在北边的沐月兽穴找到他。
text.completion: A terrible sadness surrounds the creature.  Its eyes stare beyond you as you approach it.

english.title: The Last Wildkin
english.objectives: Speak to Aroom at the Moontouched Den north of the Eye of the Vortex.
english.description: The wildkin were once numerous in Darkshore.  Such are their ties to the land that the Cataclysm that shattered Darkshore also decimated their numbers.$B$BThe wildkin Aroom is the last of his tribe and is a powerful elder with a strong connection to Elune.  His help will be most necessary in healing the land -- you will find him north of here at the Moontouched Den.
english.completion: A terrible sadness surrounds the creature.  Its eyes stare beyond you as you approach it.

text.title: 阿隆姆的告别
text.objectives: 获得8根死去野枭兽的羽毛。
text.description: <这生物看到你，悲伤地嘶鸣着。>$B$B阿隆姆是部族里的最后一名幸存者了……$B$B其他人无法安息……需要安葬。把其他枭兽的羽毛带给阿隆姆……让他们安息。$B$B然后阿隆姆才能帮你。
text.progress: You bring others' feathers?
text.completion: I thank you, $R. Soon my kin will rest.
text.completed: Return to Aroom at the Moontouched Den in Darkshore.

english.title: Aroom's Farewell
english.objectives: Obtain 8 Slain Wildkin's Feathers.
english.description: <The creature hoots sadly as it addresses you.>$B$BAroom is last of tribe...$B$BOthers won't rest... need funeral pyre.  Bring Aroom the feathers of others.... let them rest.$B$BThen Aroom help you.
english.progress: You bring others' feathers?
english.completion: I thank you, $R. Soon my kin will rest.
english.completed: Return to Aroom at the Moontouched Den in Darkshore.

text.title: 亚米萨兰的保护者
text.objectives: 跟亚米萨兰废墟的瑟里恩谈一谈。
text.description: 没有什么比栖息在其中生物的力量能更快地治疗大地了。好在我们暗夜精灵的一些盟友既是这样的生物，同时也是大地自身。$B$B战争古树瑟里恩负责守护南边的亚米萨兰废墟。去那里寻求他的帮助。
text.completion: If the great Malfurion requires my presence, it is my duty to heed his call.  It is also my duty to protect these ruins, however.$B$BPerhaps you'll help me fulfill both my obligations, $N?

english.title: Protector of Ameth'Aran
english.objectives: Speak to Selenn at the Ruins of Ameth'Aran.
english.description: Nothing will repair the land quicker than the strength of those who inhabit it.  We night elves are fortunate that some of our best allies just happen to be both the land and its inhabitants at once.$B$BThe Ancient of War known as Selenn was charged with guarding the ruins of Ameth'Aran, to the south.  Go there and seek his help.
english.completion: If the great Malfurion requires my presence, it is my duty to heed his call.  It is also my duty to protect these ruins, however.$B$BPerhaps you'll help me fulfill both my obligations, $N?

text.title: 安抚元素
text.objectives: 将充能的安抚图腾放在炽热海岸附近的礁石顶部，保护它直到仪式结束。
text.description: 它们的火焰之灵已经纳入图腾之中。将它带到炽热海岸附近的锯齿暗礁上。$B$B图腾的安抚之力可以渐渐将元素的戾气洗刷涤荡。$B$B你必须保护好图腾，因为火焰对安抚仪式的反应通常不是那么友好。
text.completion: We are in your debt, $N.  Perhaps now, with Malfurion's help, we can save the rest of Darkshore.
text.completed: Return to Elder Brownpaw at the Blackwood Camp in Darkshore.

english.title: Soothing the Elements
english.objectives: Place the Charged Soothing Totem at the top of the reef near the Blazing Strand and protect it until the ritual is complete.
english.description: Their fiery spirits are contained in the totem now.  Take it to the top of the Jagged Reef near the Blazing Strand and set it on the ground.$B$BThe totem's soothing energies will slowly wash over the elementals until their fury simmers down to calm.$B$BYou must protect the totem, for fire does not react favorably to the ritual of soothing.
english.completion: We are in your debt, $N.  Perhaps now, with Malfurion's help, we can save the rest of Darkshore.
english.completed: Return to Elder Brownpaw at the Blackwood Camp in Darkshore.

text.title: 黑木誓言
text.objectives: 去找漩涡之眼的玛法里奥·怒风。
text.description: 虽然不是马上，但元素之怒不久将会平息，我的人也将重振雄风。$B$B我会尽我所能去帮助你和玛法里奥。
text.completion: This is fortunate news, $N.  The furbolg may seem little more than a savage race, but their ties to the land are ancient and their shamans are second to none.

english.title: The Blackwood Pledge
english.objectives: Return to Malfurion Stormrage at the Eye of the Vortex.
english.description: It won't be immediate, but the elementals' anger will soon die down and my people will live to fight another day.$B$BI will go help you and Malfurion in any way that I can.
english.completion: This is fortunate news, $N.  The furbolg may seem little more than a savage race, but their ties to the land are ancient and their shamans are second to none.

text.title: 艾露恩之火
text.objectives: 从护火者霍鲁那里获得月神之火。
text.description: 我们的仪式需要特殊的火焰。我们需要的是艾露恩之火。$B$B霍鲁的灵魂游荡在东部，他带着月神的火炬。把它带来，让灵魂们安息。$B$B阿隆姆感谢你。
text.progress: You have torch?
text.completion: <Aroom lets out a long low-pitched hoot.>$B$BFinally kin may rest.
text.completed: Return to Aroom inside the Moontouched Den in Darkshore.

english.title: Elune's Fire
english.objectives: Obtain Elune's Torch from Horoo the Flamekeeper.
english.description: We need special flame for ritual.  We need Elune's fire.$B$BHoroo's spirit wanders east of here.  Horoo carries torch of Elune.  Bring here so spirits rest.$B$BAroom thanks you.
english.progress: You have torch?
english.completion: <Aroom lets out a long low-pitched hoot.>$B$BFinally kin may rest.
english.completed: Return to Aroom inside the Moontouched Den in Darkshore.

text.title: 枭兽之誓
text.objectives: 去找漩涡之眼的玛法里奥·怒风。
text.description: 枭兽与月神同在。阿隆姆现在欠你的情。$B$B阿隆姆现在帮你。回到玛法里奥那里去，我随后就来。
text.completion: The wildkin were once the guardians of the land.  It is good to hear they haven't all forgotten their old ways.

english.title: The Wildkin's Oath
english.objectives: Return to Malfurion Stormrage at the Eye of the Vortex.
english.description: Wildkin with Elune.  Aroom in your debt now.$B$BAroom help you now.  Return to Malfurion, I join you soon.
english.completion: The wildkin were once the guardians of the land.  It is good to hear they haven't all forgotten their old ways.

text.title: 平息土地
text.objectives: 消灭8名被激怒的大地元素。
text.description: 假如我现在放弃岗位，任那么多的元素在废墟肆意妄为，那就是渎职。$B$B在帮助玛法里奥之前，我们得先对付它们。你怎么说，小家伙？
text.completion: It's become clear, $N.  The elements won't be calm until Malfurion succeeds in returning balance to the land.  Aiding him is, in a way, also fulfilling my task.
text.completed: Return to Selenn at the Ruins of Ameth'Aran in Darkshore.

english.title: Calming the Earth
english.objectives: Kill 8 Enraged Earth Elementals.
english.description: I would be neglecting my responsibility if I abandoned my post just now, with so many elementals out of control in the ruins.$B$BLet us deal with them first, before we see how we can aid Malfurion.  What do you say, small one?
english.completion: It's become clear, $N.  The elements won't be calm until Malfurion succeeds in returning balance to the land.  Aiding him is, in a way, also fulfilling my task.
english.completed: Return to Selenn at the Ruins of Ameth'Aran in Darkshore.

text.title: 誓死保护
text.objectives: 跟黑海岸漩涡之眼的玛法里奥·怒风谈一谈。
text.description: 我在这里的职责已经履行了。告诉玛法里奥我不久就加入他。$B$B祝你好运，$n。也祝我们都好运。
text.completion: Excellent job, $N!  Selenn's help in holding back the vortex will be invaluable.

english.title: Sworn to Protect
english.objectives: Talk to Malfurion Stormrage at the Eye of the Vortex in Darkshore.
english.description: My duty here has been fulfilled as best it can.  Send word to Malfurion that I'll be joining him soon.$B$BGood luck to you, $n.  Good luck to all of us.
english.completion: Excellent job, $N!  Selenn's help in holding back the vortex will be invaluable.

text.title: 翡翠梦境
text.objectives: 穿过碎地者洞穴的梦魇之门，同塔丝瑟拉交谈。
text.description: 我们阻止毁灭的努力成效甚微。恐怕我们还需要来自他界的援助。$B$B东边碎地者洞穴里暮光邪教徒们打开了一道界门，通往翡翠梦境被噩梦感染的区域。他们抓住了一条名叫塔丝瑟拉的绿龙。$B$B穿过梦魇之门，把她救出来。她将是一名强大的盟友。
text.completion: Malfurion calls?  Yes... I can hear his voice through the dream...

english.title: The Emerald Dream
english.objectives: Step through the Nightmare Portal in the Earthshatter Cavern and speak to Thessera.
english.description: Our efforts in containing the destruction don't appear to be quite enough.  I fear we're going to need aid from beyond the waking world.$B$BTwilight cultists inside the Earthshatter Cavern to the east have opened a gateway to a nightmare-infested section of the Emerald Dream.  They hold a green dragon prisoner named Thessera there.$B$BGo through the nightmare portal and free her.  She will be a powerful ally.
english.completion: Malfurion calls?  Yes... I can hear his voice through the dream...

text.title: 清醒的梦魇
text.objectives: 从碎地者洞穴的噩梦守护者那里获得翡翠卷轴。
text.description: 玛法里奥的话是对的，小家伙。即将撕裂黑海岸的裂隙也威胁着这个世界和你们的世界。$B$B让我尽我所能帮助你，以免我们两个世界都遭到灭顶之灾。$B$B首先，你得从下面大厅里的噩梦守护者那里获得翡翠卷轴，好将我从禁锢中解放出来。
text.progress: Did you find it, $N?
text.completion: I thank you, $N.  You've given me my freedom.  Let's see what we can do for your world now.
text.completed: Return to Thessera inside the Earthshatter Cavern in Darkshore.

english.title: The Waking Nightmare
english.objectives: Obtain the Emerald Scroll from the Nightmare Guardian inside the Earthshatter Cavern.
english.description: Malfurion's words are true, small one.  The rift that threatens to split Darkshore in half also threatens the separation between this world and yours.$B$BLet me aid you in any way that I can, lest further rifts between our worlds amplify the destruction taking place in both places.$B$BFirst you must undo the shackles cast upon me by retrieving the emerald scroll from the nightmare guardian that roams the halls below.
english.progress: Did you find it, $N?
english.completion: I thank you, $N.  You've given me my freedom.  Let's see what we can do for your world now.
english.completed: Return to Thessera inside the Earthshatter Cavern in Darkshore.

text.title: 群风之眼
text.objectives: 乘塔丝瑟拉打败12名暮光龙骑兵，并摧毁暮光传送门。
text.description: 暮光龙骑兵在漩涡上方盘旋。恐怕正是他们的魔法阻碍着我们抑制灾变之力。$B$B同塔丝瑟拉一起飞上天空，消灭那些龙骑兵和他们得以前来的传送门。
text.completion: We are turning the tides, $N.  We should be able to contain further damage.$B$BMuch work still remains to be done.
text.completed: Return to Malfurion Stormrage at the Eye of the Vortex in Darkshore.

english.title: The Eye of All Storms
english.objectives: Ride Thessera to defeat 12 Twilight Riders and destroy the Twilight Portal.
english.description: Twilight riders circle the skies above the vortex.  I fear it is their magic that has kept the cataclysmic forces from being contained by our efforts.$B$BTake to the skies with Thessera and destroy the riders and the portal from whence they came.
english.completion: We are turning the tides, $N.  We should be able to contain further damage.$B$BMuch work still remains to be done.
english.completed: Return to Malfurion Stormrage at the Eye of the Vortex in Darkshore.

text.title: 碎矛入侵者
text.objectives: 去找玛塞斯特拉废墟的莫拉·星风中尉。
text.description: 好像光有大地和元素跟我们作对还不够似的，东北边的巨魔也有所动作，开始做战争的准备了。我不知道他们的目的是什么，但他们攻击我们的斥候，围攻奥萨拉克斯之塔的邪教徒。$B$B我们已经派了一支最为精良的哨兵小分队前去展开反击。你不妨到东北方的废墟去支援他们，我肯定他们用得着人手。
text.completion: Glynda sent you to lend a hand, did she? I'm glad she did - I could certainly use the help.$B$BI'm working on our initial plans to start whittling away at their ranks. Please feel free to help Tysha and Balthule in the meantime.

english.title: The Shatterspear Invaders
english.objectives: Report to Lieutenant Morra Starbreeze at the Ruins of Mathystra.
english.description: If we didn't have enough on our hands with the land and the elements turning against us, it seems something has riled up the trolls to the northeast, and they've started on a war path. I'm not sure what their aims are, but they've already attacked several of our scouts and have besieged the cultists at the Tower of Althalaxx.$B$BWe've sent a contingent of our best Sentinels to counter their attacks. If you would travel northeast to the ruins and join them, I'm certain that they could use the extra hand.
english.completion: Glynda sent you to lend a hand, did she? I'm glad she did - I could certainly use the help.$B$BI'm working on our initial plans to start whittling away at their ranks. Please feel free to help Tysha and Balthule in the meantime.

text.title: 前线
text.objectives: 去找碎矛谷的女猎手桑德娅·月落。
text.description: 他们的力量被削弱了，他们的补给被摧毁了，他们的小头目也死了。是时候进攻他们的老巢，干掉他们的首领了。我得承认，直到现在我还是无从得知隐藏在他们突然袭击背后的企图，但也许我们能在他们的家门口找到答案。$B$B带上这支巴苏尔准备的箭，去向山谷深处参加战斗的桑德娅·月落报告。最好骑一头夜刃豹去——步行会很危险。
text.progress: Greetings, $c. Did you bring the arrow?
text.completion: It is good to meet you. Word has been sent to me of the efforts you have made to aid us against the trolls, and I must admit I am a bit impressed. The final fight is upon us now, I hope you are prepared.

english.title: The Front Line
english.objectives: Report to Huntress Sandrya Moonfall deep in Shatterspear Vale.
english.description: Their forces are weakened, their supplies destroyed, and their subleaders are dead. It is time for us to take this fight to their home, and their leader. I'm admittedly still in the dark as to what spurred their sudden aggression, but perhaps we will find some answers on their doorstep.$B$BTake this arrow that Balthule prepared and report to Sandrya Moonfall deep in Shatterspear Vale to join the attack. It would be best to secure a ride on one of our nightsabers - going on foot would be dangerous.
english.progress: Greetings, $c. Did you bring the arrow?
english.completion: It is good to meet you. Word has been sent to me of the efforts you have made to aid us against the trolls, and I must admit I am a bit impressed. The final fight is upon us now, I hope you are prepared.

text.title: 令人不安的联系
text.objectives: 将地狱咆哮的信函带给洛达内尔的游侠戈琳达·纳希恩。
text.description: 加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮的信清楚地证实了我们对这次碎矛突袭动机的怀疑。被遗忘者出现在了高塔废墟，以及部落对碎矛战争营地的补给支援只是一个开始。加尔鲁什本人支持着碎矛对洛达内尔的进攻，而且表明他打算朝南全面推进。$B$B一定要把这个情报告诉戈琳达·纳希恩，让暗夜精灵们做好准备。
text.progress: You're back! I hear the battle went well.
text.completion: Well, this news is disturbing indeed. I will start dispatching messengers to Ashenvale immediately and see if we can't get some reinforcements prepared for them.$B$BI cannot thank you enough for all the help you've lent us in these trying times. Such heroic deeds deserve reward. I think I might have something that will serve you perfectly.

english.title: Disturbing Connections
english.objectives: Bring the Hellscream's Missive to Ranger Glynda Nal'Shea at Lor'danel.
english.description: The letter from Garrosh Hellscream makes clear the suspicions that were raised during the offensive on the Shatterspear. The presence of forsaken at the tower ruins and horde supplies and enforcers at the Shatterspear War Camp were only the start. Garrosh himself contacted the Shatterspear to spur their offensive towards Lor'danel, and it seems clear that he fully intends to push from the south as well.$B$BGlynda Nal'Shea will need this information if the night elves are to be prepared.
english.progress: You're back! I hear the battle went well.
english.completion: Well, this news is disturbing indeed. I will start dispatching messengers to Ashenvale immediately and see if we can't get some reinforcements prepared for them.$B$BI cannot thank you enough for all the help you've lent us in these trying times. Such heroic deeds deserve reward. I think I might have something that will serve you perfectly.

text.title: 勇士的实战训练
text.objectives: 银色比武场的马库斯·巴洛爵士要你消灭10名被转化的英雄。
text.description: 在锦标赛上，你可以和你的战友们一起练习技术，但是时刻都不要忘记，我们真正的敌人——天灾军团绝不会坐等灭亡。你不但要和队友切磋，还要在与敌人的战斗中磨砺自己的刀锋。$B$B到位于陨落英雄之谷西南和恐惧之门科雷萨以北的那个地区去。天灾军团正在那里复活死亡的英雄们，并将他们变成我们的敌人。击败那些天灾军团的爪牙，让我们的勇士得到安息，并在那里磨砺你的战斗技艺。
text.progress: Have you tested yourself in combat against the Scourge?
text.completion: Welcome back from your exercises, $N. Even while we practice for the competition, it's good to remind ourselves that the Scourge is still out there.
text.completed: Return to Sir Marcus Barlowe at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: A Valiant's Field Training
english.objectives: Sir Marcus Barlowe at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 10 Converted Heroes.
english.description: The tournament is a time for testing your skills against your peers, but we must not forget that the real enemy, the Scourge, will not wait. As you hone your skills against others, so should you maintain your edge in combat against the enemy.$B$BTravel to the area southwest of the Valley of Fallen Heroes and north of Corp'rethar. There, the Scourge raises dead heroes and turns them against us. Defeat these minions of the Scourge, do honor to our allies, and keep yourself prepared for combat.
english.progress: Have you tested yourself in combat against the Scourge?
english.completion: Welcome back from your exercises, $N. Even while we practice for the competition, it's good to remind ourselves that the Scourge is still out there.
english.completed: Return to Sir Marcus Barlowe at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 暴风城的勇士
text.objectives: 如果你想要成为暴风城的勇士，就再找雅克布·奥勒留斯元帅谈一谈。
text.description: 欢迎你，冠军。对你英勇战斗的事迹，我们早有耳闻。你是否希望加入我们暴风城代表团，参加锦标赛？$B$B你可以像以前一样训练并提升自己的级别，不过如果你获得了暴风城冠军的称号，就可以在参赛时让你的侍从打出我们的旗帜。
text.completion: We are proud that you have agreed to train with us and compete on our behalf.

english.title: Valiant Of Stormwind
english.objectives: Speak with Marshal Jacob Alerius again if you wish to become a valiant of Stormwind.
english.description: Welcome, champion. Word of your combat prowess has already reached my ears. Do you seek to join Stormwind's tournament delegation?$B$BYou will train and rise through the ranks as you have before, but when you are named a champion of Stormwind, your squire will have the option of carrying our banner into battle.
english.completion: We are proud that you have agreed to train with us and compete on our behalf.

text.title: 别忘了部落
text.objectives: 在巴斯兰鬼屋杀死任意10名部落。
text.description: 埃凡纳和其他的学徒们在战场上派不了多少用场，但你看上去像是能照顾好自己的人。得有人管管大路东边巴斯兰鬼屋的部落混账们。$B$B他们的新酋长加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮，就没带他们干什么好事。想不想教训教训他们？$B$B我也愿意和你一起去，但是我的任务是留在这里，保护奥雷迪尔的学徒们，我只好照办。
text.completion: <The sentinel eyes you appreciatively for a moment.>$B$BA job well done, $c. If you're any indication of the quality of the $r adventurers we're going to be seeing more of, we should have this war against the orcs and their Horde taken care of faster than expected.
text.completed: Return to Sentinel Shyela at Orendil's Retreat in Ashenvale.

english.title: Don't Forget the Horde
english.objectives: Kill any 10 Horde at Bathran's Haunt.
english.description: Evenar and the other apprentices may not be much use in a battle, but you look like you can more than hold your own. The Horde scum across the road to the east at Bathran's Haunt need to be taught a lesson.$B$BTheir new warlord, Garrosh Hellscream, has them up to no good. Feel like teaching them a thing or two?$B$BI'd come with you, but my assignment is to stay here and protect Orendil's apprentices, and that's exactly what I'm going to do.
english.completion: <The sentinel eyes you appreciatively for a moment.>$B$BA job well done, $c. If you're any indication of the quality of the $r adventurers we're going to be seeing more of, we should have this war against the orcs and their Horde taken care of faster than expected.
english.completed: Return to Sentinel Shyela at Orendil's Retreat in Ashenvale.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败巴斯兰鬼屋的部落

text.title: 自食其果
text.objectives: 获得一瓶火种，把它扔在巴斯兰的尸体上，将其烧掉。
text.description: 这些生物……这些所谓的部落……把我生生地砍倒，割下我的头发去实施他们的邪恶计划。$B$B你能不能帮我结束这一切，小$r？$B$B我听到他们的药草师在对面高谈阔论什么火种的事情。要是你能把那瓶邪恶的东西拿来，扔在东北方我的尸体上，就可以把它焚烧殆尽，我的头发也不会在这里长出来了。$B$B我已经死了，为了阻止他们，这点代价算不得什么。
text.completion: You have helped me to return to the ground, $N.$B$BNow my hair will cease to sprout for these creatures. Better yet, I will be regrown all the sooner.
text.completed: Return to Bathran at Bathran's Haunt in Ashenvale.

english.title: Of Their Own Design
english.objectives: Obtain a Bottle of Wildfire and throw it at Bathran's Corpse to burn it.
english.description: These creatures... these so-called Horde... they have cut me down in my prime and they are harvesting my hair for their evil plans.$B$BWill you help me to put an end to it, little $r?$B$BI have overheard their herbalists speaking of something called wildfire upon their table across the way. If you were to take the bottle of this unnatural stuff and throw it at my corpse to the northeast, it would burn and no more of my hair will grow here.$B$BI am already dead and it is a small price to pay to stop them.
english.completion: You have helped me to return to the ground, $N.$B$BNow my hair will cease to sprout for these creatures. Better yet, I will be regrown all the sooner.
english.completed: Return to Bathran at Bathran's Haunt in Ashenvale.

text.title: 暮光计划
text.objectives: 在暮光营地搜集6份暮光计划书。
text.description: 我们还没有完全掌握西南暮光之锤邪教徒的意图。恐怕是要攻打洛达内尔，但他们的动机可能远不止如此。$B$B我要你去暮光营地把他们的计划书弄到手。赶快，$n。我们可能没多少时间了。
text.progress: Have you obtained the plans yet, $n?
text.completion: Excellent job, $n. Now give me a moment to examine the plans you've brought me.
text.completed: Return to Sentinel Lendra at Lor'danel in Darkshore.

english.title: Twilight Plans
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Twilight Plans at the Twilight Encampment.
english.description: We're not fully aware of the intentions of the Twilight's Hammer cultists to the southwest.  We fear an attack on Lor'danel, however their motives might go well beyond that.$B$BI need you to go to the Twilight Encampment and get your hands on their plans.  Hurry, $n.  We might not have much time.
english.progress: Have you obtained the plans yet, $n?
english.completion: Excellent job, $n. Now give me a moment to examine the plans you've brought me.
english.completed: Return to Sentinel Lendra at Lor'danel in Darkshore.

text.title: 蓟熊巨灵
text.objectives: 守护者卡里修斯吩咐你接受蓟熊巨灵的祝福。
text.description: 在这片林子里居住着三位巨灵，雄鹿巨灵、蓟熊巨灵，以及月夜猛虎巨灵。这些巨灵都是强大的盟友，但你只能投靠其中之一。$B$B你若是愿意投靠蓟熊巨灵，便将这焚香带到大漩涡东面的洞穴里。在你和巨灵中间点起焚香，在它面前冥想，接受他的试炼，获得他的祝福。成功之后，再来找我。
text.completion: For countless ages I have walked these forests and lived in these mountains. Through snow and fire, I have watched civilizations crumble and nature press on. Now, the very earth turns against us, and it becomes very apparent that we must fight if our legacy is to continue.$B$BYour heart is true, and I would choose you as our champion. If you value the thick hide and resilience of my kind, then accept my boon. Know that the other spirits will not accept you once this choice is made, so choose wisely.

english.title: Spirit of the Thistle Bear
english.objectives: Keeper Karithus has instructed you to receive the blessing of the Great Thistle Bear Spirit.
english.description: In these woods reside three great spirits, that of the Stag, that of the Thistle Bear, and that of the Moonstalker. These spirits make powerful allies, but you can only align yourself with one of them.$B$BIf you wish to align yourself with the Great Thistle Bear Spirit, take this incense to a cave just east of the great whirlpool. Meditate before the great spirit while burning the incense on the ground between you, and face his trial to earn his blessing. Should you succeed, return to me.
english.completion: For countless ages I have walked these forests and lived in these mountains. Through snow and fire, I have watched civilizations crumble and nature press on. Now, the very earth turns against us, and it becomes very apparent that we must fight if our legacy is to continue.$B$BYour heart is true, and I would choose you as our champion. If you value the thick hide and resilience of my kind, then accept my boon. Know that the other spirits will not accept you once this choice is made, so choose wisely.

text.title: 良药苦口
text.objectives: 采集6株熏烟伞菌。
text.description: 毫无疑问在我的治疗魔法下锐爪会恢复健康，不过那些攻击他的偷猎者可就难说了。不过，我还是要用药膏来愈合他的伤口，给他止痛。$B$B在东边你可以找到洛雷斯塔废墟，在断壁残垣中你可以找到大量生长在潮湿环境中的熏烟伞菌。给我采一点来，我好给我们的朋友制作一份药膏。
text.progress: Grimclaw is quite the fierce combatant. I feel somewhat sorry for those poachers, despite their aims.
text.completion: You have my thanks, young one. We should be able to speed Grimclaw's recovery dramatically with this salve.
text.completed: Return to Keeper Karithus at the Withering Thicket.

english.title: Unsavory Remedies
english.objectives: Recover 6 Fuming Toadstools.
english.description: I have no doubts that Grimclaw will recover with the help of my healing magics, though I can't say the same for the poachers that attacked him. Still, I could use some salve to close his wounds and lessen his pain while he heals.$B$BTo the east you will find the Ruins of Lornesta. Among the crumbled stones, there is a variety of fuming toadstool that flourishes in the damp environment. Bring me some of the toadstools so that I can mix a salve for our friend here.
english.progress: Grimclaw is quite the fierce combatant. I feel somewhat sorry for those poachers, despite their aims.
english.completion: You have my thanks, young one. We should be able to speed Grimclaw's recovery dramatically with this salve.
english.completed: Return to Keeper Karithus at the Withering Thicket.

text.title: 锐爪复元
text.objectives: 去找洛达内尔的沃科尔和锐爪。
text.description: 仪式已经完成，祝福已经生根。它会让你在这片土地上畅行无阻。$B$B锐爪已经完全康复。我还没来得及阻止他，他就奔向洛达内尔了。我想这就是说你也该动身了。$B$B能遇见你实在是荣幸。现在，再会——帮我向沃科尔和锐爪问好。
text.completion: You've returned! It is good to see you again. I suppose we have you to thank for Grimclaw's return?$B$BI'm afraid... I have some bad news. I've been unable to purge the toxin... their conditions worsen. Gershalla died shortly after you left, and Volcor... Volcor passed just before you came back.$B$BHe lived long enough to see Grimclaw come back safely, so he died with a smile on his face. I'm just sorry that I couldn't do more.$B$BFor now, I'm doing everything I can to save Shaldyn, so please excuse me.

english.title: Grimclaw's Return
english.objectives: Return to Volcor and Grimclaw in Lor'danel.
english.description: With the binding complete, the blessing has taken hold. It will most certainly make your travels in these lands easier.$B$BGrimclaw made a full recovery. Before I could do anything to stop him, he bolted off towards Lor'danel. I suppose that means it's time for your departure.$B$BIt was a great pleasure to have met you. For now, farewell - send my best wishes to Volcor and Grimclaw.
english.completion: You've returned! It is good to see you again. I suppose we have you to thank for Grimclaw's return?$B$BI'm afraid... I have some bad news. I've been unable to purge the toxin... their conditions worsen. Gershalla died shortly after you left, and Volcor... Volcor passed just before you came back.$B$BHe lived long enough to see Grimclaw come back safely, so he died with a smile on his face. I'm just sorry that I couldn't do more.$B$BFor now, I'm doing everything I can to save Shaldyn, so please excuse me.

text.title: 珍贵的武器
text.objectives: 将达克玛尔之剑交给银色比武场的雅克布·奥勒留斯元帅。
text.description: 为什么我的运气总是烂到家了呢？我的比赛用剑无影无踪了！$B$B在吟游诗人的传说里，如果哪位旅人能给一位孤独的女士带去几朵冬水仙，就可以获得她的礼物。那些花只生长在铁墙大坝下游的浮冰上，就在晶歌森林的西北部，与冰冠冰川交界的地方。去摘些这种花，然后把花带到龙骨荒野东北部的达克玛尔湖去，就在该地区与祖达克、灰熊丘陵交界处的灯环中找到那位孤独女士。把花献给她，她会回赠你一把优秀的利剑。
text.progress: Were the wandering bard's tales true? Have you brought a blade?
text.completion: <The marshal accepts the Blade of Drak'Mar from you.>$B$BA fine weapon, and perfectly balanced. It will serve me well in the next match.
text.completed: Return to Marshal Jacob Alerius at the Argent Tournament Grounds.

english.title: A Worthy Weapon
english.objectives: Bring the Blade of Drak'Mar to Marshal Jacob Alerius at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Of all the times to have such rotten luck!$B$BMy tournament blade has gone missing. I've heard the bards telling tales of travelers offering winter hyacinths to a lonely maiden in return for gifts. Those hyacinths grow only on the ice flowing from the Ironwall Dam, on Crystalsong Forest's northwestern border with Icecrown. Gather the flowers and take them to the circle of lamps in Drak'Mar Lake in northeastern Dragonblight, near Zul'Drak and Grizzly Hills. Ask the lonely maiden for a worthy blade.
english.progress: Were the wandering bard's tales true? Have you brought a blade?
english.completion: <The marshal accepts the Blade of Drak'Mar from you.>$B$BA fine weapon, and perfectly balanced. It will serve me well in the next match.
english.completed: Return to Marshal Jacob Alerius at the Argent Tournament Grounds.

text.title: 援助难民
text.objectives: 洛达内尔的哨兵兰德拉要你跟难民营的女祭司艾琳雅谈一谈。
text.description: 以艾露恩之名！看来许多我们以为在奥伯丁被攻打时丧生的人都逃到镇外的废墟来了。$B$B暮光营地的邪教徒们正打算除掉他们，还好你的突袭成功地打乱了他们的计划。$B$B到南边远处奥伯丁旧址东面的难民营去找女祭司艾琳雅吧。
text.completion: I thank you for coming to our assistance. As you can see, the refugees' situation is dire.

english.title: In Aid of the Refugees
english.objectives: Sentinel Lendra at Lor'danel wants you to speak to Priestess Alinya at the Refugee Camp.
english.description: By Elune!  It appears that many of those we feared dead from the attack on old Auberdine have taken refuge in a camp outside the town ruins.$B$BThe cultists at the Twilight Encampment were planning on making quick work of them.  It's a good thing that you successfully attacked their position.$B$BSeek out Priestess Alinya at the Refugee Camp east of old Auberdine and far south of here.
english.completion: I thank you for coming to our assistance. As you can see, the refugees' situation is dire.

text.title: 海岸的纳迦
text.objectives: 在佐拉姆海岸杀死15只怒尾纳迦。
text.description: 邪恶的力量正潜伏在西边的海岸附近。$B$B海面下长眠着一座在天崩地裂时被摧毁的城市：佐拉姆城。佐拉姆海岸正是它的葬身所在。暗夜精灵很久以前就失去了它，几乎将它遗忘。$B$B现在，出于某种未知的原因，纳迦回来了。但是这其中的原因并不重要，我们必须杀掉这些恶魔，将它们逼回深海！
text.completion: Very well done, $N. Your actions in the Zoram Strand against the naga are commendable.$B$BI know your feat was not easily accomplished, for the strength and guile of the naga is well known to the night elves. We know this, for we share a history with them.$B$BThe naga are cursed Highborne night elves. Ten thousand years ago, Queen Azshara made a pact of desperation with the Old Gods to save her surviving people from a watery grave.$B$BThe naga are the result of that pact.
text.completed: Return to Shindrell Swiftfire at the Blackfathom Camp in Ashenvale.

english.title: Naga of the Strand
english.objectives: Slay any 15 Wrathtail naga at the Zoram Strand.
english.description: There is evil lurking on the coast to the west.$B$BThe Zoram Strand is the resting place of the doomed city of Zoram, destroyed during the Sundering and submerged beneath the seas. It has been lost to the night elves for ages. Lost, and nearly forgotten.$B$BNow, the naga have returned, and for what reason we do not know. But reason matters little; we must slay these fiends and throw them back to the depths!
english.completion: Very well done, $N. Your actions in the Zoram Strand against the naga are commendable.$B$BI know your feat was not easily accomplished, for the strength and guile of the naga is well known to the night elves. We know this, for we share a history with them.$B$BThe naga are cursed Highborne night elves. Ten thousand years ago, Queen Azshara made a pact of desperation with the Old Gods to save her surviving people from a watery grave.$B$BThe naga are the result of that pact.
english.completed: Return to Shindrell Swiftfire at the Blackfathom Camp in Ashenvale.

text.title: 冠军的利剑
text.objectives: 找到灰木之剑，把它交给银色比武场的雅克布·奥勒留斯元帅。
text.description: 啊，说实话，光靠锋利的钢剑是不足以获得胜利的。其他参赛者用的都是附有魔法的武器，这对我非常不利，不过这也不是什么大问题。$B$B一个流传于灰熊丘陵的古老传说中提到，那里有位女士为了守护一把剑受到诅咒，变成了一只青蛙。现在她就住在灰木哨站东边的灰木湖岸上，和其它的湖蛙生活在一起。根据传说，唯一能够解除这道诅咒的方法，是有人自愿去亲吻她。不过呢，你要记得先在嘴唇上涂抹这种药膏，然后再去亲吻湖蛙，不然你的嘴上会长疣的。
text.progress: Were you able to recover the blade?
text.completion: So the tales were true? This is a fine blade and I have no doubt that it will serve me well in the tournament. You have my thanks, $N.
text.completed: Return to Marshal Jacob Alerius at the Argent Tournament Grounds

english.title: A Blade Fit For A Champion
english.objectives: Retrieve the Ashwood Brand and bring it to Marshal Jacob Alerius at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Good, honest, honed steel may not carry the day. The other combatants are using enchanted blades and I find myself at a disadvantage, but all is not lost.$B$BThere's an old legend from Grizzly Hills about a maiden cursed with a frog's form to protect the blade she has long guarded. She lives among the lake frogs on the shore of Ashwood Lake, just east of Ashwood Post. The only thing said to break the curse is a kiss, freely given. Apply this balm before kissing anything, $n. Otherwise, you'll catch warts.
english.progress: Were you able to recover the blade?
english.completion: So the tales were true? This is a fine blade and I have no doubt that it will serve me well in the tournament. You have my thanks, $N.
english.completed: Return to Marshal Jacob Alerius at the Argent Tournament Grounds

text.title: 档案馆数据圆盘
text.objectives: 将档案馆数据圆盘带到奥杜尔的档案馆控制台前。
text.description: 这张白金圆盘的表面惊人地光滑匀称，没有一丝的划痕和瑕疵。在这张圆盘的边缘，有一行符文刻成的字：“档案馆”。$B$B奥杜尔内部一定有什么装置可以读取这张圆盘中包含的信息。
text.progress: The console whirrs with energy as the round receptacle opens.
text.completion: The platinum disc fits perfectly inside the console.  It begins to spin as its contents are scanned by white beams of light.
text.completed: Return to Archivum Console.

english.title: Archivum Data Disc
english.objectives: Bring the Archivum Data Disc to the Archivum Console in Ulduar.
english.description: This platinum disc is surprisingly symmetrical and devoid of any scratches or imperfections.  Engraved along its edge, bold runes spell out the word "ARCHIVUM."$B$BThere must be a device inside Ulduar capable of reading the disc.
english.progress: The console whirrs with energy as the round receptacle opens.
english.completion: The platinum disc fits perfectly inside the console.  It begins to spin as its contents are scanned by white beams of light.
english.completed: Return to Archivum Console.

text.title: 最后的难民
text.objectives: 安全护送考古学家霍莉。
text.description: 先是巨大的地震，然后就一片漆黑。接下来我所知道的，就是我一睁眼成了囚犯。整个地方都是空气元素！$B$B我希望大家都没事。这些暮光之锤的混帐最好别伤害我的朋友们！$B$B快，$c，找些尖的把脚镣上的锁打开。咱们一起的话应该能逃回难民营。
text.completion: Aye, you're the fine $g lad : lass; who saved my Hollee!$B$BWell, I've got a fitting reward for you here, I'm sure. We really can't thank you enough for bringing her to safety, $N.
text.end: 安全护送考古学家霍莉。
text.completed: 跟黑海岸奥伯丁难民营的柯艾丽萨·钢拳谈一谈。

english.title: The Last Refugee
english.objectives: Escort Archaeologist Hollee to safety.
english.description: There was this massive earthquake and then everything went black. The next thing I know, I woke up here a prisoner. The whole place is overrun with air elementals!$B$BI hope that everyone's okay. These Twillight's Hammer scum better not have hurt any of my friends!$B$BQuick, $c, use something sharp to jimmy the lock on this ball and chain. Together we should be able to make it to the refugee camp.
english.completion: Aye, you're the fine $g lad : lass; who saved my Hollee!$B$BWell, I've got a fitting reward for you here, I'm sure. We really can't thank you enough for bringing her to safety, $N.
english.completed: Speak with Elisa Steelhand at the Auberdine Refugee Camp in Darkshore.

text.title: 弗蕾亚的徽记
text.objectives: 将弗蕾亚的徽记交给奥杜尔档案馆中的勘探员多尔伦。$B$B你可以向档案馆控制台查询如何获得弗蕾亚的徽记。
text.description: 我想弗蕾亚的徽记可能是最难得到的一块。$B$B根据档案馆的数据，徽记与弗蕾亚身边的三位古树仆从密切关联，它们是明叶长老、铁枝长老和石树长老。一旦它们之中有任何一位受到伤害，徽记的完整性就无法保障了。$B$B然而，如果你们对这三位长老手下留情，弗蕾亚的力量就会变得更加强大。$B$B我又能说什么呢，$n，我们现在真是进退维谷。
text.progress: Freya's sigil, $N? Do ye have it?
text.completion: Excellent job, $N. We're one step closer to saving Azeroth!
text.completed: Return to Prospector Doren in Ulduar.

english.title: Freya's Sigil
english.objectives: Prospector Doren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to obtain Freya's Sigil.$B$BFor more information on obtaining Freya's Sigil consult the Archivum Console.
english.description: Freya's Sigil is going to be one of the tougher ones, I reckon.$B$BAccording to the Archivum, the essence of the Sigil is tied to her three elder servants, Brightleaf, Ironbranch and Stonebark.  Should any of the elders be harmed, the Sigil's integrity will be compromised.$B$BSparing the elders, however, means that Freya will be more powerful when you face her.$B$BWhat can I say, $n.  We're stuck between a rock and hard place.
english.progress: Freya's sigil, $N? Do ye have it?
english.completion: Excellent job, $N. We're one step closer to saving Azeroth!
english.completed: Return to Prospector Doren in Ulduar.

text.title: 天文台
text.objectives: 奥杜尔档案馆中的勘探员多尔伦要你找到天文台的入口。
text.description: 听着，$g小伙子:小姑娘;，艾泽拉斯的命运危在旦夕。$B$B我们唯一的机会是到天文台去，找到奥尔加隆，阻止他向他的泰坦主人发送信息。$B$B赶快找到天文台。如果你发现了任何有价值的信息，就立即回来向我报告。奥尔加隆抵达之前，我们还有一些时间可以准备。
text.completion: It's locked?  Figures!$B$BLet's see what information this junk heap can give us...
text.completed: Return to Prospector Doren in Ulduar.

english.title: The Celestial Planetarium
english.objectives: Prospector Doren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to locate the entrance to the Celestial Planetarium.
english.description: Listen, $glad:lass;!  Azeroth's fate is at stake here.$B$BOur only chance is to get to the Celestial Planetarium in time to find this Algalon and stop him from beaming back any messages to his Titan masters.$B$BLocate the Celestial Planetarium and come back with any information you get.  We might still have some time to prepare for Algalon's arrival.
english.completion: It's locked?  Figures!$B$BLet's see what information this junk heap can give us...
english.completed: Return to Prospector Doren in Ulduar.

text.title: Along for the Ride
text.objectives: Sentinel Glynda Na'Shea at Lor'danel has requested that you join one of her sentinels on an aerial scouting mission. Speak to her when you are prepared to depart.
text.description: Greetings, $c! You have a fresh look about you. You new to Darkshore?$B$BI could catch you up on the happenings--and there are quite a few--or I could just let you see for yourself. I have a Sentinel flying out on a scouring mission shortly. Why don't you join her and get aquatinted with things? I insist. You can stop by when you return at deliver her report yourself.$B$BSpeak to me again when you're ready to go.

english.title: Along for the Ride
english.objectives: Sentinel Glynda Na'Shea at Lor'danel has requested that you join one of her sentinels on an aerial scouting mission. Speak to her when you are prepared to depart.
english.description: Greetings, $c! You have a fresh look about you. You new to Darkshore?$B$BI could catch you up on the happenings--and there are quite a few--or I could just let you see for yourself. I have a Sentinel flying out on a scouring mission shortly. Why don't you join her and get aquatinted with things? I insist. You can stop by when you return at deliver her report yourself.$B$BSpeak to me again when you're ready to go.

text.title: 霍迪尔的徽记
text.objectives: 将霍迪尔的徽记交给奥杜尔档案馆中的勘探员多尔伦。$B$B你可以向档案馆控制台查询如何获得霍迪尔的徽记。
text.description: 要拿到霍迪尔的徽记可不容易。你不但要击败霍迪尔，而且必须抢在他打碎装着徽记的箱子之前击败他！$B$B如果你想了解更多信息的话，可以去查查档案馆的控制台。那里面的知识比世界上所有的图书馆加在一起还要多！
text.progress: Did ye obtain the sigil, $N?
text.completion: Ye did it! I don't know how, but ye did!
text.completed: Return to Prospector Doren in Ulduar.

english.title: Hodir's Sigil
english.objectives: Prospector Doren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to obtain Hodir's Sigil.$B$BFor more information on obtaining Hodir's Sigil, consult the Archivum Console.
english.description: Hodir's Sigil won't be easy to obtain.  Not only are ye going to have to defeat Hodir himself, but yer going to have to do it before he destroys the chest that contains it!$B$BCheck the Archivum console if you need more information.  That thing contains more knowledge than all of the world's libraries put together!
english.progress: Did ye obtain the sigil, $N?
english.completion: Ye did it! I don't know how, but ye did!
english.completed: Return to Prospector Doren in Ulduar.

text.title: 托里姆的徽记
text.objectives: 将托里姆的徽记交给奥杜尔档案馆中的勘探员多尔伦。$B$B你可以向档案馆控制台查询如何获得托里姆的徽记。
text.description: 托里姆已经失去了自我，$n。一股黑暗的力量正在影响着他。$B$B某个邪恶的家伙假扮成他死去的妻子西芙，蒙蔽了他的心智。$B$B你要阻止那个冒牌货控制托里姆。如果托里姆被这股力量征服，我们就永远都无法找到他的徽记了！$B$B你要让他清醒过来，越快越好！$B$B和以往一样，档案馆的控制台会给你提供所有必要的讯息……包括那些你不喜欢听到的讯息。
text.progress: Well, $N? Do ye have it?
text.completion: Ye never cease to impress, $N.$b$bYe and me are having a pint together after all this is done, ye hear me?
text.completed: Return to Prospector Doren in Ulduar.

english.title: Thorim's Sigil
english.objectives: Prospector Doren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to obtain Thorim's Sigil.$B$BFor more information on obtaining Thorim's Sigil consult the Archivum Console.
english.description: Thorim's not himself, $n.  He's come under a dark influence.$B$BAn evil presence under the guise of an illusion pretends to be his lost wife, Sif.$B$BYe can't let him be overcome by this impostor's spell.  If he does, the location of his sigil might forever be lost!$B$BYer going to have to beat some sense into him and yer going to have to do it quick.$B$BAs always, the Archivum Console will give ye all the gory details... even the ones ye don't like.
english.progress: Well, $N? Do ye have it?
english.completion: Ye never cease to impress, $N.$b$bYe and me are having a pint together after all this is done, ye hear me?
english.completed: Return to Prospector Doren in Ulduar.

text.title: 米米尔隆的徽记
text.objectives: 将米米尔隆的徽记交给奥杜尔档案馆中的勘探员多尔伦。$B$B你可以向档案馆控制台查询如何获得米米尔隆的徽记。
