text.description: 米米尔隆是个聪明的家伙，他给自己的地盘装上了一套自毁装置。$B$B很不幸，如果你想要拿到徽记，就必须争分夺秒。如果你需要了解什么详细的资料，可以去档案馆控制台那里查询。
text.progress: Were you able to obtain the sigil, $N?
text.completion: I've got to hand it to you, $N. Our odds might not be the best, but I feel a lot better with you lending a hand.
text.completed: Return to Prospector Doren in Ulduar.

english.title: Mimiron's Sigil
english.objectives: Prospector Doren at the Ulduar Archivum wants you to obtain Mimiron's Sigil.$B$BFor more information on obtaining Mimiron's Sigil consult the Archivum Console.
english.description: Mimiron's a clever one.  His entire abode is rigged with some sort of self-destruction mechanism.$B$BUnfortunately yer gonna have to race against it if ye want to get his sigil.  Check the Archivum Console for more details if ye need them.
english.progress: Were you able to obtain the sigil, $N?
english.completion: I've got to hand it to you, $N. Our odds might not be the best, but I feel a lot better with you lending a hand.
english.completed: Return to Prospector Doren in Ulduar.

text.title: 莫尔杉的防御
text.objectives: 莫尔杉农场的卡德拉克要你杀死5名灰谷步兵和5名灰谷弓箭手。
text.description: Lok'tar，$r！$b$b战役终于打响了！不久，整个灰谷就会被部落掌握。$b$b正如预料的那样，我们的进攻迫使敌人到处寻找我们的防御薄弱点。$b$b在这里，莫尔杉农场，他们的犯兵一败涂地！然而迫于形势，他们除了继续对我们施压外，没有别的办法。$b$b侦查这一地区，$c。寻找暗夜精灵，把他们干掉，不要让他们重新组织起来，对我们发动又一次进攻。
text.completion: Good work, $C!$B$BYour efforts will help keep the enemy on their heels while our forces sweep across the land!
text.completed: Speak to Kadrak at Mor'shan Ramparts.

english.title: Mor'shan Defense
english.objectives: Kadrak at Mor'shan Ramparts wants you to kill 5 Ashenvale Skirmishers and 5 Ashenvale Bowmen.
english.description: Lok'tar, $r!$b$bThe campaign is finally underway! Soon, all of Ashenvale will be in the grip of the Horde.$b$bAs we expected, our offensive is forcing the enemy to test our defenses at every position.$b$bHere at Mor'shan, their assault has been decimated! But as the vice tightens, they will have no choice but to continue to press us here.$b$bScout the region, $c. Search for night elf survivors and cut them down before they can regroup for another assault!
english.completion: Good work, $C!$B$BYour efforts will help keep the enemy on their heels while our forces sweep across the land!
english.completed: Speak to Kadrak at Mor'shan Ramparts.

text.title: 救治伤兵
text.objectives: 用药膏救治5名受伤的莫尔杉防御者。
text.description: 我们的部队战况喜人，$c。$b$b尽管如此，依然有伤员要照顾——他们很多人还留在战场上。$b$b我配了一种药膏，可以让伤员们恢复一定的体力，然后自己回到农场来接受治疗。请把药膏给重伤者们敷上，避免他们牺牲。
text.completion: Thank you, $R. I shall include your service to the Horde in my report.$B$BI should have these troops fit to fight again in no time!
text.completed: Speak to Dinah at Mor'shan Ramparts.

english.title: Rescue the Fallen
english.objectives: Use the Medicated Salve on 5 Wounded Mor'shan Defenders.
english.description: Our forces are holding up admirably, $c.$b$bBe that as it may, there are yet wounded to attend to - many still in the field of battle.$b$bI have created a salve that should grant the wounded enough energy to return to the ramparts for treatment. Please administer it to any in need before they become lost to us.
english.completion: Thank you, $R. I shall include your service to the Horde in my report.$B$BI should have these troops fit to fight again in no time!
english.completed: Speak to Dinah at Mor'shan Ramparts.

objectiveDetails.description: 营救受伤的莫尔杉防御者

text.title: 奥尔加隆
text.objectives: 将守护者的徽记带到奥杜尔的档案馆控制台前。
text.description: 你成功了，$n。把这些徽记拿到档案馆的控制台那里去，看看你能否进入天文台。$B$B你最好快一点，$g伙计:小丫头;，时间紧迫。
text.progress: The console's bright lights scan the glass surface repeatedly, as if awaiting some form of input.
text.completion: Stand by for verification.$b$bAccess to the Celestial Planetarium granted. Please retrieve your key.
text.completed: Return to Archivum Console.

english.title: Algalon
english.objectives: Bring the Sigils of the Watchers to the Archivum Console in Ulduar.
english.description: You really did it, $n.  Take the sigils to the Archivum Console and see if you can gain access to the Celestial Planetarium.$B$BYou best hurry, $g lad:lass;.  Time is of the essence.
english.progress: The console's bright lights scan the glass surface repeatedly, as if awaiting some form of input.
english.completion: Stand by for verification.$b$bAccess to the Celestial Planetarium granted. Please retrieve your key.
english.completed: Return to Archivum Console.

text.title: 箭壶见底
text.objectives: 莫尔杉农场的图伦要你从坠星湖地区收集10支耐用的箭矢。
text.description: 你好，$c，欢迎来到农场。$b$b这里看起来有点乱，不过不用担心。卡德拉克将这处要冲把守得严丝合缝，一个精灵也没能突破我们的防线！$b$b趁你在这儿……奥格瑞玛的一批新补给随时就会到，但我的守卫箭支日趋告急。$b$b把你能找到的都给我带来，我不会给你白白添麻烦的。
text.progress: Have you collected the arrows we need, $c?
text.completion: Well done, $C.$B$BThis should help get us by until our shipment arrives.

english.title: Empty Quivers
english.objectives: Truun at Mor'shan Ramparts wants you to collect 10 Serviceable Arrows from the Fallen Sky Lake region.
english.description: Greetings, $c, and welcome to the Ramparts.$b$bThings may appear a little chaotic here but do not worry. Kadrak has this juncture sealed up tight. Not a single elf has breached our lines!$b$bWhile you're here... I'm expecting a shipment of fresh supplies from Orgrimmar any day, but our watchmen are running dangerously low on arrows.$b$bBring me any you find and I will make it worth your trouble.
english.progress: Have you collected the arrows we need, $c?
english.completion: Well done, $C.$B$BThis should help get us by until our shipment arrives.

text.title: 冬之利刃
text.objectives: 将冬之利刃交给银色比武场的雅克布·奥勒留斯元帅。
text.description: 那个天杀的死亡骑士，把我的剑给弄坏了！$B$B前往晶歌森林的南部，你可以在水晶裂痕的出口上方找到恒焰领主。杀死他，拿到他身上的恒焰灰烬。$B$B带着恒焰灰烬前往嚎风峡湾北部的冬息湖中心，解救一位被寒冰困在那里的女士。她守护着一把古代宝剑，能够解救她的人就可以获得那把宝剑作为奖励。$B$B证明你的能力，拿到她守护了许久的宝剑吧，$n。
text.progress: Did you win the blade I seek?
text.completion: The blade is as fine as the stories say. It would seem there's little reason to complete the repairs on my customary blade. Winter's Edge is far superior and I will continue to carry it. You have my thanks, $N.
text.completed: Return to Marshal Jacob Alerius at the Argent Tournament Grounds.

english.title: The Edge Of Winter
english.objectives: Marshal Jacob Alerius at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to bring him Winter's Edge.
english.description: Curse that death knight for breaking my sword!$B$BIn southern Crystalsong Forest, overlooking the Crystal Vice's exit, you will find Lord Everblaze. Kill him and take the everburning ember from his corpse.$B$BBring it to the center of Winter's Breath Lake in northern Howling Fjord, and use it to free the maiden encased in ice. She is the guardian of an ancient sword and will award it to whoever frees her.$B$BProve your worth and earn the weapon that she has guarded for so long, $n.
english.progress: Did you win the blade I seek?
english.completion: The blade is as fine as the stories say. It would seem there's little reason to complete the repairs on my customary blade. Winter's Edge is far superior and I will continue to carry it. You have my thanks, $N.
english.completed: Return to Marshal Jacob Alerius at the Argent Tournament Grounds.

text.title: 西行海岸
text.objectives: 去跟灰谷黑渊营地的塔尔伦谈一谈。
text.description: $n，我有个朋友，用得着你这样的人才。他的名字叫做塔尔伦，是个考古学家。最近他被浮出水面的佐拉姆古城及其宝藏迷住了。$B$B要是你愿意帮把手的话，可以沿着路往西边走，去黑渊营地找到他。
text.completion: Hello, $c.$B$BWhat's that? You say that Shyela sent you?$B$B<The night elf briskly rubs his nimble hands together.>$B$BVery well, let's get started.

english.title: West to the Strand
english.objectives: Speak with Talen at the Blackfathom Camp in Ashenvale.
english.description: $n, I have a friend who could make good use of particular talents. His name is Talen and he's an archaeologist of sorts. Recently he's been fascinated with the upheaval of the old city of Zoram and its treasures.$B$BIf you're willing to lend him a hand, you can find him at the Blackfathom Camp down the path to the west.
english.completion: Hello, $c.$B$BWhat's that? You say that Shyela sent you?$B$B<The night elf briskly rubs his nimble hands together.>$B$BVery well, let's get started.

text.title: 找到高拉特！
text.objectives: 莫尔杉农场的卡德拉克要你在坠星湖地区寻找高拉特。
text.description: 高拉特是部落最为资深的刺客之一。$b$b光是听到他的名字，联盟的将士们就闻风丧胆。$b$b他从不失手，忠心不二，而且——到目前为止——都恪守时间。$b$b有什么地方不对劲，$c。$b$b高拉特的任务是找到并消灭负责进攻农场的精灵。$b$b他应该就在坠星湖一带。$b$b去找到他！
text.completion: Listen carefully, $R....

english.title: Find Gorat!
english.objectives: Kadrak at Mor'shan Ramparts wants you to search the Fallen Sky Lake region for Gorat.
english.description: Gorat is one of the Horde's most adept assassins.$b$bThe mere mention of his name strikes fear into the hearts of our Alliance foes.$b$bHe is reliable, fiercely loyal, and - until now - punctual.$b$bSomething's not right, $c.$b$bGorat's mission was to find and eliminate the elf in charge of this assault on the ramparts.$b$bHe should be somewhere in the region of Fallen Sky Lake.$b$bFind him!
english.completion: Listen carefully, $R....

text.title: 最后的报告
text.objectives: 高拉特要你把高拉特之血带给莫尔杉农场的卡德拉克。
text.description: <伴随着剧烈的咳嗽，高拉特艰难地说道。>$b$b是……埋伏……$b$b我们当时……正要回到农场。所有人……都死了……$b$b我们……发现了他们的领袖……$b$b<高拉特强忍痛苦，从自己的一处伤口里挤出一瓶血来。>$b$b一定要……替我的人报仇……把这个……交给卡德拉克……$b$b他知道该怎么做……$b$b<高拉特断气了。>
text.progress: Did you find Gorat, $c?!
text.completion: <Kadrak listens intently as you share Gorat's last words.>$B$BIt is as I feared, then. May his rest be peaceful - only not yet!

english.title: Final Report
english.objectives: Gorat wants you to return the Vial of Gorat's Blood to Kadrak at Mor'shan Ramparts.
english.description: <Gorat coughs deeply as he strains to speak.>$b$bIt was... an ambush....$b$bWe were... returning to the ramparts. All of us... lost....$b$bWe... discovered their leader... $b$b<Gorat painstakingly fills a vial with the blood spilling from one of his wounds.>$b$bMy men... must be avenged.... Bring this... to Kadrak....$b$bHe will know what to do....$b$b<Gorat expires.>
english.progress: Did you find Gorat, $c?!
english.completion: <Kadrak listens intently as you share Gorat's last words.>$B$BIt is as I feared, then. May his rest be peaceful - only not yet!

text.title: 去找迪娜，立刻出发！
text.objectives: 卡德拉克要你把高拉特之血带给莫尔杉农场的迪娜。
text.description: 也许不再会有像高拉特一样忠于部落的人了。他的任务从来没有失败过一次，想来他也不允许这次变成先例。$b$b高拉特让你把这瓶血带来是有目的。迪娜是一名受人敬重的萨满祭司的女儿，她比看上去要强大得多。把这瓶血给她带去，但愿还不太迟。
text.progress: What have you there, $r?
text.completion: Let's have a look, $C.

english.title: To Dinah, at Once!
english.objectives: Kadrak wants you to bring the Vial of Gorat's Blood to Dinah at Mor'shan Ramparts.
english.description: The Horde may have never known one more loyal than Gorat. He never failed to complete a mission, and it would seem that he refuses to allow this to be his first.$b$bGorat had you deliver this vial for a purpose. Dinah is the daughter of a revered shaman, and is more powerful than she appears. Bring her the vial and hope that we are not too late.
english.progress: What have you there, $r?
english.completion: Let's have a look, $C.

text.title: 高拉特的复仇
text.objectives: 在高拉特的尸体上使用高拉特的灌魔之血，然后击败艾伦迪拉德队长。
text.description: 如今命运与我们同在，$r。$b$b高拉特的血还很新鲜，足以让我举行一个自幼习得的特殊仪式。$b$b将这灌魔之血洒在高拉特的尸体上，召唤他不散的英魂。$b$b完成他最后的遗愿，然后回来找卡德拉克。$b$b愿万灵庇佑你，朋友。
text.completion: Well done, $R.$B$BThe elf captain is dead and the soul of one of our beloved brethren can sleep in peace.$B$BI shall pass on word of your deeds to my superiors in Orgrimmar.
text.completed: Speak to Kadrak at Mor'shan Base Camp.

english.title: Gorat's Vengeance
english.objectives: Use Gorat's Imbued Blood on Gorat's corpse, then defeat Captain Elendilad.
english.description: Fortune is with us this day, $r.$b$bGorat's blood was fresh enough for me to conduct a special ritual taught to me as a child.$b$bUse this imbued blood on Gorat's corpse to summon forth his lingering spirit.$b$bDo his final bidding, then report back here to Kadrak.$b$bSpirits keep you safe, friend.
english.completion: Well done, $R.$B$BThe elf captain is dead and the soul of one of our beloved brethren can sleep in peace.$B$BI shall pass on word of your deeds to my superiors in Orgrimmar.
english.completed: Speak to Kadrak at Mor'shan Base Camp.

text.title: 远古的历史
text.objectives: 将瓦兰奈尔的碎片拿到奥杜尔的档案馆控制台那里去。
text.description: 这些碎片组合在一起，拼成了一把华丽的战锤。从构造上来看，它至少有一部分是由泰坦制造的。$B$B也许你可以在档案馆的控制台那里找到更多关于这把古代神器的讯息。
text.progress: Awaiting input.
text.completion: Analyzing fragments... please stand by.
text.completed: Return to Archivum Console.

english.title: Ancient History
english.objectives: Bring the Shattered Fragments of Val'anyr to the Archivum Console in the Archivum in Ulduar.
english.description: The pieces fit together to form an elegant hammer.  Its construction appears to be at least partially Titan in nature.$B$BThe console inside the Archivum might have some information regarding this artifact.
english.progress: Awaiting input.
english.completion: Analyzing fragments... please stand by.
english.completed: Return to Archivum Console.

text.title: 给奥雷迪尔的货物
text.objectives: 将一包巴斯兰的头发送给灰谷梅伊瑟娜岗哨的奥雷迪尔·阔叶。
text.description: 快，$n。我将巴斯兰的头发放在这只袋子里，你一定要把它送给我的主人奥雷迪尔·阔叶。沿着左边的路朝南走，他就在梅伊瑟娜岗哨。$B$B不过要当心，我们收到报告说，部落正在攻打岗哨！
text.progress: You're a brave one to come here given the circumstances.$B$BWhat business have you, stranger?
text.completion: So, Evenar was succesful. Actually, more to the point, YOU were successful.$B$BI cannot thank you enough, $c, but there is more that must be done to the leaves before they will serve as a curative for what ails the child, Relara.

english.title: Delivery for Orendil
english.objectives: Deliver the Bag of Bathran's Hair to Orendil Broadleaf at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.
english.description: Quickly, $n. I will put the Bathran's Hair into this bag, but you must deliver it to my master, Orendil Broadleaf. You will find him at Maestra's Post, just south down the road on the left.$B$BBut beware, we've received reports that the post is under attack from the Horde!
english.progress: You're a brave one to come here given the circumstances.$B$BWhat business have you, stranger?
english.completion: So, Evenar was succesful. Actually, more to the point, YOU were successful.$B$BI cannot thank you enough, $c, but there is more that must be done to the leaves before they will serve as a curative for what ails the child, Relara.

text.title: 你自己的人马
text.objectives: 带一队梅伊瑟娜哨兵消灭3辆灰谷清障车和10名部落入侵者。
text.description: 我衷心希望你是来帮忙的，$c。眼下的情况十分危急，简单来说，就是我们要输了！$B$B姑娘们和我组成了对抗部落的最后一条防线，不打上一场，我们是别想全身而退了。你想不想挑战一下？$B$B我有一小队哨兵可以借给你，把她们组织起来，我肯定她们的魔箭足以消灭那些劫掠者和入侵者。$B$B假如你需要预备役人员的话，就来问我要。
text.completion: I'd received a report about you from some of my scouts out in the forest but I had no idea how capable you are!$B$BThank you, $N. With what you've accomplished the tide is turned. I've no doubt now that we'll rout them by the end of the day!
text.completed: Return to Sentinel Onaeya at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.

english.title: A Squad of Your Own
english.objectives: Use a squad of Maestra's Post Sentinels to destroy 3 Ashenvale Wreckers and slay 10 Horde Invaders.
english.description: I certainly hope that you're here to help, $c. The situation is as dire as it appears. To put it quite simply, we are losing!$B$BMy girls and I are the last line of defense against the Horde, but we're not going to get out of this one without taking the fight to them. Up for a challenge?$B$BI have a small squad of sentinels that I can loan to you. Get them close and I'm certain that their magic arrows can destroy those wreckers and invaders.$B$BSpeak to me again if you need replacements.
english.completion: I'd received a report about you from some of my scouts out in the forest but I had no idea how capable you are!$B$BThank you, $N. With what you've accomplished the tide is turned. I've no doubt now that we'll rout them by the end of the day!
english.completed: Return to Sentinel Onaeya at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.

text.title: 学习骑战
text.objectives: 使用刺击技能攻击一个近战目标5次，使用碎盾技能攻击2个脆弱的远程目标，使用冲锋技能攻击2个脆弱的冲锋目标，然后回到银色比武场，向斥候沙琳蒂亚复命。$B$B如果你丢失了长枪，可以在银色盟约大帐或者兽栏附近的长枪架上再拿一根。
text.description: 锦标赛中的大部分项目都要求参赛者熟练掌握骑乘战斗的技巧。为了让大家熟悉一边驾驭坐骑一边战斗的方式，我们在赛场北部布置了一些训练用的假人。$B$B到大帐外面的兽栏中去，拿起你的长枪，跨上奎尔多雷战马吧。你可以熟悉一下骑乘战斗中能够使用的战术，然后击败三种不同种类的训练假人。
text.progress: How goes the mounted combat practice?
text.completion: Well done, $N. Mounted combat is often hard to pick up for those accustomed to fighting on foot. I have no doubt that you'll continue to improve with practice, which is more than I can say for some warriors.
text.completed: Return to Scout Shalyndria at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: Learning The Reins
english.objectives: Strike a Melee Target with Thrust 5 times, use Shield-Breaker on 2 vulnerable Ranged Targets, use Charge on 2 vulnerable Charge Targets and then return to Scout Shalyndria at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$B$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or the Silver Covenant Pavilion.
english.description: Most of the tournament's competitions require competitors to master the command of a mount in battle. In order to familiarize you with mounted combat, we've put up training dummies all over the northern part of the tournament grounds.$B$BVisit the stables outside the pavilion, equip your lance, and mount up on the Quel'dorei steed. Familiarize yourself with the tactics available to you and use them to defeat the three different kinds of training dummies.
english.progress: How goes the mounted combat practice?
english.completion: Well done, $N. Mounted combat is often hard to pick up for those accustomed to fighting on foot. I have no doubt that you'll continue to improve with practice, which is more than I can say for some warriors.
english.completed: Return to Scout Shalyndria at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

objectiveDetails.description: 对脆弱的远程目标使用碎盾
对脆弱的冲锋目标使用冲锋

text.title: 存荣没哀
text.objectives: 找回费罗的圣光之锤和净化者的祷文手册。
text.description: 曾经有这么两个人类：费罗·艾隆汉和净化者德尔格伦，他们都隶属于一个叫做银色黎明的神圣组织。这两人都为了抵御部落对哨所的第一次进攻，献出了自己的生命。$B$B我要把这件魔法斗篷借给你，它是塞纳留斯的礼物，可以让我隐形。$B$B把那两人的尸体找到，将费罗的战锤和德尔格伦祷文手册拿回来。费罗的遗体位于庭院，德尔格伦的则在塔顶。$B$B要当心，那里的术士还是能看见你的。
text.progress: Our losses here have been staggering.
text.completion: I do not look forward to writing the letter to the Argent Dawn embassy in Darnassus. At least we'll be able to send their most prized possessions back for their loved ones.$B$BI cannot thank you enough for your courage, $N. Please accept this on behalf of the post.
text.completed: Return to Sentinel Onaeya at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.

english.title: Respect for the Fallen
english.objectives: Retrieve Feero's Holy Hammer and The Purifier's Prayer Book.
english.description: There were two humans here: Feero Ironhand and Delgren the Purifier. They were members of a holy organization known as The Argent Dawn. Both fell defending the post when the Horde first attacked.$B$BI'm going to loan you my magical cloak. It was a gift from Cenarius that allows me to move invisibly.$B$BFind both of their corpses and retrieve Feero's hammer and Delgren's prayer book. Feero's corpse is in the courtyard and Delgren's is atop the tower.$B$BBeware, the warlock up there will be able to see you.
english.progress: Our losses here have been staggering.
english.completion: I do not look forward to writing the letter to the Argent Dawn embassy in Darnassus. At least we'll be able to send their most prized possessions back for their loved ones.$B$BI cannot thank you enough for your courage, $N. Please accept this on behalf of the post.
english.completed: Return to Sentinel Onaeya at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.

text.title: 砍木头
text.objectives: 把12块做工粗糙的木板交给银色比武场的贝兹尔·布拉斯波。
text.description: 过来一点。不不不，别太近。我们可不想引起什么不必要的怀疑，对吧？$B$B建造这座竞技场需要许多木材，我们的存货远远不够。但是我又没有义务花钱从灰熊丘陵运货过来。在晶歌森林的西边，符印巨树的附近有许多新长成的晶歌森林橡树。$B$B这些橡树做成的木板完全可以满足我们盖房子、搭手脚架的需要。带着这把斧子，去把那些小橡树砍倒并削成符合我们要求的木板吧。注意，不要让别人看到你！
text.progress: Did you get the "goods" we talked about?
text.completion: All excellent planks, and the price is right, too! Even better, those Argent Crusade sticks-in-the-mud will never know. They'll get their precious coliseum and I'll get my early completion bonus. Now that's a win-win if I ever saw one.
text.completed: Return to Bezzle Blastbolt at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: Jack Me Some Lumber
english.objectives: Bring 12 Rough Hewn Planks to Bezzle Blastbolt at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Come closer. No, not too close. Don't want any unnecessary suspicion now, do we?$B$BThis coliseum requires more lumber than we've stockpiled and there's no way I'm going to pay to have it shipped in from Grizzly Hills. At the western end of Crystalsong Forest, by the Great Tree, grow a number of young Crystalsong oaks. They'd provide just the kind of planking we need for building and scaffolding. Take this axe, use it to fell the trees and then hew them into planks, but don't let anyone see you!
english.progress: Did you get the "goods" we talked about?
english.completion: All excellent planks, and the price is right, too! Even better, those Argent Crusade sticks-in-the-mud will never know. They'll get their precious coliseum and I'll get my early completion bonus. Now that's a win-win if I ever saw one.
english.completed: Return to Bezzle Blastbolt at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 有木头没有？
text.objectives: 图伦要你坐蛮角前往战歌劳工营地。$b$b跟卡德拉克交谈，拿到卡德拉克的缰绳，骑上布鲁图斯。
text.description: 卡德拉克刚接到给我们部队的新命令。我听说咱们要开始攻打灰谷了！$b$b我这里的补给实在不够支援一次进攻的，奥格瑞玛的那批货也没有到。$b$b我是巧妇难为无米之炊啊，你得帮帮我，$c。$b$b跟卡德拉克谈一谈，问他借蛮角的缰绳一用。科多兽将把你带往战歌劳工营地，在那里找到戈尔卡，叫她给你装满木头。
text.completion: Welcome, $C. It is good to see that the road to Mor'shan Ramparts remains clear.
text.completed: Speak to Gorka at the Warsong Labor Camp in Ashenvale.

english.title: Got Wood?
english.objectives: Truun wants you to ride Brutusk to the Warsong Labor Camp.$b$bSpeak with Kadrak to get Kadrak's Reins to ride Brutus.
english.description: Kadrak has just received fresh orders for our troops. I hear we're to begin offensive strikes into Ashenvale!$b$bI have far too few supplies to support an assault, and my shipment from Orgrimmar has yet to arrive.$b$bI am forced to  improvise, and could use your help, $c.$b$bSpeak with Kadrak and ask him for the reins to Brutusk. The kodo will take you to the Warsong Labor Camp. Once there, seek out Gorka and ask her to load you up with logs.
english.completion: Welcome, $C. It is good to see that the road to Mor'shan Ramparts remains clear.
english.completed: Speak to Gorka at the Warsong Labor Camp in Ashenvale.

text.title: 瓦兰奈尔，远古王者之锤
text.objectives: 在尤格-萨隆发出震耳咆哮时，将瓦兰奈尔的碎片投入尤格-萨隆张开的嘴中，然后击败尤格-萨隆，获得重铸的远古王者之锤。$B$B只能在英雄模式下完成，且至少需要有一位奥杜尔的守护者没有协助你。
text.description: 根据档案馆控制台的提示，也许这个办法可以将瓦兰奈尔的碎片重新组合起来：你要把碎片放入尤格-萨隆的体内。$B$B这方案听起来风险极大，不过为了这柄强大的上古神器，冒多大的风险都是值得的。
text.progress: Awaiting input.
text.completion: Object integrity confirmed. Please hold while solidified residue is removed.
text.completed: Return to Archivum Console.

english.title: Val'anyr, Hammer of Ancient Kings
english.objectives: Throw the Shattered Pieces of Val'anyr into Yogg-Saron's maw while he's casting Deafening Roar and defeat Yogg-Saron and recover the Reforged Hammer of Ancient Kings.$B$BThis can only be completed in Heroic mode and only if at least one Ulduar Watcher is not assisting you.
english.description: The Archivum Console has hinted at a possible way to rebind the fragments of Val'anyr:  you must get the fragments inside the physical form of the being known as Yogg-Saron.$B$BIt sounds like a long shot, but for an artifact of such power you think the risk might just be worth it.
english.progress: Awaiting input.
english.completion: Object integrity confirmed. Please hold while solidified residue is removed.
english.completed: Return to Archivum Console.

text.title: 事出有因
text.objectives: 关闭蓝色、绿色和红色月亮石。
text.description: 熊怪从高地打下来，侵占了北方的奥迪拉兰废墟。我相信它们这么做，是为了已死的邪教徒们在那里发现的三块月亮石。$B$B利拉迪斯·月河会建议你用更为直接的方式来对付熊怪，我并不反对，不过我要你做的，是去废墟把那些月亮石关掉。
text.completion: Thank you, $N.$B$BWith the moonstones of Ordil'Aran deactivated, we should not need to worry about any further incursions of furbolg here.$B$BHowever, my scouts have returned with disturbing news from the furbolg village. There is an imminent danger massing there.$B$BI wonder, might I entice you to carry a warning to Astranaar for me?
text.completed: Return to Moon Priestess Maestra at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.

english.title: The Reason Why
english.objectives: Deactivate the Blue, Green, and Red Moonstones.
english.description: The furbolg have descended from the heights and overrun the Ruins of Ordil'Aran to the north. I believe they did so because they were attracted to what the dead cultists there uncovered:  three moonstones.$B$BLiladris Moonriver will counsel you to deal with the furbolg in a more direct manner, and I will not gainsay her, but I would ask that you go to the ruins and deactivate the moonstones.
english.completion: Thank you, $N.$B$BWith the moonstones of Ordil'Aran deactivated, we should not need to worry about any further incursions of furbolg here.$B$BHowever, my scouts have returned with disturbing news from the furbolg village. There is an imminent danger massing there.$B$BI wonder, might I entice you to carry a warning to Astranaar for me?
english.completed: Return to Moon Priestess Maestra at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.

text.title: 结果好，一切都好
text.objectives: 将回复代码阿尔法交给达拉然的罗宁。
text.description: 我们必须抓紧时间，$n。必须回到达拉然，在那里把回复代码发射出去。$B$B带着它去找罗宁吧，我会在那里等你。
text.progress: You're ready, $N?
text.completion: You're here.  Let us hope this works.  For all our sakes.
text.completed: Return to Rhonin in Crystalsong Forest.

english.title: All Is Well That Ends Well
english.objectives: Take the Reply-Code Alpha to Rhonin in Dalaran.
english.description: We'd best hurry now, $n.  We're going to have to transmit the reply-code from Dalaran.$B$BTake it to Rhonin, I will meet you there.
english.progress: You're ready, $N?
english.completion: You're here.  Let us hope this works.  For all our sakes.
english.completed: Return to Rhonin in Crystalsong Forest.

text.title: 后方吃紧
text.objectives: 杀死奥迪拉兰废墟的任意10个熊怪。
text.description: 月之女祭司有办法让熊怪不再从高地对我们发动进攻。我更关心的则是那些已经在废墟里的家伙，其中有一些还在岗哨外聚集。$B$B我知道这是不情之请，但还请你去北边的奥迪拉兰废墟杀掉熊怪。我们可不能两线作战！$B$B谢谢你，$c。
text.completion: We are in your debt, $c. If I know anything about the furbolg, they do not like their noses bloodied.$B$BIt won't be long now before they tuck tail and return to their village.
text.completed: Return to Liladris Moonriver at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.

english.title: Rear Guard Duty
english.objectives: Slay any 10 furbolg at the Ruins of Ordil'Aran.
english.description: The moon priestess has a plan to make sure that no further furbolg descend upon us from the highlands. I am more concerned with those that are already at the ruins, some of which are massing just outside of the post.$B$BDistasteful as it may be, I must ask that you head north into the Ruins of Ordil'Aran and slay the furbolg. We cannot fight on two fronts!$B$BThank you, $c.
english.completion: We are in your debt, $c. If I know anything about the furbolg, they do not like their noses bloodied.$B$BIt won't be long now before they tuck tail and return to their village.
english.completed: Return to Liladris Moonriver at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败奥迪拉兰废墟的熊怪

text.title: 西部荒野的黑骑士？
text.objectives: 调查黑骑士的身世是否属实，然后回到银色比武场，向北伐军战士莱达拉汇报你的发现。
text.description: 最近有不少关于那个被称为“黑骑士”的选手的传闻，你肯定也听说了吧？据说凡是将要与他对阵竞技的骑士都会惨遭横死。$B$B当然了，我们手里还没有确切的证据，不过调查一下他的背景总不会错的。$B$B他自称来自西部荒野的库珀家族。你能不能到西部荒野的月溪镇去一趟，在镇子里的西部区域调查一下这个家族的住所？看看你能不能查出些什么线索。
text.progress: Have you found anything related to the Black Knight's story?
text.completion: So you're saying this knight's story is a sham? Most suspicious. Dishonorable at the least, and murderous at the worst. Still, we can't confront him until we know for certain whether he was involved in these murders.$B$BDo nothing to arouse his suspicions, $N. Discretion will serve us well as we continue to investigate.
text.completed: Return to Crusader Rhydalla at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: The Black Knight of Westfall?
english.objectives: Investigate the Black Knight's claims and return to Crusader Rhydalla at the Argent Tournament Grounds with your findings.
english.description: No doubt you've heard the disturbing rumors about the contestant the others are calling the Black Knight. It's said that any rider who was scheduled to face him in combat has met an untimely end.$B$BOf course, we have no definitive proof of anything, but it wouldn't hurt to look into this knight's background.$B$BHe claims to be descended from the Cooper family of Westfall. Would you visit their residence in the western part of Moonbrook in Westfall? See if you can find any proof of his story.
english.progress: Have you found anything related to the Black Knight's story?
english.completion: So you're saying this knight's story is a sham? Most suspicious. Dishonorable at the least, and murderous at the worst. Still, we can't confront him until we know for certain whether he was involved in these murders.$B$BDo nothing to arouse his suspicions, $N. Discretion will serve us well as we continue to investigate.
english.completed: Return to Crusader Rhydalla at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 银松森林的黑骑士？
text.objectives: 调查黑骑士的身世是否属实，然后回到银色比武场，向北伐军战士莱达拉汇报你的发现。
text.description: 最近有不少关于那个被称为“黑骑士”的选手的传闻，你肯定也听说了吧？据说凡是将要与他对阵竞技的骑士都会惨遭横死。$B$B当然了，我们手里还没有确切的证据，不过调查一下他的背景总不会错的。$B$B他自称出生于银松森林的瓦尔甘农场。这个小农场就坐落在洛丹米尔湖的西岸。你能否到农场去调查一下，看看他说的是不是实话？
text.progress: Have you found anything related to the Black Knight's story?
text.completion: So you're saying this knight's story is a sham? Most suspicious. Dishonorable at the least, and murderous at the worst. Still, we can't confront him until we know for certain whether he was involved in these murders.$B$BDo nothing to arouse his suspicions, $N. Discretion will serve us well as we continue to investigate.
text.completed: Return to Crusader Rhydalla at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: The Black Knight of Silverpine?
english.objectives: Investigate the Black Knight's claims and return to Crusader Rhydalla at the Argent Tournament Grounds with your findings.
english.description: No doubt you've heard the disturbing rumors about the contestant the others are calling the Black Knight. It's said that any rider who was scheduled to face him in combat has met an untimely end.$B$BOf course, we have no definitive proof of anything, but it wouldn't hurt to look into this knight's background.$B$BHe claims to hail from Valgan's Field in Silverpine Forest. It's a small farm on the western shore of Lordamere Lake. Would you visit the farm and let me know if there's any truth to his story?
english.progress: Have you found anything related to the Black Knight's story?
english.completion: So you're saying this knight's story is a sham? Most suspicious. Dishonorable at the least, and murderous at the worst. Still, we can't confront him until we know for certain whether he was involved in these murders.$B$BDo nothing to arouse his suspicions, $N. Discretion will serve us well as we continue to investigate.
english.completed: Return to Crusader Rhydalla at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 南门进度报告
text.objectives: 将驾驶员塞克·锤足的进度报告交给国王谷的拉格弗斯上尉。
text.description: 我们本该将一份进度报告送交给国王谷的巡山人。$B$B不管怎么说，我希望你的下一站就是去那里——你是否介意帮我把它送过去？走东边的通道，在警戒哨那里登记。把它直接交给拉格弗斯上尉。
text.progress: What brings you all the way out here?
text.completion: The South Gate status report? Excellent. I've been awaiting news from them for a while.$B$BWith the increasing number of troggs in the hills on all sides, I fear the outposts will be the first to feel any aggressive action.

english.title: South Gate Status Report
english.objectives: Deliver Pilot Hammerfoot's Status Report to Captain Rugelfuss in the Valley of Kings.
english.description: We're due for sending a status report over to the mountaineers in the Valley of Kings.$B$BI expect you're on your way there next anyhow - would you mind dropping it off for me? Just take the tunnel to the east, and check in at the guard station. Hand it directly to Captain Rugelfuss.
english.progress: What brings you all the way out here?
english.completion: The South Gate status report? Excellent. I've been awaiting news from them for a while.$B$BWith the increasing number of troggs in the hills on all sides, I fear the outposts will be the first to feel any aggressive action.

text.title: 雷矛的命令
text.objectives: 将雷矛的命令送交给奥加兹岗哨的巡山人雷矛。
text.description: 我要把一些命令传给奥加兹岗哨的巡山人雷矛。如果你不介意带上它们的话，沿着路一直走到西北边，就能看见主碉堡了。$B$B要是你愿意帮忙完成他的任务，我们也将很高兴为此奖赏你。
text.completion: Orders! Let's see what we have here... hah! He wants me to deal with the infestation of rat men. We're already in the middle of that, so no real deviation there.$B$BCare to lend a hand?

english.title: Stormpike's Orders
english.objectives: Deliver Stormpike's Orders to Mountaineer Stormpike at Algaz Station.
english.description: I need to get some orders up to Mountaineer Stormpike at his post in Algaz Station. If you wouldn't mind taking them, just follow the road all the way up to the northwest and you'll be sure to see the main bunker.$B$BIf you'd like to lend a hand in accomplishing his tasks, we'd be glad to reward you for that as well.
english.completion: Orders! Let's see what we have here... hah! He wants me to deal with the infestation of rat men. We're already in the middle of that, so no real deviation there.$B$BCare to lend a hand?

text.title: Ram Delivery
text.description: The mountaineers at South Gate Outpost have requested a delivery of rams for their patrols. I didn't think we'd be able to spare any, but we can get them at least one thanks to you.$B$BMind riding it over and delivering it to Private Hammerfall for me? Just let me know when you're ready to go.

english.title: Ram Delivery
english.description: The mountaineers at South Gate Outpost have requested a delivery of rams for their patrols. I didn't think we'd be able to spare any, but we can get them at least one thanks to you.$B$BMind riding it over and delivering it to Private Hammerfall for me? Just let me know when you're ready to go.

text.title: The Captured Mountaineer
text.objectives: Captain Regulfuss at Thelsamar wants you to locate Mountaineer Gravelgaw.
text.description: You've proven yourself more than capable enough in a fight. I have something a bit more pressing to ask of you now.$B$BOne of my men, Mountaineer Gravelgaw, was captured by the troggs that we've been fighting in the southern mountains. Well, not so much captured as willingly gave himself up, but similar end result. I think he was hoping to identify their leader from the inside.$B$BI need you to go get him out. They'll probably be holding him near one of their upper caves deep in the mountains.

english.title: The Captured Mountaineer
english.objectives: Captain Regulfuss at Thelsamar wants you to locate Mountaineer Gravelgaw.
english.description: You've proven yourself more than capable enough in a fight. I have something a bit more pressing to ask of you now.$B$BOne of my men, Mountaineer Gravelgaw, was captured by the troggs that we've been fighting in the southern mountains. Well, not so much captured as willingly gave himself up, but similar end result. I think he was hoping to identify their leader from the inside.$B$BI need you to go get him out. They'll probably be holding him near one of their upper caves deep in the mountains.

text.title: 补给挖掘场
text.objectives: 找到胡达尔、米兰和赛恩。
text.description: 铁环在东南边有个挖掘场，一直以来他的工程都需要协会提供大量的炸药。胡达尔、米兰和赛恩刚刚带着最新的一车货出发，可能用得着帮手。$B$B就算他们那么强壮，也应该没走多远。满载的木桶让他们只能走那么快。$b$b他们选择的是一条通往挖掘场的常规路线，出镇子往南，沿着洛克湖岸走就是。赶上他们，看有什么要帮的，行不行？
text.completion: Hmph, it'll take more than a Dark Iron ambush to stop the deliveries!$b$bBut Saean... I would never have suspected him to be one of their sympathizers. We've been working with him for almost a year now... maybe I missed the signs.$b$bWell, I'll consider that later.
text.end: 找到胡达尔、米兰和赛恩

english.title: Resupplying the Excavation
english.objectives: Locate Huldar, Miran, and Saean.
english.description: Ironband has an excavation to the southeast and he's been needing a hefty amount of explosives sent from the league for all the carving. Huldar, Miran, and Saean just departed with the most recent load and could probably use a hand.$B$BThey can't have made it very far, strong as they are. They can only move so fast laden down with those barrels.$b$bThey're taking the normal route to the site, leaving south out of town and following the curve of the Loch. Go catch up with them and help'm out, will ya?
english.completion: Hmph, it'll take more than a Dark Iron ambush to stop the deliveries!$b$bBut Saean... I would never have suspected him to be one of their sympathizers. We've been working with him for almost a year now... maybe I missed the signs.$b$bWell, I'll consider that later.

text.title: 资材管理
text.objectives: 说服垂头丧气的苦工们开工，收集5捆刚切下的木头。
text.description: 图伦要木头，是吧？平时我给，但今天不行。$b$b精灵三天两头来犯，伐木工作太过危险。我剩下来的苦工不愿意进树林。$b$b你想要木头吗？那就得去说服苦工干活。$b$b还要保障他们的安全！我可不能再损失人手了！
text.progress: Did you get the wood you need?
text.completion: It seems you've solved one problem only to face another, $C.
text.completed: Return to Gorka at the Warsong Labor Camp in Ashenvale.

english.title: Management Material
english.objectives: Convince Demoralized Peons to work and collect 5 bundles of Freshly Cut Wood.
english.description: Truun needs wood, huh? Normally I could provide, but not today.$b$bWith constant elf attacks, gathering lumber is dangerous work. The peons I have left are reluctant to venture into the woods.$b$bYou want wood? Then you go convince the peons to work.$b$bAnd keep them safe! I cannot afford to lose any more!
english.progress: Did you get the wood you need?
english.completion: It seems you've solved one problem only to face another, $C.
english.completed: Return to Gorka at the Warsong Labor Camp in Ashenvale.

text.title: 先知的水晶
text.objectives: 将一块先知的水晶交给银色比武场的北伐军战士莱达拉。
text.description: 既然已经知道这个黑骑士一直在胡扯，那我们就必须查出他和那些骑士的死之间有什么牵连。$B$B我有一个办法，可以查出他们死亡的真相，不过我需要一种稀有的材料。我们必须弄到一块先知的水晶。这种水晶只有在晶歌森林的萨特身上才能找到。到晶歌森林中部的绝望之林去，在那里的暗夜精灵废墟附近寻找自由的先知，把水晶给我带回来。
text.progress: Have you located a seer's crystal?
text.completion: This one will do nicely. All that remains is to imbue it with the power of the Light, giving it the ability to find truth amid deception.
text.completed: Return to Crusader Rhydalla at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: The Seer's Crystal
english.objectives: Bring a Seer's Crystal to Crusader Rhydalla at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Now that we know there's no truth to the Black Knight's stories, we must find a way to connect him to the murdered knights.$B$BI know a way to reveal the truth about how they died, but it requires a rare material. We must gain a seer's crystal, found only among the unbound seers who congregate near night elf ruins in the Forlorn Woods in the central part of Crystalsong Forest. Find one of these seers, $n, and bring me the crystal it holds.
english.progress: Have you located a seer's crystal?
english.completion: This one will do nicely. All that remains is to imbue it with the power of the Light, giving it the ability to find truth amid deception.
english.completed: Return to Crusader Rhydalla at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 沐浴在月光中
text.objectives: 制作一瓶经过浸泡的药剂。
text.description: 药剂尚未完成；必须等它经过月神之光的洗礼，我们才能把它交给那孩子。$B$B西边法拉希姆湖处就有一处地方，女神的月光日夜照耀着那里。行行好，$n，恳求你看在蕾拉的份上，将这药剂沐浴在月神的光芒下。$B$B但是要当心，奇怪的东西降临到了湖水附近，我恐怕前往那里的路将不再安全。
text.progress: Did you have any trouble getting to the Light of Elune at Lake Falathim?
text.completion: With the concoction blessed by the Light of Elune, it should be ready for delivery to Astranaar.$B$BThere is no time to waste, $N!
text.completed: Return to Orendil Broadleaf at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.

english.title: Bathed in Light
english.objectives: Create a Bathed Concoction.
english.description: The concoction is not quite complete; it must be bathed within the Light of Elune before we can even think about giving it to the child.$B$BThere is a known location just to the west at Lake Falathim where the goddess's moonlight always touches down, day or night. Please, $n, I implore you for the sake of Relara, take the concoction and bathe it in Elune's radiance.$B$BBut beware, strange things have befallen the area of the lake, and I fear that it is no longer safe to go there.
english.progress: Did you have any trouble getting to the Light of Elune at Lake Falathim?
english.completion: With the concoction blessed by the Light of Elune, it should be ready for delivery to Astranaar.$B$BThere is no time to waste, $N!
english.completed: Return to Orendil Broadleaf at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.

text.title: 死者讲述的故事
text.objectives: 在温德尔·巴尔弗爵士、洛林·阳焰和康纳尔·铁拳的坟墓前使用先知的水晶，查出他们死亡的真相，然后将结果报告给北伐军战士莱达拉。
text.description: 这块水晶将揭开那三名选手的死亡真相。把它带到比赛场东边的墓地里去，并在温德尔·巴尔弗爵士、洛林·阳焰和康纳尔·铁拳的墓前使用它。$B$B如果他们真的是被谋杀的，那我们必须在黑骑士再次行动前抓住他的把柄。你要仔细观察水晶所展示的东西，$n，我们必须确证这些死亡不是巧合。
text.progress: Have you visisted the graves of the slain combatants?
text.completion: So you say Lorien Sunblaze was done in by poison and Sir Wendell was burnt alive? Dreadful ways to die, both of them. Only Conall was killed by cold steel, and from your description, it was a coward's strike, not honorable combat that laid him in his grave.$B$BAll three sparred with and were scheduled to fight the Black Knight. This cannot be a coincidence. Now, we must find a way to prove it was the Black Knight's work.
text.completed: Return to Crusader Rhydalla at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: The Stories Dead Men Tell
english.objectives: Use the Seer's Crystal at the graves of Sir Wendell Balfour, Lorien Sunblaze, and Conall Irongrip to determine how they died, then return to Crusader Rhydalla.
english.description: The crystal will reveal the truth about how three of the tournament's combatants died. Take it with you to the graveyard east of the Tournament Grounds and use it before the graves of Sir Wendell Balfour, Lorien Sunblaze, and Conall Irongrip.$B$BIf indeed these men were murdered, then we must find a way to tie it to the Black Knight before he strikes again. Look closely at what the crystal tells you, $n, for we must be certain these deaths were not accidental.
english.progress: Have you visisted the graves of the slain combatants?
english.completion: So you say Lorien Sunblaze was done in by poison and Sir Wendell was burnt alive? Dreadful ways to die, both of them. Only Conall was killed by cold steel, and from your description, it was a coward's strike, not honorable combat that laid him in his grave.$B$BAll three sparred with and were scheduled to fight the Black Knight. This cannot be a coincidence. Now, we must find a way to prove it was the Black Knight's work.
english.completed: Return to Crusader Rhydalla at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

objectiveDetails.description: 调查温德尔·巴尔弗爵士的死因
调查康纳尔·铁拳的死因

text.title: 地底来客
text.objectives: 杀死预言者阿伏提克。
text.description: 当我感觉到这些……东西……就要从下面上来时，我就前来降服它们。我发现了你朋友的尸体，尽可能地把他带得远远地，直到我折断了一根炮骨。我已经竭尽全力抵挡这些邪恶的触须了。$B$B有一个家伙在控制着这些触须和眼睛，它管自己叫预言者阿伏提克——我肯定你听到过它在南边发出的喊叫声。$B$B预言者处于我的魔法射程之外，但是你可以去把它干掉。只要你敢的话……
text.completion: With the death of the harbinger, I can begin to cleanse the lake.$B$BYou have my deepest thanks, $N. I mourn the loss of your friend, but know that his remains will fuel the reclamation of the forest hereabouts.
text.completed: Return to Keeper Heartwise at Lake Falathim in Ashenvale.
text.giverWindow: 将这个邪秽的生物赶回下界去。

english.title: That Which Has Risen
english.objectives: Slay Harbinger Aphotic.
english.description: When I sensed these... things... rising from below, I came to put them back down. I found the corpse of your friend and dragged him as far as I could before one of my fetlocks was broken. It is all that I can do to hold off these foul tendrils.$B$BThere is one that controls the tendrils and eyes. It calls itself Harbinger Aphotic -- I'm sure that you have heard it yelling from the south.$B$BThe harbinger stands out of range of my magic, but you could get to him. If you dare....
english.completion: With the death of the harbinger, I can begin to cleanse the lake.$B$BYou have my deepest thanks, $N. I mourn the loss of your friend, but know that his remains will fuel the reclamation of the forest hereabouts.
english.completed: Return to Keeper Heartwise at Lake Falathim in Ashenvale.
english.giverWindow: Return this vile creature below from whence it came.

text.title: 给莱恩·狼行者
text.objectives: 将发光的宝石交给灰谷阿斯特兰纳的莱恩·狼行者。
text.description: 我要你把这颗宝石直接交给莱恩·狼行者。根据我所知的最新消息，她还在东南边的阿斯特兰纳。$B$B至少从这里到那儿的路还相对安全，因此走过去不是什么大问题。当然了，要是你愿意，我相信哨兵阿瓦娜可以把她的夜刃豹借你一头，好让你快些到达。$B$B不管怎样，都祝你一切安好，$n。愿我们能够再次见面。
text.progress: I am Raene Wolfrunner. Who might you be?
text.completion: Teronis is dead?$B$B<The lady weeps softly for the loss of her friend and then composes herself after a moment.>$B$BWe must see to it that his sacrifice was not in vain. Are you willing to see this through, $c?$B$BVery well, allow me some time to think about how we should proceed. I will know shortly.

english.title: To Raene Wolfrunner
english.objectives: Deliver the Glowing Gem to Raene Wolfrunner at Astranaar in Ashenvale.
english.description: I would ask you to deliver the gem directly to Raene Wolfrunner. Last I heard, she was still in Astranaar to the southeast.$B$BAt least the road between here and there is still relatively safe, so it should be a simple matter of following it there. Of course, if you'd rather, I believe that Sentinel Avana would be willing to loan you one of her nightsabers to swiftly make the trip.$B$BWhatever you choose, good health to you, $n. May our paths cross again soon.
english.progress: I am Raene Wolfrunner. Who might you be?
english.completion: Teronis is dead?$B$B<The lady weeps softly for the loss of her friend and then composes herself after a moment.>$B$BWe must see to it that his sacrifice was not in vain. Are you willing to see this through, $c?$B$BVery well, allow me some time to think about how we should proceed. I will know shortly.

text.title: 姐妹情深
text.objectives: 跟灰谷阿斯特兰纳的哨兵露亚娜谈一谈。
text.description: 你已经给我们帮了大忙，$n。没有你，我们现在可能已经统统被消灭了。$B$B能为你随时提供夜刃豹是我的荣幸，无论你是去阿斯特兰纳，还是去东南方。我肯定你在那里有非常重要的事情。$B$B要是你方便的话，不妨去和我的姐妹哨兵露亚娜谈谈，告诉她我很好。$B$B你准备好出发就跟我说一声，想要坐骑的时候也尽管来找我便是。
text.completion: Avana is alive?! I feared that she might be dead when we heard about the attack on Maestra's Post!$B$BAs you can see, we have our hands full with the Horde here as well.$B$BYou have given me the greatest gift by letting me know she is well. Any time that you wish to ride one of my nightsabers back to Maestra's Post, it is yours.

english.title: Astranaar Bound
english.objectives: Speak with Sentinel Luara at Astranaar in Ashenvale.
english.description: You have been of great assistance to us, $n. Without you, we would have been wiped out by now.$B$BIt would be my pleasure to offer you one of my nightsabers anytime to ride to Astranaar up and to the southeast. I'm sure that you have very important business to attend to there.$B$BI would consider it a great kindness if you would speak with my sister, Sentinel Luara, when you arrive to tell her that I am well.$B$BJust speak to me again when you are ready to go, and anytime that you need a ride it is yours.
english.completion: Avana is alive?! I feared that she might be dead when we heard about the attack on Maestra's Post!$B$BAs you can see, we have our hands full with the Horde here as well.$B$BYou have given me the greatest gift by letting me know she is well. Any time that you wish to ride one of my nightsabers back to Maestra's Post, it is yours.

text.title: 参加狩猎
text.objectives: 跟旅行者营地的马雷克·铁心谈一谈。
text.description: 嗯，你身手倒还真是不凡。$B$B要知道，东边的营地里也有几个猎人模样的家伙，就在山上——他们或许对你的胃口。为什么不去造访一下他们，看看他们是不是有什么你或许感兴趣的工作呢？
text.completion: Hello there, $G laddy:lass;! The mountaineers sent you over, eh? I do suspect we might have just the sort of work you're looking for. Welcome to the Farstrider Lodge!

english.title: Joining the Hunt
english.objectives: Speak to Marek Ironheart at the Farstrider Lodge.
english.description: Well, you definitely have some fight in you.$B$BYou know, there are some hunter types at the lodge east of here, up in the hills - they might be right up your alley. Why don't you go pay them a visit and see if they have any work that you might be interested in?
english.completion: Hello there, $G laddy:lass;! The mountaineers sent you over, eh? I do suspect we might have just the sort of work you're looking for. Welcome to the Farstrider Lodge!

text.title: 通缉：黑铁间谍
text.objectives: 击败葛瑞克·豪饮。
text.description: 一名黑铁矮人间谍混进镇子里，偷走了探险者协会的文件。此人如今就藏身在附近。最后一次有人目击到他，是在镇子南边的山顶上。$B$B任何人，只要能将此间谍绳之以法，将大大有赏。无论死活——死的尤佳。
text.completion: You brought that damned spy to justice! This is good news. We can all rest a little bit easier, not worrying about that one.
text.completed: Return to Magistrate Bluntnose at Thelsamar in Loch Modan.
text.giverWindow: 去找到并干掉这个蠢货！

english.title: WANTED: The Dark Iron Spy
english.objectives: Slay Gorick Guzzledraught.
english.description: A dark iron spy has infiltrated the town, stolen documents from the Explorers' League establishment, and is now in hiding somewhere nearby. He was last sighted near the top of the hill to the south of town.$B$BA sizable reward awaits anyone who can bring this spy to justice. Dead or alive - dead preferred.
english.completion: You brought that damned spy to justice! This is good news. We can all rest a little bit easier, not worrying about that one.
english.completed: Return to Magistrate Bluntnose at Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

text.title: Justin's Fun Test
text.objectives: Use the Complimentary Brewfest Sampler to hit S.T.O.U.T. 5 times, then talk to Boxey Boltspinner.
text.description: Hey there!  You look like you can handle your brew.  But can you handle your brew mug? $b$bThe Dark Irons have come back with a vengeance to ruin our celebration.  Tossing mugs at them is the best way to stop them, but first, let's see if you can toss one at old S.T.O.U.T. here.$b$bIt's easy, pick up a complimentary sampler and take a drink.  Just make sure you're facing S.T.O.U.T.  Talk to me after you've hit him 5 times.
text.completed: Return to [PH] Justin's Test NPC.

english.title: Justin's Fun Test
english.objectives: Use the Complimentary Brewfest Sampler to hit S.T.O.U.T. 5 times, then talk to Boxey Boltspinner.
english.description: Hey there!  You look like you can handle your brew.  But can you handle your brew mug? $b$bThe Dark Irons have come back with a vengeance to ruin our celebration.  Tossing mugs at them is the best way to stop them, but first, let's see if you can toss one at old S.T.O.U.T. here.$b$bIt's easy, pick up a complimentary sampler and take a drink.  Just make sure you're facing S.T.O.U.T.  Talk to me after you've hit him 5 times.
english.completed: Return to [PH] Justin's Test NPC.

text.title: 把你的脏手拿开！
text.objectives: 检查颠倒的巨人、盛装的妇女，以及破碎的石板神器。
text.description: 我们在这个挖掘场出土了一些了不起的神器。我还不太敢相信这些都是真品，但它们的历史价值一定非常惊人。$B$B不幸的是，当穴居人侵占这个挖掘场的时候，我们丢失了3件迄今为止最为重要的文物。我相信一定是穴居人趁我们不在的时候把它们偷走，玷污了它们。$B$B如果你去挖掘场的话，找到颠倒的巨人、盛装的妇女，以及破碎的石板，确保它们还完好无损。
text.completion: Woo! I'm relieved... I was worried they'd all be destroyed by now. Thank you for checking in on them.
text.completed: Return to Prospector Ironband at Ironband's Excavation in Loch Modan.

english.title: Keep Your Hands Off The Goods!
english.objectives: Inspect the Upturned Giant Artifact, the Overdressed Woman Artifact, and the Broken Tablet Artifact.
english.description: We've uncovered some incredible artifacts at this site. It's hard to be convinced that it's all authentic, but there could be serious historical potential.$B$BUnfortunately, when the troggs overran the site, we lost access to three of our most notable finds to date. I'm concerned that the troggs might have stolen them or defiled them in our absence.$B$BIf you go into the excavation, find the Upturned Giant, the Overdressed Woman, and the Broken Tablet, and make sure they're still intact.
english.completion: Woo! I'm relieved... I was worried they'd all be destroyed by now. Thank you for checking in on them.
english.completed: Return to Prospector Ironband at Ironband's Excavation in Loch Modan.

text.title: 需要一点润滑
text.objectives: 战歌劳工营地的戈尔卡要你从腐烂的泥浆怪身上获得5份自然之油。
text.description: 你的木头也拿到了，但精灵日益逼近，你的科多兽看来是没法回到莫尔杉农场了。$b$b我已经派传令兵前往碎木岗哨搬救兵了，他们的部队应该要不了多久就能把路给清出来。$b$b与此同时，我想让你给我们帮个忙。咱们的伐木机已经锈得不能用了，来点润滑油的话，它们就可以焕然一新。$b$b北边腐烂的泥浆怪身上的油应该就可以。
text.progress: Were you able to collect the oil we need, $C?
text.completion: Thank you for the oil, $C. Now prepare yourself!$B$BMy runner has returned with some desperate news....$B$BSplintertree is surrounded!
text.completed: Speak to Gorka at Warsong Lumber Camp.

english.title: Needs a Little Lubrication
english.objectives: Gorka at Warsong Labor Camp wants you to collect 5 Natural Oil from the Rotting Slimes in Ashenvale.
english.description: You have your wood, but the encroaching elves have made it impossible for your kodo to return to Mor'shan Ramparts.$b$bI've dispatched a runner to Splintertree to summon aid. It shouldn't take long for their forces to clear the way.$b$bIn the meantime, I would ask that you do us a service. Rust has rendered our shredders inoperable. A little lubrication and they'll be as good as new.$b$bThe oil from the rotting slimes just north of here should work just fine.
english.progress: Were you able to collect the oil we need, $C?
english.completion: Thank you for the oil, $C. Now prepare yourself!$B$BMy runner has returned with some desperate news....$B$BSplintertree is surrounded!
english.completed: Speak to Gorka at Warsong Lumber Camp.

text.title: Defense of the Stonewrought Dam
text.objectives: Seek out Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII at the Stonewrought Dam.
text.description: We appreciate all of your help. We'll regain control of the excavation with a little bit of time, I'm just glad to know that all of our work wasn't destroyed in the process of this occupation.$B$BWe've been greedy enough with your time. I have a friend who could really use some of your help if you have any to lend. Go to the far side of the Loch and you'll find Stonewrought Dam. Once you're there, seek out Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII.

enders.name: 主工程师辛德维尔七世

text.title: 碎木的危机
text.objectives: 戈尔卡要你陪她前往莫尔杉农场去找卡德拉克。$b$b准备好出发的话就跟她谈一谈。
text.description: 碎木岗哨的援军没法来了。$b$b精灵的部队对我们的要塞展开了猛攻，把那里完全包围了！$b$b就算是死，我们也要警告卡德拉克！$b$b你要的木头已经装在科多兽上，准备好了就告诉我，我们将对敌方阵线展开冲锋。
text.completion: Gorka...$B$BWe must always be prepared for losses. Her honorable service to the Horde will not be forgotten.$B$BAnd her sacrifice shall not be in vain!
text.completed: Report to Kadrak at the Mor'shan Ramparts.

english.title: Crisis at Splintertree
english.objectives: Gorka wants you to accompany her to Mor'shan Ramparts and report to Kadrak.$b$bSpeak to her when you are ready to depart.
english.description: There will be no help coming from Splintertree.$b$bThe elves have launched a major assault on our stronghold there and they have the place surrounded!$b$bWe must inform Kadrak or die trying!$b$bYour kodo has been loaded up with the wood you collected. Let me know when you're ready and we'll charge the enemy lines.
english.completion: Gorka...$B$BWe must always be prepared for losses. Her honorable service to the Horde will not be forgotten.$B$BAnd her sacrifice shall not be in vain!
english.completed: Report to Kadrak at the Mor'shan Ramparts.

objectiveDetails.description: 陪伴戈尔卡前往莫尔杉农场

text.title: 怪异的侍从
text.objectives: 从一个骷髅伐木工身上取下一根大腿骨，用它打昏玛洛里克。在玛洛里克身上搜查一番，找到证据后向银色比武场的北伐军战士莱达拉报告。
text.description: 每天，黑骑士的侍从玛洛里克都会扛着斧子，大摇大摆地离开营地，前往晶歌森林。他必然是想让我们相信他是出去砍柴了，但每次他都只带回几根小树枝。$B$B他经常到暮色之镜西南方的废墟去。也许他的骑士领主的确是让他去办什么事情，但即使如此，他在那里待的时间也太长了些。$B$B想点什么办法吸引他的注意力，或者把他打昏，然后搜搜他身上的东西。如果他真的在打什么鬼主意，我们可不能蒙在鼓里。
text.progress: Did the squire's behavior yield any clues?
text.completion: <Crusader Rhydalla examines the bag's contents with a look of disgust on her face.>$B$BIt's all here, $N: the poison that killed Lorien, a collection of knives, torches, and oil. No man has cause to possess these things here and no squire would do so without orders from his knightly master. We've found our murderer, $N, but who is he working for?
text.completed: Return to Crusader Rhydalla at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: There's Something About the Squire
english.objectives: Obtain a Large Femur from a Skeletal Woodcutter and use it to incapacitate Maloric. Search Maloric for evidence, then report back to Crusader Rhydalla at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Every day, the Black Knight's squire, Maloric, makes a big show of heading to Crystalsong Forest with his axe over his shoulder. He wants us to believe he's chopping wood, but he never returns with more than a few twigs.$B$BHe usually goes toward the ruins southwest of the Mirror of Twilight. He spends a lot of time out there, even for a squire with responsibilities to his knight.$B$BFind a way to distract or incapacitate him and search him. If he's up to something, we'll know it.
english.progress: Did the squire's behavior yield any clues?
english.completion: <Crusader Rhydalla examines the bag's contents with a look of disgust on her face.>$B$BIt's all here, $N: the poison that killed Lorien, a collection of knives, torches, and oil. No man has cause to possess these things here and no squire would do so without orders from his knightly master. We've found our murderer, $N, but who is he working for?
english.completed: Return to Crusader Rhydalla at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 探险者协会的文件（2/6）
text.objectives: 将探险者协会的文件交给塞尔萨玛的托瑞恩·方颔。
text.description: 这份文件上盖着探险者协会的徽记，上面详细记载了洛克莫丹地区有发掘价值的挖掘点。根据文件上的煤黑色污迹推断，你认为是黑铁矮人间谍偷走了这些文件。$B$B你想起来，在塞尔萨玛的探险者协会的房间里听人提起过，他们有一些文件丢失了。
text.completion: Well look at that. You found one of our stolen documents!$B$BWe're much obliged for its return. Hopefully a bit of gold will suit your fancy for the finder's fee?

english.title: Explorers' League Document (2 of 6)
english.objectives: Return the Explorers' League Document to Torren Squarejaw in Thelsamar.
english.description: The document bears the Explorers' League crest and seems to detail potential dig sites in Loch Modan. Sooty smudges lead you to believe it was likely stolen by the Dark Iron spies in the area.$B$BYou recall mention of missing documents at the Explorers' League building in Thelsamar.
english.completion: Well look at that. You found one of our stolen documents!$B$BWe're much obliged for its return. Hopefully a bit of gold will suit your fancy for the finder's fee?

text.title: 探险者协会的文件（1/6）
text.objectives: 将探险者协会的文件交给塞尔萨玛的托瑞恩·方颔。
text.description: 这份文件上盖着探险者协会的徽记，上面详细记载了大量洛克莫丹当地生物的资料。根据文件上的煤黑色污迹推断，你认为是黑铁矮人间谍偷走了这些文件。$B$B你想起来，在塞尔萨玛的探险者协会的房间里听人提起过，他们有一些文件丢失了。
text.completion: Hello, $G sonny:lass;! You seem to have found one of our stolen documents, eh?$B$BThank you kindly for bringing it back to us. We'll gladly lend some coin as thanks for its return.

english.title: Explorers' League Document (1 of 6)
english.objectives: Return the Explorers' League Document to Torren Squarejaw in Thelsamar.
english.description: The document bears the Explorers' League crest and contains extensive information on the indigenous creatures of Loch Modan. Sooty smudges lead you to believe it was likely stolen by the Dark Iron spies in the area.$B$BYou recall mention of missing documents at the Explorers' League building in Thelsamar.
english.completion: Hello, $G sonny:lass;! You seem to have found one of our stolen documents, eh?$B$BThank you kindly for bringing it back to us. We'll gladly lend some coin as thanks for its return.

text.title: 探险者协会的文件（3/6）
text.objectives: 将探险者协会的文件交给塞尔萨玛的托瑞恩·方颔。
text.description: 这份文件上盖着探险者协会的徽记，上面记载了洛克莫丹地区所有重要地点的历史资料。根据文件上的煤黑色污迹推断，你认为是黑铁矮人间谍偷走了这些文件。$B$B你想起来，在塞尔萨玛的探险者协会的房间里听人提起过，他们有一些文件丢失了。
text.completion: Our historical records! The thought of dark iron vermin delving into our past just made me sick to my stomach.$B$BWe appreciate you bringing this back to us. We'd like to offer you some coin as a reward.

english.title: Explorers' League Document (3 of 6)
english.objectives: Return the Explorers' League Document to Torren Squarejaw in Thelsamar.
english.description: The document bears the Explorers' League crest and contains historical records for all the notable locations in Loch Modan. Sooty smudges lead you to believe it was likely stolen by the Dark Iron spies in the area.$B$BYou recall mention of missing documents at the Explorers' League building in Thelsamar.
english.completion: Our historical records! The thought of dark iron vermin delving into our past just made me sick to my stomach.$B$BWe appreciate you bringing this back to us. We'd like to offer you some coin as a reward.

text.title: 探险者协会的文件（4/6）
text.objectives: 将探险者协会的文件交给塞尔萨玛的托瑞恩·方颔。
text.description: 这份文件上盖着探险者协会的徽记，上面详细记载了协会进出洛克莫丹的交通路线。根据文件上的煤黑色污迹推断，你认为是黑铁矮人间谍偷走了这些文件。$B$B你想起来，在塞尔萨玛的探险者协会的房间里听人提起过，他们有一些文件丢失了。
text.completion: Ug, I can't believe they got their hands on our transport routes - that was just asking for trouble!!$B$BThank you for getting this back to us before they were able to do much with it! You probably saved us a lot of heartache. Please accept some coin as a reward for your efforts.

english.description: The document bears the Explorers' League crest and seems to detail transport routes utilized by the league into and out of Loch Modan. Sooty smudges lead you to believe it was likely stolen by the Dark Iron spies in the area.$B$BYou recall mention of missing documents at the Explorers' League building in Thelsamar.

text.objectives: 将探险者协会的文件交给塞尔萨玛的托瑞恩·方颔。
text.description: 这份文件上盖着探险者协会的徽记，上面详细记载了对于洛克莫丹境内各种威胁的风险评估。根据文件上的煤黑色污迹推断，你认为是黑铁矮人间谍偷走了这些文件。$B$B你想起来，在塞尔萨玛的探险者协会的房间里听人提起过，他们有一些文件丢失了。
text.completion: Hah! Think they got a kick out of seeing how low they were on our list of threat assessments! This document was admittedly a bit out of date, but none the less amusing.$B$BOf course, we'll offer you some money as a reward for returning this anyway - your efforts are appreciated!

english.description: The document bears the Explorers' League crest and contains detailed assessments of the various threats present within Loch Modan. Sooty smudges lead you to believe it was likely stolen by the Dark Iron spies in the area.$B$BYou recall mention of missing documents at the Explorers' League building in Thelsamar.

text.objectives: 将探险者协会的文件交给塞尔萨玛的托瑞恩·方颔。
text.description: 这份文件上盖着探险者协会的徽记，上面记载了铁环挖掘队在洛克莫丹东南部发掘出土的各种文物的清单。根据文件上的煤黑色污迹推断，你认为是黑铁矮人间谍偷走了这些文件。$B$B你想起来，在塞尔萨玛的探险者协会的房间里听人提起过，他们有一些文件丢失了。
text.completion: Our artifact records! I was pretty well worried what the dark irons might try to steal with this information at their disposal.$B$BThank you for bringing this back to us. We'll gladly part with some coin to express our gratitude.

english.title: Explorers' League Document (5 of 6)
english.objectives: Return the Explorers' League Document to Torren Squarejaw in Thelsamar.
english.description: The document bears the Explorers' League crest and contains a detailed list of the artifacts excavated by Ironband's workers in southeastern Loch Modan. Sooty smudges lead you to believe it was likely stolen by the Dark Iron spies in the area.$B$BYou recall mention of missing documents at the Explorers' League building in Thelsamar.
english.completion: Our artifact records! I was pretty well worried what the dark irons might try to steal with this information at their disposal.$B$BThank you for bringing this back to us. We'll gladly part with some coin to express our gratitude.

text.title: 衷心的感谢
text.description: 你找到了我们所有的文件！我们不知道怎么感谢你才好……如果黑铁矮人依照这些情报行事，那我们就只能放弃一切希望了。真高兴知道他们现在有好一阵子只能盲目攻击。$B$B为了感谢你替我们所做的一切，我们将赠送你一件礼物。事实上是一件神器……从我们的一个挖掘场里出土的。探险者协会全体感谢你。
text.completion: You located all of our documents! We can't thank you enough for the help... we'd all but given up hope. It seemed sure that the dark irons would be able to act upon all of this information soon. It's good to know that they'll be left blind in their attacks for quite a while yet.$B$BTo thank you for all of your efforts on our behalf, we would like to offer you a gift. An artifact really... something we recovered from one of our digs. You have the appreciation of all of the Explorers' League.

english.title: Heartfelt Appreciation
english.description: You located all of our documents! We can't think you enough for the help... we'd all but given up hope that the dark irons would be able to act upon all of this information soon. It's good to know that they'll be left blind in their attacks for quite a while yet.$B$BTo thank you for all of your efforts on our behalf, we would like to offer you a gift. An artifact really... something we recovered from one of our digs. You have the appreciation of all of the Explorers' League.

An artifact really... something we recovered from one of our digs. You have the appreciation of all of the Explorers' League.

text.title: 获得信任
text.progress: You've worked your way up through the Brotherhood's corporate hierarchy, $r. We have begun to look favorably upon you. Quite an accomplishment!$B$BIf you're interested in more work and earning more respect amongst us, listen up.$B$BWe can refine our fiery flux by adding a simple Dark Iron residue to the mix. This Dark Iron residue can be found in Blackrock Depths.$B$BBring me all the Dark Iron residue you find!
text.completion: Keep the residue pouring in!
